ashby:1password:b141ee0c-30aa-42f8-8ff7-.description:
1Password is growing. We’ve surpassed $400M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.



About 1Password

At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.



If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.



As a Principal Solutions Engineer, Acceleration, you’ll help define how 1Password brings emerging technologies to market. Working across Product Management, Product Marketing, Enablement, Engineering, Sales, Customer Success, and strategic customers, you’ll validate new capabilities, shape product direction through field feedback, and turn what works into repeatable customer-facing motions.



Your work will help customers adopt innovations that strengthen secure access for people, machines, and artificial intelligence (AI) agents while advancing 1Password’s mission to make secure access simpler. Reporting to the Vice President, Global Solutions Engineering, this remote role is open to candidates in the United States or Canada and may involve up to 30% travel.



How we’re using AI today

Across GTM, we’re transforming the way we work with AI. We expect every seller, CSM, and team member to become a power user, using it daily to work smarter and move faster. AI is already embedded in how we operate – from real-time coaching that sharpens how we sell and interact with customers, to surfacing insights that help us anticipate needs – creating more time for meaningful customer engagement. If you’re excited to reshape how you think, make decisions, and drive growth with AI, you’ll feel right at home here.



This is a remote opportunity within Canada and the US.



Note: All go-to market roles will have an in-person onboarding in Toronto.



What we're looking for:

 - 8+ years of experience in customer-facing technical roles within enterprise Business-to-Business Software as a Service (B2B SaaS), including leading initiatives beyond an individual sales territory.

 - A track record of translating emerging technologies into customer value, repeatable field motions, and clear recommendations that shape product or go-to-market direction.

 - Experience partnering effectively with Product Management, Engineering, Product Marketing, and other cross-functional teams to validate capabilities and incorporate customer feedback.

 - Strong executive communication, storytelling, and presentation skills, with the ability to influence audiences ranging from technical practitioners to senior executives, analysts, and strategic partners.

 - Deep knowledge of modern identity architectures and developer or AI-powered workflows, including Open Authorization (OAuth), OpenID Connect (OIDC), System for Cross-domain Identity Management (SCIM), application programming interfaces (APIs), Model Context Protocol (MCP), continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), infrastructure automation, AI agents, and modern cloud platforms.

 - Experience with Metrics, Economic Buyer, Decision Criteria, Decision Process, Paper Process, Identify Pain, Champion, and Competition (MEDDPICC), or a similar enterprise sales methodology, along with the ability to work autonomously and influence without direct authority.





Bonus points for:

 - Experience with private previews, beta programs, or early-stage products; technical enablement and customer-facing content; or domains such as Artificial Intelligence Security (AI Security), Developer Security, Privileged Access, Software as a Service (SaaS) Manager, or Unified Access Management is preferred. 

 - A track record of public speaking, technical writing, podcasts, analyst engagements, or other forms of technical thought leadership is also valued.







What you can expect:

 - Lead technical validation for emerging products, strategic initiatives, and incubating technologies from early development through general availability.

 - Partner with Product Management, Product Marketing, and Engineering to shape product direction and turn field feedback into actionable recommendations.

 -  Build repeatable discovery frameworks, demonstrations, technical messaging, reference architectures, and implementation guidance for the global Solutions Engineering organization.

 - Design and deliver technical enablement, including workshops, labs, certifications, and playbooks that help Solutions Engineers confidently support new capabilities.

 - Lead strategic customer engagements, private previews, beta programs, and early-adopter initiatives, providing executive-level technical guidance and influencing customer outcomes.

 - Identify emerging market opportunities and represent 1Password through executive briefings, conferences, webinars, podcasts, customer events, and industry content.

 - Mentor Solutions Engineers and lead cross-functional initiatives that accelerate adoption, strengthen technical excellence, and scale what works across the organization.
   
   



USA-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $171,000 USD and $248,000 USD, and is commission-eligible. This role is also eligible for immediate participation in 1Password's benefits program (health, dental, 401k and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.



Canada-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $170,000 CAD and $247,000 CAD, and is commission-eligible. This role is also eligible for immediate participation in 1Password’s generous benefits program (health, dental, RRSP and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.



At 1Password, we approach each individual's compensation with a promise of fair market value and internal equity commensurate with experience and specific skill set.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.



Our culture 
At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first. 

You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, 1Password is not for everyone https://blog.1password.com/inside-the-culture-powering-1passwords-next-chapter/. Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results. 

How we work with AI
We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged—it's an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password.



This approach extends to our hiring process—candidates are welcome to use AI tools responsibly and thoughtfully during the application process. To us, this means we do ask that you join live interviews without using AI tools so we can get to know how you communicate, solve problems, and collaborate with others.


Our approach to work
We recognize the power of both in person collaboration and remote work. Some roles are designated as remote-first, with an expectation that individuals work from their homes majority of the time, while others are designated as in-office roles, with an expectation of being on-site on a regular basis. We recognize that certain roles benefit from regular, in-person connection to support collaboration, team cohesion, and customer engagement.

For all roles, occasional travel may be required. This includes things like: department-wide offsites, quarterly department meetings and periodic customer events. These events are typically held in varying locations across Canada, USA and/or EMEA. In leadership roles, you can expect to travel once per month on average.

Note: All go-to market roles will have an in-person onboarding in Toronto. 


What we offer
We believe in working hard, and rewarding that hard work through our benefits. While not an exhaustive list, here is a glance at what we currently offer: 

Health and wellbeing
👶 Maternity and parental leave top-up programs
🩺 Competitive health benefits
🏝 Generous PTO policy 

 Growth and future 
📈 RSU program for most employees
💸 Retirement matching program
🔑 Free 1Password account

Community 
🤝 Paid volunteer days 
🏆 Peer-to-peer recognition through Bonusly
🌎 Remote-first work environment
*Some roles in our GTM team are currently being hired for in-person hybrid work in Toronto and Austin. These roles will specify on the posting.



You belong here.



1Password is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse and equitable workplace that is built on trust, support and respect. We welcome all individuals and do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity and expression, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, colour, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, marital status, pregnancy, sex, citizenship, education, languages spoken or veteran status. Be yourself, find your people and share the things you love.



Accommodation is available upon request at any point during our recruitment process. If you require an accommodation, please speak to your talent acquisition partner or email us at nextbit@agilebits.com and we’ll work to meet your needs.



Remote work is a part of our DNA. Given that our company was founded remotely in 2005, we can safely say we're experts at building remote culture. That said, remote work at 1Password does mean working from your home country. If you've got questions or concerns about this, your talent partner would be happy to address them with you.



Successful applicants will be required to complete a background check that may consist of prior employment verification, reference checks, education confirmation, criminal background, publicly available social media, credit history, or other information, as permitted by local law.

With over 180,000 business customers, Enterprise Password Manager is 1Password's core product. It is rapidly evolving into a complete credentials security platform for humans, machines, and AI agents.

This is a Senior Staff PMM role. Individual contributor with broad organizational visibility. You’ll report to the Director of Product Marketing and own EPM end-to-end: messaging, positioning, competitive strategy, and launch execution.

You will shape how the market understands credentials security as 1Password grows.



How we’re using AI today
On the Marketing team, we’re growing our AI capability together and redesigning how work gets done. We’ve built agents to improve workflows focused on competitive intelligence, content creation, and campaign planning, helping us stay sharp, reduce context-switching, and surface the right information at the right time. AI helps us coordinate, execute, and uncover insights faster so we can spend more time on what’s most important: performance, judgement, and driving the future of 1Password.



This is a remote opportunity within Canada and the US.



What we're looking for:

Experience and Domain Expertise

 - 7+ years of B2B SaaS product marketing, with direct experience in password management, enterprise vaulting, credentials security, or identity security.

 - Working knowledge of broad cybersecurity concepts.

 - You've repositioned a mature enterprise product. You know the difference between a messaging refresh and actually shifting how the market thinks about something.

 - You can market to enterprise IT and security buyers: the admin managing rollout, the CISO approving the spend, and the security engineer evaluating the technical depth.

 - A track record of winning in competitive markets by displacing incumbents, not just differentiating in an open field.

Technical Depth

 - You understand how credentials work beyond passwords: API keys, certificates, machine secrets, passkeys, and what it takes to issue credentials to AI agents.

 - Working knowledge of enterprise IT: MDM, SSO, directory services, and where password management fits in the IAM stack.

AI-Forward, Not AI-Dependent

 - You use AI to go faster, not to think less. You know what to hand off and what to own, and you can tell good output from output that still needs work.

 - You want AI to free up time for the work only a good product marketer can do: strategy, judgment, and narrative.

 - You own the ideas you bring. Walk into a room with a recommendation and you can defend it. Candidates who produce content but can’t explain the thinking behind it won’t fit here.

Strategic Storytelling and Senior-Level Communication

 - You write for multiple audiences without diluting the message. An IT admin and a CISO aren't reading the same document for the same reason. You know how to serve both.

 - Strong narrative instincts: open with the problem, build to the solution, and land in a way that makes the reader feel the product was built for their situation.

 - You’ve shaped category narratives, not just contributed to them.



Bonus points for:

 - Security certifications (CISSP, Security+, or similar).

 - Experience developing thought leadership in a fast-moving category. 1Password has a team that produces content. This role provides the point of view.

 - You've repositioned an established product category. There's a real difference between entering a space and redefining it.



What you can expect:

Own EPM Product Marketing

 - Own messaging, positioning, and launch strategy for the Enterprise Password Manager.

 - Define how 1Password talks about credentials security for employees, service accounts, and AI agents.

 - Tell the story clearly to analysts, IT buyers, security leaders, and sellers. The narrative has to work for practitioners and executives.

 - Connect EPM’s story to the Unified Access platform narrative.

Build Competitive Intelligence and Category Positioning

 - Own positioning and market leadership claims for EPM.

 - Partner with Solutions Marketing on competitive differentiation. Know the competitive set cold: where they’re strong, where they’re not, and how to win against each.

 - Track where the credentials security market is moving and keep 1Password’s messaging ahead of it.

Enable the Field with Tools That Actually Get Used

 - Produce discovery decks, battlecards, objection-handling guides, and technical briefs that sellers and SEs reach for because they work.

 - Take complex concepts like passkeys, machine credential lifecycle, AI agent authentication, and zero-knowledge architecture and make them usable in a customer conversation.

 - Surface win/loss signals from the field and turn them into repeatable GTM motions, not one-off documents.

Influence EPM Product Strategy

 - Bring the market's perspective to Product: customer evidence, analyst intelligence, competitive signals, field feedback.

 - Make the market case early, before decisions are locked.
   
   

Why join us:

 - The credentials security market is being reshaped by machine identities and AI agents. You'll own how 1Password tells that story.

 - You'll work across product strategy, competitive positioning, and field execution. The work is visible at the executive level.

 - 1Password is remote-first and has been since day one. We hire for judgment, not proximity.

 - The company is growing and there's room to shape how PMM works here, not just execute what's already been defined.

As Senior Staff Product Manager, Device Security, you’ll define the strategy and roadmap for the device security capabilities that help organizations understand, control, and govern access across their environments. You’ll work at the intersection of device health, identity, access management, and Artificial Intelligence (AI), helping customers reduce security risk while building a more unified experience across people, machines, and AI agents.

You’ll partner with Engineering, Design, and Go To Market (GTM) teams to turn complex security challenges into products that are clear, useful, and measurable. Reporting to the Director, Product Management – Device Security, this is a remote role open to candidates in the United States or Canada.



How we’re using AI today

Our Engineering, Product, and Design teams are thoughtfully integrating AI across the full software and product development lifecycle to move faster without sacrificing quality or security. In practice, that looks like engineers using AI-assisted coding tools to accelerate reviews and catch bugs earlier, product managers synthesizing user research at scale, and designers rapidly prototyping and iterating with AI-generated mockups. We approach AI the same way we approach security: with clear principles, human accountability at every consequential decision point, and rigorous evaluation before anything ships to customers.



This is a remote opportunity within Canada and the US.



What we're looking for:

Required qualifications

• 8+ years of Product Management experience, including ownership of security, Identity and Access Management (IAM), endpoint, or access-control products.

• A track record of defining and delivering roadmaps for complex, cross-functional initiatives in a Business-to-Business (B2B) Software as a Service (SaaS) environment.

• Experience contributing to product vision and strategy across multiple engineering teams or product areas.

• Strong written communication skills, with experience creating PRDs, PR/FAQs, and other artifacts that align teams and support decision-making.

• Experience defining Objectives and Key Results (OKRs), success metrics, and measurement frameworks connected to business outcomes.

• The ability to communicate complex security and product concepts clearly with technical and non-technical audiences, including senior customer stakeholders.

• A customer-centered approach to prioritization that combines qualitative insight with quantitative data.

Preferred qualifications

• Experience with endpoint security, device management, zero-trust, least-privilege architectures, or related security technologies.

• Familiarity with Mobile Device Management (MDM) or Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) tools.

• Experience working with enterprise administration consoles and IT buyer or administrator personas.

• Experience taking AI or machine-learning products from concept to initial launch.

• Experience prototyping with AI-enabled developer tools and curiosity about how AI agents operate.

• Familiarity with device compliance frameworks, endpoint telemetry platforms, or related security systems.



What you can expect:

Own and evolve the Device Security product roadmap, partnering with engineering leadership to define priorities and deliver key capabilities.

• Shape the role of Device Security within 1Password Unified Access and contribute to cross-company product strategy.

• Lead weekly, monthly, and quarterly prioritization, balancing near-term delivery with an 18–24 month product vision.

• Represent the customer perspective through discovery, feedback loops, recorded and live demos, and structured product artifacts such as Product Requirements Documents (PRDs) and Product Requirements/FAQs (PR/FAQs).

• Collaborate with Product Managers (PMs) across adjacent product areas, as well as Engineering, Design, Sales, Marketing, and Product Marketing.

• Establish success metrics that connect customer outcomes and Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) contribution to product progress.

• Engage directly with enterprise customers, including Chief Information Security Officers (CISOs), Vice Presidents of Security, and Information Technology (IT) leaders.

• Prototype proof-of-value solutions using AI-enabled developer tools to explore and communicate product ideas.

Security isn't a feature at 1Password. It is the product. We're looking for a Principal Product Manager to shape security strategy across the company, working with Security Engineering, who hold one of the highest technical bars in the industry, and with the product teams building everything our customers touch.


You'll be the bridge. You'll understand cryptographic and architectural detail well enough to earn the trust of our security engineers, and you'll translate what matters into clear priorities for feature teams. Just as importantly, you'll bring a deep respect for the customer: a security control nobody can stand to use makes everyone less safe. You'll help us find the design that's both rigorous and usable, and have the credibility to say so in a room full of experts



WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Partner with product teams on security early. Work with PMs and feature teams to understand their upcoming roadmaps, identify security requirements and threat-model implications before designs are locked, and make sure those needs are visible, prioritized, and resourced.

 - Align Security Engineering with product strategy. Translate feature-team needs into prioritized security work, and make Security Engineering's priorities legible to the rest of the company so tradeoffs are made in the open.

 - Own an independent security roadmap. Set direction for platform-level security investments, such as key management and recovery, the cryptographic foundations of our zero-knowledge architecture, authentication, and our long-term readiness for post-quantum cryptography.

 - Lead our strategy for the AI era. Define how 1Password approaches agentic access to credentials, secrets for non-human identities and AI agents, and the trust models emerging around tools and protocols like MCP.

 - Balance risk and usability with evidence. Help security engineers weigh real-world risk against user friction, using adoption, support, and telemetry data alongside threat models. Shipping with accepted, documented residual risk is sometimes the right call, and you'll help us make and defend those decisions.

 - Represent 1Password to the security community. Engage with security researchers and our bug bounty program, speak at conferences, and contribute to the wider conversation about where credential security is heading.

 - Raise the bar for product work. Coach PMs on security thinking, challenge assumptions constructively, and set the standard for how security-critical product work gets done.




OUR PHILOSOPHY ON PRODUCT CONSISTS OF FIVE CORE PILLARS:



 - Focus and execution: Can you ship quickly and measure results?

 - Customer empathy: Are you motivated first and foremost to solve customer problems?

 - Effective communication: Can you bring the entire organization, horizontally and vertically, along on the journey?

 - Go to market: Can you understand and drive business outcomes through product decisions?

 - Technology: Articulating how our technology beats our competitors



Product Managers play a highly visible role at 1Password and are critical to the development and execution of our product strategy. As PMs, we are responsible for setting and championing a high bar for our products. At the Principal level, you also set the standard for how product work gets done. You coach, you challenge assumptions, and you make the whole team better. You must excel at prioritization, collaboration, and communication, while holding yourself and others accountable for measuring quality and business results. You will work with Engineering, Design, Security Research, and GTM teams to ensure every decision we make as a product is grounded in our commitment to verifiable security.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 10+ years of product management experience, including significant time on security-critical products or platforms in a SaaS environment. We'll also strongly consider exceptional candidates with equivalent depth, such as security engineers or researchers who moved into product.

 - Deep, demonstrable knowledge of security fundamentals: cryptography, authentication protocols, identity and access management, zero-knowledge and end-to-end encrypted system design, and threat modeling.

 - Fluency in the credential and identity landscape, including passkeys, WebAuthn/FIDO, and the standards shaping how people sign in.

 - A track record of earning credibility with security engineering teams, not just working alongside them.

 - The ability to read and reason through technical specifications, security audits, and cryptographic design documents.

 - Experience making and defending risk-based tradeoffs, and explaining them clearly to engineers, executives, and customers.

 - A history of shipping security features that users actually adopt, and of using friction and adoption data to improve them.

 - Experience setting strategy at the platform or infrastructure level, and influencing roadmaps you don't own without formal authority.

 - Communication that scales from a security research paper to an executive briefing without losing precision in either direction.

 - A strong point of view on how the security landscape is shifting, and the ability to connect it to concrete roadmap decisions.


STRONG PLUS

 - Standing in the security community, through conference talks, publications, research, open-source work, or standards participation.

 - Hands-on experience with AI security: agent identity and authorization, prompt injection, secrets management for automated systems.

 - Experience with compliance and certification regimes such as SOC 2, FedRAMP, or FIPS.

 - Prior work in vulnerability disclosure, incident response, or threat intelligence that gives you a practitioner's intuition.

 - Experience running or working closely with a bug bounty program or researcher community.




WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT

 - Working with a passionate, highly motivated Product and Security team that holds an exceptional bar and genuinely cares about getting it right

 - A direct line to decisions that shape the security architecture millions of people depend on every day

 - Empowerment to set long-term security product strategy and drive it through execution

 - A culture where technical depth is respected, tradeoffs are named honestly, and shipping the right thing matters more than shipping fast

 - A collaborative environment where the best argument wins, regardless of title

ashby:1password:8151254c-b7d1-4653-87b1-.description:
1Password is growing. We’ve surpassed $400M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.



About 1Password

At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.



If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.



Reporting to the Senior Director of Product, the Director of Product, AI Growth grows 1Password's new business in artificial intelligence. In this role, you own driving growth for our AI opportunities by identifying which customers we target, which outcomes we win on, and proving it with design customers. You scale growth through our go-to-market organization and through partnerships with the agent ecosystem and channel partners.



How we’re using AI today

Our Engineering, Product, and Design teams are thoughtfully integrating AI across the full software and product development lifecycle to move faster without sacrificing quality or security. In practice, that looks like engineers using AI-assisted coding tools to accelerate reviews and catch bugs earlier, product managers synthesizing user research at scale, and designers rapidly prototyping and iterating with AI-generated mockups. We approach AI the same way we approach security: with clear principles, human accountability at every consequential decision point, and rigorous evaluation before anything ships to customers.



This is a remote opportunity within Canada and the US.



What we're looking for:

 - Minimum of 8 years of product management experience, including experience carrying a revenue or adoption target, with a preference for experience in security products, agentic products, or developer tools.

 - Experience owning the strategy for a new product area or market entry, and taking it from hypothesis to customers running in production.

 - Experience working directly with enterprise customers on a technical deployment, as the person accountable for the outcome, and turning what those deployments proved into a repeatable motion a sales team can run.

 - Experience building technology partnerships and integrations, including judging where a product should sit in a larger technology ecosystem and working with business development on commercial terms.

 - Technical depth to hold a credible conversation with developers and security architects about how AI agents are built, deployed, and given access to systems.

 - Demonstrated ability to build alignment across go-to-market and engineering teams toward a shared goal, without direct authority over either.

 - Demonstrated ability to make decisions and move work forward with incomplete information in a fast-changing market.

 - Takes ownership end to end, including the work that falls between teams.

 - Works AI-first: uses agents in daily work, and applies their own judgement to decisions, product taste, and customer and internal relationships.

 - Preferred: familiarity with agentic access products, meaning the products that give AI agents credentials and access to the systems they work in.





What you can expect:



GROWTH STRATEGY

 - Own the growth thesis for 1Password's AI opportunities, covering the customer segments we target, the outcomes we deliver that we win on, and the workflows we get embedded into. Revise it as evidence arrives from customers, partners, and the market.

 - Form and test hypotheses using customer feedback, product usage data, partner input, and market research gathered with the go-to-market, product, user experience, and product marketing teams.

 - Lead a weekly business review that brings the voice of the customer, field feedback, and product usage telemetry into one view, so the team can refine targets, forecast the roadmap's impact on growth, and prioritize the blockers that hold adoption back.

 - Identify what stops customers from adopting, and drive each blocker to a resolution with the product team that owns it.


DESIGN CUSTOMER PROGRAM

 - Run the design customer program for new artificial intelligence opportunities, from selecting customers through to delivered outcomes.

 - Act as the general contractor for each design customer: the single person accountable for getting that customer deployed on 1Password for their agentic access, and for delivering the security and convenience outcomes they came for. Coordinate every team the deployment touches, and build what it requires together with a forward deployed engineering team.

 - Bring in solutions engineering, customer success, and product managers to help each customer reach their goal, and run feature betas with the product managers who own those features.

 - Turn what the program proves into the repeatable signal the company needs to scale, meaning the customer evidence, the deployment pattern, and the measured outcomes that the go-to-market and channel teams build sales plays on.

 - Improve the program each cycle so it reaches more design customers, raises delivery success rates and customer satisfaction, and shortens the time it takes the company to commercialize a new product.


PARTNERSHIPS

 - Decide where 1Password should play in the customer's artificial intelligence stack to deliver the most customer value in securing agent access. Agent access can be controlled at several points in that stack, so weigh those points and choose the ones that solve the most of the customer's problem, rather than the ones we fit into most easily. Base the call on how customers run AI today and on how the industry is evolving.

 - Identify and pursue the partnerships that let us play at those points and that complete an end-to-end customer outcome, meaning the outcome a customer cannot reach with 1Password alone.

 - Work with partners to deliver integrations, and find the patterns that let us repeat an integration across similar partners instead of building each one from scratch.

 - Work with the business development team to structure commercial relationships that grow both companies' business and deliver value to shared customers.


SCALE THROUGH THE FIELD AND THE DEVELOPER COMMUNITY

 - Work with product enablement to build demos and enablement content that the field and our channel partners can use without your involvement.

 - Work with developer relations to grow adoption organically among developers, through reference architectures, sample code, and open source contributions.


TRAVEL

 - Travel to design customer sites, partner meetings, and industry events approximately 10 to 20% of a given year.

 



USA-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $238,000 USD and $357,000 USD, plus immediate participation in 1Password's benefits program (health, dental, 401k and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.



Canada-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $208,000 CAD and $312,000 CAD, plus immediate participation in 1Password’s generous benefits program (health, dental, RRSP and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.



At 1Password, we approach each individual's compensation with a promise of fair market value and internal equity commensurate with experience and specific skill set.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.



Our culture 
At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first. 

You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, 1Password is not for everyone https://blog.1password.com/inside-the-culture-powering-1passwords-next-chapter/. Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results. 

How we work with AI
We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged—it's an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password.



This approach extends to our hiring process—candidates are welcome to use AI tools responsibly and thoughtfully during the application process. To us, this means we do ask that you join live interviews without using AI tools so we can get to know how you communicate, solve problems, and collaborate with others.

Our approach to remote work 
We believe in the power of remote work, but recognize that in-person connection is important to help us achieve our mission. While we are a remote-first company, travel for in-person engagement is a part of almost all roles, and we require our employees to be ready and willing to take part. Frequency will depend on role and responsibilities, and may include, but is not limited to: annual department-wide offsites, team meetings, and customer/industry events.

What we offer
We believe in working hard, and rewarding that hard work through our benefits. While not an exhaustive list, here is a glance at what we currently offer: 

Health and wellbeing

🩺 Competitive health benefits

 Growth and future

Community

🌎 Remote-first work environment

lever:achievers:33b4e5e0-f9ca-4ff6-972a-.description:
Achievers is an employee recognition and engagement platform, and our mission is to Change the Way the World Works. We help companies celebrate great work, build stronger cultures, and make sure people feel valued. Every day, our platform powers millions of recognition moments for global, multi-generational workforces.  We’re hiring a Senior Product Manager to lead the product behind our Milestone and Celebration experiences. This is the part of Achievers that recognizes work anniversaries, birthdays, and service milestones, the moments people tend to remember from their time at a company. You’ll work in a product triad with a Product Designer and a Lead Engineer, setting the roadmap and leading the work together. When the product works, a hard-earned anniversary or a quiet milestone gets noticed instead of slipping past. Millions of those moments run through what you would build.  Learn more about the domain here: https://www.achievers.com/platform/celebrate/ Why you`ll love this role::
  • Your work will change how millions of people feel about their jobs. Change the Way the World Works is the mission, and this product is one of the places you can watch it happen.
  • You’ll own product strategy for a core part of the platform, reporting to the Digital Product Director who leads our Member Experience portfolio.
  • You’ll work in a true product triad with a Product Designer and a Lead Engineer, sharing direction and delivery rather than handing off specs.
  • You`ll join a team that values empathy, ownership, and high standards, and gives you room to make decisions that matter.
  • You`ll thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment where innovation is encouraged and your voice truly matters.
    • How you'll shape our Milestone and Celebration experiences::
  • Set the roadmap and lead the work alongside your Product Designer and Lead Engineer, across web, mobile, and the channels we integrate with.
  • Understand the admins and program owners who run recognition and the employees who receive it, and turn what you learn into clear priorities.
  • Improve the automation that spots employee milestones and sends timely, personal celebrations without creating extra work for admins.
  • Keep the experience feeling personal and authentic rather than automated and generic.
  • Use data, research, and experimentation to guide decisions and measure impact, including participation, recipient response, on-time delivery, and engagement.
  • Work with enterprise customers and teams across Achievers to understand their programs, cultural norms, and configuration needs in different regions.
  • Make sure celebration experiences work at global scale, with localization, multiple languages, and culturally appropriate recognition across regions.
  • Mentor and coach other Product Managers, raising the standard of the work without managing anyone directly.
    • Experience we feel will set you up for success::
  • 5+ years of hand-on product management experience, shipping digital products end to end in SaaS or B2B2C.
  • Advanced experience in a product triad, or close partnership with Design and Engineering with shared ownership of strategy and delivery.
  • Comfort using data, research, and experimentation to decide what to build and to measure results.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to align people without relying on authority.
  • A strong interest in building products that people enjoy using.

    • Advantageous but not required

  • Experience in employee experience, engagement, HR tech, or recognition platforms.
  • Experience with automated or triggered experiences, personalization, or messaging and notifications.
  • Familiarity with HRIS integrations such as Workday or SuccessFactors.
  • Comfort with SQL or BI tools for exploring engagement and sentiment data.
  • Interest in applying new technology and AI to improve product experiences.

greenhouse:ada18:5232334007.description:
About Us 

 Ada is an AI customer service company whose mission is to make customer service extraordinary for everyone. We're driven to raise a new standard of quality customer service at scale, enabling enterprise companies to deliver experiences that people love–instant, proactive, personalized, and effortless.

 Ada is an AI transformation platform and partner—combining strategic expertise with powerful AI agent management technology to accelerate businesses’ AI maturity to keep them ahead of the curve. With Ada, 83% of customer conversations—and counting—are effortlessly resolved through automation, giving teams more time back, companies more resources to focus on growth, and customers more life to focus on what matters most to them.

 Established in 2016, Ada is a Canadian company that has powered over 5.5 billion interactions for leading brands like Square, YETI, IPSY, and Monday.com , saving millions of hours of human effort. Backed with over $250M in funding from tier-one investors including Accel, Bessemer, FirstMark, Spark, and Version One Ventures, Ada is a pioneer in the management and application of AI in customer service.

 At Ada, we see growth as a reflection of each individual owner’s personal growth. That’s why our values are rooted in driving progress and continuous improvement. If you’re ambitious and eager to grow, Ada could be the place for you.

 Learn more at  www.ada.cx .

 Ada Accelerate is Ada’s Customer Success program for 1:many support, targeted interventions, and data-driven insights to grow and retain SMB/MME customers at scale. We’re looking for a Customer Solutions Consultant to support the activation, growth, and retention of our self-service customers. Your focus will be on ensuring alignment with the customer's goals after implementation and ensuring they derive value from our platform and services, with an eye toward self-service capabilities. You’ll be responsible for prioritizing and managing a scaled book of business by driving relationship value through proactive and reactive customer engagement.

 As a Customer Solutions Consultant  you will:

- Provide customer success and support to Ada’s SMB and MME customers through resolving customer inquiries, advising with AI expertise, and ensuring optimal value realization of the platform.

- Leverage internal tools, utilizing AI and automations to support surfacing actionable customer insights at scale.

- Design and execute automated and human-touch strategies (e.g., proactive touchpoints, demos, renewal discussions, strategy sessions) that drive revenue and retention.

- Collaborate across Professional Services, Customer Solutions, Sales, Revenue Operations, Data Analytics, Product, and Marketing to align resources, share insights, and drive towards common goals.

 Outcomes 

- Handle escalated customer success inquiries and requests to the Accelerate ticket queue, providing additional support where needed and facilitating syncs as required.

- Identify at-risk customers and implement personalized engagement strategies to improve retention and satisfaction.

- Host ad-hoc meetings for customers, providing Q&A and live support at scale.

- Drive adoption and utilization of the platform with a focus on increasing automated resolutions for existing customers.

- Collaborate with Product Management, Engineering, and Marketing to continuously provide feedback and improve Ada’s products and marketing.

- Proactively engages with new customers, projects, and internal teams, ensuring continuous alignment and staying ahead of emerging needs and opportunities.

 About You 

- 2+ years of Customer Success, and/or strategy, management, implementation, technology consulting experience, ideally in a scaled CS model.

- Working knowledge of APIs and a common understanding of SaaS platforms (e.g. Shopify, Salesforce, Zendesk, Hubspot, etc.)

- Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to effectively explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences.

- Strong interpersonal skills as you will be required to engage with technical and non-technical champions across the table.

- Experience building relationships with senior stakeholders is a plus.

- Technically and analytically curious, where you demonstrate the ability to be a perpetual learner and love to make new discoveries and improve the status quo.

- Resourceful and tenacious, able to thrive in ambiguity and guide/inform decisions with data-driven insights.

- Reliable and resilient team player with a start-up mentality able to deliver on your commitments whilst managing multiple competing priorities in a fast-paced constantly-changing environment.

 Benefits & Perks 

 At Ada, you’ll not only build extraordinary products but also thrive in an environment designed for your success. We prioritize your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Here’s what we offer:

 Benefits 

- Unlimited Vacation: Recharge when you need to.

- Comprehensive Benefits: Extended health coverage, dental, vision, travel, and life insurance.

- Wellness Account: Empowering you to invest in your overall well-being and lifestyle.

- Employee & Family Assistance Plan: Resources to support you and your loved ones.

 Perks 

- Flexible Work Schedule: Balance your work and personal life.

- Remote-First, In-Person Friendly: Options to work from home or at our local hub.

At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

 Consumers across the globe need safe, transparent financing while merchants want to provide users with their preferred way to pay and convert more buyers. To help achieve this vision, we are hiring a Senior Product Manager for our 1:Many Growth team.

 Affirm's Distribution Partnerships program - internally called " 1:Many " - is one of the highest-leverage growth levers at the company. Instead of integrating merchant by merchant, we integrate once into a platform merchants already use, and every merchant on that platform becomes reachable through that single integration. This role is responsible for:

- 
 Own and grow Affirm's partner portfolio  - making it easier and more frictionless for merchants to onboard and offer Affirm as a payment method to their customers. This includes taking product ownership of Affirm's existing vertical software partnerships, and growing the broader portfolio of platform partners still being stood up.

- 
 Partner Acceleration Strategy  - building the durable capabilities that make every future partner integration faster to launch and easier to scale, rather than solving the same problem one partner at a time.

 As a Senior Product Manager, you will work closely with cross-functional teams including commercial, merchant risk, design, product analytics, and engineering to define, launch and grow integrations with platform partners. Effective stakeholder management and ability to successfully navigate organizational dynamics are a must for success. You should be outcomes-driven with a very high bias for action.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define, launch, and grow integrations with payment and platform partners.

- Define and prioritize product features and requirements to improve the customer, partner, and merchant experience.

- Create and manage the product roadmap for the broader 1:Many growth team.

- Develop success metrics/OKRs to measure the effectiveness of these initiatives.

- Partner with commercial and product marketing teams to develop go-to-market strategies for new partner integrations and features.

- 5+ years of product management experience

- Proven ability to multiple technical software products from kickoff to post-launch, driving meaningful business impact you can clearly articulate. 

- Skilled in cross-functional collaboration — diving into technical details with engineers, iterating with designers in Figma, and analyzing funnel performance with data analysts.

- Strong organizational and communication skills to navigate complex dynamics and drive alignment. 

- Execution-oriented with a proactive approach to overcoming obstacles and blockers.

- Demonstrated track record of shipping high-quality products on time.

This is a rare opportunity to build a foundational new business line from the ground up — one that will reshape how Affirm funds, serves, and grows relationships with its consumers. You’ll work at the intersection of regulated banking, platform engineering, and consumer products to bring Affirm’s bank to life.

 What You’ll Do 

- Serve as the single-threaded product owner across deposits, loan originations, banking compliance, and operations. You are the person who holds the full picture of how the bank works within Affirm’s ecosystem — and you drive it forward.

- Partner cross-functionally with Engineering, Marketing, Branding, Content, and Design to shape the consumer deposit experience and go-to-market strategy, including owning positioning, launch sequencing, and consumer-facing messaging for the deposit product.

- Own the roadmap for the deposit product on a go-forward basis, scaling from early launch to a multi-billion-dollar deposit base and making strategic decisions about how deposits integrate with Affirm’s credit products and broader consumer experience.

- Collaborate cross-functionally across Affirm’s internal teams and with our external vendors to ensure stakeholders are aligned on the vision for launch.

- Partner with Legal, Compliance, Risk, and the Bank’s executive team to drive bank operations readiness — regulatory readiness, process maturity, and vendor selection and integration (deposit core, fraud, KYC).

- Communicate strategy and tradeoffs to senior leadership and the Bank Board, and build alignment across Engineering, Legal, Compliance, Treasury, and Capital Markets.

- 6+ years of product management experience, with demonstrated ability to operate as a strategic, independent leader on complex, ambiguous initiatives

- Experience growing or launching a regulated consumer-facing product in the financial services industry with go-to-market experience

- Proven program leadership at scale — you’ve owned high-visibility cross-functional launches across many stakeholders, with direct exposure to leadership

- Strong technical fluency — you’re comfortable working with engineers on system design, data models, API architecture, and core banking platform integrations

About  AlayaCare   

 At AlayaCare, we’re more than just a fast-growing SaaS company, we’re a team of people passionate about transforming home healthcare. Our cloud-based platform empowers care providers around the world to deliver better outcomes for their clients.     

 With 600+ employees across Canada, the US, Australia, and Brazil, we’re united by a shared mission and a strong culture of transparency, growth, and human connection. Whether you're early in your career or a seasoned expert, AlayaCare offers the opportunity to grow your impact, your skills, and your career.   

 About the Role 

 At AlayaCare, we believe technology can transform how care is delivered, and how people age and heal at home. As Product Marketing Manager, US Home Care, you'll lead product marketing strategy and execution for our US Home Care business, turning product capabilities, market insight, and customer feedback into positioning, go-to-market plans, and enablement that our teams can actually put to use.

 You'll be the driving force behind our Tri-Annual Release process, partnering closely with Product, Product Marketing, Customer Success, Education, and Sales to make sure every release lands with impact. You'll also build a repeatable internal enablement program so colleagues always know what's changing, why it matters, who it's for, and how to talk about it with confidence.

 What You'll Do 

- Own the Tri-Annual release process end-to-end, from planning and readiness through communications, enablement, activation, and follow-up, while setting clear success criteria and rallying stakeholders around measurable US go-to-market results.

- Shape the story: develop compelling value propositions, narratives, pitches, and competitive differentiation, and build the US Home Care buyer journey to support our Land and Expand motion.

- Build and continuously improve our internal enablement program, creating frameworks and assets (learning paths, launch toolkits, talk tracks, demos, FAQs, objection handling, and competitive guidance) that help colleagues sell and support with confidence.

- Establish consistent, repeatable processes alongside our US Market Product Marketing Managers, and measure what matters: awareness, confidence, adoption, and commercial impact.

- Partner with Product, Customer Experience, and Education to drive feature adoption and retention, and own our US buyer personas and competitive research so the whole team stays sharp on the market.

- Contribute to US Home Care thought leadership and market-facing content, refine pricing and packaging alongside the Principal Product Marketing Manager, and manage incoming content requests.

- Use AI thoughtfully and responsibly, in line with AlayaCare's privacy, security, and fairness standards, owning the outcomes of AI-supported work and sharing what you learn with the team.

 What You'll Bring 

- 4 to 5 years of relevant experience, including at least 2 years in Product Marketing, Strategy, Management Consulting, or a related field, along with a bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Administration, Engineering, or a related discipline.

- Proven experience driving enterprise SaaS go-to-market strategy; broader SaaS experience is a strong asset.

- 3 to 4+ years in healthcare or home care is an asset, ideally with an understanding of payors and business lines.

- Strong analytical and metrics-driven instincts, paired with excellent project management, organizational, communication, interpersonal, decision-making, and time-management skills.

- Familiarity with tools like JIRA, Confluence, Roadmunk, Looker, Amplitude, Asana, or Crayon is an asset.

- Working knowledge of AI, with the ability to apply AI tools to enhance day-to-day work.

 Location and Work Model     

 This role is based in the Greater Toronto Area. At AlayaCare, our hybrid model includes set in-office collaboration days, and it is expected that team members are present in the office on those days to foster connection, innovation, and teamwork.   

 Why Join  AlayaCare ?     

 Work With Purpose     

 At AlayaCare, you’ll help build technology that empowers care providers and improves outcomes for patients and families. Every line of code and every customer interaction contributes to making care more connected, accessible, and human.    

 Grow in a High-Trust Culture     

 We believe in transparency, feedback, and assuming positive intent. Here, you’ll feel safe to share your ideas and career goals, and be supported to achieve them through mentorship, career mobility, and a promote-from-within philosophy.    

 Balance That Works for You     

 We value flexibility and well-being. From “Wellness Fridays” to volunteer time off, to flexible vacation, we make sure you have the space to recharge, contribute to your community, and live your best life.    

 Benefits That Matter     

- Equity in a well-funded, scaling company.    

- Comprehensive health benefits, telemedicine, and lifestyle spending accounts.    

- Parental leave top-up and family support programs.    

 Inclusive by Design     

 We celebrate diverse perspectives and foster belonging through our DEIB initiatives. Employee-led events, summits, and social activities, both in-person and virtual, create meaningful connections across our global teams.    

 Ready to Join Us?     

 Apply today and be part of a company that makes a real difference in the future of home and community care. Not the right role for you? Share this posting with someone who might be a great fit.    

 AlayaCare uses AI tools during our hiring process to support fair, consistent, and objective decision-making. Some initial screening steps may be automated to help identify qualified candidates. If your application is declined automatically you will be notified and you may request a human review.    

 We’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone belongs. If you require accommodation during the application process, please reach out to careers@alayacare.com   

 At AlayaCare, we consider a range of factors when determining compensation, including skills, qualifications, experience, and market data. These factors may cause compensation to vary. The expected hiring range is what we reasonably anticipate offering for this position at the time of posting.

AlayaCare offers a comprehensive benefits program, which may include medical, dental, wellness, life insurance, equity participation, paid parental leave top up, and paid time off.

This expected hiring range applies only to candidates hired to perform work in Ontario. This role represents an existing vacancy at AlayaCare. AlayaCare uses artificial intelligence enabled tools to support certain aspects of the recruitment process. All hiring decisions are made by our hiring teams.

 Expected Hiring Range
 $85,000 — $120,000 CAD

About AlayaCare  

 At AlayaCare, we’re more than just a fast-growing SaaS company, we’re a team of people passionate about transforming home healthcare. Our cloud-based platform empowers care providers around the world to deliver better outcomes for their clients.

Whether you're early in your career or a seasoned expert, AlayaCare offers the opportunity to grow your impact, your skills, and your career.

 About the Role 

 We are seeking a Solutions Architect to join our Forward Deployed Engineering division. Reporting to the Senior Director, Customer Engineering & Delivery, you will bridge the gap between our customers’ strategic vision and the technical execution of solutions within AlayaCare’s SaaS platform.

 As a member of the Forward Deployed Engineering team, you will be responsible for understanding customer requirements, aligning them with AlayaCare’s capabilities, and designing solutions that address customer needs while influencing the evolution of AlayaCare’s extensibility platform. Success in this role requires strong communication skills to engage effectively with CIOs and other technical stakeholders, as well as deep technical expertise to collaborate with the broader engineering team.

 What You’ll Do 

 Customer Engagement 

- Collaborate with the Revenue and Customer Success teams to understand customer needs, challenges, and objectives.

- Engage in strategic discussions with CIOs and other technical stakeholders to comprehend their business goals and technical requirements.

- Conduct discovery sessions, workshops, and presentations to gather information and provide insights on solution design and implementation.

 Solution Design and Architecture 

- Translate customer requirements into comprehensive solution designs that leverage and influence AlayaCare’s SaaS platform capabilities.

- Develop innovative and scalable solutions that align with industry best practices, security standards, and regulatory requirements.

- Create architectural diagrams, documentation, and other artifacts to communicate the proposed solution to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

- Collaborate with the FDE team to validate technical feasibility and refine the solution design based on implementation constraints and considerations.

 Cross-Functional Collaboration 

- Partner with the sales and account management teams to develop compelling proposals, including solution design, implementation timeline, and cost estimates.

- Collaborate with the FDE team to ensure a smooth handover of the solution design, providing necessary guidance and context.

- Engage deeply with AlayaCare’s Platform Architecture team to further develop the extensibility platform.

- Work closely with project managers and other internal teams to ensure successful delivery and implementation of the designed solutions.

- Provide ongoing support to the FDE team by addressing any solution-related questions or issues that arise during the implementation phase.

 Industry and Product Knowledge 

- Stay up to date with industry trends, emerging technologies, and regulatory changes related to the home care sector.

- Continuously expand knowledge of AlayaCare’s SaaS platform, its features, and functionalities, to effectively propose optimal solutions to customers.

- Drive external endpoint development based on solution requirements.

 What You Bring to the Team 

- Bachelor’s or advanced degree in computer engineering, computer science, or any related fields.

- 2-3 years professional software engineering experience.

- Proven experience in a solution architecture role, preferably within the SaaS industry or healthcare sector.

- Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to assess risks and propose mitigation strategies.

- Experience working with interoperability standards like HL7 FHIR and integration engines such as Iguana and Mirth.

- Strong understanding of software development principles, system integration, and cloud-based architectures.

- Experience engaging with CIOs and other high-level technical decision-makers.

- Proficiency in creating architectural diagrams and documentation using standard tools and methodologies.

- Familiarity with regulatory compliance requirements in the healthcare industry (e.g., HIPAA, GDPR) considered an asset.

- Ability to work collaboratively in cross-functional teams and manage multiple projects simultaneously.

amazon:amazon:10577301.description:
Amazon Business customers buy at a scale most retail systems were never built for: a school district ordering 2,000 chairs, a contractor ordering 900 boxes of fasteners, a hospital restocking an entire floor. Today those orders often arrive as dozens of separate boxes over many days, and we are rebuilding how Amazon fulfills them.
You will own the product roadmap for bulk and large order fulfillment at Amazon Business. The goal is simple to state and hard to build: a customer places one large order, picks one date, and receives it once, in the form factor that fits their dock and their crew. Getting there means changing how Amazon sources, consolidates, packs and ships large orders, working shoulder to shoulder with the engineering teams that own fulfillment planning and fulfillment center operations. This is a builder role with a funded roadmap and direct exposure to senior leaders across Amazon Business, supply chain and operations.

Key job responsibilities
Own the product roadmap for bulk and large order fulfillment, from customer problem through launch and measured outcome.
Write the documents that get the work funded and built: PRFAQs, business requirements documents, and annual and three year planning inputs.
Act as the requirements owner with partner engineering teams in fulfillment planning and fulfillment center technology, not a ticket filer. Negotiate scope, sequence and dependencies directly with their product and engineering leaders.
Define how Amazon consolidates a large order into as few deliveries as possible, including palletized delivery and customer selected delivery dates.
Define how a request for many individual units can be served from cases and pallets of the same product, working through the inventory, receive and pick changes that requires.
Build the case for dedicated bulk fulfillment capacity, including moving product from suppliers to customers without a putaway step.
Replace manual operator work with automation across sourcing, consolidation and promise, and track the reduction.
Own the metrics: deliveries per order, delivery date accuracy, ship cost per unit and contribution profit per unit. Pull your own data and defend your own numbers.

A day in the life
You will spend your day between customers and builders. Mornings often start in the data, checking how last week's large orders actually shipped and where they fragmented. From there it is working sessions with fulfillment planning and fulfillment center engineering teams on requirements, a review with operations leaders on the manual work still left in the flow, and time with Amazon Business sales and customer teams on what large buyers are asking for. You will write often, and you will present what you write to directors and above.

About the team
Amazon Business (AB) launched in the United States in April 2015 with the vision of delivering a comprehensive procurement solution for business customers of all sizes. In the US, AB now serves Fortune 500 companies, hospital systems, local governments, and education organizations. To support AB's mission, the AB Operations team owns end to end customer experience for AB customers right from checkout to final mile delivery and sits under the broader Global Transportation Services (GTS). We are the Single Threaded WW Ops team driving B2B operations, developing products and programs unique to business customers, and enhancing the business delivery capabilities.

- 3+ years of product management experience
- Experience managing technical products or online services
- Experience in product, program, or project management in leading cross-functional teams in delivery of major new products or services
- Bachelor's degree

- Experience building and analyzing cost/benefit scenarios and business cases and communicating results throughout the organization
- Experience working with technical and product stakeholders to define requirements, prioritize features, and influence product roadmaps

This position is part of the AWS Specialist and Partner Organization (ASP). Specialists own the end-to-end go-to-market strategy for their respective technology domains, providing the business and technical expertise to help our customers succeed. Partner teams own the strategy, recruitment, development, and growth of our key technology and consulting partners. Together, they provide our customers with the expertise and scale needed to build innovative solutions for their most complex challenges.

Amazon Web Services is seeking a bilingual (English/French) Solutions Architect to join the Agentic WorkSpaces team in Toronto, Canada. This role requires a professional operating at the intersection of enterprise desktop infrastructure and applied AI—with a primary, clearly defined depth in Agentic WorkSpaces platform architecture (60%), complemented by advisory-level proficiency in applied AI and Large Language Model (LLM) deployment patterns (40%).

The primary mandate is mastery of the Agentic WorkSpaces platform. You will architect, deploy, and optimize Virtual Desktop Infrastructure (VDI) and Desktop-as-a-Service (DaaS) solutions using Amazon WorkSpaces Personal and Core, as well as Amazon WorkSpaces Applications (formerly AppStream 2.0). You will ensure production readiness for enterprise customers, covering network design, identity federation, image management, directory services, protocol optimization, and operational health. This requires "Level 300" depth—you are the definitive technical authority customers rely on to move from assessment to large-scale production.

The secondary mandate is applied AI consulting. You will guide customers through the agentic AI capabilities integrated into Agentic WorkSpaces—including AI agent configuration, foundation model selection via Amazon Bedrock, prompt engineering, tool integration via the Model Context Protocol (MCP), and agent-to-agent (A2A) communication patterns. You will evaluate LLM performance, design agent evaluation frameworks, and advise on deployment models for production AI workloads. This role requires a "200+" level of technical depth—sufficient to lead customer conversations, conduct hands-on demonstrations, and identify when to engage deeper AI engineering resources.

Canada represents a strategic growth market for Agentic WorkSpaces. Federal, provincial, and regulated-sector clients (financial services, healthcare, public sector) require native-level French engagement for procurement, compliance documentation, and day-to-day technical consulting. This role directly serves Canadian public sector and enterprise clients, leading discovery sessions, architecture reviews, and production readiness assessments in both English and French. Toronto offers geographic proximity to Canada's largest concentration of businesses while providing access to bilingual talent.

Availability to travel up to 25%–50% of the time for on-site customer engagements across Canada.
**************************
Ce poste fait partie de l'AWS Specialist and Partner Organization (ASP). Les spécialistes possèdent la stratégie de mise sur le marché de bout en bout pour leurs domaines technologiques respectifs, en fournissant l'expertise commerciale et technique pour aider nos clients à réussir. Ensemble, ils offrent à nos clients l'expertise et l'envergure nécessaires pour construire des solutions innovantes face à leurs défis les plus complexes.

Amazon Web Services recherche un architecte de solutions bilingue (anglais/français) pour rejoindre l'équipe Agentic WorkSpaces à Toronto, Canada. Ce rôle exige un professionnel qui opère à l'intersection de l'infrastructure de bureau d'entreprise et de l'intelligence artificielle appliquée — avec une profondeur principale clairement définie en architecture de plateforme Agentic WorkSpaces (60 %), complétée par une proficiency au niveau consultatif en IA appliquée et en modèles de déploiement de grands modèles linguistiques (LLM) (40 %).

Le mandat principal est la maîtrise de la plateforme Agentic WorkSpaces. Vous architecturerez, déploierez et optimiserez des solutions d'infrastructure de bureau (VDI) et de bureau en tant que service (DaaS) en utilisant Amazon WorkSpaces Personal et Core, ainsi qu'Amazon WorkSpaces Applications (anciennement AppStream 2.0). Vous assurerez la préparation à la production pour les clients d'entreprise : conception réseau, fédération d'identité, gestion d'images, services d'annuaire, optimisation de protocole et santé opérationnelle. Il s'agit d'une profondeur de niveau 300 — vous êtes l'autorité technique définitive sur laquelle les clients comptent pour passer de l'évaluation à la production à grande échelle.

Le mandat secondaire est le conseil en IA appliquée. Vous guiderez les clients à travers les capacités d'IA agentique intégrées à Agentic WorkSpaces — notamment la configuration d'agents IA, la sélection de modèles de base via Amazon Bedrock, l'ingénierie des invites, l'intégration d'outils via le Model Context Protocol (MCP), et les modèles de communication agent à agent (A2A). Vous évaluerez la performance des LLM, concevrez des cadres d'évaluation d'agents et conseillerez sur les modèles de déploiement pour les charges de travail d'IA en production. Il s'agit d'une profondeur de niveau 200+ — suffisante pour diriger les conversations avec les clients, mener des démonstrations pratiques et identifier quand engager des ressources d'ingénierie IA plus approfondies.

Le Canada représente un marché de croissance stratégique pour Agentic WorkSpaces. Les clients fédéraux, provinciaux et des secteurs réglementés (services financiers, santé, secteur public) requièrent un engagement en français natif pour l'approvisionnement, la documentation de conformité et le conseil technique quotidien. Ce rôle sert directement les clients du secteur public et des entreprises canadiennes — menantdes découvertes, des examens d'architecture et des évaluations de préparation à la production en anglais et en français. Toronto offre une proximité géographique avec la plus grande concentration d'entreprises au Canada tout en offrant l'accès à des talents bilingues.

Agentic WorkSpaces Expertise (60%)

Create reusable artifacts—reference architectures, implementation guides, sample configurations, prompt libraries, and data readiness checklists—that scale best practices across the SA community and the partner ecosystem.

Provide structured product feedback to the Agentic WorkSpaces and Amazon Bedrock service teams based on real-world customer implementations, directly contributing to roadmap prioritization.

Act as a technical liaison between customers, partners, service engineering teams, and support—ensuring the voice of the customer reaches product leadership with accuracy and urgency.

Author or contribute to publications for AWS customers—such as white papers, blog posts, technical guides, and case studies—that demonstrate Canadian customers' success with Agentic WorkSpaces.

Dispenser des séances de transfert de connaissances en personne et à distance (ateliers, journées immersion, bootcamps) pour transférer les connaissances opérationnelles d'Agentic WorkSpaces aux équipes clients.

Concevoir et déployer des configurations de serveur Model Context Protocol (MCP) qui exposent les outils, API et sources de données des clients dans un format standardisé pour la découverte dynamique et l'invocation d'outils d'agents.
