 À propos de l'équipe Données de la plateforme AEC 
 Notre équipe conçoit les API, les services et les expériences utilisateur qui constituent l'infrastructure de données de la plateforme Design and Make d'Autodesk. Nous nous attachons à résoudre les défis critiques liés aux flux de travail en matière d'échange de données, permettant ainsi à nos clients de tirer pleinement parti de leurs données de projet et d'actifs. En rationalisant la manière dont les exigences en matière d'informations sur les actifs sont définies, gérées et satisfaites tout au long du cycle de vie, nous aidons les professionnels du secteur AEC à travailler de manière plus efficace, plus intelligente et plus collaborative.

 Présentation du poste 
 Autodesk recherche un Product Owner pour rejoindre notre équipe AEC Platform Data. À ce poste, vous contribuerez à la mise en place de fonctionnalités de gestion des exigences d’information qui rationalisent la manière dont les clients d’Autodesk définissent, gèrent et satisfont les exigences d’information relatives aux actifs construits tout au long de leur cycle de vie, de la conception à l’exploitation

 En tant que Product Owner, vous travaillerez directement avec les clients pour comprendre leurs besoins et servirez de lien essentiel entre la gestion de produit, la conception d’expérience et l’ingénierie. En collaboration avec une équipe diversifiée et interfonctionnelle comprenant d'autres Product Owners, des responsables de développement, des concepteurs d'expérience et des responsables d'ingénierie, vous définirez et hiérarchiserez les éléments du backlog qui apportent une valeur significative à nos utilisateurs.

 Sous la responsabilité du Senior Manager de la gestion de produit pour la gestion du cycle de vie des informations AECO, vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec vos pairs Product Owners et Product Managers afin de traduire les besoins des clients et la stratégie produit en décisions de backlog et de lancement réfléchies et fondées sur les données pour un domaine produit défini.

 Responsabilités 

- Travailler avec les clients pour définir et maintenir des épopées, des user stories et des critères d'acceptation clairs et exploitables, reflétant les besoins clients, techniques et métier

- Collaborer avec les chefs de produit pour aligner la hiérarchisation du backlog et la planification des sprints sur la stratégie produit, les objectifs de livraison et la feuille de route

- Traduire des exigences complexes en tâches bien délimitées grâce à une étroite collaboration avec les concepteurs, les ingénieurs et les parties prenantes

- Assurer le raffinement du backlog et la préparation des sprints, en servant de contact principal pour les équipes de livraison concernant les priorités, la portée, les dépendances et les blocages

- Surveiller les performances de livraison et l'alignement avec les résultats attendus, en utilisant la télémétrie, l'analyse et les retours clients pour piloter l'itération

- Identifier, gérer et aider à résoudre les risques ou les dépendances susceptibles d'affecter la livraison dans les délais

- Promouvoir les meilleures pratiques agiles et une mentalité « plateforme d'abord » en maintenant le backlog visible, transparent et prêt à l'exécution

 Qualifications minimales 

- Plus de 5 ans d'expérience en tant que Product Owner ou dans un rôle étroitement lié à la livraison de produits au sein d'environnements de développement logiciel Agile

- Connaissance du secteur AEC, y compris la modélisation des informations du bâtiment (BIM) et les workflows associés en matière de conception, de données d'actifs et de cycle de vie

- Expérience dans la gestion ou la hiérarchisation d'un backlog de produit, la rédaction d'histoires utilisateur et de critères d'acceptation, et la collaboration étroite avec les équipes d'ingénierie tout au long de la livraison

- Solide compréhension des méthodologies Agile/Scrum et du cycle de vie du développement de produits logiciels

- Excellentes compétences en communication et en collaboration, avec la capacité d’influencer les parties prenantes et d’aligner des équipes interfonctionnelles

- Expérience dans la livraison de solutions SaaS basées sur le cloud et dans l’utilisation d’outils tels que Jira et Confluence

- Capacité à trouver un équilibre entre les besoins des clients, la faisabilité technique et la valeur commerciale dans les décisions quotidiennes de priorisation et de périmètre

 Qualifications souhaitées 

- Compréhension des principes de gestion et de gouvernance des données, y compris les métadonnées et la gouvernance de l'information

- Expérience de travail au sein d'organisations matricielles et de la capacité à influencer sans autorité directe

- Expérience dans le développement de produits axés sur les plateformes ou les API

- Expérience dans la mise en œuvre de capacités SaaS ou de plateformes évolutives et dans leur amélioration grâce aux retours clients, à la télémétrie et à la livraison itérative

Axonify is the AI-Powered Frontline Enablement Platform that helps organizations close the gap between learning and execution. By unifying learning, execution and insights capabilities, Axonify drives real business impacts for the world’s largest frontline organizations across retail, grocery, healthcare, and financial services.
More than 4 million employees across 160+ countries rely on Axonify today. It’s an exciting time to join as we transform the company and build what’s next.
We’re a team that thinks deeply, moves with intention, and embraces new ideas. We learn quickly, keep a sharp focus on real-world impact, and take meaningful action to drive progress. And we do it as one team, with openness, creativity, and a shared drive to keep pushing what’s possible
The Role
The Senior Product Manager is a strategic role at the heart of Axonify’s product offering. You will define and own the strategy for a key area of our enterprise SaaS platform, balancing the delivery of prioritized initiatives with discovery to shape the longer-term vision and roadmap. Working closely with Engineering, Design, Analytics, customers, and cross-functional stakeholders, you will have significant autonomy and the opportunity to influence the direction of our platform while driving customer value, adoption, retention, revenue, and growth.
What You’ll Build
Drive customer and user research (qualitative + quantitative), define buyer personas, use cases, user workflows, and deeply understand the job your customer needs to do and the key unmet needs that unlock value.
Translate research and insights into prioritized product roadmap, requirements, user stories, release plans, and success metrics (KPIs).
Deliver solutions that span multiple interconnected product areas, ensuring they integrate cleanly with shared systems and administrative frameworks while respecting established platform boundaries.
Partner cross-functionally with engineering, design/UX, QA, marketing, sales, operations, and support teams to deliver high-quality and high-impact features, coordinate product lifecycle changes, and orchestrate go-to-market launches.
AI-powered features and tools across the full lifecycle - from research and ideation to prototypes, development integrations, and customer feedback systems that enhance creativity, speed, and decision quality.
Customer-facing AI experiences with well-designed prompts, human-in-the-loop workflows, quality evaluation, and safeguards for reliability and control.
Ensure internal teams (sales, marketing, enablement) are enabled to sell and support your product.
Monitor product performance post-launch (usage metrics, adoption, retention, feedback), run experiments, iterate on features.
Contribute to product excellence through peer collaboration, shared discovery, and informal mentorship as needed. 
Skillfully manage continuous customer & user input, navigate trade-offs, and ensure transparent alignment across the entire organization.
What You’ll Bring
5–7 years of experience in product management or related roles within a SaaS or enterprise technology environment.
Proven ability to translate complex business and user problems into clear, actionable product strategies.
Strong technical fluency - able to reason about data, system interactions, and implementation tradeoffs in partnership with engineering, without owning underlying platform architecture.
Experience leveraging product research and analytics to inform decisions, understand customer behavior, and track opportunities.
Practical understanding of modern AI-enabled workflows and how AI can be applied throughout the product lifecycle to enhance creativity, speed, and decision-making.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills — with the ability to influence across teams and levels of the organization. 
Exceptional organizational skills; proven success managing multiple priorities in a fast-moving environment.
Empathy, emotional intelligence, and a team-first mindset.
Experience building products for frontline employees is strongly preferred, particularly within frontline enablement or adjacent retail technology areas such as point-of-sale, merchandising, planogram, inventory, or warehouse management solutions.
A bachelor’s degree in business, engineering, or a related field is strongly preferred.
Familiarity with Agile and Scrum methodologies and product management tools is strongly preferred.
Previous experience managing or mentoring junior product managers or product teams is strongly preferred.
It's ok if your experience doesn't check every box! If you check off more than a few - great! We’d welcome a chance to get to know what you can bring, how you can add to our culture, and hear your unique story.
Work Location
We have a strong preference for candidates located in the 
Greater Boston area
 or within commuting distance of our 
Waterloo, Ontario, Canada
 office, as these locations provide opportunities for in-person collaboration with other Axonifers in the area.
Candidates outside these locations are also encouraged to apply if they are based in the 
Eastern Time Zone
 and authorized to work in 
Canada

United States
.
Candidates within commuting distance of our 
Waterloo, Ontario 
office can enjoy our hybrid-flexible work environment. On Wednesdays, local Axonifers come together for Work from Work Wednesdays, a day designed for collaboration, connection, and meaningful in-person moments.
Whether you are working remotely or in a hybrid environment at Axonify, you will have the tools, resources, and support you need to succeed.
What You’ll Love About Axonify
We offer a comprehensive total rewards package designed to support your wellbeing, growth, and overall success. Here’s what you can expect:
Competitive Compensation:

,000

Comprehensive Health Benefits:
 Health benefits from day one to support your overall wellbeing.
Time Off:
 4 weeks of vacation, 7 Life Care Days, and a flexible holiday program to choose the religious, spiritual, and cultural holidays that matter most to you.

 Wellness Spending Account to support whatever wellbeing looks like for you.

Growth & Learning:

Community Impact: 
Paid Volunteer Time to give back to the causes that matter to you.
AI at Axonify
We believe AI should help people do their best work, not replace the human judgment, creativity, and connection that make us who we are. AI is a tool we use to learn fast, elevate our craft, and focus on the work that truly creates impact. That shows up in our hiring process too.
We use AI-assisted tools to create a smoother, more organized, and ultimately more human candidate experience. These tools allow our team to spend more time on real conversations and thoughtful decision-making, the things that matter.
What AI doesn’t do at Axonify is make hiring decisions. Every decision is made by real people, using real judgment and grounded in our values.
Here’s what that means for you as a candidate:
Feel free to use AI to support your thinking - not replace it.
 We use AI to learn and level up, and you can too.
Be open about how you use AI if asked.
 Transparency helps us understand your process and how you approach problem-solving.
Stay authentic.
 We’re hiring people, not prompts, your ideas, your experiences, and your voice are what matter.
Diversity & Accessibility
We believe our team’s unique experiences, backgrounds, cultures, beliefs, and abilities add richness to our culture and depth to our ideas. Our commitment to diversity and inclusion creates an environment that supports, empowers, and delivers a sense of belonging for all team members.

ashby:beaconsoftware:71965ed6-44a9-4d11-.description:
Beacon https://beaconsoftware.com/ is building the essential technology infrastructure for the everyday economy: the businesses, organizations, and services that make real life work, and that mainstream tech has largely left behind. We acquire, operate, and grow vertical market software companies — niche, founder-built businesses serving industries that are often overlooked and too profitable to ignore.

Our model is simple: we seek out founders who have built their business by spending years understanding their market and prioritizing their customers' specific needs. We buy great businesses, invest in their continued growth, and hold them permanently — accelerating that growth with an AI-native platform built specifically for vertical market software. No mandate to cut, flip, or roll up into something unrecognizable.

We are not a financial firm. We are technology entrepreneurs and operators who believe the most important businesses in the world are already running quietly in industries most people never think about. Our job is to find them, support the people who built them, and make them better.

Beacon is backed by a diverse base of investors, with $550M+ raised to date, including General Catalyst, Lightspeed, D1 Capital, CPMG, the family offices of the founders of Stripe, DoorDash, and Ramp, and evergreen funds built for the long game.

 

About the role

You'll join Beacon's Portfolio Product team — a cross-functional group of Product Managers, Engineers, Designers, GTM experts, and Data Scientists working directly with our 40+ portfolio companies and counting (at roughly one new acquisition per week) to drive measurable outcomes through AI and software.

 

At the core, every PM at Beacon owns product outcomes for 2 to 5 portfolio companies at a time, acting as a hands-on, founding product leader embedded in each business. You'll sit close to the GM, the operators, and the customers, figure out where the leverage is, and ship software directly into the business. The best PMs don't just deliver for the companies they're deployed at — they compress what they learn into reusable playbooks that spread to every other portfolio company in the same vertical. The ultimate objective is to transform our portfolio companies into unicorns!

 

For the right candidates, this role grows beyond individual ownership. As your vertical scales, you may build and lead a team of PMs, take on hiring and coaching responsibilities, and become the person who sets product vision and standards across an entire industry segment — partnering directly with GMs, founders & operators, and driving planning across the whole portfolio. How much of that path applies to you depends on your background and trajectory, and we'll shape the role around what you bring.

 

This is not a consulting role. We ship software, not slides. The deliverable is a running system.


Key Responsibilities

 - Own product outcomes for 2 to 5 portfolio companies simultaneously, acting as a fractional/founding product leader embedded in each business

 - Lead quarterly and annual planning, helping teams set product visions and translate them into achievable goals

 - Build and maintain roadmaps that balance customer needs, business goals, and technical constraints

 - Drive sprint planning and execution, improving team velocity and predictability over time

 - Develop prioritization frameworks that help CEOs and operators make better product decisions

 - Build customer feedback systems that turn qualitative inputs into actionable roadmap decisions

 - Coordinate feature launches across engineering, sales, marketing, and support

 - Coach developers, designers, and early PMs to think like product managers

 - Distill learnings into cross-portfolio playbooks that scale impact beyond your assigned companies

 - Partner with GMs, founders, and operators to set product vision and translate it into executable roadmaps

 - Contribute to Beacon's broader AI platform by surfacing patterns and opportunities from your companies

 

As your scope grows you may also:

 - Build and lead a team of PMs, hiring, onboarding, and developing them as your portfolio scales

 - Codify cross-portfolio playbooks that turn individual wins into repeatable systems across an entire vertical

 - Set the bar for how great product work looks at Beacon — spec quality, customer discovery, prioritization rigor

 - Own product strategy and outcomes across a defined vertical, not just individual companies

 

What We're Looking For

 - BA/BS degree; MBA a plus

 - 4+ years of product management experience, ideally in B2B SaaS (senior candidates typically bring 7+ years, including 2+ years in a formal leadership role or as a co-founder)

 - Strong fundamentals: roadmapping, sprint planning, spec writing, prioritization frameworks

 - Sharp customer discovery instincts and the ability to identify high-impact opportunities fast

 - Comfortable managing multiple companies and stakeholders simultaneously

 - Ability to influence founders and executives without direct authority

 - For more senior candidates: a proven track record leading and developing other PMs, not just doing great PM work individually

 - Strong systems thinking — you see patterns across companies and know how to turn them into playbooks

 - High autonomy, low ego. You figure things out and get them done

 - Entrepreneurial mindset and genuine comfort with ambiguity

This Role Is Perfect for You If...

 - You are an ex-founder, or have founding PM / early product hire experience at a high-growth startup

 - You want real ownership over how businesses (and, over time, entire industry verticals) get transformed through software and AI

 - You get satisfaction from shipping great product yourself — and, as you grow, from building capability in others

 - You are commercially-minded and curious about private equity, rollups, and how profitable businesses are built


Our Values at Beacon Software

 - Humility: We acknowledge that the path to getting to the right answer involves being wrong along the way. We have strong beliefs which are weakly held. We actively seek new ideas and believe we can learn from anyone at any time.

 - Honesty: We are truth seeking in our approach to business problems. Business is a repeat game and we believe that human relationships generate alpha. We understand that trust is earned over a lifetime and can be lost in an instant.

 - Hunger: We play to win. We hold ourselves to high standards and will not be outworked. We take pride in having a deep sense of responsibility to ourselves, each other, our partners, and our customers. We believe to whom much is given much is expected.

 - Horizon: We seek to build a generational software company. This will take decades. We manage our expectations and those of our partners to take advantage of the 8th wonder of the world - compounding growth.


How We Use AI in Our Hiring Process: To ensure transparency, we want candidates to know that Beacon Software uses Artificial Intelligence and AI-enabled tools to assist with screening, reviewing, organizing and highlighting profiles and applications that match the key requirements for each role.

 

AI does not make hiring decisions: Every application is reviewed by a member of our team, and all decisions throughout the process are made by humans. We use AI to support efficiency and consistency, not to replace human judgment. We are committed to a fair, thoughtful, and equitable experience for every candidate.

workday:bb/BlackBerry:20260306.title: QNX Ecosystem Program Manager
workday:bb/BlackBerry:20260306.description:
Worker Sub-Type: 
Regular   
 Job Description:  
 QNX, a division of BlackBerry Limited (NYSE: BB; TSX: BB), provides the trusted foundation that software-defined and physical AI systems depend on to operate safely and predictably in the real world. For nearly half a century, QNX has powered safety-critical applications where failure is not an option. The business leads the way in delivering safe and secure operating systems, hypervisors, middleware, solutions, and development tools, along with the support and services delivered by trusted embedded software experts. Today, QNX technology underpins hundreds of millions of vehicles on the road and a wide range of mission-critical systems across industrial controls, robotics, medical devices, commercial transportation, rail, and aerospace and defense.

 Are You the Person We're Looking For? 

 At QNX, we're building more than industry-leading embedded software. Through our QNX Everywhere initiative, we're creating a thriving developer ecosystem that connects open-source technologies, startups, universities, consortiums, technology partners, and developers with the QNX Real-Time Operating System (RTOS). We're looking for an Ecosystem Program Manager to help scale and operationalize that vision. In this role, you'll be responsible for driving the day-to-day execution of ecosystem initiatives, managing strategic partnerships, and ensuring external engagements translate into measurable outcomes for QNX and our developer community.

 Are you someone who thrives at the intersection of technology, partnerships, and program execution? Do you enjoy bringing people together, building meaningful relationships, and turning strategic ideas into measurable results? We're looking for someone who is highly organized, proactive, and passionate about growing technology ecosystems. You enjoy working with startups, developers, universities, open-source communities, industry consortiums, and technology partners. You're comfortable navigating both technical and business conversations and can coordinate activities across multiple teams and organizations simultaneously.

 If you enjoy working with cutting-edge technologies, collaborating with diverse stakeholders, and helping shape the future of the developer ecosystem around QNX, we'd love to hear from you.

 What You'll Do 

- Own the operational execution of the QNX Everywhere ecosystem strategy, ensuring initiatives progress from approval through completion.

- Act as the primary operational point of contact for ecosystem partners, technology vendors, universities, consortiums, incubators, accelerators, and other strategic organizations.

- Lead and manage the QNX Everywhere Enablement Program, helping partners integrate QNX-related offerings, developer resources, and assets into their platforms and user experiences.

- Build and maintain strong relationships with ecosystem partners while identifying opportunities to increase engagement, adoption, and collaboration.

- Develop and maintain program plans, milestones, dependencies, dashboards, KPIs, and executive status reporting.

- Coordinate cross-functional stakeholders across engineering, marketing, developer relations, product management, sales, legal, and finance teams.

- Manage relationships with incubators and accelerators such as startup hubs, innovation networks, and entrepreneurial programs.

- Create engagement plans, run recurring operational meetings, and ensure commitments, deliverables, and obligations are completed.

- Connect startups, developers, researchers, and ecosystem participants with appropriate QNX resources and subject matter experts.

- Manage operational aspects of industry consortiums, standards bodies, and strategic technology initiatives.

- Participate in consortium working groups, track action items, and ensure organizational commitments are fulfilled.

- Manage sponsorship activities and associated contracts, including NDAs, SLAs, SOWs, sponsorship agreements, and academic framework agreements.

- Coordinate procurement and purchasing activities required to support ecosystem investments and programs.

- Track engagement outcomes, program effectiveness, ecosystem investments, renewal cycles, sponsorship commitments, and budget utilization.

- Maintain a partner inventory database and identify opportunities to strengthen ecosystem coverage.

- Develop scalable, repeatable frameworks for: 
- Partner onboarding

- Sponsorship evaluation

- Ecosystem investment reviews

- Success metric tracking

- Quarterly business reviews

- Renewal and exit decisions

- Coordinate QNX participation in hackathons, workshops, conferences, demo days, job fairs, and other community events.

- Partner with marketing teams to develop and promote ecosystem initiatives and developer-focused programs.

- Use modern AI tools responsibly to help automate, streamline, and scale ecosystem operations and reporting activities.

- Travel as needed to support ecosystem partners, events, workshops, and strategic engagements.

 What You Bring 

- Experience managing programs, partnerships, strategic relationships, or ecosystem initiatives within the technology industry.

- Strong project and program management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.

- Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail.

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

- Demonstrated ability to work effectively with executives, engineers, academics, developers, startups, and industry partners.

- Ability to drive initiatives forward through influence, coordination, and strong follow-through.

- Comfort engaging with technical audiences and understanding developer-focused tools, technologies, and platforms.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

- Experience working cross-functionally within a technology-driven organization.

- Understanding of software development concepts, particularly within embedded systems, operating systems, developer platforms, or related technical domains.

- Experience managing external vendors, contracts, partnerships, or business relationships.

- Fluency in English.

 It Would Be Nice If You Had Any of the Following 

- Experience in Developer Relations, Product Management, Technical Program Management, Technical Marketing, Partner Management, or Engineering.

- PMP certification or formal project/program management training.

- Experience working with startups, incubators, accelerators, or venture-backed technology companies.

- Familiarity with embedded systems, real-time operating systems, IoT platforms, or edge computing technologies.

- Experience working with open-source communities, foundations, or developer ecosystems.

- Experience organizing technical workshops, hackathons, conferences, training programs, or community events.

- Experience developing dashboards, metrics, KPIs, Salesforce reporting, or ecosystem analytics.

- Knowledge of procurement, sponsorship management, contract administration, or legal coordination processes.

- Experience collaborating with universities, academic institutions, or research organizations.

- Familiarity with AI-powered productivity tools and workflow automation solutions.

- Additional language skills such as French, German, Japanese, Korean, Swedish, or Mandarin.

 Why Join Us? 

- Help shape the future of the QNX Everywhere developer ecosystem.

- Build relationships with leading technology companies, startups, research institutions, and developer communities around the world.

- Take ownership of high-impact programs that directly influence ecosystem growth and adoption.

- Work alongside passionate experts in embedded systems, open-source software, developer relations, and product development.

- Join a collaborative, innovative team that values curiosity, creativity, and continuous learning.

- Be exposed to emerging technologies, entrepreneurial communities, and the next generation of developers building intelligent connected systems.

 Scheduled Weekly Hours: 
40   
 Compensation Hiring Base Salary Range: 
$90,000.00 - $126,000.00   
 Please be advised that the compensation hiring range indicated herein is provided solely as a good-faith estimate of expected base compensation for the position. The actual compensation offered will be determined at the time of hire and is contingent upon multiple factors, including but not limited to the candidate’s qualifications, relevant experience, demonstrated skills, and results of assessments conducted during the hiring process.

 Bonus: 
The BlackBerry Variable Incentive Pay (VIP) program is an organization-wide bonus incentive program which aims to reward full-time eligible employees for their contribution to BlackBerry’s success. VIP payments are made in addition to base salary and factor in company’s performance as a way for employees to share in BlackBerry’s achievements.   
 Benefits: 
The BlackBerry Employee Benefits programs offer a wide range of benefits that support your physical, financial and personal well-being. BlackBerry remains committed to offering affordable benefits including coverage for medical, dental, vision, life, disability insurance, retirement, employee share purchase program and paid-time-off to those that meet the eligibility requirements.   
 Disclosure of Position Status: 
This is an active opening. We are seeking to fill this position immediately     
 Disclosure of Artificial Intelligence: 
 We do not use artificial intelligence (AI) to screen, assess, or select applicants at any stage of our recruitment process. All applications are reviewed and evaluated by our hiring team.

 Job Description:  
 QNX enhances the human experience and amplifies technology-driven industries, providing a trusted foundation for software-defined businesses to thrive. The business leads the way in delivering safe and secure operating systems, hypervisors, middleware, solutions, and development tools, along with support and services delivered by trusted embedded software experts. QNX® technology has been deployed in the world’s most critical embedded systems, including more than 275 million vehicles on the road today. QNX® software is trusted across industries including automotive, medical devices, industrial controls, robotics, commercial vehicles, rail, and aerospace and defense.

 Shape the Future of Embedded Solutions with QNX! 

 We are looking for a Senior Technical Product Manager to help define and deliver solutions to the QNX portfolio such as our General Embedded Development Platform, Cabin (digital cockpit), and Sound (vehicle acoustics). You’ll take individual components and orchestrate them into integrated offerings that solve real-world problems for global customers.

 Join a team that transforms cutting-edge components into high-value solutions powering next-generation vehicles and Industry 4.0. If you thrive on solving complex challenges and influencing technology at scale, this is your opportunity to make an impact.

 Why QNX? 

- Industry Leader: Be part of a company powering the next generation of critical embedded systems.

- Impactful Work: Lead high-impact product initiatives that influence growth and market positioning.

- Innovation & Growth: Join a team that thrives on innovation and drives cutting-edge solutions.

- Collaborative Culture: Work with talented professionals across diverse functions.

- Solutions Impact: Your work will shape offerings that define the future of industry and intelligent systems.

 You will: 

- Own the end-to-end lifecycle of multi-component solutions, from strategic planning through delivery and continuous improvement.

- Define integration strategies that turn building blocks into cohesive offerings.

- Partner with engineering and ecosystem partners to accelerate time-to-market for new verticals.

- Lead go-to-market strategy for new solution launches, aligning with QNX’s roadmap and business objectives.

- Act as the voice of the customer, synthesizing feedback from strategic accounts and market signals.

- Conduct competitive intelligence and market analysis to identify emerging trends and opportunities.

- Serve as a thought leader and brand ambassador, representing QNX at industry events, webinars, customer briefings, and executive-level engagements.

 You will have: 

- Bachelor’s or Master’s in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent technical degree.

- Significant product management experience in industrial automation, robotics, IoT, or embedded systems.

- Demonstrated ability to define and prioritize product requirements, balancing customer impact, business viability, and technical feasibility.

- Strong cross-functional knowledge spanning engineering, product strategy, finance, and marketing.

- Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with a track record of influencing stakeholders at all levels.

 It will be great if you have: 

- Experience with ecosystem partnerships or build vs. buy decisions.

- Familiarity with industrial connectivity standards (OPC UA, Modbus, PROFINET).

- Knowledge and understanding the importance of regulatory compliance in embedded space (e.g. functional safety standards such as IEC 61508 and/or security standards such as IEC 62443).

 Join us as we accelerate towards the next chapter of innovation! 

 #LI-KH1

 Job Description:  
 QNX, a division of BlackBerry Limited (NYSE: BB; TSX: BB), provides the trusted foundation that software-defined and physical AI systems depend on to operate safely and predictably in the real world. For nearly half a century, QNX has powered safety-critical applications where failure is not an option. The business leads the way in delivering safe and secure operating systems, hypervisors, middleware, solutions, and development tools, along with the support and services delivered by trusted embedded software experts. Today, QNX technology underpins hundreds of millions of vehicles on the road and a wide range of mission-critical systems across industrial controls, robotics, medical devices, commercial transportation, rail, and aerospace and defense.

 Are You the Person We're Looking For? 

 At QNX, we're building more than industry-leading embedded software. Through our QNX Everywhere initiative, we're creating a thriving developer ecosystem that connects open-source technologies, startups, universities, consortiums, technology partners, and developers with the QNX Real-Time Operating System (RTOS). We're looking for an Ecosystem Program Manager to help scale and operationalize that vision. In this role, you'll be responsible for driving the day-to-day execution of ecosystem initiatives, managing strategic partnerships, and ensuring external engagements translate into measurable outcomes for QNX and our developer community.

 Are you someone who thrives at the intersection of technology, partnerships, and program execution? Do you enjoy bringing people together, building meaningful relationships, and turning strategic ideas into measurable results? We're looking for someone who is highly organized, proactive, and passionate about growing technology ecosystems. You enjoy working with startups, developers, universities, open-source communities, industry consortiums, and technology partners. You're comfortable navigating both technical and business conversations and can coordinate activities across multiple teams and organizations simultaneously.

 If you enjoy working with cutting-edge technologies, collaborating with diverse stakeholders, and helping shape the future of the developer ecosystem around QNX, we'd love to hear from you.

 What You'll Do 

- Own the operational execution of the QNX Everywhere ecosystem strategy, ensuring initiatives progress from approval through completion.

- Act as the primary operational point of contact for ecosystem partners, technology vendors, universities, consortiums, incubators, accelerators, and other strategic organizations.

- Lead and manage the QNX Everywhere Enablement Program, helping partners integrate QNX-related offerings, developer resources, and assets into their platforms and user experiences.

- Build and maintain strong relationships with ecosystem partners while identifying opportunities to increase engagement, adoption, and collaboration.

- Develop and maintain program plans, milestones, dependencies, dashboards, KPIs, and executive status reporting.

- Coordinate cross-functional stakeholders across engineering, marketing, developer relations, product management, sales, legal, and finance teams.

- Manage relationships with incubators and accelerators such as startup hubs, innovation networks, and entrepreneurial programs.

- Create engagement plans, run recurring operational meetings, and ensure commitments, deliverables, and obligations are completed.

- Connect startups, developers, researchers, and ecosystem participants with appropriate QNX resources and subject matter experts.

- Manage operational aspects of industry consortiums, standards bodies, and strategic technology initiatives.

- Participate in consortium working groups, track action items, and ensure organizational commitments are fulfilled.

- Manage sponsorship activities and associated contracts, including NDAs, SLAs, SOWs, sponsorship agreements, and academic framework agreements.

- Coordinate procurement and purchasing activities required to support ecosystem investments and programs.

- Track engagement outcomes, program effectiveness, ecosystem investments, renewal cycles, sponsorship commitments, and budget utilization.

- Maintain a partner inventory database and identify opportunities to strengthen ecosystem coverage.

- Develop scalable, repeatable frameworks for: 
- Partner onboarding

- Sponsorship evaluation

- Ecosystem investment reviews

- Success metric tracking

- Quarterly business reviews

- Renewal and exit decisions

- Coordinate QNX participation in hackathons, workshops, conferences, demo days, job fairs, and other community events.

- Partner with marketing teams to develop and promote ecosystem initiatives and developer-focused programs.

- Use modern AI tools responsibly to help automate, streamline, and scale ecosystem operations and reporting activities.

- Travel as needed to support ecosystem partners, events, workshops, and strategic engagements.

 What You Bring 

- Experience managing programs, partnerships, strategic relationships, or ecosystem initiatives within the technology industry.

- Strong project and program management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.

- Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail.

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

- Demonstrated ability to work effectively with executives, engineers, academics, developers, startups, and industry partners.

- Ability to drive initiatives forward through influence, coordination, and strong follow-through.

- Comfort engaging with technical audiences and understanding developer-focused tools, technologies, and platforms.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

- Experience working cross-functionally within a technology-driven organization.

- Understanding of software development concepts, particularly within embedded systems, operating systems, developer platforms, or related technical domains.

- Experience managing external vendors, contracts, partnerships, or business relationships.

- Fluency in English.

 It Would Be Nice If You Had Any of the Following 

- Experience in Developer Relations, Product Management, Technical Program Management, Technical Marketing, Partner Management, or Engineering.

- PMP certification or formal project/program management training.

- Experience working with startups, incubators, accelerators, or venture-backed technology companies.

- Familiarity with embedded systems, real-time operating systems, IoT platforms, or edge computing technologies.

- Experience working with open-source communities, foundations, or developer ecosystems.

- Experience organizing technical workshops, hackathons, conferences, training programs, or community events.

- Experience developing dashboards, metrics, KPIs, Salesforce reporting, or ecosystem analytics.

- Knowledge of procurement, sponsorship management, contract administration, or legal coordination processes.

- Experience collaborating with universities, academic institutions, or research organizations.

- Familiarity with AI-powered productivity tools and workflow automation solutions.

- Additional language skills such as French, German, Japanese, Korean, Swedish, or Mandarin.

 Why Join Us? 

- Help shape the future of the QNX Everywhere developer ecosystem.

- Build relationships with leading technology companies, startups, research institutions, and developer communities around the world.

- Take ownership of high-impact programs that directly influence ecosystem growth and adoption.

- Work alongside passionate experts in embedded systems, open-source software, developer relations, and product development.

- Join a collaborative, innovative team that values curiosity, creativity, and continuous learning.

- Be exposed to emerging technologies, entrepreneurial communities, and the next generation of developers building intelligent connected systems.

greenhouse:block:5371509008.description:
Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn’t work together.

So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.

Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We’re building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.

 The Role 

 Block's Canada Compliance team is building a scalable, technology-enabled compliance function for our regulated Canadian entities - Square Canada and Afterpay Canada. Reporting to the Chief Compliance Officer, Canada, and serving as a designee of the CCO in governance forums, Board meetings, and regulatory engagements, you will be a “full-stack” compliance leader: driving the annual compliance plan end-to-end, overseeing frameworks across AML/ATF, sanctions, the Retail Payment Activities Act (RPAA), consumer protection, privacy, and payment card industry obligations, and co-building the AI-enabled programs and tools that keep both entities aligned with Canadian regulatory expectations and Block's global standards.

 You Will 

- Serve as the Regulatory Program Lead for Block's Canadian regulated entities, acting as a designee of the CCO in governance forums, Board meetings, and regulatory engagements

- Lead end-to-end execution of the annual Canada Compliance Plan -  regulatory change management, monitoring and testing, risk assessments, and policy reviews - delivering against key milestones and regulatory commitments

- Run Canada's compliance programs across AML/ATF (Square Canada MSB), RPAA, the PCI Code of Conduct, and consumer protection and privacy obligations (PIPEDA, CASL, FCAC, provincial requirements), including FINTRAC registration and support for regulatory examinations and audits

- Lead governance and tracking of regulatory commitments, audit actions, and findings - driving issue management and remediation through to closure - while maintaining the compliance risk assessment framework, policies, and governance documentation

- Prepare Board and governance committee materials, translating multi-domain regulatory complexity into clear, decision-ready narratives for senior leadership

- Lead cross-functional regulatory programs across Legal, Risk, Product, Operations, and Engineering, driving operational excellence through process improvement, automation, and AI-enabled compliance solutions

- Coordinate compliance training and targeted regulatory awareness materials for senior leadership, Boards, and business stakeholders

 You Have 

- 10+ years of progressive experience in compliance, financial crime, or regulatory affairs, which must include payments compliance at a regulated payments entity - an MSB, payment service provider, acquirer, or comparable fintech such as Square Canada and serving in, or directly supporting, a senior compliance leadership role (CCO, Deputy CCO, Head of Compliance, CAMLO / Deputy CAMLO)

- Deep knowledge of Canadian AML/ATF legislation (PCMLTFA, FINTRAC guidance), the RPAA, the Code of Conduct for the Payment Card Industry in Canada, consumer protection frameworks (FCAC, PIPEDA, CASL), and Canadian sanctions regimes (SEMA, UN sanctions)

- Executive presence, with experience preparing and presenting Board-level compliance reporting and engaging directly with regulators through examinations and ongoing supervision

- Direct end-to-end working knowledge of payment systems, money services businesses - including payments-specific financial crime typologies and controls

- Hands-on, day-to-day use of AI tools for regulatory analysis, drafting, and process automation - with sound judgment about their limits

- A builder mindset with proven leadership, people management, and stakeholder engagement capabilities in a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment; CAMS, ICA, or equivalent certification

- Bonus points: knowledge of buy-now-pay-later compliance programs, Quebec regulatory regime, hands-on RPAA compliance, OSFI guidelines, the AUSTRAC / Australian AML/CTF regime, or bilingual English/French

 Technologies We Use and Teach 

- Protecht (GRC / issue and risk management)

- AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT / OpenAI Enterprise / GitHub) for regulatory analysis, drafting, and process automation

- JIRA and Confluence (program and documentation management)

- Looker / Tableau (reporting and dashboards)

 Use of AI in Our Hiring Process

Remote work, medical insurance, flexible time off, retirement savings plans, and modern family planning are just some of our offering.  Check out our other benefits at Block.

gem:blue-j:am9icG9zdDoappk5NpRc8mKVEWdgA.description:
About Blue J
Blue J is the leading generative AI solution for tax professionals and one of Canada's fastest-growing AI companies. Headquartered in Toronto, we're a high-growth B2B SaaS company building industry-leading tax research software that helps accountants find accurate answers to complex tax questions with greater speed and confidence.
Backed by a $122M USD Series D funding round, we're scaling rapidly across North America and the UK while continuing to push the boundaries of what's possible with AI. By combining advanced technology with deep tax expertise, we empower tax professionals to work more efficiently, make better decisions, and deliver greater value to their clients.
A Note on Location
This is a hybrid role based in Toronto. We’re looking for someone who can join us in-office 2 times per week in our downtown office, while also enjoying flexibility to work remotely the rest of the time. All candidates must be eligible to work in Canada. 
To help you get off to a great start, we bring all new team members together for their first three days of onboarding. If you’re based outside of our local commuting area, Blue J will arrange and cover your travel and accommodation.
The Opportunity
This is a unique opportunity to join Blue J at a stage of rapid growth, taking on dedicated ownership of a key part of our product roadmap. Working day-to-day with a cross-functional team (Product, Design, Engineering) and partnering closely with engineering leadership, you'll bridge the gap between initial discovery and long-term product success. You'll shape how tax professionals experience Blue J day to day, building the strategy and systems that turn core product value into consistent and lasting usage.
What You’ll be Doing
Partner with engineering, design, and other cross-functional teams to help define and execute the product roadmap, from concept through launch.
Understand the competitive landscape and evaluate market trends to inform product strategy and prioritization.
Engage with end users and internal stakeholders to identify pain points, market opportunities, and unmet needs.
Partner with Marketing and Sales to develop go-to-market strategies and ensure successful product launches.
Become an expert on our clients and end users, using a mix of quantitative and qualitative research to shape product requirements and improvements.
Write clear specs and user stories, and work closely with engineering to scope, sequence, and ship features.
Establish, monitor, and measure success metrics after launch, and consistently incorporate usage data and customer feedback into product decisions.
Communicate roadmap, priorities, and trade-offs clearly to stakeholders across the organization.
What You Offer Blue J 
5+ years of product management experience in a B2B SaaS company, with a solid technical foundation
Comfortable engaging deeply with engineers on architecture, trade-offs, and implementation details, and experience taking products from concept to launch alongside a software engineering team.
Comfortable balancing qualitative and quantitative inputs (user research, data analysis, market trends) to make prioritization calls.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to break down ambiguous problems into actionable plans.
Excellent communication skills (oral, written, and presentation) to align diverse audiences around a shared direction.
Enjoys working across teams in a collaborative environment, with a high level of diplomacy and tact.
Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant experience required.
Comfortable leveraging AI tools and emerging technologies to drive efficiency, improve workflows, and stay ahead of industry trends.
What We Offer You 
A rare opportunity  to make a difference and help shape the future of our product.
A mission-driven culture where your work directly advances clarity, efficiency, and accessibility in tax research.
Competitive base salary, stock options, and benefits designed to support you and your family.
A collaborative, ambitious, and supportive team that values innovation, respect, and fun.
The excitement of a fast-growing, well-funded company with clear momentum, and the resources to back bold initiatives.
The Core Values that Define Our Culture
We are customer-focused
We put team over self
We are pleasant and playful
We are open to better ideas
We move fast and fix things
What to Expect in the Interview Process
We anticipate a high volume of applicants for this role and are excited to grow our team. A human will review each application and get back to you as soon as possible. We appreciate your patience and look forward to connecting with you! 
Interview Process
Chat with Bailey, Talent Acquisition Manager
Meet Adam Haines, VP of Product
Present your Case study to Adam Haines, VP of Product, Matt Malden, Chief Product Officer, and one other stakeholder 
Meet Ben, our CEO
We believe our strength is built on diversity of thought, and encourage candidates from all backgrounds and experiences to apply. We value inclusiveness and are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
We strive to create an inclusive and accessible hiring experience for all candidates. If you need any accommodations during the interview process, please let us know in your application. Our team is dedicated to providing the necessary support and making reasonable adjustments to ensure a smooth process for everyone.
How We Use AI in Our Hiring Process
To ensure transparency, we want candidates to know that Blue J uses AI-enabled tools within our applicant tracking system to help organize applications and highlight profiles that match the key requirements for each role.
AI does not make hiring decisions.
Every application is reviewed by a member of our Talent team, and all decisions throughout the process are made by humans.
We use these tools to support efficiency and consistency, not to replace human judgment and we’re committed to a fair, thoughtful, and equitable 
experience for every candidate.
Compensation
The base pay range for this role i
s $130-150K CAD 
per year.
This is a Level 
3 in
 Blue J’s career level framework. We use levels to define the expected scope, autonomy, impact, decision-making, and experience for each role. Final compensation will be set fairly and thoughtfully based on experience, expertise, and alignment with the role’s responsibilities. While all candidates are expected to bring directly relevant experience, the top of the range is typically reserved for individuals who demonstrate exceptional depth in the role’s core competencies, a strong track record of impact in similar environments, and the ability to operate with a high degree of autonomy from day one.

Technology 

 Role Overview
 The Global Product Owner, Observability is accountable for defining, owning, and executing the enterprise observability strategy for the bank. This role owns the enterprise-wide observability roadmap, ensuring consistent, scalable, and cost-effective observability capabilities are delivered across all technology domains.

Operating with enterprise influence, this role provides strategic direction and dotted-line leadership to three horizontal capability teams—Enterprise Monitoring Tools, Application Performance Monitoring (APM), and Site Reliability Engineering (SRE)—ensuring their priorities, investments, and execution are aligned to the enterprise roadmap.

The role regularly engages with senior and executive leadership, translating complex technical concepts into clear business outcomes, progress updates, and value realization.
 Key Accountabilities
 Enterprise Strategy & Roadmap Ownership
 - Define, maintain, and evolve the bank-wide observability vision, strategy, and multi-year roadmap spanning infrastructure, platforms, applications, and digital services.
- Establish enterprise observability standards, patterns, and guardrails to ensure consistency, scalability, and reliability across all technology domains.
- Ensure observability capabilities extend to AI-enabled systems, providing visibility into model behavior, performance, and operational health as part of the broader observability strategy.
- Align the observability roadmap with cloud strategy, reliability objectives, security requirements, and business priorities.
 Cross-Team Leadership & Alignment
 - Provide dotted-line accountability and strategic direction for Enterprise Monitoring Tools, APM, and SRE teams.
- Ensure team roadmaps, backlogs, and delivery plans align with the enterprise observability strategy, including coverage for cloud-native and AI-enabled workloads.
- Drive horizontal alignment across engineering, operations, architecture, data, and platform teams in a federated environment.
 Execution, Measurement & Reporting
 - Define enterprise-level KPIs, success metrics, and maturity measures for observability, reliability, and operational resilience.
- Ensure observability metrics include appropriate coverage for AI-enabled services, such as model stability, drift indicators, and operational risk signals where applicable.
- Monitor and measure progress against the roadmap, including adoption, benefits realization, risk reduction, and cost efficiency.
- Prepare and present clear, outcome-focused updates to executive-level audiences, translating technical signals into business and risk-focused insights.
 Platform Optimization, Cost & Scale
 - Optimize observability platform efficiency, performance, and cost across multiple vendors.
- Lead simplification and standardization efforts to reduce tooling sprawl and operational complexity.
- Ensure observability platforms and practices are easily scalable up and down to support changing business demand and consumption patterns.
 Reliability, Automation & NoOps Progression
 - Advance self-healing and auto-remediation capabilities using actionable telemetry, automation, and policy-driven responses across platforms and services.
- Partner with SRE and platform teams to reduce manual operational effort and improve mean time to detect and remediate incidents.
- Leverage observability signals—including those from AI-enabled systems—to support intelligent automation and controlled remediation.
- Drive the long-term progression toward NoOps-aligned operating models, where observability, automation, and governance enable safe, scalable, and repeatable operations.
 Governance, Security & AI Explainability
 - Ensure observability capabilities support governance, security, and risk management, including traceability, logging, and auditability.
- Establish observability requirements for AI-enabled systems to support explainability, accountability, and model risk management.
- Partner with security, risk, data, and architecture teams to ensure compliance with enterprise security, privacy, and regulatory standards.
 Required Qualifications
 - Senior-level experience owning enterprise-scale technology platforms or products.
- Deep hands-on experience with Dynatrace, including APM, infrastructure monitoring, and advanced observability use cases.
- Strong experience with cloud-native observability tooling in Azure and AWS environments.
- Proven track record delivering and governing multi-year roadmaps across large, federated organizations.
- Strong executive-level communication skills, with experience presenting to senior leadership forums.
- Demonstrated success in platform rationalization, vendor management, and cost optimization.
 Preferred Qualifications
 - Experience in financial services or other highly regulated enterprise environments.
- Strong exposure to SRE operating models, reliability engineering, and automation at scale.
- Background working within large, matrixed, global technology organizations.
 Note: This is a hybrid role.

 BMO Capital Markets is a leading, full-service North American-based financial services provider, with over 2,700 professionals in 30 locations around the world, including 20 offices in North America, offering corporate, institutional and government clients access to a complete range of investment and corporate banking products and services. BMO Capital Markets is a member of BMO Financial Group (NYSE, TSX: BMO), one of the largest diversified financial services providers in North America with US$1.0 trillion total assets and approximately 54,000 employees as of January 31, 2025. 

 What is the opportunity? 
 The Data Cognition Team (DCT) is BMO Capital Markets’ AI engineering and enablement team, with nearly a decade of experience building and deploying AI solutions in complex, regulated financial services environments.

 As Vice President, AI Strategy & Product Management, you will operate at the intersection of business strategy, product management, and AI. You will own the vision, strategy, roadmap, delivery, and adoption of high-value AI and data products, working closely with front-office users, senior leaders, engineers, data scientists, UX, risk, and compliance partners.

 The successful candidate will bring the judgment, influence, and hands-on product leadership required to scale trusted AI and data products and capabilities in a highly regulated Capital Markets environment.

 What will you do? 

- Own the vision, strategy, roadmap, investment priorities, and business outcomes for one or more AI-enabled products or capabilities supporting Capital Markets users and workflows.

- Develop a deep understanding of front-office and business needs; translate strategic pain points into clear product opportunities.

- Lead product discovery, experimentation, and investment decisions, including prototypes, proofs of concept, and minimum viable products, to validate assumptions before scaling.

- Align senior business, technology, data, and control-function stakeholders around product priorities, trade-offs, risks, and expected outcomes.

- Establish product goals and success measures, monitor adoption and performance, and use quantitative and qualitative insights to improve products and demonstrate business impact.

- Present product recommendations, performance, risks, and strategic choices to senior leadership and governance forums.

- Apply Responsible AI, data governance, privacy, security, model risk, and regulatory considerations throughout the product lifecycle in partnership with control functions.

 What do you need to succeed? 

- Bachelor’s degree in a related field; an advanced degree or relevant professional designation is an asset.

- 6+ years of relevant experience in product management, strategy, digital transformation, or technology delivery, ideally within Capital Markets or financial services; familiarity with AI and data product management is an asset.

- Ability to understand complex Capital Markets workflows and translate between business users and technical teams; direct experience with sales, trading, research, banking, or client-coverage workflows is an asset.

- Hands-on familiarity with AI and LLM-enabled products, including retrieval-augmented generation, evaluation, and production deployment considerations.

- Strong written and verbal communication, analytical judgment, structured problem-solving, and stakeholder-management skills.

- Ability to develop informed perspectives on the evolving AI landscape, including emerging technologies, industry trends, and market practices, and translate relevant developments into strategic implications and opportunities for BMO Capital Markets.

workday:bmo/External:R260025553.description:
Application Deadline: 

10/30/2026 

 Address: 
250 Yonge Street 

 Job Family Group:

Customer Solutions 

 About the Opportunity: 
 Imagine helping build the next generation of AI-powered products that transform how Commercial Banking teams work, serve clients, and make decisions. 
 As a Product Owner within BMO's AI & Analytics team, you will operate at the intersection of business, technology, data, and user experience, turning complex challenges and strategic opportunities into solutions that deliver measurable business value. 
 You will partner with business leaders, relationship managers, sales professionals, data scientists, engineers, and product partners to identify opportunities, shape product direction, and drive AI-enabled capabilities from concept through delivery, adoption, measurement, and continuous improvement. 
 This role is ideal for someone who thrives in ambiguity, takes ownership, enjoys solving complex business problems, and is energized by turning vision into outcomes that create meaningful impact across Commercial Banking. 

 Product Owner, AI & Analytics 
 What if your next role wasn't about managing a backlog?
 What if it was about taking complex business challenges and transforming them into AI-powered products that change how bankers work, how clients are served, and how decisions are made?
 As a Product Owner within BMO's AI & Analytics team, you will help shape and deliver innovative products that leverage analytics, artificial intelligence, machine learning, and data-driven insights to solve meaningful challenges across Commercial Banking.
 You will work directly with business leaders, relationship managers, sales professionals, data scientists, engineers, and product partners to identify opportunities, shape product strategy, and transform ideas into products that drive measurable business value.
 This role is ideal for someone who enjoys shaping product vision, solving complex business problems, and leading products from concept through adoption and business impact.

 What You'll Do 
 Turn Ideas Into Products
 Take customer needs, business challenges, and strategic opportunities and transform them into products that create measurable business value.
 You will help answer questions such as:

- What problem are we solving?

- Why does it matter?

- Who are we solving it for?

- What experience will create the greatest value?

- What should we prioritize first?

- How do we build something users will adopt and trust?
 Starting with customer needs, business challenges, and strategic opportunities, you will help develop product strategies, priorities, and roadmaps that deliver measurable business outcomes.

 Lead Discovery and Shape Product Direction 

- Partner with business stakeholders to understand challenges, opportunities, workflows, priorities, and user needs.

- Facilitate discovery discussions that align stakeholders, challenge assumptions, and uncover opportunities for innovation.

- Gather and synthesize customer, business, operational, and data-driven insights to identify opportunities, evaluate alternatives, and inform product direction.

- Examine processes and workflows to identify opportunities for simplification, optimization, and improved business performance.

- Help stakeholders define, prioritize, and validate opportunities that create value.

- Challenge assumptions and ask thoughtful questions that help teams focus on the problems that matter most.

 Apply Business Acumen to Drive Better Decisions 

- Develop a strong understanding of Commercial Banking objectives, customer needs, operational processes, and strategic priorities.

- Evaluate opportunities through both a product and business lens, balancing customer value, commercial impact, risk, effort, and long-term benefit.

- Build credibility with business leaders by connecting product decisions to measurable outcomes.

- Help stakeholders evaluate trade-offs and investment decisions that maximize value.

 Bridge Business and Technology 
 Act as the link between business stakeholders and delivery teams, translating business goals, user workflows, data requirements, and technology capabilities into clear product requirements.
 Translate business needs into:

- Product roadmaps

- Product requirements

- User stories

- Acceptance criteria

- Prioritized backlogs
 Ensure teams understand what needs to be built, why it matters, and how success will be measured.

 Champion the User Experience 
 Advocate for end users throughout the product lifecycle.
 Continuously evaluate how products can become:

- Easier to use

- More valuable

- More intuitive

- Stay current on emerging trends, evolving risks, and regulatory developments; recommend adjustments to ensure oversight practices remain effective.

- Take on broader work or enterprise‑wide deliverables as required.

- Typically, 7+ years of progressive experience in credit risk management, policy, strategy, or governance preferably within retail lending or OSFI‑regulated environments.

- Strong understanding of credit lifecycle economics, ROE drivers, and risk‑return optimization principles.

- Advanced skills in Python, SQL, SAS, R, or comparable analytical tools; ability to translate complex analysis for senior audiences.

- Strong communication, influencing, and stakeholder management skills; able to operate autonomously in a fast‑paced environment.

- Access to senior leadership, cross‑functional partners, and complex analytical challenges that support ongoing career development.

- Flexibility, autonomy, and support to build a long‑term career at one of North America’s most respected financial institutions.

- Own the end-to-end lifecycle of the assigned products and capabilities, including strategy, design, value proposition, pricing, implementation, servicing, enhancement, sustainment and retirement.

- Ensure product requirements, documentation, templates, customer and employee materials, policies and procedures accurately reflect approved product and system functionality.

- Assess product and process issues, establish root causes and lead sustainable solutions that improve customer outcomes, operational effectiveness and control performance.

- Maintain an integrated view of product, process, technology, data and channel interdependencies and ensure changes are appropriately sequenced and governed.
 Portfolio economics, pricing and performance 

- Establish and monitor financial, customer, growth, utilization, retention, operational and risk indicators for the portfolio.

- Develop a deep understanding of portfolio economics and performance drivers, including balances, originations, revenue, margin, expenses, capital considerations, customer behaviour and channel performance.

- Lead or support pricing and value-proposition strategies, including analysis of customer impact, competitiveness, financial outcomes, operational feasibility and risk implications.

- Partner with Finance, Treasury, Analytics, Risk and channel stakeholders on forecasting, performance reporting and recommended corrective actions.

- Prepare clear executive-level insights, recommendations and decisions required to improve portfolio growth, profitability and risk-adjusted performance.
 Customer, frontline and channel experience 

- Champion the end-to-end customer and frontline experience across acquisition, fulfilment, servicing, renewal, refinance, re-advance and other relevant lifecycle events.

- Use customer research, behavioural data, frontline feedback, complaints, operational insights and journey analysis to identify friction points and prioritize improvements.

- Partner with Marketing, Analytics, Digital, Operations and distribution channels to develop effective value propositions, offers, campaigns, education, training and adoption plans.

- Ensure frontline teams have clear product guidance, job aids, documentation, escalation paths and change-management support.

- Promote simple, transparent and consistent experiences across assisted and digital channels.
 Business cases, investment and roadmap prioritization 

- Identify product and capability opportunities and develop business cases that articulate customer, financial, strategic, operational, technology and risk outcomes.

- Evaluate solution options, delivery dependencies, expected benefits, implementation costs and return on investment.

- Recommend investment priorities and roadmap trade-offs; support project and budget approval processes and maintain visibility of expected outcomes and benefits.

- Govern material roadmap changes through the appropriate approval and escalation forums.

- Ensure initiatives remain aligned to approved scope, intended benefits and product strategy throughout delivery and sustainment.
 Cross-functional execution and change leadership 

- Lead complex, cross-functional initiatives from opportunity definition and business requirements through implementation, readiness, adoption, benefits realization and sustainment.

- Establish clear outcomes, decision requirements, accountabilities, dependencies, risks and escalation paths.

- Build alignment among Technology, Credit Risk, Operations, Collections, Finance, Treasury, Legal, Compliance, Marketing, Analytics and frontline-channel partners.

- Monitor delivery progress, resolve obstacles and escalate material scope, funding, risk, customer or timing decisions to the appropriate governance body.

- Lead change-management activities, including stakeholder engagement, readiness, communications, training, implementation and post-launch monitoring.
 Risk, regulatory, audit and control governance 

- Manage product risks in accordance with BMO’s Risk Management Framework, Risk Culture and approved Risk Appetite.

- Maintain an effective understanding of legal, regulatory, compliance, credit, operational, conduct, technology, data and third-party risks affecting the portfolio.

- Partner with Risk, Compliance, Legal, Corporate Audit and operational control partners to identify control gaps, develop sustainable remediation and demonstrate ongoing effectiveness.

- Lead or support product reviews, attestations, regulatory reporting, audit responses, control testing and maintenance of product policies, directives and procedures.

- Ensure product and pricing decisions are risk-informed, appropriately documented and approved through established authorities.

- Surface emerging risks promptly and drive timely escalation and remediation.
 External partners and complex escalations 

- Develop and maintain effective relationships with relevant external partners, vendors and industry contacts.

- Establish expectations, monitor performance and support negotiations or issue resolution while balancing customer outcomes, cost, risk and service quality.

- Provide senior product leadership for complex customer, frontline, product, policy or operational escalations.

- Assess exceptions and escalations within delegated authority and ensure matters outside that authority are advanced to the correct decision maker.
 People Leadership 

- Lead, coach and develop product-management colleagues, establishing clear mandates, priorities, expected outcomes and accountability.

- Build a collaborative, inclusive and high-performing team connected to BMO’s purpose, values and Home Financing strategy.

- Attract, retain and develop talent; provide regular feedback, recognize strong contribution and address performance or capability gaps.

- Delegate meaningful accountability and provide appropriate challenge, guidance and decision support.

- Develop product-management capability, subject-matter depth, succession readiness and cross-training to reduce key-person dependency.

- Promote collaboration across functional and operating groups and create an environment in which colleagues can constructively challenge, learn and deliver together.

 Qualifications and Experience 

- Typically 9+ years of relevant experience in banking product management, home financing, secured lending, consumer credit, financial-services strategy or a closely related field.

- Post-secondary degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Commerce or a related field of study, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

- Senior-level experience developing product strategies, multi-year roadmaps and business cases and managing products across their full lifecycle.

- Strong knowledge of Canadian retail banking and home financing, including secured-lending products, pricing, customer and channel considerations, product economics, delivery infrastructure and applicable regulatory requirements.

- Demonstrated experience with portfolio performance, financial analysis, forecasting, market research, competitive analysis and data-driven decision-making.

- Strong experience managing risk associated with new and existing products, including product policies, controls, regulatory or audit requirements and sustainable remediation.

- Demonstrated success leading complex, cross-functional initiatives in a large, matrixed organization.

- People-management experience, including coaching, delegation, talent development and building team capability.

- Experience managing senior stakeholders and developing effective external-partner or vendor relationships.

- Experience translating complex product, financial, risk, customer and technology considerations into clear executive recommendations.

 Skills and Capabilities

- End-to-end product lifecycle management

- Home financing and secured-lending knowledge

- Financial management and portfolio economics

- Pricing and value-proposition development

- Customer and frontline experience

- Product policy and documentation governance

- Cross-functional delivery and change leadership

- People leadership, coaching and capability building

- Executive communication and storytelling

- Stakeholder influence and relationship management

 Independent Risk Oversight & Effective Challenge

 What We Offer

- A culture that values integrity, inclusion, innovation, and high performance.

- Access to senior leaders, cross‑functional partners, and complex oversight challenges that support ongoing career development.
