 The Product Manager, Home Financing is accountable for the end-to-end ownership, performance, and evolution of the Home Financing leads program. The role also owns the analytical execution of monitoring tools used to measure the success of acquisition programs and lead strategies and plays a critical role in advancing the Home Financing acquisition growth strategy.

The role sits at the center of leads program management, data, forecasting, and performance insights. It combines strong analytical and problem-solving skills with cross-functional leadership to translate complex information into clear recommendations, optimize lead generation and conversion, improve acquisition outcomes, and support disciplined risk management.

Mandate
 Leads Program Ownership, Performance Analytics & Reporting 

- Owns the Home Financing leads program end to end, including program strategy, performance management, operating processes, stakeholder alignment, and continuous improvement.

- Owns regular application, funding, and origination reporting across Home Financing acquisition programs, lead sources, and channels.

- Develops and maintains forecasting models for leads, applications, fundings, and volumes to support planning and performance management.

- Analyzes lead quality, conversion funnels, and acquisition performance to identify trends, capacity constraints, root causes, and performance gaps by segment, channel, partner, and program.

- Defines and monitors key performance indicators and recommends actions to improve lead generation, distribution, conversion, and overall acquisition growth.

- Delivers clear, executive-ready insights that connect performance outcomes to underlying drivers, strategic implications, and prioritized actions.
 Product Management 

- Plays a critical role in shaping and executing the Home Financing acquisition growth strategy, with accountability for translating strategic priorities into measurable product and leads program outcomes.

- Monitors key product, lead, conversion, and growth metrics to identify trends and recommend action plans.

- Reviews complex business issues, identifies root causes and gaps, and develops practical solutions.

- Provides competitive analysis and benchmarking to identify product strengths, growth opportunities, and market gaps.

- Analyzes customer and consumer insights, channel data, and lead performance to identify opportunities and inform product and acquisition decisions.
 Advisory 

- Develops solutions and makes recommendations based on an understanding of the business strategy and stakeholder needs.

- Recommends and implements solutions based on analysis of issues and implications for the business.

- Assists in the development of strategic plans and forecasts.

- Identifies emerging issues and market trends to inform decision-making.
 Strategy / Strategic Initiatives 

- Contributes to the development and execution of the Home Financing acquisition growth strategy, with a focus on building scalable and effective lead generation, distribution, and conversion capabilities.

- Leads strategic initiatives related to the leads program in collaboration with internal and external stakeholders.

- Conducts independent analysis and structured problem solving to resolve strategic and operational issues.

- Develops business cases by identifying needs, analyzing potential options, and assessing expected returns on investment.

- Translates data and market insights into recommendations that strengthen the acquisition pipeline and improve customer and business outcomes.

- Provides recommendations on product lifecycle and acquisition program enhancements.
 Relationship Management 

- Builds effective relationships with internal/external stakeholders.

- Ensures alignment between stakeholders.
 Data / Analytics 

- Breaks down strategic problems, and analyzes data and information to provide insights and recommendations.

- Monitors and tracks performance, and addresses any issues.

- Designs and produces regular and ad-hoc reports, and dashboards.
 Qualifications: 

- Experience in the residential mortgage industry / secured lending product management.

- Demonstrated ownership of a leads, acquisition, referral, or comparable growth program, including strategy, execution, performance management, and continuous improvement.

- Strong experience working with retail and business product fundamentals, including product design, functionality, and related policies and procedures.

- Researching market trends – in depth

- Analytics and reporting – in-depth

- Financial Understanding – in-depth

- Verbal & written communication skills - In-depth.

- Collaboration & team skills - In depth.

- Advanced analytical skills, including the ability to interpret complex data, identify performance drivers, and translate findings into actionable recommendations.

- Strong structured problem-solving skills, including root-cause analysis, option assessment, and resolution of ambiguous business issues.

- Possesses a university degree in business/commerce, data sciences, engineering, finance and/or mathematics (graduate level degrees preferred) and/or 5 to 7 years of experience in product management and/or consulting

- Familiar with/ willing to learn one or more industry leading data and analytics tool sets including, but not limited to PowerBI, SQL, SAS and Tableau

 Salary : 

$70,000.00 - $150,000.00 
 Pay Type: 

Salaried

 Salaries will vary based on factors such as location, skills, experience, education, and qualifications for the role, and may include a commission structure. For commission roles, the salary listed above represents BMO Financial Group’s expected target for the first year in this position.

 BMO Financial Group’s total compensation package will vary based on the pay type of the position and may include performance-based incentives, discretionary bonuses, as well as other perks and rewards. successfactors:jobs.canadalife.com:14425.title: Solutions Architect - Wealth Management
successfactors:jobs.canadalife.com:14425.description:
Permanent Full Time  

 - 

 The Individual Wealth Technology team within Application Delivery, Canada and Lifeco, is seeking a Solutions Architect. This role is a match for you if you are passionate about Wealth and working to innovate, define, and deliver high quality technology solutions. The Solutions Architect will play a key role in our team by serving as a trusted advisor to our internal clients and partnering with the business to enable and support delivery.

 The Solutions Architect will collaborate with their portfolio & technology teams as well as business partners, sponsors, and stakeholders to contribute to the development of strategies and roadmaps for the business. They will work to define and maintain architecture artifacts for supporting project delivery and application support. They will play an active role in setting the technical vision and direction for solutions, ensuring consistency with overall enterprise and portfolio architecture. During the execution of these activities this may, at times, require hands-on development. The Solutions Architect will also have the opportunity to effect change within the organization by incorporating new patterns and/or technologies into new ways of working that improve business value. 

 At our company, the customer is at the center of what we do. The Individual Wealth Technology team is looking for innovative, collaborative, fun-loving candidates that exemplify this and can demonstrate it in their work. We care about the financial, physical, and mental well-being of our customers and our staff. 

 What you will do: 

- Defines and facilitates a solution architecture that leverages enterprise capabilities and efficient usage of processes, technology, data and people to align these capabilities 

- Consults with business partners and delivery stakeholders 

- Participates in the definition of, and helps to maintain the technical solution architecture(s) 

- Actively participates in the discussions which drive the architectural decisions for the team and develop the technical vision and direction for the solution. 

- Defines and creates candidate architecture solutions 

- Defines and maintains solution architectures for applications 

- Ensures quality designs when involved in solutioning any infrastructure and development issues. 

- Proactively identifies opportunities where solutions can enhance organizational efficiency 

- Actively engaged as the team works to solve complex problems 

- Keeps abreast of latest technological/industry trends 

- Acts as trusted technology advisor/advocate for business units 

- Supports the development of technology roadmaps and proposals to achieve business plans. 

- Works closely with all team members to create solutions that accommodate future architectural changes and designs 

- Identify critical driving forces of process, data, people and technology and identify any changes or improvements that can be made. 

- Ability to look beyond traditional business concepts and drill to the heart of a given concept 

 What you will bring: 

- Bachelor Computer Science / Software Engineering degree or equivalent experience. 

- Minimum 7 years of related experience in technology environments. 

- Minimum of 4 years working as an architect with experience on large scale projects enabling business to achieve the goals and objectives. 

- Experience leading architecture activities in conjunction with the Enterprise Architect or Portfolio Architect. 

- Able to act as a mentor to less experienced architects and developers/engineers. 

- Architectural experience using modelling languages and frameworks (UML, TOGAF, Archimate, 4+1 View Model, LeanIX), architecture practices and principles in Business, Information (data), Application, Technology, and Security architecture disciplines 

- Experience in Wealth Management technology ecosystems. 

- Proven business acumen demonstrated through a broad understanding of an organization, functions, practices, trends and competition. 

- Financial knowledge demonstrated through the ability to calculate the Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) and Return on Investment (ROI). 

- Values simplicity, ability to simplify difficult concepts. 

- Ability to foster collaborative stakeholder relationships across multiple business functions. 

- Ability to effectively communicate high-level concepts and solutions with technology and business teams and stakeholders.  

- Capable of high level of analysis of the big picture while maintaining a level of detail appropriate to the context of a variety of situations. 

- Understands the framework (i.e. structure, people, processes, and technology) that supports an organization’s strategy and can successfully leverage it. 

- Understands policy, practice, and standards to ensure design and delivery of compliant solutions. 

- Able to challenge business and technical constraints in support of continuous improvement. 

- Self-starter with the ability to comfortably operate in ambiguity. 

 - 

 The base salary for this position is between $113,500.00 - $163,500.00 annually. This represents base salary only and does not represent other variable compensation components of our total compensation ( i.e. annual bonus, commission etc). If you are selected to move forward in our recruitment process, your recruiter will be able to discuss additional details of our total rewards program with you. 

 Career opportunities will be open a minimum of 5 business days from the date of posting, closing dates will vary depending on the search activity. All applications received will be reviewed on a rolling basis. 

 Grow with Canada Life   

 We’re united by a shared purpose: to improve the financial, physical and mental well-being of Canadians. Our company is trusted by 1 in 3 Canadians and contributes to the strength of communities across the country.    

 We’re looking for people who live our values everyday: we step up, we do the right thing, and we deliver – for our customers, communities and each other. Are you someone who always strives to do the right thing, who steps up for themselves and others, and who delivers with impact? Then we want to hear from you!   

 What we offer :   

 We’re committed to supporting our employees through every stage of their career. Here’s what you can expect as a full-time or part-time permanent team member:  

- Career Development : Opportunities for career advancement, access to industry-leading learning programs and up to $2,000 annually towards education reimbursement.  

- Health & Wellness:  Flexible health and dental benefits, plus a $5,000 mental health benefit to support your well-being.  

- Time Off:  In addition to regular vacation and personal days, we support community involvement with a volunteer day.   

- Financial Security:  Company-matching pension plan, share ownership program and additional investment options.  

- Rewards and Recognition:  Employee recognition programs, service milestone celebrations, employee discounts and more!     

- Emphasis on Community : We provide a workplace where employees feel connected and supported through Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), mentorship programs, social clubs and events.   

 Learn more about  Canada Life .   

 We’re committed to removing barriers and ensuring equal access to employment. Applicants requiring reasonable accommodation during the application process may contact   talentacquisitioncanada@canadalife.com . All information provided will be handled in accordance with applicable laws and Canada Life policies.   

 Canada Life   would like to thank all applicants, however only those who qualify for an interview will be contacted .

successfactors:jobs.canadalife.com:14445.description:
Permanent Full Time  

 - 

 The Individual Wealth Technology team within Application Delivery, Canada and Lifeco, is seeking a Solutions Architect. This role is a match for you if you are passionate about Wealth and working to innovate, define, and deliver high quality technology solutions. The Solutions Architect will play a key role in our team by serving as a trusted advisor to our internal clients and partnering with the business to enable and support delivery. 

 The Solutions Architect will collaborate with their portfolio & technology teams as well as business partners, sponsors, and stakeholders to contribute to the development of strategies and roadmaps for the business. They will work to define and maintain architecture artifacts for supporting project delivery and application support. They will play an active role in setting the technical vision and direction for solutions, ensuring consistency with overall enterprise and portfolio architecture. During the execution of these activities this may, at times, require hands-on development. The Solutions Architect will also have the opportunity to effect change within the organization by incorporating new patterns and/or technologies into new ways of working that improve business value. 

 What you will do: 

- Defines and facilitates a solution architecture that leverages enterprise capabilities and efficient usage of processes, technology, data and people to align these capabilities 

- Consults with business partners and delivery stakeholders 

- Participates in the definition of, and helps to maintain the technical solution architecture(s) 

- Actively participates in the discussions which drive the architectural decisions for the team and develop the technical vision and direction for the solution. 

- Defines and creates candidate architecture solutions 

- Defines and maintains solution architectures for applications 

- Ensures quality designs when involved in solutioning any infrastructure and development issues. 

- Proactively identifies opportunities where solutions can enhance organizational efficiency 

- Actively engaged as the team works to solve complex problems 

- Keeps abreast of latest technological/industry trends 

- Acts as trusted technology advisor/advocate for business units 

- Supports the development of technology roadmaps and proposals to achieve business plans. 

- Works closely with all team members to create solutions that accommodate future architectural changes and designs 

- Identify critical driving forces of process, data, people and technology and identify any changes or improvements that can be made. 

- Ability to look beyond traditional business concepts and drill to the heart of a given concept 

 What you will bring: 

- Bachelor Computer Science / Software Engineering degree or equivalent experience. 

- Minimum 7 years of related experience in technology environments. 

- Minimum of 4 years working as an architect with experience on large scale projects enabling business to achieve the goals and objectives. 

- Experience leading architecture activities in conjunction with the Enterprise Architect or Portfolio Architect. 

- Able to act as a mentor to less experienced architects and developers/engineers. 

- Experience in Wealth Management technology ecosystems. 

- Experience with Web Technologies and Networking TCP/IP, DNS, Proxy, Reverse Proxy, SSL/TLS, SFTPProven business acumen demonstrated through a broad understanding of an organization, functions, practices, trends and competition. 

- Financial knowledge demonstrated through the ability to calculate the Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) and Return on Investment (ROI). 

- Values simplicity, ability to simplify difficult concepts. 

- Ability to foster collaborative stakeholder relationships across multiple business functions. 

- Ability to effectively communicate high-level concepts and solutions with technology and business teams and stakeholders.  

- Capable of high level of analysis of the big picture while maintaining a level of detail appropriate to the context of a variety of situations. 

- Understands the framework ( i.e. structure, people, processes, and technology) that supports an organization’s strategy and can successfully leverage it. 

- Understands policy, practice, and standards to ensure design and delivery of compliant solutions. 

- Able to challenge business and technical constraints in support of continuous improvement. 

- Self-starter with the ability to comfortably operate in ambiguity. 

- Experience with application modernization 

- Experience in the financial services industry 

- Experience with virtualization, service architecture, and cloud computing 

- Development experience in RDBMS, modern programming language(s) and frameworks, services, SDLC, automation, agile 

- Architectural experience using modelling languages and frameworks (UML, TOGAF, Archimate, 4+1 View Model, etc, LeanIX), architecture practices and principles in Business, Information (data), Application, Technology, and Security architecture disciplines 

- Experience with Java Application Servers would be an asset 

- Experience with SSO would be an asset. 

- TOGAF Level 1 and 2 Certification 

- One or more BAITS domain certifications 

 - 

 The base salary for this position is between $94,800.00 - $144,800.00 annually. This represents base salary only and does not represent other variable compensation components of our total compensation ( i.e. annual bonus, commission etc). If you are selected to move forward in our recruitment process, your recruiter will be able to discuss additional details of our total rewards program with you. 

 Career opportunities will be open a minimum of 5 business days from the date of posting, closing dates will vary depending on the search activity. All applications received will be reviewed on a rolling basis. 

 Grow with Canada Life

All information provided will be handled in accordance with applicable laws and Canada Life policies.

workday:canadiantirecorporation/Enterpri.description:
Number of Openings: 2

 We’re looking for multiple Solution Architects to design and govern end-to-end solutions across the retail value chain— Supply Chain & Logistics, Store Technology, Merchandising, eCommerce/Digital , and enabling capabilities including AI/ML, data platforms, integration, and cloud . You will translate business outcomes into secure, scalable, and resilient architectures, partnering closely with product, engineering, data, security, and operations teams.

 Architecture & Solution Design 

- Lead solution architecture for initiatives across supply chain, stores, merchandising, and digital platforms.

- Produce and maintain architecture deliverables: high-level designs, integration flows, sequence diagrams, data flows, NFRs, deployment views, and architecture decision records (ADRs).

- Define target-state architectures and transition roadmaps aligned to enterprise standards.

- Ensure solutions meet non-functional requirements: availability, performance, resiliency, scalability, security, and operability

 Retail Domain Enablement (Cross-domain) 

- Architect solutions across domains including:

- Supply Chain & Logistics: demand planning, replenishment, inventory visibility, WMS/TMS integration, ASN, yard management, DC automation, last-mile.

- Store Technology: POS, store inventory, handhelds, RFID, edge solutions, offline/nearline patterns, store networking.

- Merchandising: PIM, pricing & promotions, assortment planning, vendor onboarding, space/category analytics.

- Digital & Omnichannel: eCommerce, order management, fulfillment orchestration (BOPIS/ship-from-store), returns, customer identity.

 Cloud, Data, Integration & AI 

- Design cloud-first solutions using Azure and/or Google Cloud architecture best practices.

- Architect enterprise integration using APIs, event-driven patterns, streaming, and batch.

- Partner with data and AI teams to enable: 
- AI/ML lifecycle architecture (training pipelines, deployment patterns, inference)

- GenAI-enabled use cases with responsible AI guardrails

- Advanced decisioning for forecasting, pricing, inventory, personalization, and fraud.

- Promote strong data architecture practices: domain-aligned models, master/reference data, lineage, and privacy.

 Governance, Standards & Delivery Enablement 

- Participate in and lead architecture reviews; provide guardrails without slowing delivery.

- Define and promote reusable reference architectures and patterns.

- Ensure secure-by-design and operationally ready solutions in partnership with security and SRE teams.

- Mentor engineers and analysts; contribute to architecture and engineering communities of practice.

 Stakeholder Partnership & Influence 

- Work with Product, Engineering, and Business leaders to shape solution options and trade-offs.

- Clearly communicate architectural intent, risks, and decisions to both technical and non-technical audiences.

- Act as a trusted advisor during delivery and planning.

 What you bring 

 Required experience 

- 7+ years in technology with 3+ years in solution or technical architecture roles.

- Experience delivering solutions across retail platforms (supply chain, stores, merchandising, and/or digital).

- Strong experience with API-led and event-driven integration architectures.

- Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (Azure and/or GCP) including networking, identity, and deployment models.

- Strong understanding of security, resiliency, performance, and observability.

 Strongly preferred 

- Experience with retail enterprise platforms such as OMS, POS, WMS/TMS, ERP, PIM, pricing or promotion engines.

- Data platform and analytics architecture experience (lakehouse/warehouse patterns, streaming).

- AI/ML or GenAI architecture exposure, including deployment, monitoring, and responsible AI considerations.

- Store edge computing or offline-first architecture experience.

 Core skills 

- Architecture modeling (C4, UML, sequence/data flows, domain models).

- Strong analytical thinking and decision-making.

- Clear, concise written and verbal communication.

 We’re always looking for great talent! In addition to competitive pay, we offer:

- Comprehensive benefits and retirement programs

- Performance incentives, Continuing Education Programs

- Other perks to support your well-being

- Career growth opportunities and product discounts

 Our typical hiring range is between $80,000.00 and $131,000.00 per annum. Salary decisions are also dependent on other factors such as your experience, job-related knowledge, skills and competencies, market location, industry benchmarks, internal equity and other role-specific requirements. We're committed to attracting top talent.  For critical roles, the compensation offering will be reviewed to ensure alignment with market rate and conditions and the unique value you bring to the role. #LI-AG2

We dream big and work as one to innovate with purpose for our customers at every level of our business, investing in new technologies and products, and doubling down on top talent to drive the company forward. We offer competitive salaries and wages to CTC employees, as well as store discounts, supported learning through our Triangle Learning Academy, Canadian Tire Profit Sharing, and retirement and savings programs for eligible employees. As part of our enhanced flex benefits program, we offer mental health benefits in the amount of $5,000 per year for benefits-eligible employees and their families, including total well-being, and mental health tools and resources for all employees. Join us in helping to make life in Canada better through living and working our Core Values: we are innovators and entrepreneurs at our core, outcomes drive us, inclusion is a must, we are stronger together and we take personal responsibility. It is an especially exciting time to join CTC and its family of companies where career opportunities are wide-ranging! Join us, where there's a place for you here.

 We are committed to fostering an environment where belonging thrives, and diversity, inclusion and equity are infused into everything we do. We believe in building an organizational culture where people are consistently treated with dignity while respecting individual religion, nationality, gender, race, age, perceived ability, spoken language, sexual orientation, and identification. We are united in our purpose of being here to help make life in Canada better.

The Associate Program Manager, Sales Acceleration plays a key role in driving store performance and Dealer engagement across the business. Acting as a bridge between Merchandising, Operations, and the Dealer network, you'll help bring strategic sales initiatives to life by leading programs, coordinating cross-functional teams, and ensuring successful execution at the store level.
 This role is ideal for someone who enjoys a combination of program management, stakeholder engagement, communications, and business analysis, with the opportunity to make a measurable impact on commercial performance.

 What You'll Do: 

 Lead Sales Acceleration Programs 

- Support the planning, execution, and continuous improvement of sales-driving initiatives across the Dealer network.

- Manage project plans, timelines, stakeholder alignment, and key deliverables to ensure successful program outcomes.

- Track program performance, identify opportunities for improvement, and provide recommendations based on insights and feedback.

- Initiatives include SmartStockup, Frontier Product Feedback, Dealer Teams engagement, SKU opportunity programs, and Convention, Dealer's Den, PrePack Management, and Convention/Showcase activations achieve measurable business outcomes.

 Drive Dealer Engagement & Enablement 

- Develop and execute communication and engagement strategies that help Dealers understand and activate key business priorities.

- Partner with cross-functional teams to support product launches, promotional initiatives, and store-focused programs.

- Facilitate feedback channels and working groups that strengthen collaboration between Dealers and internal teams.

 Build Strong Partnerships 

- Collaborate with leaders across Merchandising, Store Operations, Marketing, and Communications to deliver high-impact initiatives.

- Act as a trusted partner by helping align priorities, solve problems, and drive execution across multiple stakeholders.

 Support Business Insights & Continuous Improvement 

- Monitor program effectiveness through performance metrics and engagement data.

- Identify opportunities to improve processes, simplify execution, and enhance the Dealer experience.

- Leverage new technologies and AI-powered tools to drive efficiency and innovation.

 What You'll Bring: 

- 3-5+ years of experience in program management, communications, retail operations, merchandising, sales enablement, or a related field.

- Strong project management and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

- Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management abilities.

- Experience working cross-functionally and influencing without direct authority.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a focus on delivering business results.

- Proficiency with Microsoft 365 tools, including PowerPoint and Excel.

- Experience in retail, store-centric programs, or a Dealer-based environment is considered an asset.

- Comfort using AI-powered tools to support communication, analysis, and day-to-day productivity.

What you'll do 

 Reporting to the AVP, Cyber Security Program Management, we are seeking an experienced Cyber focused technical Program Manager to lead strategic initiatives in the network and security infrastructure domain. This role will translate enterprise cyber strategy and risk priorities into actionable capabilities roadmaps, security requirements, and technical standards, ensuring a robust and resilient infrastructure security posture.

 Strategy and Roadmap Development:

- Develop and maintain a network and security infrastructure capabilities roadmap aligned with organizational cyber strategy and risk assessments.

- Define and enforce security-focused technical standards and guidelines for infrastructure technologies.

 Prioritization and Planning:

- Engage with stakeholders to prioritize initiatives that strengthen network and security infrastructure while balancing business objectives.

- Drive alignment across engineering, operations, and architecture teams through outcome-driven planning and dependency management.

- Define, defend, align and adjust iteratively on recommendations:

- Governance reinforcement.

- Tool rationalization opportunities.

- Prioritization of in-flight initiatives (e.g. stop or continue).

- Capability gaps (e.g., lifecycle automation, analytics).

- Quick wins (e.g., decommissioning unused tools, automating manual processes).

- Security posture preservation.

- Define, defend, align, adjust short-term (0–6 months), mid-term (6–18 months), and long-term (18+ months) roadmap for CTC, including common solutions intended for use across CTC enterprise.

- Prioritize roadmap initiatives based on impact, cost, and feasibility.

- Identify areas requiring deeper analysis of integrations, workflows, and dependencies.

- Embed governance and security controls into roadmap initiatives.

- Present roadmap to relevant executive stakeholders for feedback and alignment. 

 Delivery:

- Deliver a detailed capability framework, aligned to the strategic expectations of CISO and deep technical engagement with CTC Platform owners.

- Capability Heatmap and In-Flight Initiatives Mapped to Framework Expectations.

- Prioritized recommendations aligned to the approved capability framework.

- Deep knowledge and technical experience in delivering a comprehensive capability roadmap for network and security infrastructure.

- Communications: Develop clear, scalable communication plans to share program status, health, and achievements with technical teams and senior leadership.

- Translate complex technical concepts into business-friendly language for executive reporting.

- Facilitation & Influence: Facilitate fact-based, data-driven decision-making with domain expertise.

- Influence technical and business outcomes through strong interpersonal and negotiation skills.

- Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner with cross-functional teams to gather feedback, identify improvement areas, and implement actionable solutions.

 What you bring: 

- Experience:  7+ years in program management within technology or cybersecurity, with at least 4+ years focused on network and security infrastructure.

- Technical Expertise:  Deep understanding of network architecture, security controls, and infrastructure technologies and security architectural strategies (firewalls, IDS/IPS, VPNs, segmentation).

- Industry Certifications:  CISSP, CISM, CCNP Security, or equivalent required.

- Communication & Influence:  Proven ability to influence outcomes and drive consensus across diverse technical and business stakeholders.

- Track Record:  Demonstrated success delivering large-scale security-focused infrastructure projects.

- Familiarity with security frameworks (NIST, CIS, ISO 27001).

- Experience working in Agile environments and using tools like Jira and Confluence.

- SAFE certification is a plus.

 We’re always looking for great talent! In addition to competitive pay, we offer:

- Comprehensive benefits and retirement programs

- Performance incentives, Continuing Education Programs

- Other perks to support your well-being

- Career growth opportunities and product discounts

 Broadband Salary Range: 90,000 - 131,000 per annum.
Our typical hiring range is between 120,000 - 131,000 per annum. Salary decisions are also dependent on other factors such as your experience, industry benchmarks, internal equity and other role-specific requirements. For critical roles, the compensation offering will be reviewed to ensure alignment with market rate and conditions and the unique value you bring to the role.#LI-AG2

 Canadian Tire Corporation, Limited (“CTC”) is one of Canada’s most admired and trusted companies. With more than 90 Owned Brands, over 1,600 retail locations, financial services, exemplary e-commerce capabilities, and exciting market-leading merchandising strategies. We offer competitive salaries and wages to CTC employees, as well as store discounts, supported learning through our Triangle Learning Academy, Canadian Tire Profit Sharing, and retirement and savings programs for eligible employees. What you'll do 
 Reporting into AVP, AI Activation, the Program Manager, AI Activation is accountable for the end‑to‑end program orchestration of AI initiatives across the AI Activation portfolio. This role leads and supervises all Project Managers within AI Activation, ensuring consistent delivery, governance, financial rigor, and executive visibility across all AI programs and projects.
 The role operates at the program and portfolio level , translating AI strategy into executable, well‑governed programs that deliver measurable business outcomes.

 Program & Portfolio Leadership 

- Own the AI Activation program portfolio , structuring work from Big Rock → Program → Project level.

- Ensure consistent program design, dependency management, and sequencing across all AI initiatives.

- Serve as the single point of accountability for program‑level planning, delivery status, and risk management.

 PM Supervision & Delivery Excellence 

- Directly lead, coach, and supervise all AI Activation PMs .

- Set clear delivery standards across:

- Planning

- Milestones

- RAID management

- Status reporting

- Intervene proactively when delivery is off‑track, unblocking PMs and escalating where required.

 Governance, Financials & CBA Ownership 

- Own program‑level governance , including:

- CBAs

- Forecasting

- Financial tracking

- Executive readiness

- Partner with Finance, PMO, and leadership to ensure funding, benefits realization, and financial transparency.

- Ensure all AI initiatives meet enterprise governance and audit expectations.

 Tools, Standards & Artifacts 

- Own and standardize Planview / portfolio tooling for AI Activation.

- Define and enforce:

- Program and project structures

- Documentation standards

- SharePoint / artifact organization

- Ensure AI Activation artifacts are centralized, discoverable, and governance‑compliant.

 Executive & Cross‑Functional Engagement 

- Act as the primary program interface with senior stakeholders across IT, Finance, Data, and Business teams.

- Prepare executive‑ready updates, escalations, and decision framing.

- Ensure PM‑level communication is elevated to program‑level narratives suitable for leadership forums.

 What you bring 

- Proven experience leading programs of multiple projects , not just individual initiatives

- Strong background in portfolio management, financial governance, and delivery rigor 

- Comfortable operating between strategy and execution

- Able to lead PMs directly , including performance management and coaching

- Experience delivering complex, cross‑functional technology or AI programs

workday:capitalone/Capital_One:R242630.description:
161 Bay Street (93021), Canada, Toronto,Toronto, Ontario, 

Principal Associate, Product Management 

 About Capital One Canada 
 For 30 years, we’ve been on a mission to change banking for good. We challenge the traditional bank stereotype, fostering a culture where innovation thrives and bold ideas are celebrated. Leveraging the power of data and technology, we’re where product professionals come to solve complex problems and shape customer experiences that have influence across industries.  

 Here, you’ll shape customer experiences and take transformative ownership of strategies that propel us into the future, creating value at a scale that directly accelerates our growth. If you’re ready to redefine what’s possible, to turn insights into experiences that make a real-world impact, this is where you can create what’s next. 

 About the Team 
 At Capital One Canada, our Product Management team is on a mission to redefine financial well-being and empower millions of Canadians by improving access to credit. We don’t just manage roadmaps or check boxes—we fall in love with complex problems and take true ownership of business outcomes. 

 Collaboration is at the heart of how we deliver bold, industry-leading customer experiences. Working closely with cross-functional partners in Tech, Data, Strategy, and Design, we balance fast-paced innovation with multi-layered risk to shape products that drive meaningful impact. If you thrive on autonomy, continuous learning, and building what’s next, you’ll fit right in.  
 About the Role 
 Here are a few of the ways our Product Managers are helping people create meaningful interactions with Capital One:

- Give customers the confidence to apply without rejection with Quick Check, our credit card eligibility tool.

- Enhance the credit card application experience to encourage early adoption of digital habits.

- Manage and scale data and machine learning platforms across the organization to deliver smart, personalized experiences.

- Create easy digital solutions that help customers address fraud and easily get back to using their card.

- Develop assistance programs to help customers who are struggling with their payments

- Provide customers with relevant details about their account, conveniently within the mobile app.

 Your Responsibilities: 
 As a Product Manager,  you’ll be expected to demonstrate proficiency in four key areas:

- Human Centered 

- You’ll lead sourcing and synthesis of customer discovery efforts to understand customer needs to drive the long term vision for your product

- You’ll turn these customer insights into actionable strategies that will define the priorities for your team and rally your stakeholders to your vision

- Business Focused 

- You’ll own and prioritize the product roadmap to deliver on business outcomes, working closely with a cross-functional team to ensure that all the right resources are aligned to ensure that and your team will be successful

- You’ll define KPIs for your product and will be responsible for measuring and tracking to those measures, with an eye to adjusting and refining your roadmap as the data dictates

- Technology Driven

- You’ll have an end-to-end understanding of your product and how it fits into the larger ecosystem to be able to anticipate impacts from changes in other parts of the business

- You’ll work closely with tech leadership and architecture to understand the tradeoffs of technical decisions and how they impact the ultimately customer experience your team will deliver always looking to ensure you’re using the best tool for the job

- Transformational Leadership 

- You’ll rally your teams and senior stakeholders to your product vision and proactively leverage relationships throughout the ecosystem to align to your vision and influence prioritization across partner teams

 We want you if you are:   

- Intellectually Curious. You ask why, you explore and you're not afraid to blurt out your crazy idea. Comfortable with ambiguity, a hunger to learn and a seeker of new challenges.

- Communicator & Influencer. You can communicate complex ideas clearly regardless of your audience. Your team knows their priorities and why they’re doing what they’re doing. You can always rally associates to work with you.

- Do-er. You’re biased toward action, you try things and sometimes you fail. You can get around roadblocks and stay focused on your goals. You’re well organized, able to multitask and able to prioritize your work.

- Passionate & Customer Focus. You care about growing others and bringing them together around what’s possible. You get a thrill from the journey of building and shipping products, and you have a desire and ability to connect with our external or internal customers to fully understand their needs.

- Learner. You have an appetite to learn new things or new technologies all while exhibiting humbleness when the time comes to ask for help.

- Team Player. You enjoy working with diverse people and driving the team toward a common goal. You have the ability to put the team before yourself and establish long-lasting relationships.   

 Basic Qualifications: 

- At least 3 years of Product Management experience with software products

- Experience successfully delivering a software product

- Strong quantitative and qualitative skills; able to make data-driven decisions and provide recommendations to drive action

 Preferred Qualifications: 

- Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Finance, Engineering or related field

- 5+ years of experience of Product Management experience

- Experience in financial services, technology or operations

 Working at Capital One 
 You’ll be empowered to take end-to-end ownership of your work and your career, backed by a high-performance, hybrid culture and holistic suite of benefits designed to support your whole self.  

- Take ownership of your own potential: Whether you’re looking to upskill, pivot into new business areas, or master your craft, you’ll have access to tools and mentorship to reach your potential and define your career trajectory. 

- Find your rhythm: We believe trust fosters the flexibility and autonomy required to balance personal needs with a focus on high performance. We support a hybrid model – with 3 days in the office per week – that gives room for both collaboration and personal commitments. 

- Benefits built for your life: We take a holistic approach to well-being, providing support for you and those who are most important to you. This includes: full coverage for spouses, domestic partners and dependents, a one-time Work From Home allowance to build your comfortable workspace, up to $3,000 in mental health coverage and up to $5,000 in annual tuition subsidies. 

 You’ll find that Capital One is committed to helping you thrive and evolve every step of the way. 

 This posting is for an existing vacancy. 
 The expected annual salary range for this position is $134,400- $153,300. This role is also eligible to earn performance based incentive compensation, which may include cash bonus(es). Incentives could be discretionary or non discretionary depending on the plan.

 We embrace the responsible use of artificial intelligence (AI) to enhance the candidate experience and streamline our recruitment processes. However, no hiring decisions are made using AI as every hiring decision is made by our hiring managers, business interviewers, and recruitment professionals. Our teams are equipped with training that empowers them to use AI responsibly. 

 We may use your information for automated decision making. We may, for certain purposes, render a decision based exclusively on automated processing of your personal information as a part of the candidate screening process.

Capital One Canada is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment. We consider all qualified applicants and will meet the needs of those requiring reasonable accommodations. 

 If you have visited our website in search of information on employment opportunities or to apply for a position, and you require an accommodation, please contact Capital One Recruiting at 1-800-304-9102 or via email at ARCanada@capitalone.com . 161 Bay Street (93021), Canada, Toronto,Toronto, Ontario, 

Manager, Product Management- Data Products 

 About Capital One Canada 

 For 30 years, we’ve been on a mission to change banking for good. We challenge the traditional bank stereotype, fostering a culture where innovation thrives and bold ideas are celebrated. Leveraging the power of data and technology, we’re where product professionals come to solve complex problems and shape customer experiences that have influence across industries.  

 Here, you’ll shape customer experiences and take transformative ownership of strategies that propel us into the future, creating value at a scale that directly accelerates our growth. If you’re ready to redefine what’s possible, to turn insights into experiences that make a real-world impact, this is where you can create what’s next. 

 About the Team 

 At Capital One Canada, our Product Management team is on a mission to redefine financial well-being and empower millions of Canadians by improving access to credit. We don’t just manage roadmaps or check boxes—we fall in love with complex problems and take true ownership of business outcomes. 

 Collaboration is at the heart of how we deliver bold, industry-leading customer experiences. Working closely with cross-functional partners in Tech, Data, Strategy, and Design, we balance fast-paced innovation with multi-layered risk to shape products that drive meaningful impact. If you thrive on autonomy, continuous learning, and building what’s next, you’ll fit right in.  

 About the Role 

 This is a senior Product Management position that does not have direct reports.

 Our Data Product Managers have: 

- Excellent problem solving and influencing skills 

- Thrive at the intersection of data and business strategy - able to understand complex business intent and translate strategy into data requirements that promote consistent, reusable and interoperable data consumption 

- Data analysis skills (e.g., SQL, Python, R) along with a high level understanding of technical patterns used to process, present, and consume data at scale (e.g., relational databases, data storage formats, spark, graphQL) 

- Framework driven approach to problem solving with ability to simplify technical complexity and drive well-educated business decisions across stakeholders 

- Exceptional cross-team collaboration; able to work across different functions, organizations, and reporting boundaries to get the job done. 

- Highly tuned emotional intelligence, good listener, and deep seated empathy for teams and partners 

 Your Responsibilities: 

- Drive the definition, design and operationalization of data products that maximize leverage for the business and serve the needs of your internal and external customers 

- Own and prioritize the long-term roadmap for your product, working with a cross-functional stakeholder group balancing priorities based on impact and risk to drive winning customer outcomes.  

- Define OKRs for your Data Product with a metrics-driven strategy to maximize value of your product and iteratively adjust and refining roadmap based on inputs 

- Immerse yourself in understanding your customer(s) by employing empathy and design thinking to build a customer-backed product roadmap that that drives business value 

- Serve as the internal and external subject matter expert for your product and its role in Capital One’s ecosystem with accountability for owning the definition of data, including its usage and constraints 

- Partner closely with technology and data experts to design robust solutions, shaping the business capabilities and associated architecture necessary to drive the broader product agenda 

- Inspires the team to deeply understand technical opportunities to increase the speed of delivery and prioritize opportunities for reuse 

- Develop a robust integration strategy that demonstrates customer-based thinking to make the lives of internal and external customers easier by delivering scalable, reliable and consistently defined data solutions 

- Mentor and contribute to the data talent community at Capital One, empowering local and cross-functional teams to do their best work  

 Basic Qualifications: 

- At least 5+ years of Product Management experience  

- Experience creating and delivering customer centric, data-driven product vision and strategy 

- A track record of delivering results with significant business and customer impacts 

 Preferred Qualifications: 

- Bachelor’s or Master's Degree in Business, Finance, Engineering or related field 

- Experience in financial services, technology or operations 

- You ask why, you explore and you're not afraid to blurt out your crazy idea. Comfortable with ambiguity, a hunger to learn and a seeker of new challenges. 

- You can communicate complex ideas clearly regardless of your audience. Your team knows their priorities and why they’re doing what they’re doing. You can always rally associates to work with you. 

- You’re biased toward action, you try things and sometimes you fail. You can get around roadblocks and stay focused on your goals. You’re well organized, able to multitask and able to prioritize your work. 

- You care about growing others and bringing them together around what’s possible. You get a thrill from the journey of building and shipping products, and you have a desire and ability to connect with our external or internal customers to fully understand their needs. 

- You have an appetite to learn new things or new technologies all while exhibiting humbleness when the time comes to ask for help. 

- You enjoy working with diverse people and driving the team toward a common goal. You have the ability to put the team before yourself and establish long-lasting relationships. 

 Working at Capital One 

 You’ll be empowered to take end-to-end ownership of your work and your career, backed by a high-performance, hybrid culture and holistic suite of benefits designed to support your whole self.  

- Take ownership of your own potential: Whether you’re looking to upskill, pivot into new business areas, or master your craft, you’ll have access to tools and mentorship to reach your potential and define your career trajectory. 

- Find your rhythm: We believe trust fosters the flexibility and autonomy required to balance personal needs with a focus on high performance. We support a hybrid model – with 3 days in the office per week – that gives room for both collaboration and personal commitments. 

- Benefits built for your life: We take a holistic approach to well-being, providing support for you and those who are most important to you. This includes: full coverage for spouses, domestic partners and dependents, a one-time Work From Home allowance to build your comfortable workspace, up to $3,000 in mental health coverage and up to $5,000 in annual tuition subsidies.\ 

 You’ll find that Capital One is committed to helping you thrive and evolve every step of the way.

successfactors:careers.celestica.com:144.description:
Req ID: 141532 
Remote Position: Hybrid
Region: Americas 
Country: Canada 
State/Province: Ontario 
City:  Toronto 
 Summary

 The Senior Solutions Architect, Services Operations develops integrated service offerings for major customers within the Services Business Unit (Fulfillment, Supply Chain, After-Market Services, and Product Launch). This role involves leveraging resources to deliver world-class solutions, supporting the entire sales cycle for solution project proposals. They create quantifiable, documented, and technically integrated product lifecycle solutions, identifying and assembling expert teams from various Services core businesses to optimize Product Launch Acceleration, Fulfillment, Supply Chain, After Sales, and Operations. Recognized as a technical expert by clients, the Solutions Architect, Services Operations builds strong relationships with major customers at all organizational levels, directly engaging with key decision-makers. They serve as the technical point of contact, provide expert support to the Sales Organization, participate in Mega Deal Teams, and document standard solutions. 

 Detailed Description

 Performs tasks such as, but not limited to, the following

- Leads solution development for assigned Services Business Unit opportunities.

- Acts as subject matter expert on solutions for integrated solutions being addressed by Services/Celestica.

- Works with other team members to scope the project and create high level work-plans, milestones, decision points, and approval paths.

- Works with customers to understand specific and unstated needs in a consultative manner.

- Identifies pain points, service gaps, dependencies, risks, and requirements not addressed by solution, and communicates to the team.

- Develops complete solutions to customer problems, including service scope, operating model, process flow, capacity, staffing, space, logistics, equipment, technology, quality, and launch approach.

- Pulls in subject matter experts and site resources as needed to develop solutions.

- Works with business process analysts to ensure processes are developed to integrate solutions to customers.

- Works with financial analysts to ensure understanding of financial implications of solutions for Celestica and the customer.

- Works with Account Teams/Engagement Leaders to develop compelling communication solutions.

- Assists with the negotiation team to understand the implications of alternatives.

- Works with salespeople to validate and qualify opportunities.

- Prepares approval-ready recommendations for internal leadership and customer review.

- Leads proposal-to-NPI or proposal-to-implementation handoffs, including scope boundaries, operating assumptions, acceptance criteria, risks, dependencies, and readiness actions.

- Supports launch reviews, early-life stabilization, lessons learned, and post-launch improvement activities.

- Identifies opportunities for standardization, automation, data-quality improvement, and margin expansion.

- Documents reusable solution patterns, templates, models, and standards.

- Develops unsolicited proposals to targeted customers.

 Knowledge/Skills/Competencies

 Knowledge/Skills/Competencies

- Project and Opportunity management experience.

- Strong leadership, professionalism, reliability, creativity, detail oriented and follow-through with a can-do attitude.

- Consultative skills (ability to understand true customer needs).

- Distinctive solution development and systems definition skills.

- Expert spreadsheet and presentation skills, with the ability to make models auditable and explain assumptions clearly.

- Outstanding communication skills.

- Demonstrated team-leadership capabilities, including leadership without direct authority.

- Ability to generate leads within targeted customers.

- Demonstrated success with unsolicited proposals or customer expansion concepts.

- Understand and achieve Financial Plan objectives.

- Demonstrated capability to build relationships and participate effectively on cross-functional teams.

- Ability to translate incomplete or ambiguous requirements into executable operating models.

- Ability to manage multiple time-sensitive opportunities and maintain action ownership through completion.

- Substantial knowledge of business (Fulfillment and Supply Chain, After-Market Services or Product Launch) and demonstrated ability to leverage organization

 Physical Demands

- Duties of this position are performed in a normal office environment.

- Duties may require extended periods of sitting and sustained visual concentration on a computer monitor or on numbers and other detailed data.

- Repetitive manual movements (e.g., data entry, using a computer mouse, using a calculator, etc.) are frequently required.

- Frequent overnight travel may be required.

- Duties may require extended or unusual working hours during critical customer proposals, approvals, implementations, or launches.

 Salary

 The stated range includes Base Salary and target Short-Term Incentive (STI) compensation only. A comprehensive benefits package is offered in addition to this range.

The range described in this posting is an estimate by the Company, and may change based on several factors, including but not limited to a change in the duties covered by the job posting, or the credentials, experience or geographic jurisdiction of the successful candidate.

 Salary + Short Term Incentive = 125,000 - 199,000 CAD

 Typical Experience

- Eight plus years of applicable experience, including two plus years of directly applicable solutions architect experience.

- Experience in Services Business Unit (Fulfillment and Supply Chain, After-Market Services or Product Launch) solution development.

- Experience in profit & loss responsibility is highly desired.

 Typical Education

- 
 Bachelor’s degree in a related field, or consideration of an equivalent combination of education and experience.

- 
 Educational requirements may vary by geography.

 Notes

 This job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties and responsibilities of the position. Employees are held accountable for all duties of the job. Job duties and the % of time identified for any function are subject to change at any time.

 Celestica is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, pregnancy, genetic information, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected category under applicable federal, state, and local laws. 
At Celestica we are committed to fostering an inclusive, accessible environment, where all employees and customers feel valued, respected and supported. Special arrangements can be made for candidates who need it throughout the hiring process. Please indicate your needs and we will work with you to meet them. 

 COMPANY OVERVIEW: 

 Celestica, Inc. (NYSE: CLS; TSX: CLS) is a technology leader dedicated to driving customer success and market advancements. With deep expertise in design, engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, and platform solutions, Celestica enables critical data center infrastructure for AI, cloud, and hybrid cloud and advances technologies in high-growth markets. With a talented team and a strategic global network, Celestica helps its customers achieve competitive advantages. 

 Today, Celestica delivers innovative supply chain solutions globally to customers in strategic two operating and reporting segments:  Advanced Technology Solutions (ATS) and Connectivity and Cloud Solutions (CC): 

 ATS: This segment serves customers in complex, regulated and high-reliability markets such as Industrial & Smart Energy, Aerospace & Defense, Semiconductor Capital Equipment, and HealthTech. It is engineering led, with deep expertise in design, manufacturing and lifecycle solutions. 

 CCS: This segment focuses on high-performance technology solutions and services for the data center, serving hyperscalers, digital native customers and enterprises. Celestica's Platform Solutions offering provides innovative and customizable computing, storage and networking solutions enabling AI-driven growth. 

 Built on a legacy of trust and performance, Celestica has earned its reputation by delivering results in complex and fast-changing markets. Celestica exceeds customer expectations by identifying trends and staying ahead of the curve. Backed by comprehensive capabilities and a global network across North America, Europe and Asia, Celestica helps customers gain competitive advantage with the quality, flexibility and resiliency they need to respond quickly to shifts in demand. Guided by a bold vision to accelerate market advancements, Celestica delivers innovative solutions and technologies that turn complexity into opportunity. Anchored in teamwork and commitment, Celestica strives to be the most trusted partner to its customers and colleagues worldwide. 

 We use artificial intelligence tools to assist in screening and assessing  applications for this role. All hiring decisions involve human review. 

 This posting is for an existing vacancy. 

 Celestica would like to thank all applicants, however, only qualified applicants will be contacted.
Celestica does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruitment agencies or fee based recruitment services.

successfactors:careers.celestica.com:140.description:
Req ID: 137610 
Region: Americas 
Country: USA 
State/Province: California 
City:  San Jose 
 Summary

 This individual acts as end-to-end technical “authority” and liaison across HW and SW domains for the hyperscale customers. This role is responsible for guiding daily execution, driving strategic and tactical engineering alignment, remediating customer issues, and maintaining operational trust across the full lifecycle of infrastructure delivery and support. The "Uber” TPL is accountable for orchestration of flawless technical operations and ensuring an exceptional customer experience.

 Detailed Description

- Serves as a single accountable technical owner for all aspects of customer across firmware, BIOS/BMC, OS integration, platform hardware, diagnostics, and telemetry

- 
 Drives technical excellence from design through deployment

- 
 Drives all HW & SW engineering workstreams and coordinates activities within programs

- 
 Acts as the final technical TPL escalation point for platform-level issues impacting delivery to customers

- 
 Has a direct path to Executive escalation and support

- 
 Owns incident response leadership for both HW and SW problems- coordinating root cause analysis, corrective action plans, and continuous improvements

- 
 Leads bring-up, debug, and release processes, ensuring functional alignment between HW and SW stacks

- 
 Champions interoperability, performance tuning, and issues traceability across layers

- 
 Coordinates activities and planning between HW, SW, programs, PMOs, and GCBU

 Physical Demands

- Duties of this position are performed in a normal office environment.

- Duties may require extended periods of sitting and sustained visual concentration on a computer monitor or on numbers and other detailed data. 

- Repetitive manual movements (e.g., data entry, using a computer mouse, using a calculator, etc.) are frequently required.

- Occasional travel may be required.

 Salary

 The salary range described in this posting is an estimate by the Company, and may change based on several factors, including by not limited to a change in the duties covered by the job posting, or the credentials, experience or geographic jurisdiction of the successful candidate.

 Salary Range: $141K - $221K 

 The stated range includes Base Salary and target Short-Term Incentive (STI) compensation only. A comprehensive benefits package is offered in addition to this range.

The range described in this posting is an estimate by the Company, and may change based on several factors, including but not limited to a change in the duties covered by the job posting, or the credentials, experience or geographic jurisdiction of the successful candidate.

 Typical Experience

- 11  + Years of experince  

 Typical Education

 Bachelor degree or consideration of an equivalent combination of education and experience.

 Educational Requirements may vary by Geography

 Notes

 This job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties and responsibilities of the position. Employees are held accountable for all duties of the job. Job duties and the % of time identified for any function are subject to change at any time.

 #HPS-NA

 Celestica is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, pregnancy, genetic information, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected category under applicable federal, state, and local laws. 
This policy applies to hiring, promotion, discharge, pay, fringe benefits, job training, classification, referral and other aspects of employment and also states that retaliation against a person who files a charge of discrimination, participates in a discrimination proceeding, or otherwise opposes an unlawful employment practice will not be tolerated. All information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
Celestica is an E-Verify employer. 

 COMPANY OVERVIEW: 

 Celestica, Inc. (NYSE: CLS; TSX: CLS) is a technology leader dedicated to driving customer success and market advancements. With deep expertise in design, engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, and platform solutions, Celestica enables critical data center infrastructure for AI, cloud, and hybrid cloud and advances technologies in high-growth markets. With a talented team and a strategic global network, Celestica helps its customers achieve competitive advantages. 

 Today, Celestica delivers innovative supply chain solutions globally to customers in strategic two operating and reporting segments:  Advanced Technology Solutions (ATS) and Connectivity and Cloud Solutions (CC): 

 ATS: This segment serves customers in complex, regulated and high-reliability markets such as Industrial & Smart Energy, Aerospace & Defense, Semiconductor Capital Equipment, and HealthTech. It is engineering led, with deep expertise in design, manufacturing and lifecycle solutions. 

 CCS: This segment focuses on high-performance technology solutions and services for the data center, serving hyperscalers, digital native customers and enterprises. Celestica's Platform Solutions offering provides innovative and customizable computing, storage and networking solutions enabling AI-driven growth. 

 Built on a legacy of trust and performance, Celestica has earned its reputation by delivering results in complex and fast-changing markets. Celestica exceeds customer expectations by identifying trends and staying ahead of the curve. Backed by comprehensive capabilities and a global network across North America, Europe and Asia, Celestica helps customers gain competitive advantage with the quality, flexibility and resiliency they need to respond quickly to shifts in demand. Guided by a bold vision to accelerate market advancements, Celestica delivers innovative solutions and technologies that turn complexity into opportunity. Anchored in teamwork and commitment, Celestica strives to be the most trusted partner to its customers and colleagues worldwide.

Celestica does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruitment agencies or fee based recruitment services.

successfactors:careers.celestica.com:143.description:
Req ID: 139011 
Remote Position: Hybrid
Region: Americas 
Country: Canada 
State/Province: Ontario 
City:  Toronto 
 Summary

 The Sr. Solutions Engineer - Infrastructure with expertise in Nutanix , VMware, and Windows designs, builds and maintains hybrid cloud and on-premises enterprise environments. Will lead infrastructure modernization, manage virtualization platforms, ensure high availability, and align IT systems with business goals 

 Detailed Description

 Performs tasks such as, but not limited to, the following:

- 
 Architecture & Design: Design scalable, secure, and resilient enterprise architectures using Nutanix, VMware, and Windows Server ecosystems. 

- 
 Virtualization & Hypervisor Management: Manage and optimize Nutanix AHV environments and VMware vSphere/ESXi, including cluster expansion and resource allocation. 

- 
 Hybrid Cloud Integration: Bridge on-premises data centers with cloud environments using Nutanix Cloud Clusters, HyperV or VMware Cloud solutions. 

- 
 Windows Administration: Oversee Windows Server infrastructure, Active Directory, Group Policy, and core Microsoft enterprise services. 

- 
 Migration & Upgrades: Lead complex data center migrations, hypervisor conversions, and operating system upgrades with minimal downtime. 

- 
 Performance & Troubleshooting: Monitor system health, analyze performance bottlenecks, and resolve high-level infrastructure incidents. 

- 
 Security & Compliance: Implement security baselines, disaster recovery strategies, backups, and patching schedules. 

- 
 Project Management : Managing and overseeing project progress along with designing and implementing solutions.  

- 
 Team Leader : Technical manager leading project teams. 

- 
 Travel : 30% 

 Knowledge/Skills/Competencies

- 
 Experience: 10+ years in Solution integration and architecting IT infrastructure, implementation, and administration. 

- 
 Nutanix: Deep knowledge of Nutanix AOS, Prism Central, Files, and hypervisors (AHV or ESXi on Nutanix). 

- 
 VMware: Strong proficiency in VMware vSphere, vCenter, vSAN, and NSX network virtualization. 

- 
 Windows Server: Advanced expertise in Windows Server (2016 to 2025), Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, and IIS. 

- 
 Project and Vendor management skills would be essential 

- 
 Storage & Networking: Understanding of SAN/NAS storage, software-defined storage, backup solutions; preferably on Dell Power Store, Power Flex solutions and Data Domains.  

- 
 Automation: Experience with PowerShell, PowerCLI, or Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible) to automate routine tasks. 

 Preferred Certifications 

- 
 Nutanix Certified Professional (NCP) or Nutanix Certified Master (NCM) 

- Microsoft Certified: Windows Server Hybrid Administrator Assoicate or Azure Solutions Architect, Microsoft HyperV Certifications 

- 
 VMware Certified Professional (VCP) or Advanced Professional (VCAP) 

 Physical Demands

- Duties of this position are performed in a normal office environment.

- Duties may require extended periods of sitting and sustained visual concentration on a computer monitor or on numbers and other detailed data. Repetitive manual movements (e.g., data entry, using a computer mouse, using a calculator, etc.) are frequently required.

 Salary

 The stated range includes Base Salary and target Short-Term Incentive (STI) compensation only. A comprehensive benefits package is offered in addition to this range.

The range described in this posting is an estimate by the Company, and may change based on several factors, including but not limited to a change in the duties covered by the job posting, or the credentials, experience or geographic jurisdiction of the successful candidate.

 Salary + Short-Term Incentive = 109,000 - 173,000 (CAD)

 Typical Experience

- 
 10+ years in Solution integration and architecting IT infrastructure, implementation, and administration. 

 Typical Education

- Bachelor's Degree or consideration of an equivalent combination of education and experience.

- Educational requirements may vary by geography.

workday:cibc/search:2620820.description:
We’re building a relationship-oriented bank for the modern world. We need talented, passionate professionals who are dedicated to doing what’s right for our clients. 

 At CIBC, we embrace your strengths and your ambitions, so you are empowered at work. Our team members have what they need to make a meaningful impact and are truly valued for who they are and what they contribute. 

 To learn more about CIBC, please visit CIBC.com 

 What You’ll Be Doing 

 As a Group Product Manager within the Liquidity Products and Accounts Services team, you will be supporting the Senior Director in achieving business objectives, and managing the relationship with various partners throughout the bank for all facets of the product management lifecycle and projects related to Virtual Account Management & Liquidity Products.

 You will lead in the development, management, presentation and implementation of Virtual Account Management solutions, including tactics that will build the business and optimize profitability, efficiency, growth and improve the client experience.  You will also serve as the point person on a variety of overarching projects across Transaction Banking.

 At CIBC we enable the work environment most optimal for you to thrive in your role. Details on your work arrangement (proportion of on-site and remote work) will be discussed at the time of your interview. 

 How You’ll Succeed 

- Product Development - Responsible for leading and supporting end-to end development of Virtual Account Management solution. From design, development, testing, launch and ongoing product optimization. This role works closely with other Payments, Channels and Billing Product partners, cross functional stakeholders to deliver client centric solutions that aligns with the bank's strategic objective, meet regulatory and risk requirements and drive sustainable business growth.

- Product Management - Take ownership of the assigned product portfolio, focusing on maximizing market share and profitability of products through collection of revenue, regular competitive reviews and cost management. Develop product roadmaps and recommendations for consideration by management and subsequent incorporation into Transaction Banking’s overall business plan. Defining criteria to monitor on-going compliance to established service level agreements, and ensuring service levels meet or exceed the client’s expectations and the standards of key major competitors with reasonable consistency. Communicate business strategy and initiative updates to large groups of stakeholders via presentation formats to deliver clear, concise and effective communication.

- Collaboration - Act as a focal point for product and market information for the assigned product portfolio, providing specialized support for key client solutions during the sales cycle. Provide subject matter expertise to various internal business partners in order to support key stakeholders, business cases, requirement documents, product collateral and communications. Contribute to strategy, annual business plans, development of recommendations and business cases for programs supporting Commercial Banking clients.

- Project Management & Continuous Improvement - Accountable for delivery of key initiatives related to your assigned product portfolio. Lead in the development of options and proposals for projects related to product enhancements and developments and make recommendations regarding impact, effectiveness and feasibility. Develop recommendations inclusive of research market activities to ensure timely and comprehensive knowledge of technology, target market segments, and key clients is reflected.

 Who You Are 

- You can demonstrate experience in Virtual Account Management and Liquidity, with preferred experience in Liquidity related Products. You have strong knowledge of strategic planning with demonstrated project delivery skills and understanding of our network and operations.

- You think and act as a Product owner. You take full responsibility for how clients interact with financial services products. You are constantly thinking about how to improve the client experience and possess the drive and demonstrated ability to take the necessary measures to achieve these goals.

- You're digitally savvy. You seek out innovative solutions and embrace evolving technologies. You have strong command of Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint.

- You give meaning to data. You have strong analytical skills, and are able to understand and draw conclusions from data. You are experienced in building financial models and conducting/understanding credit risk analysis

- You're driven by collective success. You value building effective working relationships and know that collaboration can transform a good idea into a great one. You understand the power of an inclusive team that enjoys working together to bring a shared vision to life.

- You put our clients first. You engage with purpose to find the right solutions. You go the extra mile, because it's the right thing to do.

 #LI-TA

 What CIBC Offers 

 At CIBC, your goals are a priority. We start with your strengths and ambitions as an employee and strive to create opportunities to tap into your potential. We aspire to give you a career, rather than just a paycheck.

- We work to recognize you in meaningful, personalized ways including a competitive salary, incentive pay, banking benefits, a benefits program*, defined benefit pension plan*, an employee share purchase plan, a vacation offering, wellbeing support, and MomentMakers, our social, points-based recognition program.

- Our spaces and technological toolkit will make it simple to bring together great minds to create innovative solutions that make a difference for our clients.

- We cultivate a culture where you can express your ambition through initiatives like Purpose Day; a paid day off dedicated for you to use to invest in your growth and development.

 *Subject to plan and program terms and conditions

 What you need to know 

- CIBC is committed to creating an inclusive environment where all team members and clients feel like they belong. We seek applicants with a wide range of abilities and we provide an accessible candidate experience. If you need accommodation, please contact Mailbox.careers-carrieres@cibc.com 

- CIBC is committed to clarity in our hiring process. All roles posted are opportunities we’re actively recruiting for, unless stated otherwise.

- You need to be legally eligible to work at the location(s) specified above and, where applicable, must have a valid work or study permit.

- We may ask you to complete an attribute-based assessment and other skills test (such as simulation, coding, French proficiency). 

- We use artificial intelligence tools during the recruitment process. Our goal for the application process is to get to know more about you, all that you have to offer, and give you the opportunity to learn more about us. 

 Job Location 
Toronto-81 Bay, 12th Floor 
 Employment Type 
Regular 
 Weekly Hours 
37.5 
 Skills 
Analytical Thinking, Data Analysis, Leadership, Market Research, Product Analysis, Product Development, Product Management, Product Planning, Product Pricing, Strategic Objectives
