greenhouse:doordashcanada:8103344.title: Associate Manager, Consumer Strategy & Operations
greenhouse:doordashcanada:8103344.description:
About the Team 

 The Canadian DoorDash Growth & Consumer team focuses on making DoorDash a more valuable and accessible part of consumers’ everyday lives. We identify opportunities to grow the business by improving affordability, strengthening the consumer experience, and solving marketplace challenges across consumers, merchants, and Dashers.

 Our team partners across Restaurants, New Verticals, Legal, Product, Finance, and Operations to develop strategies that support sustainable growth across Canada.

 About the Role 

 The Associate Manager role is for a self-motivated, curious, and ownership-minded individual who approaches problems through a customer-first lens. You will use data and market insights to identify growth opportunities, develop strategies, and drive cross-functional execution.

 Your scope may include pricing and affordability, market-specific growth, consumer engagement and retention, and other high-priority strategic initiatives. Success will be measured by your ability to translate ambiguous problems into clear plans and deliver measurable business and customer outcomes.

 You're excited about this opportunity because... 

- Pricing & Affordability: Develop strategies across pricing, fees, promotions, and other value levers that balance customer affordability, growth, and sustainable economics.

- Analysis & Reporting: Analyze performance, build reporting and financial models, identify key trends, and translate insights into clear recommendations for leadership and XFN partners.

- Market Growth & Initiatives: Identify market-specific opportunities and lead high-impact growth initiatives from strategy and experimentation through execution and measurement.

- Big Bets & Innovation: Identify emerging opportunities, test new ideas, and build scalable solutions that can unlock new sources of customer and business growth.

- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Marketing, Merchant, Dasher, Product, Finance, Analytics, and other teams to align priorities, remove blockers, and deliver measurable outcomes.

 We're excited about you because... 

- You thrive as both a generalist and a specialist. You can develop an overarching strategy while diving deeply into specific customer, marketplace, and operational problems.

- You are a self-starter with a bias toward action who excels in a fast-paced, evolving business environment.

- You are comfortable with ambiguity and bring structure, organization, and focus to your work and cross-functional teams.

- You are a structured problem solver who can identify root causes, develop hypotheses, size opportunities, and recommend practical solutions.

- You combine analytical rigour with customer empathy and understand the trade-offs between affordability, growth, and business economics.

- You can influence without direct authority, build alignment across teams, and push initiatives from recommendation through execution.

- You are comfortable using SQL and AI tools to analyze data, building dashboards to track key metrics, and developing high-level financial models.

- You have 4+ years of experience in strategy, operations, product, growth, analytics, investment banking, consulting, or a related field.

 Compensation 

 Actual compensation within the pay range listed below will be decided based on factors including, but not limited to, skills, prior relevant experience, and specific work location. Base salary is localized according to employee work location. 

 In addition to base salary, the compensation for this role includes opportunities for equity grants. Talk to your recruiter for more information.

 DoorDash cares about you and your overall well-being. That’s why we offer a comprehensive benefits package for all regular employees, that includes paid time off, paid parental leave, wellness benefit and several paid holidays.

 Additionally, for full-time employees, DoorDash offers medical, dental, and vision benefits, disability and basic life insurance, an RRSP including an employer match, and a mental health program, among others.

 To learn more about our benefits, visit our careers page here .

 The base pay for this position ranges from our lowest geographical market up to our highest geographical market within British Columbia.
 $116,000 — $145,000 CAD 

 About DoorDash 

 At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.

 DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees’ happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks including premium healthcare, wellness expense reimbursement, paid parental leave and more. 

 Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion 

 We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.  

 If you need any accommodations, please inform your recruiting contact upon initial connection.

 Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash .

greenhouse:doordashcanada:8267406.title: Senior Associate, New Verticals - Canada Strategy & Operations
greenhouse:doordashcanada:8267406.description:
About the Team 

 New Verticals launched in 2020 to take the DoorDash marketplace beyond restaurants: it now spans 100,000+ grocery, convenience, alcohol, retail, and DashMart stores across the US and Canada. This team focuses on building our Canadian marketplace to ensure we are able to deliver exactly what consumers are looking for when they want it, with speed and quality. 

 About the Role 

 We are hiring a few Senior Associates on our Canada New Verticals Strategy & Operations. One role will focus on improving how we partner with our Dashers and driving efficiencies to how they operate. The second role will focus on driving quality improvements to our platform that enhances the shopping experience resulting in higher consumer spend. Both roles will require you to understand marketplace data and constraints to strategize actionable plans to improve efficiency levers impacting things like in-store navigation, in-app experience, dasher pay, pricing & promotions and so much more! These roles require you to understand our three-sided marketplace and the unit economics that impact our financial success all while balancing growth, cost and quality. You’ll need to weigh both sides of that tradeoff in every lever you pull.

 These roles sit at the intersection of strategy, operations, and product. The best operators today are rapidly generating new ideas, taking ownership over metrics and moving them in the right direction through building product visions, synthesizing complex analyses and testing every idea — all while leveraging AI to uplevel how we operate. We expect this person to stay at the forefront of how AI is reshaping the work, actively exploring new tools, automating repetitive workflows, and finding ways to do in hours what used to take weeks.

 You will report into a Manager on our New Verticals Strategy & Operations team and be an individual contributor position. We operate in a hybrid model and spend a few days a month in person together. We have two positions so throughout the interview process, we will consider you for two roles and align on role fit throughout the interview process!

 You’re excited about this opportunity because you will… 

- Strategize. From first principles, you’ll develop the optimal strategy for best serving all sides of the marketplace - dashers, merchants and consumers.

- Operate . Own tracking dashboards and manage week over week metrics to drive high quality operations.

- Experiment. Design, launch, and share out operational experiments and product features that impact things like dynamic delivery windows, order batching, predictive ordering, in-app merchandising, etc.

- Analyze . Build models using Excel and SQL to evaluate the economic, operational and strategic costs and benefits of various programs and experiments — and increasingly, use AI to accelerate and deepen that analysis.

- Build with AI . You'll use AI tools to automate manual processes, build new prototypes and develop product visions. You'll be expected to push the boundaries of what's possible with AI in your day-to-day work, and share what you learn with the team.

- Lead, collaborate and Influence. You’ll partner with and influence cross-functional teams including growth, quality, finance, product, analytics and engineering to launch initiatives to the finish line. 

- Own. You will manage core metrics across Dashers or Consumers and be the DRI for the success of metrics ranging from acceptance rates, batch rates, subtotals, basket size and so many others! 

- Partner. Work with Product, Engineering, Analytics, and our US Logistics counterparts to share learnings and scale what works.

 We’re excited about you because…

- You solve problems from first principles. You resist “this is how it’s always been done” thinking.

- You're entrepreneurial. You have a bias for action and are able to build things from the ground up. 

- You are an operator. You solve problems by actually understanding the problem.

- You like data, and you let it win arguments. You’re comfortable building complex SQL queries across multiple data sources and have experience with data visualization and dashboarding tools.

- You're energized by AI tools — and you actively experiment with them. You don't wait to be told how to use a new tool; you’re already exploring tools like Claude, Cursor, Gemini and more. You bring a builder's mindset to AI: using it to automate the repetitive, accelerate the analytical, and unlock work that would otherwise require a larger team. You're comfortable with a role whose scope will continue to shift as AI becomes more capable, and you see that as an opportunity rather than a threat.

- You’re unafraid of uncharted territory. This role is still taking shape, and you’re excited to help define it rather than inherit a fixed playbook.

- You have 2-4+ years of experience. You’ve succeeded in high-performing cultures (tech, operations, strategy, consulting, banking, startups or a related experience). 

- You have a completed Bachelor’s Degree. 

 Compensation

About the Team 

 DoorDash Drive is our white label fulfillment platform powering e-commerce for merchants on and off the DoorDash platform. The Drive New Verticals team partners with merchants across Grocery, Convenience, Retail, and Pharma to strategically and operationally address their e-commerce and logistics needs through our three-sided marketplace.

 About the Role 

 We are looking for a Senior Associate to join our New Verticals Drive Strategy & Operations team, passionate about scaling high-growth products. This team focuses on growing Last Mile Delivery and Dasher Shop & Deliver for our Drive partners, with this role specifically focused on Dasher Shop & Deliver. In this role, you will unlock accessibility to local businesses on their own terms by launching new products and services to expand both DoorDash’s and merchants’ total addressable market. You will work on growth, profitability, and merchant strategy initiatives to scale our Dasher Shop & Deliver offering across Grocery and other New Verticals categories. You will partner cross-functionally to improve product quality and operational excellence, contribute to the ideation, testing, and execution of new services and features, and support profitability efforts through data-driven recommendations, financial modelling for merchant negotiations and new-net merchant contracts, and account optimization initiatives. Reporting to the Manager of Drive Strategy & Operations, you will work cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Sales, Operations, Finance, and other teams to make your vision a reality. We operate in a hybrid model, so we spend a few days a quarter in person together, but all our offices are open should you choose to go in more regularly.

 You’re excited about this opportunity because you will… 

- Strategize:  You will develop the strategy to best serve our customers, thinking at a deeply strategic level about the success now and 3+ years out. 

- Operate : You will get to the lowest level of detail to identify opportunities and scale solutions. You will work directly with internal and external partners to execute short- and long-term plans, serving as a cross-functional enabler and strong operator.

- Analyze. You will use data to root-cause problems, identify opportunities, build business cases, develop solutions, and ideate net-new initiatives.

- Build: You will develop and lead 0 to 1 opportunities, creating the roadmap for future growth vectors and determine how to invest our resources to achieve desired outcomes. You’ll do whatever it takes to launch, get 1% better every day, and scale something completely new. This means everything from high-level strategy to nitty-gritty operational details.

- Collaborate : You value partnerships, and will excel at working across Operations, Finance, Product, Sales, Engineering, and more to bring new products and services to merchants.

 We’re excited about you because… 

- You have an extreme sense of ownership. You display extreme ownership for the products and business lines that you are responsible for. You never shy away from raising your hand to solve ambiguous problems and are able to motivate and empower your teammates to go above and beyond.

- You solve problems from first principles.   You’re excited to solve problems in innovative ways, and you resist “this is how it’s always been done” thinking.

- You’re an analytical powerhouse. You let data win arguments and are comfortable pulling your own data in SQL and modeling in Excel to identify opportunities and build clear business cases. You can translate complex findings into concise, compelling recommendations for both internal stakeholders and merchant partners. You’ve adapted to AI tooling and are comfortable using Claude, Cursor, Gemini and/or Copilot to improve and enhance your work.

- You’re relentless.   You do what it takes to win, no matter what.

- You’re a team player. You’re able to work cross-functionally across internal & external stakeholders, ranging from technical & non-technical teams. You meet people on their level. 

- You act with urgency.   Speed excites you. You prefer an accomplishment today to an accomplishment tomorrow. 

- You’re a builder. You enjoy building from the ground up and excel in creating structure and process.

- You have 2-4 years of experience ideally in logistics, tech, consulting, startups, AI or other related fields.

The Product Manager, Due Diligence & Legal Filings, is responsible for implementing the strategic vision, roadmap, and delivery of key Canadian products within the Due diligence & Legal Filings Portfolio. Reporting to the VP of Product, this role leads the translation of business strategy into prioritized product outcomes, ensuring alignment with customer needs, regulatory requirements, and commercial objectives. The Product Manager provides leadership to Product Owners and Product Analysts, manages key external stakeholder relationships, and drives the adoption of AI-enabled product and operational practices. This role is critical to maintaining portfolio growth, supporting Ministry and vendor partnerships, delivering roadmap commitments, and ensuring the successful execution of strategic initiatives across the Canadian Due Diligence & Legal Filings portfolio. 

Key Responsibilities 

Execute the product strategy and vision for the Due Diligence & Legal Filings portfolio, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and customer needs. 
Own and manage the product roadmap, including prioritization, sequencing, and trade-off decisions across multiple products and initiatives. 
Conduct market research, competitive analysis, and customer discovery activities to identify opportunities for growth and innovation. 
Contribute to the development of business cases and investment recommendations that drive measurable business outcomes and profitability. 
Lead the product development lifecycle from concept and planning through delivery, enhancement, and retirement. 
Work closely with Product Owners to develop, prioritize, and maintain product backlogs and roadmaps. 
Collaborate with Software Development Managers to align product priorities, development capacity, and delivery plans. 
Partner with UI/UX teams to deliver intuitive, customer-focused product experiences. 
Lead agile product delivery activities, including backlog management, release planning, requirements definition, and prioritization. 
Analyze product performance metrics, user feedback, and business data to support data-driven decision-making and continuous improvement. 
Provide regular updates to senior leadership on roadmap progress, strategic initiatives, risks, and performance metrics. 
Develop and execute go-to-market strategies in partnership with Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, and Support teams. 
Ensure organizational readiness for product launches, enhancements, and customer-facing initiatives. 
Serve as the primary product contact for Ministry stakeholders, vendor partners, and external organizations. 
Manage regulatory requirements, program changes, vendor dependencies, and key stakeholder commitments. 
Lead the adoption and governance of AI tools, including though not limited to Microsoft Copilot and Claude, within product management processes and product capabilities. 
Ensure AI initiatives align with organizational governance policies and approved technology standards. 
Lead, coach, and develop a team of Product Owners and Product Analysts, fostering accountability and continuous improvement. 
Work closely with Engineering, Sales, Customer Success, Legal, Compliance, and executive stakeholders to align priorities and achieve business objectives. 
Support strategic planning and portfolio growth initiatives across the Canadian product portfolio. 

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise 

10+ years of Product Management experience within B2B SaaS or enterprise software environments. 
Proven track record of delivering measurable business outcomes through product strategy, roadmap execution, and product innovation. 
Experience leading and developing Product Owners, Product Analysts, or other product management professionals. 
Experience in the Due Diligence & Legal Filing domain within Canada. 
Deep knowledge of delivering an API first strategy and partner integration.  
Strong experience managing products throughout the full product lifecycle, from ideation to retirement. 
Demonstrated success working within Agile product development environments. 
Experience creating and managing product roadmaps, business cases, requirements, and prioritization frameworks. 
Strong understanding of software development processes, integrated technology ecosystems, and modern SaaS platforms. 
Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams including Engineering, UX/UI, Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Legal, and Compliance. 
Exceptional stakeholder management skills, including experience working with government agencies, regulatory organizations, vendors, and executive leadership. 
Strong analytical skills with the ability to leverage product and customer data to drive strategic decisions. 
Commercially minded with the ability to balance business objectives, customer needs, revenue goals, and user experience considerations. 
Excellent communication, presentation, storytelling, and influencing skills. 
Experience leading distributed teams across multiple locations and time zones. 
Demonstrated ability to manage competing priorities and make strategic trade-off decisions. 
Experience with AI technologies, specifically Microsoft Copilot and Claude, and their application within product management, product development, and operational processes. 
Knowledge of AI governance, responsible AI practices, and technology adoption frameworks. 
Strong leadership, coaching, mentoring, and team development capabilities. ]
Ability to build collaborative relationships and drive alignment across diverse stakeholder groups.
Bchelor's degree in Business, Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience. 

Benefits 

At Dye & Durham we strive to be visionaries! As a leader in our field, we ensure our employees are ready for the next challenge in their journey with us by offering internal and external training opportunities. We offer competitive salaries and a whole host of benefits including healthcare, pension, company discounts, wellness programs, and paid days off to move house or volunteer for your favourite charity. 

In line with the amended Employment Standards Act 2000, the salary range for this role is up to: $120K dependent on assessment of skills during the interview process.

Hi, we are ecobee. 

 ecobee introduced the world’s first smart Wi-Fi thermostat to help millions of consumers save money, conserve energy, and bring home automation into their lives. That was just the beginning. We continue our pursuit to create technology that brings peace of mind into the home and allows people to focus on the moments that matter most. We take pride in making a meaningful difference to the environment, all while being part of the exciting, connected home revolution.

 In 2021, ecobee became a subsidiary of Generac Power Systems. Generac introduced the first affordable backup generator and later created the category of automatic home standby generator. The company is committed to sustainable, cleaner energy products poised to revolutionize the 21st century electrical grid. Together, we take pride in making a meaningful difference to the environment.

 Why we love to do what we do: 

 We’re helping build the world of tomorrow with solutions that improve everyday life while making a positive impact on the planet. Our products and services work in harmony to provide comfort, efficiency, and peace of mind for millions of homes and businesses. While we’re proud of what we’ve done so far, there’s still a lot we can do—and you can be part of it. 

 Join our extraordinary team. 

 We're a rapidly growing global tech company headquartered in Canada, in the heart of downtown Toronto, with an office in Leeds, UK, and remote ecopeeps in the US. We get to work with some of North America and UK's leading professionals. Our colleagues are proud to bring their authentic selves to work, confident that what we do is grounded in a greater purpose. We’re always looking for curious, talented, and passionate people to join our team.

 The Senior Engineering Program Manager leads cross-functional delivery of product development initiatives, including new product introductions, cost reduction, technology integration, and lifecycle product support. This role is accountable for translating product strategy, requirements, and business objectives into clear, executable delivery plans. The Senior Engineering Program Manager owns end-to-end delivery of programs, manages cross-functional dependencies and risks, and ensures program teams remain aligned on scope, timing, trade-offs, and execution priorities.

The Senior Engineering Program Manager brings structure to ambiguity, connects decisions to business outcomes, and maintains visibility across programs within their product line or line of business. This position works closely with product management, engineering, support, manufacturing operations, supply chain, marketing, quality, finance, IT, and other cross-functional partners. Success in this role is measured by predictable execution, clear program ownership, strong stakeholder alignment, proactive risk management, and on-time delivery of business and customer outcomes.

 This role follows a hybrid schedule, with in-office work required on Wednesdays and Thursdays and as needed to support collaboration and program actions .

 Essential Duties & Responsibilities 

- Own end-to-end delivery of assigned programs of moderate complexity through planning, execution, launch readiness, and closeout.

- Develop, maintain, and communicate integrated program plans that reflect scope, timing, capacity, dependencies, risks, milestones, and key decision points.

- Manage dependencies, resource constraints, sequencing, and delivery risks across related programs within the product line or line of business, escalating conflicts with clear recommendations.

- Frame trade-offs with clear options, impacts, risks, and recommendations to drive timely decisions when scope, schedule, cost, capacity, quality, customer needs, or downstream commitments conflict.

- Translate product requirements and business objectives into clear delivery scope, milestones, and product realization plans in partnership with Product and Engineering.

- Lead programs through Generac NPD processes, including milestone, design, and gate reviews using accurate, decision-ready information.

- Drive execution with appropriate urgency by identifying blockers, clarifying ownership, escalating risks, and ensuring teams understand the decisions and actions required to maintain progress.

- Understand technical decisions at a systems level and surface schedule, cost, compliance, integration, or dependency implications proactively.

- Facilitate cross-functional alignment with documented outcomes, clear ownership, and proactive management of inter-team dependencies and conflicts.

- Own change control for material changes to scope or plan, including impact assessment and decision documentation to secure stakeholder alignment.

- Apply lessons learned, propose improvements to program management and NPD practices, and help drive adoption across the PgM team and supported business areas.

 Minimum Qualifications 

- Bachelor of Science degree in Engineering, Engineering Technology or Management, Computer Science, or another directly engineering-related field.

- 10 years of progressive experience in engineering, product management, or a related field, including 8 years of program management experience leading cross-functional teams through end-to-end delivery.

 Preferred Qualifications 

- Demonstrated experience managing new product development programs from end-to-end, using a phase-gate (or similar) development process.

- Experience supporting full-system product releases including hardware, software, firmware, manufacturing, supply chain, service, and launch readiness.

- PMP, PgMP, or related certification with demonstrated practical application.

- Experience working with global teams, international suppliers, or distributed development and manufacturing organizations.

 Knowledge, Skills and Abilities 

- Brings structure to ambiguous cross-functional work and challenges unclear assumptions.

- Builds program plans based on scope, assumptions, dependencies, trade-offs, critical path, and risk.

- Connects program decisions to schedule, cost, quality, operational readiness, portfolio priorities, and customer outcomes.

- Understands product development at a systems level and identifies when technical decisions affect program delivery.

- Raises risks and issues early, explains their impact, and drives mitigation or corrective action in a timely manner.

- Ability to influence teams and stakeholders without direct authority while building trust and productive working relationships.

- Provides concise, decision-ready updates to senior leaders.

- Takes ownership of delivery misses, applies lessons learned, and improves planning and execution practices.

lever:eqbank:ed06b95a-a20e-4a10-a8a5-fd7.title: Director, Strategy, Risk and Business Operations
lever:eqbank:ed06b95a-a20e-4a10-a8a5-fd7.description:
Join a Challenger At EQ, we're remaking banking so every Canadian gets ahead, every day. Serving nearly 4 million Canadians from coast to coast, we offer a wide variety of financial services from banking and lending, to trust and credit union solutions.  We've been at this since 1970, challenging the conventions of traditional banking with smarter, faster, and more connected financial experiences. What's kept us moving?  The people behind it all: challengers who ask better questions, push back on old assumptions, and look for a better way forward. If you're driven to help reshape how banking works for Canadians and the businesses that power our economy, this could be your next big opportunity.  We can’t wait to get to know you!  The Work   Reporting to the VP, Decumulation, the Director, Strategy, Risk & Business Operations is responsible for leading the strategic planning, business performance and enablement, governance, and risk management functions for the Reverse Mortgage and Insurance Lending business. Acting as the operational and strategic leader to the VP, Decumulation, this role ensures the business maintains a robust risk and control environment while delivering on growth, profitability, and customer objectives. The Director will oversee enterprise and business-specific risk activities including risk appetite monitoring, credit, operational, compliance, legal, conduct, model, and reputational risks. This leader will act as the primary liaison between the business and corporate Risk, Legal, Compliance, Finance, Audit, Governance and other business related risk functions such as Fraud Management while ensuring the business meets all regulatory, governance, and board reporting obligations. In addition, the Director will lead annual strategic planning, financial forecasting, business performance management, executive and Board reporting, KPI development, , enterprise initiatives, business enablement programs, and the development of new products and growth opportunities. The role requires a unique combination of strategic leadership, analytical rigor, operational execution, governance expertise, and cross-functional influence. The Core Responsibilities:

Strategic Planning & Business Performance

  • Support the development and execution of the annual business strategy, operating plan, and growth priorities for the Reverse Mortgage business.
  • Own business performance management, including KPI development, executive dashboards, forecasting, and financial modeling.
  • Drive strategic business initiatives and investment decisions through business cases, market analysis, profitability assessments and ongoing performance reporting. Lead the execution of initiatives as needed.
  • Key Metrics: Achievement of annual volume, revenue, and profitability targets, Strategic initiative delivery (% completed on time and on budget), KPI and reporting accuracy/timeliness

    • Risk Management & Governance

  • Own first-line risk management activities across credit, operational, compliance, legal, conduct, and reputational risk.
  • Act as the primary liaison between the business and Risk, Compliance, Legal, Audit, and other partners.
  • Lead program development activities such as a the corporate RCM program, risk assessments, issue remediation, governance activities, and committee submissions while ensuring compliance with risk appetite and regulatory requirements. Perform testing of business controls as needed.
  • Key Metrics: Number and severity of audit, compliance, or regulatory findings, completion of remediation actions within agreed timelines, business performance against approved risk appetite metrics.

    • Credit Risk, Portfolio Analytics & Model Governance

    • Oversee LTV model governance, portfolio monitoring, stress testing, and scenario analysis to support risk management and strategic decision-making.
    • Partner with Credit Risk and Finance teams to monitor portfolio performance, concentration risks, and emerging trends.
    • Lead development and reporting of portfolio, risk, and capital metrics for executive and Board audiences.
    • Key Metrics: Portfolio delinquency and loss performance versus plan, timeliness and accuracy of stress testing and scenario analysis, LTV model governance and validation compliance.

      • Executive, Board & Regulatory Reporting

      • Lead preparation of Board, Executive Committee, ERMC, and regulatory reporting packages.
      • Develop clear, data-driven insights and recommendations supporting strategic and risk-related decision-making.
      • Ensure reporting effectively communicates business performance, emerging risks, and mitigation actions.
      • Key Metrics: On-time delivery of Board and committee materials, stakeholder satisfaction with reporting quality and insights, number of material reporting errors or revisions.

        • Business Enablement & Transformation

        • Lead cross-functional business transformation and operational improvement initiatives that enhance scale, efficiency, and customer outcomes.
        • Establish governance frameworks to prioritize, monitor, and measure strategic project delivery.
        • Partner across Technology, Operations, Product, and Finance to remove barriers and accelerate execution. Identify and accelerate opportunities to leverage AI through the risk and all business functions.
        • Key Metrics: Benefits realized from business initiatives, project delivery on time and within budget.

          • New Product Development & Innovation

          • Lead strategic evaluation, business case development, and governance for new products and product enhancements.
          • Coordinate cross-functional assessments involving Risk, Finance, Credit, Legal, Compliance, Operations, and Technology.
          • Ensure new products meet profitability, customer, risk, and regulatory objectives.
          • Key Metrics: New product launches delivered on time, business case outcomes versus forecast, product profitability and adoption rates

            • People Leadership

            • Lead, develop, and coach a high-performing team responsible for strategy, risk, analytics, and business operations.
            • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
            • Build organizational capability in strategic planning, governance, data analytics, and risk management.
            • Key Metrics: Employee engagement scores, achievement of team performance objectives.
    Let's Talk About You:
    • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Mathematics, or a related field.
    • 10+ years of progressive experience in strategy, risk management, business management, finance, consulting, or related leadership roles within financial services.
    • Ideally has a mix of Consulting and financial industry experience.
    • Deep understanding of credit risk, operational risk, compliance risk, governance frameworks, and financial services regulatory environments.
    • Experience preparing Executive Committee, Board, and Risk Committee materials.
    • Strong financial modeling, forecasting, and business case development experience.
    • Experience leading strategic planning and enterprise transformation initiatives.
    • Strong analytical skills with the ability to synthesize complex information into clear recommendations and actionable insights.
    • Exceptional stakeholder management skills with demonstrated ability to influence senior executives and cross-functional teams.
    • Advanced proficiency in data analysis, KPI development, dashboard creation, and performance management.
    • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation communication skills.

lever:eqbank:c40c0c17-1c33-4a69-8a82-0b8.description:
Purpose of the Job:  The Lead, Program Governance & Enablement is an individual contributor role within the Integration Management Office (IMO). Working directly with the Senior Director, Program Management, the incumbent plays a key role in driving integration execution, governance effectiveness, and delivery outcomes across the program.  The role is responsible for leading assigned integration workstreams, initiatives, and cross-functional deliverables while also providing governance, reporting, and program management support across the broader integration. The incumbent works with stakeholders across business and corporate functions to drive milestones, manage risks, issues, dependencies, decisions, and actions, and help remove blockers that may impact program delivery.  In addition, the role brings together information from across the program to produce executive materials, governance reporting, and actionable insights for leadership decision-making. The role works closely with senior leaders, workstream owners, and delivery teams to ensure integration commitments are progressing as planned and that emerging issues are identified and addressed promptly.  The role provides broad exposure across the integration, including the Executive Steering Committee, IMO All Hands, leadership updates, the integration program management platform, and consolidated reporting on contracts, Transition Service Agreements, synergies, and benefits.  The role suits an organized, analytically strong individual who can structure problems, work through ambiguity, influence stakeholders, and drive outcomes in a complex environment. Relevant experience may come from management consulting, a Big Four firm, an internal strategy or transformation team, program management, or another demanding environment requiring structured problem-solving, stakeholder management, and executive communication. Main Activities: :
Integration Workstream Leadership
Lead complex integration workstreams and cross-functional initiatives, ensuring milestones, dependencies, risks, and deliverables remain on track.
Partner across business, technology, risk, legal, and operations teams to drive execution and resolve issues.
Provide status updates, recommendations and escalations to leadership while ensuring accountability for outcomes.
 
Executive Materials & Communications
Create executive-level presentations, reports, and governance materials for leadership and steering committees.
Translate complex or evolving information into clear, concise, and decision-focused narratives.
Leverage AI tools to accelerate research, content development and reporting while ensuring quality, accuracy and consistency.
 
Program Governance & Coordination
Coordinate governance processes, meeting materials, timelines, and executive submissions across the integration program.
Track decisions, outcomes, actions, and follow-up activities to ensure effective execution.
Serve as a key partner to program leadership, supporting strategic priorities, executive requests, and operational effectiveness.
 
Program Management Platform & Reporting
Manage and enhance the integration program management platform to improve visibility and collaboration.
Develop dashboards, reporting views, and executive summaries covering milestones, risks, dependencies, and program performance.
Drive automation and AI-enabled reporting solutions to improve efficiency and data quality.
 
RAID, Dependency, Decision & Action Management
Maintain centralized tracking of risks, assumptions, issues, dependencies, decisions, and actions across the program.
Monitor ownership, timelines, blockers, and escalation requirements to support timely resolution.
Provide clear exception reporting and insights to support leadership decision-making and governance.
 
Contracts, TSAs, Synergies & Benefits Reporting
Consolidate and report on contracts, Transition Service Agreements (TSAs), synergies, benefits, and value-capture initiatives.
Partner with Finance, Legal, Procurement, Technology, and delivery teams to gather and align program updates.
Highlight risks, gaps, dependencies, and integration impacts while supporting accurate enterprise-level reporting.
:

Skills & Knowledge

  • Strong problem-solving, analytical, organizational, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Advanced PowerPoint and executive communication capabilities, with the ability to translate complex information into clear, decision-focused narratives.
  • Experience with program governance, RAID and dependency management, dashboards, structured data, and AI-enabled research, analysis, and reporting.
  • Sound judgment, attention to detail, and the ability to influence, navigate ambiguity, and drive actions to completion.

    • Education & Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in program management, transformation, consulting, strategy, governance, integration management, or related fields.
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Commerce, Finance, Strategy, Technology, or a related discipline.
  • Proven experience developing executive-level presentations, management reporting, and coordinating complex, cross-functional initiatives.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint, Excel, and Microsoft 365; experience in consulting, transformations, integrations, financial services, TSAs, contracts, synergies, or benefits reporting is an asset.

    • What Success Looks Like

  • Deliver high-quality executive, governance, and All Hands materials accurately and on schedule.
  • Maintain reliable program reporting across milestones, RAID items, dependencies, decisions, actions, and blockers.
  • Ensure contract, TSA, synergy, and benefits reporting is consolidated, aligned, and linked to program outcomes.
  • Proactively identify risks, gaps, overdue actions, and escalation needs while improving efficiency through automation, templates, and AI.

workday:expedia/search:R-109904.description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

 Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

 Program Manager II, AI & Productivity 

 Please note : Role must be based in Vancouver. Relocation support not available for this role.   

 Introduction to the team 

 Expedia Group B2B connects partners across the travel industry to our leading technology, supply, and services - helping them deliver seamless travel experiences to their customers. From airlines and hotels to financial institutions and other travel platforms, we power smarter, faster, and more impactful travel solutions through the most connected marketplace in the world.

 Expedia Cruises is seeking a Program Manager II, AI & Productivity to identify and implement opportunities to improve how we work through AI, automation, and emerging technologies across the cruise and travel business. You’ll examine existing workflows, including legacy technology and manual processes, to simplify work, improve productivity, and modernize our operations for the future. This is a highly hands-on role focused on building and implementing practical AI solutions, while also championing AI adoption across our corporate teams.

 In this role, you will : 

- Identify and prioritize opportunities to use AI and automation, spending regular time with internal teams to understand workflows and pain points firsthand and shape what gets built and in what order. 

- Analyze existing workflows, legacy technology, and manual processes to identify opportunities to automate, simplify, or modernize. 

- Design, build, and implement practical AI solutions, including document processing, data extraction, email workflows, summarization, and other repetitive activities. 

- Build and deploy solutions using LLMs and agentic workflows (e.g., prompt engineering, RAG, multi-step automation) to solve real business problems. 

- Evaluate and maximize AI capabilities within existing enterprise software and licensed platforms, while identifying emerging technologies that can deliver value. 

- Take solutions from pilot to scaled rollout, managing timelines, communications, and change management to drive adoption -- iterating based on real usage and feedback. 

- Track the impact of AI initiatives against clear metrics, and keep stakeholders informed on progress and results. 

- Partner with business and Technology teams to implement, scale, and troubleshoot AI initiatives, coordinating across teams as needed to keep work moving. 

- Serve as an AI champion across the corporate organization through training, coaching, demonstrations, and practical guidance 

 Experience and Qualifications: 

- 5+ years of experience in program management, process improvement, automation, technology, or a related field. 

- Hands-on experience building with LLMs and agentic workflows (e.g., prompt engineering, multi-step automation) to solve real business problems. 

- Experience designing, building, and implementing AI-powered solutions, workflows, or automations. 

- Strong understanding of AI tools, emerging technologies, and their practical business applications.  

- Strong analytical, problem-solving, and process improvement skills. 

- Comfortable working across teams and functions to get things done, with strong communication skills to train and advocate for AI adoption.

greenhouse:faire:8864857002.description:
About Faire 

 Faire is a technology wholesale platform built on the belief that the future is local. Independent retailers around the globe collectively represent a multi-hundred-billion-dollar wholesale market that has historically been fragmented and offline. At Faire, we're using the power of tech, data, and machine learning to connect this thriving community of entrepreneurs across the globe. Picture your favorite boutique in town — we help them discover the best products from around the world to sell in their stores. With the right tools and insights, we believe that we can level the playing field so businesses can grow and local communities can thrive.

 We’re looking for smart, resourceful and passionate people to join us as we power the shop local movement. If you believe in community, come join ours.

 About the Role 

 We're looking for Product Managers to sit at the nexus of design, engineering, data science, strategy and go-to-market, partnering closely across those functions and with founders and senior leadership to shape decisions that move Faire forward.

 You’ll own a significant area of the roadmap, deeply understand the customers you build for, and execute with an eye toward impact.

 We hire role agnostic, first assessing your fit for Faire through the interview process and then matching you to the role, team and problem space where you’ll have the greatest impact, based on your experience, skills and interest.

 You’ll be aligned to one of these pillars:

 Retailer Growth focuses on making Faire’s retailers more successful by acquiring, activating, and retaining more retailers, ultimately driving demand and deeper engagement with the marketplace.⁠

 Brand drives Faire’s supply side — acquiring new brands, building tooling to help them run their businesses, partnering with them to maximize their growth and success on Faire, and ensuring quality of the marketplace.

 Discovery focuses on the core shopping experience — helping retailers find the right products and brands through search, recommendations, ads, and exploration while balancing marketplace dynamics.

 Value makes Faire the best place for independent retailers to buy , building programs that take cost and friction out of sourcing inventory: membership discounts, flexible financing, a fulfillment network enabling lower minimums and faster and cheaper shipping, and simpler inventory workflows behind every order.

 Ads helps brands succeed on Faire by putting them in control of their growth through paid placement. The team builds effective advertising products that accelerate brands’ wholesale growth while connecting retailers with relevant products.⁠

 What you’ll do 

- Own strategy and roadmap for your product area. Set the multi-year direction for how current and future products evolve and build the prioritized roadmap to get there.

- Own specific goals and outcomes. You will be responsible for specific product outcomes and goals all designed to drive meaningful growth for the marketplace.

- Own the unit economics for your product. Know the levers that drive your product's growth and margin.

- Partner deeply across Design, Data Science, Strategy & Analytics, Go-To-Market, Operations and Engineering. Earn trust across functions, lead without authority, and keep complex, multi-stakeholder work moving without losing momentum.

- Communicate clearly at every altitude. Translate complex, technical topics for a wide range of audiences, from engineering partners to senior leadership.

 What we’re looking for, across levels: 

- 4+ years of product management experience (years of experience requirements scale with level, see below), with demonstrated ability to own complex, cross-functional products end to end.

- Strategic clarity with hands-on execution. You can zoom out and develop a defensible multi-year point of view, then zoom back in to write crisp requirements, drive execution, and unblock your team.

- High learning velocity and analytical rigor. You define the metrics that matter, size the opportunity before you commit to it, and use data to drive decisions.

- Customer empathy and strong design sense. You deeply understand how retailers and brands run their businesses and what makes them trust a platform like ours. You are skilled at designing thoughtful and delightful experiences that solve customer needs.

- Structured problem solving. You break ambiguous problems into clear hypotheses, don't mistake activity for progress, and diagnose root causes rather than escalate.

- Cross-functional influence across Design, Engineering, Data Science, Strategy & Analytics, and Go to Market, and a track record of aligning diverse stakeholders while maintaining momentum.

- Proven ability to influence at the executive level and to communicate complex topics with clarity and conviction across audiences.

- AI fluency. You use AI tools to accelerate problem solving, solution definition, and analysis; you are comfortable getting hands on building prototypes and using AI to accelerate decision-making.

- Marketplace experience is a strong plus — particularly familiarity with two-sided dynamics and competing customer objectives.

 Levels we're hiring for 

 We hire generalist PMs across the following levels. Your final level and team will be determined through the interview process based on your experience and our current openings.

 Senior Product Manager - 4+ years of product management experience

 Staff Product Manager - 7+ years of product management experience

 Principal Product Manager -   10+ years of product management experience

 Salary Range 

 Senior Product Manager:

- San Francisco, CA/New York City, NY: The pay range for this role is $188,000 - 258,500 USD

- Toronto, ON: The pay range for this role is $148,000 - 203,500 CAD

 Staff Product Manager:

- San Francisco, CA/New York City, NY: The pay range for this role is $220,000 - 302,000 USD

- Toronto, ON: The pay range for this role is $184,000 - 253,000 CAD

 Principal Product Manager

- San Francisco, CA/New York City, NY: The pay range for this role is $260,000 - 357,500 USD

- Toronto, ON: The pay range for this role is $212,000 - 291,500 CAD

 This role will also be eligible for equity and benefits. Actual base pay will be determined based on permissible factors, including transferable skills, work experience, market demand, and primary work location. The base pay range provided is subject to change and may be modified in the future.
 Hybrid Faire employees currently go into the office 3 days per week on Tuesdays, Thursdays, and a third flex day of their choosing (Monday, Wednesday, or Friday). Additionally, hybrid in-office roles will have the flexibility to work remotely up to 4 weeks per year. Specific Workplace and Information Technology positions may require onsite attendance 5 days per week as will be indicated in the job posting. 

 Why you’ll love working at Faire 

- Move fast: You'll own meaningful problems that serve customers around the globe with the agency to move fast and see your results clearly.

- Equipped to scale: We invest in what matters, including the latest enterprise AI tools, to help you work smarter and get more out of every day.

- Best in class: Our team is full of sharp, kind, and generous colleagues who care about their craft and about helping you grow in yours.

- Real rewards. Competitive pay, equity, and comprehensive benefits designed to support your life inside and outside of work.

- Belonging: We're intentional about building an environment where every Faire employee has equal access to opportunities, growth, and success.

 Faire was founded in 2017 by a team of early product and engineering leads from Square. We’re backed by some of the top investors in retail and tech including: Y Combinator, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Forerunner Ventures, Khosla Ventures, Sequoia Capital, Founders Fund, and DST Global. We have headquarters in San Francisco and Kitchener-Waterloo, and a global employee presence across offices in Toronto, London, and New York. To learn more about Faire and our customers, you can read more on our blog .

 Faire provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity or gender expression.

 Faire is committed to providing access, equal opportunity and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. Accommodations are available throughout the recruitment process and applicants with a disability may request to be accommodated throughout the recruitment process. We will work with all applicants to accommodate their individual accessibility needs.  To request reasonable accommodation, please fill out our Accommodation Request Form ( https://bit.ly/faire-form) 

 Privacy 

 For information about the type of personal data Faire collects from applicants, as well as your choices regarding the data collected about you, please visit Faire’s Privacy Notice (https://www.faire.com/privacy)

dayforce:fieldeffect:695.description:
Field Effect is helping organizations around the world strengthen their cybersecurity posture through powerful, accessible solutions that simplify the complexity of cyber risk.
As we continue to grow, we're looking for a Director of Product Marketing to shape how we bring our products to market, tell our story, and help customers understand the value we deliver. This is a highly strategic role that sits at the intersection of our technical and go-to-market teams.
You'll be responsible for defining market positioning, leading go-to-market programs, driving competitive and market intelligence, supporting revenue growth through sales enablement, and ensuring our voice in the market remains differentiated and compelling.
What You'll Do:

Own product positioning, messaging, and value propositions across Field Effect's cybersecurity solutions.
Lead market research and competitive intelligence initiatives, gathering insights on customer needs, market trends, buyer behaviour, pricing, and the competitive landscape.
Develop and execute go-to-market strategies for new products, features, and strategic initiatives.
Act as the bridge between technical and go-to-market teams, delivering alignment across stakeholders, and ensuring product innovation is translated into differentiated market positioning, compelling customer messaging, and measurable business results.
Serve as the voice of the customer and market across the organization, helping shape how products are positioned, communicated, and brought to market.
Drive sales enablement initiatives, including battlecards, sales playbooks, solution briefs, presentations, and training programs that support pipeline growth and revenue generation.
Lead analyst relations and market influence programs to strengthen Field Effect's visibility and positioning within the cybersecurity industry.
Collaborate across Product, Research & Development, Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success teams to ensure consistent messaging and successful product launches.
Measure and communicate the impact of product marketing programs on awareness, pipeline, adoption, and revenue.
Build and scale product marketing processes, programs, and team capabilities as the organization grows.

Skills & Experience We Look For:

Deep cybersecurity industry expertise, with a strong understanding of the threat landscape, cybersecurity technologies, buyers, and market trends.
10+ years of experience in Product Marketing or related marketing leadership roles within cybersecurity organizations.
15+ years working in or alongside cybersecurity analysts or other technical cybersecurity roles.
Experience within an EDR, MDR, XDR, or adjacent cybersecurity vendor, with a strong understanding of selling to mid-market and enterprise organizations through both direct and channel-led motions, including MSPs and VARs.
Demonstrated success developing product positioning, messaging, and go-to-market strategies for cybersecurity products and solutions.
Demonstrated ability to influence business outcomes through product positioning, market strategy, sales enablement, and go-to-market execution.
Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, compelling customer value and business outcomes.
Experience partnering closely with technical and go-to-market teams, translating deeply technical concepts for personas and stakeholders of varied technical backgrounds.
Strong understanding of market research, competitive intelligence, sales enablement, and product launch execution.
Exceptional written, verbal, presentation, and storytelling skills.
Advanced stakeholder management skills, with a detailed approach to documentation and communication across internal teams to deepen alignment.
Fluent in using AI for Product Marketing workflows; you should be comfortable using Claude Cowork or Microsoft Copilot in your day to day, and adopting new tooling as needed.
Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, communications, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

Why Join Field Effect?

Be part of a company creating real impact by helping organizations identify, prioritize, and reduce cybersecurity risk.
Collaborate with some of the industry's leading cybersecurity experts, researchers, and software developers.
Shape how innovative cybersecurity solutions are positioned, communicated, and brought to market.
Influence business growth and market strategy at a pivotal stage in the company's evolution.
Operate with autonomy and accountability in a high-trust, results-oriented environment.
Work flexibly in ways that fit your life and help you perform at your best, with benefits and rewards that matter.
When we ask employees what makes Field Effect special, the answer is almost always the same: the people. We hire talented individuals who are not only great at what they do, but great to work with.

If this sounds exciting, we would love to hear from you! Please note that only the candidate(s) selected for the next phase of the hiring process will be contacted directly. 
Field Effect is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants are given consideration regardless of race, religion, colour, gender, sex, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, marital status, citizenship status, disability, veteran status, or any other protected class as provided in applicable employment laws. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please contact us.    
About Us:  
Field Effect is a global cybersecurity company on a mission to make intelligence-grade protection accessible to organizations of all sizes. Our managed detection and response platform combines advanced technology with expert insight to help businesses identify risks early, respond quickly, and stay ahead of evolving threats.
Founded by world-class experts, we take a practical, streamlined approach, building intuitive tools and delivering human expertise that helps organizations strengthen their security without added complexity.
We’re building a collaborative, high-performing team that values curiosity, accountability, and continuous improvement. Field Effect has been recognized as one of Canada’s Top 100 Small and Medium Employers and a top employer in Ottawa.

This posting reflects a current, actively recruited opening at Float. All applications are being reviewed on a rolling basis.



ABOUT FLOAT

Float is on a mission to simplify finance for Canadian businesses, empowering them to eliminate complexity and unlock new opportunities. Through our innovative platform, Float enables businesses to streamline financial operations and optimize cash flow, so they can focus on what matters most: growth. 

 

As one of Canada’s fastest growing companies https://www.theglobeandmail.com/business/rob-magazine/top-growing-companies/article-ranking-canadas-top-growing-companies-of-2024/ and top-rated startups in 2025 https://www.linkedin.com/posts/floatfinancial_were-proud-to-share-that-float-has-been-activity-7387093684720300032-2DDz/, 2024 https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/linkedin-top-startups-2024-15-canadian-companies-rise-linkedin-news-llihe/ and 2023 https://lnkd.in/TSU23CA, Float is customer-obsessed, passionate and entrepreneurial, with a team that includes leaders from Uber, Stripe, Shopify, Top Hat, Ada, Doordash, Snowflake, and Wealthsimple.

 

At Float, everyone is an owner, bringing their unique perspective to our team and product. Your voice is important, and we take having a culture based on feedback seriously. We openly share our thoughts and differing opinions so we can continue to improve. We do our best to keep our decision-making decentralized so that all team members feel ownership in our success.

 


OUR PRODUCT

Float is Canada’s intelligent financial operating system, combining modern financial services and software to help businesses spend, save, and grow. Trusted by more than 10,000 Canadian companies, Float provides high-limit corporate cards, automated expense management, next-day bill payments, high-yield accounts, and industry-leading support, all built in Canada, for Canada. Float recently announced our $85 million Series C https://floatfinancial.com/press/float-financial-raises-cad-85-million-series-c, and is backed by world-class investors, including Inovia Capital, Growth Equity at Goldman Sachs Alternatives, OMERS Ventures, and Silicon Valley Bank.

 

Our team is a collection of ambitious, collaborative and mission-driven people from all walks of life but with one goal: helping Canadian companies not just survive but thrive. And we’re looking for bold innovators to help shape the future of business finance in Canada.




AI USE IN OUR HIRING PROCESS

We use technology, including artificial intelligence (AI), to support parts of our hiring process. This may include AI-assisted scheduling and candidate communications, and AI-generated interview notes, guides or summaries to help our team focus on the conversation. All hiring decisions are made by our hiring team.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re hiring a Head of Product Marketing to lead the function responsible for helping customers understand, adopt, and get more value from Float’s growing multi-product platform across the full customer journey. You’ll report to the SVP GTM Strategy & Marketing and lead a team spanning product marketing, lifecycle marketing, and customer marketing, with a mandate that spans acquisition, launch support, product adoption and usage.



This is a high-impact role at the core of the business. It offers the opportunity to refine Float’s product narrative, strengthen adoption across the customer lifecycle, and enable Product, Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing to more effectively communicate and deliver the platform’s value.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Refine Float’s positioning and messaging so the multi-product platform story lands clearly across target audiences and ongoing launches.

 - Build pre- and post-sale programs that improve product adoption and help customers realize more value across the customer journey.

 - Partner with Product on launches, readiness, and activation so new products and features translate into customer understanding and usage.

 - Equip Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing with messaging, playbooks, collateral, and activation tools that improve field effectiveness and adoption outcomes.

 - Build customer programs such as advocacy and advisory motions that strengthen product adoption and the broader commercial flywheel.

 - Use data, experimentation, and customer insight to evolve positioning, lifecycle strategy, and adoption programs over time.

 - Lead and develop a high-performing team with high standards for ownership, clarity, speed, and modern AI-enabled workflows.




ABOUT YOU


HERE’S WHAT SETS YOU UP FOR SUCCESS AT FLOAT:

greenhouse:gitlab:8658878002.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

 The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

 * Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab. 

 An overview of this role 

 As Principal Product Manager, Software Factory, you’ll define and bring together GitLab’s end-to-end software creation experience, from planning and specification through coding, review, and verification. You’ll connect capabilities across GitLab Duo Agent Platform and the wider GitLab product so customers have a cohesive and delightful experience. This is a senior, high-visibility role for a product leader who can shape product direction, work across organizational boundaries, and clearly present recommendations to executive leaders.

 What you’ll do 

- Define the product vision and strategy for GitLab’s end-to-end software factory experience.

- Bring together planning, specification, coding, review, and verification workflows into a cohesive product experience.

- Partner with product, engineering, design, and go-to-market teams across GitLab to align priorities and execution.

- Identify gaps, dependencies, and opportunities across GitLab Duo Agent Platform and related areas of the GitLab product.

- Use strong product and design judgment to make complex workflows clear and useful for customers.

- Build support for product decisions through clear communication, negotiation, and cross-functional collaboration.

- Present product direction, tradeoffs, and recommendations to senior and executive leaders.

- Help shape how GitLab brings its software factory vision to market.

 What you’ll bring 

- Product management experience at principal scope, leading complex products or experiences across multiple teams.

- A strong understanding of the end-to-end software development workflow, from planning through verification.

- Experience with artificial intelligence products, developer tools, DevSecOps platforms, or related technical products.

- Technical judgment that supports effective collaboration with engineering teams and informed product decisions.

- Strong product design and user experience instincts, including the ability to connect separate capabilities into a coherent experience.

- Experience influencing across functions, resolving competing priorities, and moving work forward without relying on direct authority.

- Clear communication and presentation skills, including experience working with senior and executive leaders.

- An ownership mindset and the ability to make progress in a fast-changing product area with some ambiguity.

 We welcome candidates with different backgrounds and transferable experience. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every qualification.

 About the team 

 This role will work across GitLab to connect the teams building the future of our AI-powered DevSecOps platform. You’ll partner closely with the GitLab Duo Agent Platform organization and with product areas that own key parts of the software development workflow. The team’s central challenge is to turn work delivered across several groups into one clear, end-to-end experience for customers while supporting GitLab’s mission to enable everyone to contribute to and co-create the software that powers our world.

 How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees 

- Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being 

- Flexible Paid Time Off  

- Team Member Resource Groups 

- Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan 

- Growth and Development Fund 

- Parental Leave  

 Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.

 Country Hiring Guidelines: GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.  

 Privacy Policy: Please review our Recruitment Privacy Policy. Your privacy is important to us.

 GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also  GitLab’s EEO Policy  and  EEO is the Law . If you have a disability or special need that requires  accommodation , please let us know during the  recruiting process .

greenhouse:gitlab:8871798002.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

 The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

 * Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab. 

 An overview of this role 

 As Principal Product Manager, Orbit, you'll define the vision, strategy, and roadmap for GitLab's software lifecycle context graph. Orbit connects source code and software development lifecycle data into a structured map of systems, relationships, dependencies, and ownership. You'll help engineers, software leaders, and artificial intelligence (AI) agents understand how teams build software and how changes affect the systems around it.

 You'll shape Orbit from its underlying graph model and query experiences through customer value, pricing, packaging, launch, and adoption. This role combines technical product leadership with building a business around software lifecycle context. You'll balance foundational platform work with near-term customer needs, working directly with technical customers and senior Engineering and Design leaders.

 You'll join Anand Ahire's product organization and partner across Product, Engineering, Design, Product Marketing, Sales, Solutions Engineering, and Customer Success, including the teams building GitLab Duo and the broader AI-powered development, security, and operations (DevSecOps) platform.

 What you'll do 

- Define Orbit's multi-year vision and roadmap across graph models and ontology, ingestion and indexing, query and retrieval, developer and agent interfaces, governance, and enterprise readiness. Shape how Orbit works across GitLab.com, Self-Managed, Dedicated, GitLab Duo Agent Platform, MCP-based external agents, APIs, and developer tooling.

- Turn complex platform opportunities into customer problems, measurable outcomes, and investment decisions. Use evidence to decide where to invest, iterate, partner, or stop.

- Partner with Engineering and Design on architecture and implementation tradeoffs across graph data models, indexing, query systems, application programming interfaces (APIs), Model Context Protocol (MCP), authorization, and scale.

- Use AI tools such as Claude Code and GitLab to investigate problems, explore code and data, prototype concepts, and create or review merge requests when that's the fastest way to learn.

- Lead discovery with developers, engineering leaders, platform teams, security teams, and technical executives to validate needs around dependencies, ownership, change impact, vulnerability exposure, pipeline health, and software delivery risk. Build repeatable feedback into roadmap decisions and help customers understand the value of connected graph context over disconnected searches or API calls.

- Define target customers, priority use cases, differentiated value, and the path to product-market fit. Partner with Product Marketing, Sales, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Pricing, and Finance on positioning, packaging, pricing, launch, adoption, and expansion.

- Develop business cases and track adoption, retention, usage, customer value, and revenue outcomes. Support executive briefings, analyst conversations, customer workshops, and field enablement.

- Align teams and executive leaders around clear recommendations and tradeoffs without relying on direct authority. Mentor other product managers, share practical frameworks, and represent GitLab's product vision in customer and industry conversations.

 What you'll bring 

- Experience owning complex technical products or platforms at Staff, Principal, or equivalent scope, with a track record of defining vision and roadmaps across multiple teams.

- Deep technical fluency in one or more relevant areas, such as developer tools, DevOps, software delivery, data platforms, distributed systems, knowledge graphs, search, APIs, AI infrastructure, or agentic systems.

- The ability to work credibly with engineers on architecture, data models, APIs, scale, reliability, and security.

- Business judgment and experience in market assessment, product strategy, pricing, packaging, business cases, or commercialization of technical products.

- Experience taking a product, platform, or category from early concept through launch, customer adoption, and iteration.

- A customer-first approach and the ability to build trusted relationships with technical practitioners, engineering leaders, architects, and executives.

- Clear written and verbal communication, with experience explaining complex ideas, influencing across functions, and resolving competing priorities in ambiguous work.

- Practical experience using AI tools in product work, including exploring code and data, prototyping workflows, and creating or reviewing merge requests. You take ownership, learn quickly, and move between strategy and implementation detail.

 About the team 

 In GitLab's Analytics organization, we focus on making Orbit's context available through GitLab experiences, developer tools, MCP, APIs, and the command-line interface (CLI).

 Our challenge is to turn complex, connected data into useful, trustworthy context for engineers and agents.
