lever:magnetforensics:419d3c80-089d-4642.description:
Who We Are; What We Do; Where We’re Going   Magnet Forensics is a global leader in the development of digital investigative software that acquires, analyzes, and shares evidence from computers, smartphones, tablets, and IoT-related devices. We are continually innovating so our customers can deploy advanced and effective tools to protect their companies, communities, and countries.   Serving thousands of customers globally, our solutions are playing a crucial role in modernizing digital investigations, helping investigators fight crime, protect assets, and guard national security.   With employees based around the world, Magnet Forensics has been expanding our global presence. As a part of Magnet Forensics, you can expect to make a difference in the world, no matter what role you play. You’ll be supported through learning and development, not to mention an incredible team with unbelievable talent and integrity.   If you think you would be the right person to join our team working towards this goal, we would love to hear from you!  Role Overview  Magnet One is the connective layer across our product portfolio, and the platform team builds the foundations every other team depends on: how customer organizations are structured, how users prove who they are, how purchases turn into working access, and how our own teams support all of it. Our customers are getting larger and structurally more complex - bigger agencies, federated deployments, stricter identity and data residency requirements - and the foundational decisions ahead deserve dedicated ownership rather than being made a ticket at a time. That's the role: one person who owns this domain end to end and gives it a deliberate direction. This is a builder's role with an unusually direct line to customer pain. Our administrators are IT and operations staff at law enforcement agencies, government labs, and enterprises - people who work under strict security policies, have limited tolerance for surprises, and often manage access for dozens or hundreds of investigators. Getting their experience right is a competitive advantage. Getting it wrong shows up as support tickets, stalled deployments, and renewals at risk.  What You'll Do:
You'll be the product owner for five connected areas, listed in the order we expect you to take them on.

1. Account-level administration (the immediate priority) The way customer organizations are modeled and managed in Magnet One: org and sub-org structure, user lifecycle, roles and permissions, seat and entitlement visibility, delegated administration for large or federated agencies, and the audit trails their security teams require. You'll own the permissions model itself — what roles exist, what they can do, and how that scales as customers get larger and more complex.

2. Identity and access Single sign-on (SAML/OIDC), directory-driven provisioning and deprovisioning (SCIM), multi-factor and session policy, service accounts and API credentials, and the migration path for customers on older authentication paths. Much of this is table stakes in enterprise procurement, and gaps here surface early in security reviews.

3. Order fulfillment The path from a closed deal to a customer with working access. Entitlement provisioning, renewals and co-termination, trials, and the handoffs between our commercial systems and the platform. Your goal is to shorten time-to-access and eliminate the manual intervention this process requires today.

4. Deployment site and regional footprint Where customer data lives and how we decide to expand. You'll own the logic for placing a customer in the right region at provisioning time, the constraints that drive that choice - data residency and sovereignty rules, agency policy, latency, regional service availability - and the analysis behind opening new regions. That means building the business case: which deals are blocked today by the absence of a region, what demand justifies the cost of standing one up, and what the sequencing should be. You'll also own how region is surfaced to customers and to sales, and what happens when a customer needs to move.

5. Internal tooling The consoles our support, customer success, and operations teams use to administer accounts, resolve entitlement issues, and assist customers safely - with the auditability that assisting a customer's account demands.

Across all five, you will:
  • Work directly with three or more engineering teams and their architects, in their language, on their design decisions.
  • Talk to customer administrators regularly and bring their reality back into the roadmap.
  • Sequence work across teams and make the tradeoff calls when platform investment competes with feature delivery.
  • Define what "good" looks like - provisioning success rates, time-to-first-login, admin task completion, support ticket volume by cause, deals unblocked by region availability - and hold the team to it.
  • Build and defend investment cases with quantitative analysis, particularly for regional expansion, where the cost is real and the demand signal is scattered across the pipeline.
  • Partner with sales engineering, security, support, revenue operations, and infrastructure, who all depend on these systems.
    • What year one looks like:

    First 90 days. You've built a clear picture of the current account administration and permissions model, including where it breaks. You've talked to at least a dozen customer administrators and internal stakeholders. You've published a prioritized problem inventory the engineering teams agree with.

    By six months. There's an agreed target model for organizations, roles, and permissions, and work is underway against it. Identity roadmap commitments are defined with dates you can defend in a customer conversation.

    By twelve months. Customer administrators can complete the core set of tasks without contacting support. Order fulfillment requires materially less manual intervention. Your engineering teams and your commercial stakeholders both know what's coming next and why.
    What We’re Looking For:
  • Roughly 4–6 years in product management, focused on platform, infrastructure, or B2B administrative capabilities rather than end-user features.
  • A hands-on engineering background earlier in your career. You read code and API contracts comfortably, and you can hold your own in an architecture discussion without a translator.
  • Direct experience with at least one of: identity and access management, multi-tenant account or organization modeling, permissions and authorization systems, or billing and entitlement provisioning.
  • Enterprise or B2B SaaS experience, including exposure to how security reviews and procurement shape what you can ship.
  • Analytical rigor. You can pull pipeline and usage data, size an opportunity, and put a defensible number in front of a leadership team — regional expansion decisions in particular are made on evidence, not instinct.
  • Demonstrated autonomy. You'll be trusted to run this domain, escalate the right things, and make defensible calls on the rest.
  • Strong written communication. Platform decisions are consumed by teams who weren't in the room, and writing is how this role scales.
  • Comfort working with customers whose environments are locked down, whose change windows are narrow, and who may be several steps removed from you organizationally.
    • Nice to Have Skills :
  • Experience introducing SSO or SCIM to a product that didn't have it, including customer migration.
  • Experience with data residency, sovereignty, or multi-region deployment decisions.
  • Experience serving public sector, regulated, or highly security-conscious customers.
  • Having built internal tooling for support and operations teams.
  • Experience being the first PM on a platform team.

Are you a self-starter who thrives on solving complex technical and delivery challenges? Are you passionate about bringing teams together to deliver high-quality solutions? If so, then we want to hear from you! 

 We are seeking an experienced Technical Program Manager to lead complex, cross-functional technology initiatives supporting our omni-channel communications and document management platform. 

 Your leadership will be critical to coordinating work across teams, maintaining delivery momentum, and ensuring technology solutions achieve intended business and customer outcomes.

 Our team continues to transform as a digital, customer-centric organization. As a part of this ongoing transformation, we are building digital solutions and leveraging vendor capabilities based on the latest technologies.

 The customer is the focus of everything we do, and millions of customers rely on our products daily. We believe in the value of empowering our team members with the resources to solve critical problems for the future of the business, which is why we need you!

 Position Responsibilities: 

- Lead the end-to-end lifecycle of complex technology initiatives, from planning and mobilization through delivery, implementation, and post-implementation review.

- Define program scope, objectives, outcomes, milestones, delivery plans, governance, and success measures in partnership with business and technology stakeholders.

- Coordinate work across engineering, architecture, product, operations, security, risk, and vendor teams to maintain alignment and delivery momentum.

- Build and maintain integrated program plans that identify milestones, resources, cross-team dependencies, critical paths, and delivery commitments.

- Proactively identify, assess, and manage risks, issues, assumptions, and dependencies, driving mitigation plans and escalating decisions when needed.

- Establish clear governance, reporting, and decision-making forums to provide stakeholders and leaders with timely visibility into program health, progress, tradeoffs, and outcomes.

- Facilitate planning sessions, status reviews, dependency discussions, and retrospectives that result in clear decisions, actions, owners, and target dates.

- Partner with technical leads to understand solution architecture, delivery constraints, implementation sequencing, operational readiness, and nonfunctional requirements.

- Manage changes to scope, schedule, and delivery approach through transparent impact assessment, stakeholder alignment, and documented decisions.

- Track program performance and delivery metrics, using data and insights to improve predictability, quality, and execution.

- Ensure implementation, release, change management, and operational readiness activities are coordinated and completed successfully.

- Lead post-implementation reviews, capture lessons learned, and drive continuous improvement across program delivery practices.

- Bring an innovative mindset to improving delivery processes, team collaboration, and technology outcomes.

 Required Qualifications: 

- Minimum 3+ years of experience in technical program management, technical project management, technology delivery, or a similar role.

- Experience with program and project tracking tools such as Jira, Confluence, or similar platforms.

- Experience with Agile, hybrid, and traditional program delivery methodologies.

- Experience managing large, complex initiatives spanning multiple teams, systems, vendors, or business areas.

- Excellent communication, facilitation, collaboration, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.

- Ability to translate complex technical information into clear plans, decisions, and updates for technical and nontechnical audiences.

- Strong analytical, organizational, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.

- Ability to influence without direct authority, create accountability, and drive progress in a matrixed environment.

- Experience developing executive-level status reporting, delivery metrics, risk assessments, and decision materials.

 Preferred Qualifications: 

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, Business, or a related field, or equivalent experience

- PMP certified.

- Knowledge of life insurance or financial services workflows and regulatory considerations is an asset

 When you join our team: 

- We’ll empower you to learn and grow the career you want.

- We’ll recognize and support you in a flexible environment where well-being and inclusion are more than just words.

The Technical Program Manager (TPM) leads the end-to-end delivery and ongoing optimization of strategic technology initiatives across New Business and Underwriting. This role partners with business leaders, product owners, underwriters, operations, architecture, engineering, data, quality engineering, risk, and external vendors to translate business priorities into executable roadmaps. The TPM coordinates delivery across the application journey, from intake and evidence collection through risk assessment, case management, decisioning, policy issuance, and delivery. 

 The TPM is accountable for integrated planning, scope and dependency management, financial oversight, testing, release readiness, and stakeholder communication. The successful candidate will help ensure solutions are delivered on schedule and within budget while meeting security, regulatory, operational, and customer commitments. Success in this role will contribute to improved producer and customer experiences, faster cycle times, increased straight-through processing, high-quality underwriting decisions, and reduced operational friction. 

 Position Responsibilities: 
 Initiative management: 
 Oversee the full Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) for initiatives that support John Hancock Insurance priorities, from initiation and delivery through implementation, stabilization, and post-launch support across policyholder, producer, and operations journeys.

 Technical expertise:

 People & Culture:

- 3-5 years of technical program management experience in a related field. 

- 3+ years of experience delivering technology solutions in the life insurance industry, with direct exposure to New Business and Underwriting required; exposure to downstream capabilities is preferred. 

- Familiarity with life insurance regulatory and business concepts, including the operational cadence of product changes and their impacts on New Business operations and Underwriting. 

- Project or initiative management skills, with proficiency in relevant software tools and methodologies, including Agile and the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC). 

- Understanding of Agile metrics, Scrum, and similar Agile methodologies used to track progress, assess team performance, and identify opportunities for improvement. 

- Working knowledge of the data, integration, and platform capabilities required for AI solutions, including secure access to approved enterprise data.

- Working knowledge of insurance regulatory and compliance considerations, with the ability to partner with Compliance and Legal teams to ensure appropriate controls and evidence are in place. 

- Experience with test governance, including test-driven development (TDD), parallel testing, defect triage with business subject matter experts, and sign-off processes. 

- Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and negotiate effectively with peers and leaders. 

- Strong strategic thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, with the ability to balance short-term priorities, long-term objectives, and trade-offs. 

- Adaptability and resilience, with the ability to work effectively in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

 Preferred Qualifications: 

- Excellent organizational and problem-solving skills, with the ability to navigate competing perspectives constructively. 

- Ability to influence outcomes and execute work without direct authority over resources. 

- Strong verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to articulate a technical vision and translate desired outcomes into practical options and execution plans. 

- Confidence leading communications and delivering presentations to senior leaders, sponsors, and stakeholders on business cases and roadmaps. 

- A commitment to continuous learning, including learning from both successes and setbacks and remaining open to change and improvement. 

- Ability to work effectively through ambiguity and bring clarity to situations, decisions, and expected outcomes. 

- Experience partnering with Marketing and Distribution teams to translate product and regulatory requirements into technology deliverables with clear acceptance criteria and traceability.

- Build and maintain strong relationships with key internal and external stakeholders.

- Develop sales tools, suitability frameworks, and commercialization support materials.

- Improve distributor engagement and accelerate early product adoption. 

 Qualifications:

- 10+ years of insurance-related experience or experience in product management, product strategy, business development, commercialization, consulting, or financial services.

- Proven ability to develop and execute growth strategies that deliver measurable business outcomes.

- Experience working with distributors, advisors, private banks, strategic partners, or high-net-worth markets.

The Digital Product Analyst supports the planning, delivery, and optimization of digital experiences that meet customer needs and business goals. Working closely with Technology, Design, Product Marketing, Analytics, SEO, and Experience teams, this role helps define requirements, prioritize work, manage backlogs, and coordinate the delivery of digital solutions across content, platforms, and customer journeys. The Digital Product Analyst uses data, customer insights, and stakeholder feedback to identify opportunities for improvement, support product decisions, and help optimize performance. This role also develops an understanding of digital platforms, customer data, content management, marketing technology, and agile delivery practices to support scalable, accessible, and effective digital experiences while fostering strong cross-functional collaboration and alignment.

 The successful candidate will combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution. They will operate comfortably with business leaders while also diving into delivery details, resolving issues, managing dependencies, coordinating teams, and driving outcomes across cross-functional programs.

 Position Responsibilities: 
 Product Discovery, Strategy & Planning 

- Bring clarity to ambiguous business needs by identifying assumptions, defining scope, uncovering dependencies, evaluating solution options, and guiding stakeholders toward practical, scalable approaches.

- Create product delivery plans that identify key milestones, risks, technical constraints, and delivery considerations, helping stakeholders make informed prioritization and sequencing decisions.

- Partner closely with Technology, Design, Product Marketing, SEO, Analytics, and Experience teams to shape connected journeys and determine the most effective solution across content, platform, data, and workflow capabilities.

- Build roadmaps that account for functional and content needs, governance, distribution strategy, dependencies, and performance outcomes across priority journeys.

- Align stakeholders on product vision, priorities, trade-offs, and success measures.

 Product Delivery & Agile Execution 

- Manage and refine the backlog with clear acceptance criteria, dependencies, and priorities tied to customer and business value.

- Participate in agile planning, refinement, and standups, providing clear visibility into progress, risks, decisions, and dependencies.

- Coordinate with Product Marketing and cross-functional partners on launch readiness, campaign enablement, and consistent execution across digital touchpoints.

- Lead or support user acceptance testing to confirm solutions meet requirements, quality standards, accessibility expectations, and intended outcomes.

 Insights, Measurement & Optimization 

- Define success measures and analyze product, content, journey, and engagement performance with Analytics and Marketing partners.

- Use quantitative and qualitative insights to prioritize improvements, optimize journeys, and increase content effectiveness and conversion.

- Recommend opportunities to simplify customer experiences, workflows, requirements, and platform usage that do not support strategic priorities or measurable value.

- Apply structured prioritization methods to balance impact, effort, risk, and dependencies.

 Platform, Experience & Enablement 

- Develop working familiarity across the full MarTech stack, including content management and digital asset management, CRM and marketing automation, analytics and experimentation, customer data and personalization, consent and preference management, lead management, and integration capabilities.

- Partner with Technology to understand platform capabilities, integrations, data flows, technical constraints, and reusable services, then translate them into practical business solutions.

- Identify opportunities to consolidate capabilities, reduce redundant tooling or manual work, and improve adoption of existing MarTech investments.

- Take initiative to understand end-to-end workflows, uncover undocumented processes, and connect information across systems, teams, and business functions to support informed decision-making.

- Use enterprise and headless architectures, global design systems, and reusable components to deliver secure, accessible, consistent, and scalable experiences.

 Change Management & Stakeholder Alignment 

- Act as a connector across Product, Technology, Design, Product Marketing, Analytics, Sales, and Support to drive decisions, resolve dependencies, and maintain consistent execution and create shared understanding in situations where requirements, ownership, or solution approaches are unclear..

- Support adoption through coordinated rollout planning, training, communications, documentation, and feedback loops.

 Required Qualifications: 

- 3-5 years of experience supporting digital products, platforms, or customer journeys with demonstrated delivery outcomes.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate ambiguous business needs into clear requirements and actionable solutions.

- Effective communication and collaboration skills across business, product, technology, design, marketing, and analytics teams.

- Ability to evaluate value, effort, risk, and dependencies and recommend where to simplify, standardize, consolidate, or stop work.

- Bachelor’s degree preferred or equivalent practical experience.

 Preferred Qualifications: 

- Working familiarity with an integrated MarTech ecosystem, such as Adobe Experience Manager, Adobe Analytics or Customer Journey Analytics, a customer data platform, Adobe Target or another experimentation platform, Marketo or another marketing automation platform, Salesforce, tag management, consent management, and APIs.

- Understanding of how content, customer data, identity, consent, activation, personalization, lead management, and measurement capabilities work together across the customer journey.

- Experience partnering with Technology, Design, Product Marketing, content, brand, SEO, privacy, or compliance teams.

- Experience with design systems, accessibility standards, headless or API-first ecosystems, and scalable digital workflows.

- Familiarity with agile delivery and work management tools such as Jira or Rally.

- Customer-centric mindset with experience synthesizing qualitative and quantitative feedback.

- Awareness of emerging technologies, including AI, and their responsible application to digital experiences and workflows

- We’ll recognize and support you in a flexible environment where well-being and inclusion are more than just words.

Our Purpose 

 Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. 

 Title and Summary 

Manager, Product Management, Identity Solutions 

Overview:

The Identity Solutions team leads the development and delivery of innovative products that help partners identify their customers and enable simple and secure digital experiences for consumers in payments and beyond. Our token intelligence team focuses on preventing fraudulent tokens from being created and protecting the emerging token ecosystem. 

As digital interactions and transactions become increasingly tokenized, the team develops risk intelligence and network signals that help customers establish trust at token creation and throughout the customer journey. By connecting fraud, identity, and token intelligence across the ecosystem, the team is defining how trust is established and maintained in the next generation of digital commerce. 

We are seeking a Manager of Product Management who will lead efforts to prevent fraud across emerging network token ecosystems by:

• Understanding customer needs, emerging fraud trends, and the growing token ecosystems to identify new fraud and identity use cases 
• Collaborating with cross-functional partners in data science, engineering and digital product to transform customer needs into easy-to-understand products and features
• Working with marketing and sales to define positioning, value, and sales enablement materials 
• Prioritizing the roadmap using product metrics across adoption and performance, while helping customers balance fraud prevention, cardholder friction, and approval rates.
• Partnering with data science teams to analyze product and model performance, investigate root causes, and identify opportunities for improvement. 

All About You

• Demonstrated product management experience with a strong track record of delivering customer-focused solutions. Experience working in payments, fraud, risk, identity, authentication, or related domains.
• Strong understanding of fraud threats across digital payments, including account takeover, synthetic identity fraud, testing attacks, social engineering, and other emerging attack vectors. 
• Exceptional analytical skills with the ability to break down complex problems, identify root causes, and make data-driven product decisions. 
• A bias for action and a track record of driving products from concept through commercialization in fast-moving environments. 
• Comfortable operating in ambiguous environments and building alignment across cross-functional stakeholders to prioritize investments and drive execution.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex fraud, identity, and technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences

- Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;

- Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;

- Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and

- Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

Overview

Overview:
This role will be part of Mastercard’s Reactive Systems Architecture (RSA) organization, which underpins the company’s real‑time, event‑driven payment capabilities. RSA provides the foundational platforms, frameworks, and shared services that enable Mastercard to process payments at global scale with high throughput, low latency, resilience, and fault tolerance.

We partner with application teams to design, build, and operate mission‑critical payment applications—spanning Domestic, Cross‑Border, and Bill Payments—that are powered by RSA’s event‑driven platforms such as Axon (Kafka‑based streaming), NATS, and supporting shared services.

Together, RSA and the Applications team enable Mastercard product teams to focus on delivering business value, while the underlying architecture handles the complex non‑functional requirements essential to modern payment systems—scalability, resiliency, availability, observability, and security. Real‑time payment technology is central to Mastercard’s strategy to define a world beyond cash, and this team plays a key role in building and scaling the platforms and applications that make that vision possible.

• Do you want to be part of a team shaping Mastercard’s real‑time, event‑driven payment platforms that operate at global scale?

Services within Mastercard is responsible for acquiring, engaging, and retaining customers by managing fraud and risk, enhancing cybersecurity, and improving the digital payments experience. We provide value-added services and leverage expertise, data-driven insights, and execution.

The Disputes Solutions Product team is growing and seeking two Director, Product Operations leaders to support Mastercard's next generation disputes modernization strategy. These highly visible roles will help drive customer adoption of Mastercard's modern disputes capabilities, including API and user interface-based solutions, while enabling customers to transition successfully from legacy dispute management platforms.

While both roles focus on customer migration, transformation, and adoption, they offer distinct opportunities:
 • Customer Migration Lead: Partner directly with issuers, acquirers, processors, fintechs, and other customers to lead complex migration programs, provide operational consulting, and drive successful implementation outcomes.
 • Migration Strategy & Operations Lead: Build and operationalize Mastercard's global migration framework, create scalable processes and playbooks, enable internal teams, and establish governance models that support customer migrations across markets and regions.
 Both positions require strong program leadership, customer-centric thinking, cross-functional influence, and the ability to navigate complex stakeholder environments while delivering measurable business outcomes.

The Role
Lead Migration Strategy & Execution
 • Drive customer migration initiatives supporting Mastercard's disputes modernization strategy.
 • Develop migration approaches, readiness criteria, governance models, success metrics, and implementation plans.
 • Build migration roadmaps aligned to customer objectives, operational requirements, and business priorities.
 • Monitor progress, risks, dependencies, and adoption outcomes to ensure successful delivery.
 • Drive end-to-end migration activities from planning and assessment through implementation, onboarding, adoption, and optimization.
Partner with Customers & Internal Stakeholders
 • Build strong relationships with customers and internal stakeholders, serving as a trusted advisor throughout the transformation journey.
 • Lead discovery sessions, workshops, and operational assessments to understand current-state environments and future-state requirements.
 • Provide guidance on operational transformation, change management, implementation best practices, and customer readiness.
 • Represent customer and operational needs across Product, Engineering, Customer Delivery, Account Management, Customer Success, Sales, and Regional teams.
 • Align cross-functional stakeholders around priorities, timelines, risks, and customer outcomes.
Drive Operational Excellence & Scale
 • Design and operationalize scalable migration methodologies, frameworks, and engagement models.
 • Create playbooks, implementation guides, readiness assessments, training materials, communication templates, and best practices.
 • Establish repeatable processes that accelerate customer adoption while minimizing implementation risk.
 • Develop operating models that improve efficiency, consistency, and customer experience globally.

ABOUT MECKA AI

Mecka AI is building the data infrastructure layer for robotics and embodied AI.
We design and operate global systems for data capture, data labeling, and hardware-enabled workflows used by leading AI labs and robotics companies to train and validate humanoid and embodied AI systems.
We work closely with frontier robotics teams to bridge real-world data, simulation, learning-based systems, and deployed hardware.

The Role
You'll turn data requirements into capture programs that work across devices, operators, and locations. You will lead the execution that lets Mecka expand real-world data collection while meeting demanding standards for quality and delivery. The role connects engineering decisions to the realities of recording in the field. That means validating pilots, understanding what makes output usable, and building plans that hold up as operations grow.

What You'll Do

 - Turn dataset requirements into capture programs with clear quality standards, capacity plans, and delivery milestones.

 - Coordinate device availability, operator training, recording capacity, and data review across a program.

 - Plan and validate pilot captures before expanding operations.

 - Investigate data-quality issues with engineering and operations teams, and verify that corrective actions work.

 - Use measured capacity and data acceptance rates to forecast delivery, identify risks, and adjust the plan.

What You Bring
Must-have:

 - Experience delivering technical programs that combine hardware, software, and field operations.

 - Ability to build practical schedules, map dependencies, and resolve technical blockers across teams.

 - Understanding of sensor data, calibration, synchronization, and common recording failures.

 - Skill in analyzing throughput, quality, capacity, and cost using spreadsheets, queries, or scripts.

 - Ability to inspect recordings and diagnostic logs, ask precise engineering questions, and verify that a fix works.

 - Clear written communication, including operating procedures, technical decisions, and realistic delivery forecasts.

Nice-to-have:

 - Experience with robotics datasets or recording programs involving several sensor types.

 - Experience improving operator workflows or automating data-quality checks.


A NOTE ON APPLYING

Studies show women and candidates from underrepresented groups often only apply when they meet 100% of the listed qualifications, while others apply after meeting 60%. If you don't check every box above but believe you can do the job, we encourage you to apply — we're looking for capability and trajectory, not a perfect checklist match.

Inclusive Hiring at Mecka

We are committed to creating an inclusive and supportive candidate experience. Should you require any accommodation whatsoever during the interview process, please inform us without any hesitation. Mecka is dedicated to ensuring equal treatment and opportunity in all phases of recruitment, selection, and employment, in compliance with employment law. We do not discriminate based on gender, race, religion, national origin, ethnicity, disability, gender identity/expression, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other protected category. Mecka is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, fostering a culture of inclusivity and maintaining a work environment that is free from discrimination, harassment, and retaliation.

Use of Artificial Intelligence in Recruitment

Mecka uses artificial intelligence (AI) responsibly to support administrative and efficiency-focused aspects of our recruitment process. This includes activities such as drafting job descriptions, generating interview questions, note-taking and recordings, and supporting sourcing and scheduling workflows. All candidate evaluations, interviews, and hiring decisions are made by members of the Mecka team. While AI tools may assist with screening and assessment, they do not replace human judgment in selection decisions. Our use of AI is intended to streamline routine tasks, improve consistency, and enhance the overall candidate experience. We are committed to upholding principles of fairness, transparency, and accountability in all hiring activities. Mecka regularly reviews its recruitment practices to mitigate bias and to ensure alignment with applicable laws and evolving best practices.

 The Customer & Commercial Success (CCS) organization,  is the connected engine that turns Microsoft’s commercial strategy into execution at scale — making it simpler and faster for the field to win for every customer, in every segment, region, and role. The organization brings together planning, landing, execution excellence, services portfolio and delivery, and field activation to accelerate customer value, drive growth, and strengthen the end-to-end experience across every customer moment.
 Do you have a passion for Power Platform and SharePoint, helping customers build secure, resilient platforms that power AI transformation while using best-in-class tools created by Microsoft? Are you looking for a role where you can interact directly with large enterprise customers to grow their platforms? Do you want to join one of Microsoft's fastest-growing businesses? If so, we are looking for you! 
 Support for Mission Critical is a team within Microsoft that provides solution-specific expertise designed to drive peak health and optimum performance of a customer’s most important solutions. As a key technical resource for the customer, you will be primarily focused on delivering proactive services such as education workshops, delivering assessments, and providing tailored guidance. Troubleshooting skills are essential as this role will include working with Microsoft Support to expedite incident resolution. 
 Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

 Responsibilities 
 - Coordinate and plan a comprehensive set of deliveries to proactively address customer priorities and ensure goals are met. 
 - Drive and participate in proactive delivery management, spot resiliency and security issues, analyze problems, and provide solutions to meet customer needs. 
 - Deliver proactive and reactive support including onsite presence as needed. 
 - Provide strategic guidance to help customers modernize their platforms and prepare for AI-enabled business transformation. 
 - Evaluate customer environments and deliver data-driven recommendations that align technology investments with business objectives, operational excellence, and transformation goals. 
 - Work with support teams, account teams, product engineering teams and other stakeholders to ensure streamlined customer experience. 
 - Apply lessons learned for continuous process and delivery improvement. 
 - Share and gain knowledge through communities. 
 - Contribute to on-call rotations to ensure a high quality of service for critical incidents created by Support for Mission Critical customers.

 Qualifications 
 Required/minimum qualifications 

- Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, Liberal Arts, or related field AND 4+ years experience in cloud/infrastructure technologies, information technology (IT) consulting/support, systems administration, network operations, software development/support, technology solutions, practice development, architecture, and/or consulting OR equivalent experience. 

 Additional or preferred qualifications 

- Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, Liberal Arts, or related field AND 8+ years experience in cloud/infrastructure technologies, information technology (IT) consulting/support, systems administration, network operations, software development/support, technology solutions, practice development, architecture, and/or consulting OR Master's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, Liberal Arts, or related field AND 6+ years experience in cloud/infrastructure technologies, technology solutions, practice development, architecture, and/or consulting OR equivalent experience. 

- 4+ years experience working in a customer-facing role (e.g., internal and/or external). 

- 4+ years experience working on technical projects. 

- Technical Certification in Cloud (e.g., Azure, Amazon Web Services, Google, security certifications). 

- 4+ years of technical experience with Power Platform, SharePoint, Microsoft 365, or related cloud and collaboration technologies 

- Hands-on experience building business solutions across the Power Platform ecosystem, including Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse, and related platform capabilities, leveraging automation, low-code development, and AI-powered innovation to drive business transformation. 

- Strong understanding of SharePoint Online and Microsoft 365 collaboration services, including content management, information architecture, governance, security, and platform resiliency. 

- Experience with Microsoft Copilot Studio, including the design and implementation of AI-powered agents integrated with Power Platform, SharePoint, and Microsoft 365 services to enhance business processes and user productivity. 

- Knowledge of Microsoft 365 modernization strategies leveraging Power Platform is a plus. 

- Understanding of how Microsoft Purview, Entra ID, and Microsoft 365 security and compliance capabilities support governance, security, and modernization across Power Platform and SharePoint environments. 

- Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and / or government security screening requirements are required for this role.  These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings: Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the M icrosoft Cloud Background Check upon hire / transfer and every two years thereafter.

eightfold:microsoft.com:1970393556999409.description:
Overview 
 Are you insatiably curious, deeply passionate about the realm of Agentic AI & applications, and ready to tackle complex challenges in a dynamic environment? If so, we invite you to join our team as a Cloud & AI Apps Solution Engineer for  commercial customers  at Microsoft . 
 In this technical sales role, you'll be at the forefront of cutting-edge projects that leverage the latest technologies to drive meaningful impact. Join us and be part of a team that thrives on collaboration, creativity, and continuous learning. 
 Microsoft is transforming the experience for Agentic AI applications across the development & deployment lifecycle. We’re leading the way in Agentic AI development where AI agents streamline development and operations. As an AI Apps Solution Engineer, you’ll help customers boost productivity and become AI-native . 

 As a Cloud & AI Apps Solution Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in helping enterprise AI developers unlock the full potential of Microsoft’s AI-powered stack across every stage of the development lifecycle. You will work directly with technical and business stakeholders to design secure, scalable, and resilient Agentic AI architectures that support business-critical applications and Frontier AI transformation. As a trusted technical advisor, you’ll guide customers and win their technical decisions on Azure for their Agentic AI deployment.
 You bring deep expertise in Agentic AI workloads—including Foundry Models & Services, Copilot Studio, Microsoft IQ, and cloud-native development while exploring how to accelerate Frontier transformation. 
 As you join the team, you will have the opportunity to accelerate your career growth, develop deep business acumen, hone your technical skills, and become adept at solution design and deployment. In summary, you’ll help customers modernize their application platforms to realize the full value of Microsoft’s platform, all while enjoying flexible work opportunities.

 As a trusted technical advisor, you’ll guide customers through secure, scalable solution design, influence technical decisions, and accelerate Agentic AI applications into their development & deployment workflows. In summary, you’ll help customers modernize their applications leveraging AI and realize the full value of Microsoft’s platform.

 Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond. 

 Responsibilities 

- Lead customer engagements focused on Agentic AI and AI application platforms, guiding technical strategy, solution adoption, and digital transformation initiatives.

- Drive technical workshops, live demonstrations, architectural whiteboarding sessions, rapid prototyping, hands-on proof-of-concepts, and pilot deployments to accelerate customer success.

- Design and articulate secure, scalable, and resilient Agentic AI architectures that align with customer business objectives and enterprise requirements.

- Prove the value of technical solutions by co-creating architectures, validating designs, influencing technical decisions, and enabling customer commitment to deployment.

- Serve as a trusted technical advisor to developers, architects, engineering leaders, and business stakeholders throughout the customer journey.

- Accelerate customer adoption of Microsoft AI services by identifying business opportunities, addressing technical blockers, and demonstrating measurable business value.

- Collaborate with product engineering, customer success, partner teams, and solution specialists to deliver end-to-end AI transformation outcomes.

- Drive technical strategy and architecture discussions around application modernization, cloud-native development, and AI-powered application experiences.

- Stay current on emerging AI technologies, industry trends, and competitive offerings to provide customers with innovative technical guidance.

- Share technical best practices, reusable architectures, reference implementations, and customer success patterns across the broader Microsoft ecosystem.

- Maintain deep technical expertise in Agent Development, Azure AI Foundry Models & Services, Copilot Studio, Microsoft IQ, AI application architecture, cloud-native development, APIs, containerization, microservices, event-driven architectures, Python, Java, and .NET.

 Qualifications 
 Required/minimum qualifications

- Master's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field AND 4+ years technical pre-sales or technical consulting experience OR Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field AND 6+ years technical pre-sales or technical consulting experience OR 7+ years technical pre-sales or technical consulting experience OR equivalent experience.

 Additional or preferred qualifications

- 8+ years technical pre-sales, technical consulting, or technology delivery, or related experience OR equivalent experience.

- 6+ years experience with cloud and hybrid, or on premises infrastructures, architecture designs, migrations, industry standards, and/or technology management.

- Certification in relevant technologies or disciplines (e.g., Office 365, Power BI, Azure Architect and Development exams, Cloud Platform Technologies, Information Security, Architecture).

- 
- Expert on full stack App architecture design / modernization  and cloud native dev (e.g., App Platform Services, Container Services, Serverless & Supporting App Services, Integration Services, dev tools & languages) 

- Expert for Agent development, Foundry Models (Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, 1P MaaS), Fabric IQ, Foundry IQ, familiar with Foundry Services (AML), Copilot Studio Platform . 

- Proven ability to lead technical engagements (e.g., prototyping, pilot, PoCs) that drive production-scale outcomes.

Overview 
 Are you insatiably curious, deeply passionate about the realm of databases and analytics, and ready to tackle complex challenges in a dynamic environment in the era of AI? If so, we invite you to join our team as a Cloud & AI Solution Engineer in Innovative Data Platform for  commercial customers  at Microsoft . Here, you'll be at the forefront of innovation, working on cutting-edge projects that leverage the latest technologies to drive meaningful impact. Join us and be part of a team that thrives on collaboration, creativity, and continuous learning. 
 Databases & Analytics is a growth opportunity for Microsoft Azure, as well as its partners and customers. It includes a rich portfolio of products including IaaS and PaaS services on the Azure Platform in the age of AI. These technologies empower customers to build, deploy, and manage database and analytics applications in a cloud-native way. 

 As an Innovative Data Platform Solution Engineer (SE), you will play a pivotal role in helping enterprises unlock the full potential of Microsoft’s cloud database and analytics stack across every stage of deployment. You’ll collaborate closely with engineering leaders and platform teams to accelerate the Fabric Data Platform, including Azure Databases and Analytics, through hands-on engagements like Proof of Concepts, hackathons, and architecture workshops. This opportunity will allow you to accelerate your career growth, develop deep business acumen, hone your technical skills, and become adept at solution design and deployment. You’ll guide customers through secure, scalable solution design, influence technical decisions, and accelerate database and analytics migration into their deployment workflows. In summary, you’ll help customers modernize their data platform and realize the full value of Microsoft’s platform, all while enjoying flexible work opportunities.

 As a trusted technical advisor, you’ll guide customers through secure, scalable solution design, influence technical decisions, and accelerate database and analytics migration into their deployment workflows. In summary, you’ll help customers modernize their data platform and realize the full value of Microsoft’s platform.

 Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond. 

 Responsibilities 

- Drive technical sales with decision makers using demos and PoCs to influence solution design and enable production deployments. 

- Lead hands-on engagements—hackathons and architecture workshops—to accelerate adoption of Microsoft’s cloud platforms. 

- Build trusted relationships with platform leads, co-designing secure, scalable architectures and solutions 

- Resolve technical blockers and objections, collaborating with engineering to share insights and improve products. 

- Maintain deep expertise in Analytics Portfolio: Microsoft Fabric (OneLake, DW, real-time intelligence, BI, Copilot), Azure Databricks, Purview Data Governance and Azure Databases: SQL DB, Cosmos DB, PostgreSQL. 

- Maintain and grow expertise in on-prem EDW (Teradata, Netezza, Exadata), Hadoop & BI solutions. 

- Represent Microsoft through thought leadership in cloud Database & Analytics communities and customer forums 

 Qualifications 
 Required/minimum qualifications
•    Master's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field AND 4+ years technical pre-sales or technical consulting experience OR Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field AND 6+ years technical pre-sales or technical consulting experience OR 7+ years technical pre-sales or technical consulting experience OR equivalent experience.
 Additional or preferred qualifications
•    8+ years technical pre-sales, technical consulting, or technology delivery, or related experience OR equivalent experience.
•    6+ years experience with cloud and hybrid, or on premises infrastructures, architecture designs, migrations, industry standards, and/or technology management.
•    Certification in relevant technologies or disciplines (e.g., Office 365, Power BI, Azure Architect and Development exams, Cloud Platform Technologies, Information Security, Architecture).
•     Expert on Azure Databases (SQL DB, Cosmos DB, PostgreSQL) from migration & modernize and creating new AI apps.
•    Expert on Azure Analytics (Fabric, Azure Databricks, Purview) and competitors (BigQuery, Redshift, Snowflake) in data warehouse, data lake, big data, analytics, real-time intelligent, and reporting using integrated Data Security & Governance.
•    Proven ability to lead technical engagements (e.g., hackathons, PoCs, MVPs) that drive production-scale outcomes.
•    Proficient on data warehouse & big data migration including on-prem appliance (Teradata, Netezza, Oracle), Hadoop (Cloudera, Hortonworks) and Azure Synapse Gen2.

Overview 
 With over 17,000 employees worldwide, the mission of the Customer Experience & Success (CE&S) organization is to empower customers to accelerate business value through differentiated customer experiences that leverage Microsoft’s products, services, and partnerships. Come join CE&S and help us build a future where customers achieve their business outcomes faster with technology that does more.   

 We are looking for a Cloud Solution Architect (CSA), specializing in Security who is passionate about driving our customers’ security transformation on the Microsoft Azure and Microsoft 365 Platforms to support the Canadian business. This is a customer-facing role, owning the technical relationship between the customer and Microsoft, helping customers to leverage their Microsoft investments through architecture, implementation, and operational health engagements. This role is flexible in that you can work up to 50% from home.   

 As a Cloud Solution Architect (CSA), you will enable customers to achieve their outcomes, based on their investments in Microsoft technology. Leveraging your Security, Microsoft 365 and Microsoft Azure technical subject matter expertise you will lead technical conversations with customers to drive value from their MS investments, including identifying resolutions to issues blocking customer success projects. This opportunity will allow you to accelerate your career growth, honing your technical and collaboration skills, and deepening your cloud expertise.    

 Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.   

 Responsibilities 

- You will drive positive Customer Satisfaction and become a trusted advisor as well as provide feedback and insights from customers/partners and be the Voice of Customer to share insights and best practices, connect with Global Security teams at Microsoft, Engineering and Product teams to remove blockers and influence the solution roadmap.   

- You will land an end-to-end value proposition for Security (i.e., Zero Trust) which spans the breadth of Microsoft Security offerings, and with focus on Purview / Data Security, Threat Protection, ID + Access Management and Cloud Security.   

- You will position and deliver solutions that drive Security product usage as you develop opportunities to drive Customer Success business results & help Customers get value from their Microsoft investments and identify resolutions to Customer blockers by leveraging SA subject matter expertise.  Deliver according to MS best practices & using repeatable IP.  ​   

- You will accelerate Business Value of overall Security adoption by improving security posture and ensuring that the solution exhibits “Secure by Design” framework, such as high-performance levels, security, scalability, maintainability, appropriate reusability and reliability upon deployment.   

- You will align your individual skilling to team/area demands & Customer Success goals as you accelerate customer outcomes and share your expertise, contribute to Intellectual Property (IP) creation & re-use to accelerate customer outcomes.    

- You will run Architectural Design Sessions to build a plan for implementing the solution – governing design in line with customer business goals and their technical environment.  Outcome is consensus on solution design and next steps toward production.   

- You will collaborate and orchestrate with other Cloud Solution Architects and MS stakeholders including FastTrack, partner, and Microsoft Consulting in developing complex end-to-end Enterprise solutions with the Microsoft Security platform. 

 Qualifications 

 Required/minimum qualifications

- Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, Liberal Arts, or related field AND 4+ years experience in cloud/infrastructure technologies, information technology (IT) consulting/support, systems administration, network operations, software development/support, technology solutions, practice development, architecture, and/or consulting OR equivalent experience.

 Other Requirements: 
 This role requires the ability to meet Microsoft, customer, and/or government security screening requirements. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:  

- Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.  

- Reliability Status screening: This position requires that the successful candidate obtain and maintain a Reliability Status security screening with the Government of Canada. Microsoft will work with individuals on a case-by-case basis to determine if the requisite screening can be obtained within required timelines.  

 Preferred Qualifications:  

- Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, or related field AND 4+ years experience in cloud/infrastructure technologies, information technology (IT) consulting/support, systems administration, network operations, software development/support, technology solutions, practice development, architecture, and/or consulting OR equivalent experience 

- Breadth of technical experience and knowledge, with depth / Subject Matter Expertise in: 

- Purview / Data Security (IRM, MIP P2) and All Defender Workloads, strategies and solutions 

- Identity and Access Management  

- Zero Trust strategies including, Zero trust Foundations, Defend Against Threats, Protect and Govern Sensitive Data 

- Deep knowledge of solution architecture, design, implementation, and/or support of Cloud Security in order to identify business needs and determine solutions to business problems, process improvement, organizational change, or strategic planning and policy development. 

- Proven track record of building deep technical relationships with senior IT executives in large or highly strategic accounts. Experience in managing various stakeholder relationships to get consensus on solution/projects.  

- Presentation skills with a high degree of comfort with both large and small audiences (Senior Executives, Messaging/collaboration/Network/Security administrators, and solution architecture teams). 

- Ability to understand customer’s Security related business requirements and customer problems and solve them through Microsoft cloud technologies.  

- Competitive Landscape knowledge of Security platforms. Technical aptitude and experience to learn new cloud technologies and understand relevant cloud market trends.  

- Understanding of how Microsoft Security, compliance, and identity solutions can span across solution areas to provide a holistic and end-to-end solution.

 We are looking for a Cloud Solution Architect (CSA), specializing in Security who is passionate about driving our customers’ security transformation on the Microsoft Azure and Microsoft 365 Platforms to support the Canadian business. This is a customer-facing role, owning the technical relationship between the customer and Microsoft, helping customers to leverage their Microsoft investments through architecture, implementation, and operational health engagements. This role is flexible in that you can work up to 50% from home.

 As a Cloud Solution Architect (CSA), you will enable customers to achieve their outcomes, based on their investments in Microsoft technology. Leveraging your Security, Microsoft 365 and Microsoft Azure technical subject matter expertise you will lead technical conversations with customers to drive value from their MS investments, including identifying resolutions to issues blocking customer success projects. This opportunity will allow you to accelerate your career growth, honing your technical and collaboration skills, and deepening your cloud expertise.

 Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

 Responsibilities 

- You will drive positive Customer Satisfaction and become a trusted advisor as well as provide feedback and insights from customers/partners and be the Voice of Customer to share insights and best practices, connect with Global Security teams at Microsoft, Engineering and Product teams to remove blockers and influence the solution roadmap.

- You will land an end-to-end value proposition for Security (i.e., Zero Trust) which spans the breadth of Microsoft Security offerings, and with a focus on Threat Protection, ID + Access Management and Cloud Security.

- You will position and deliver solutions that drive Security product usage as you develop opportunities to drive Customer Success business results & help Customers get value from their Microsoft investments and identify resolutions to Customer blockers by leveraging SA subject matter expertise. Deliver according to MS best practices & using repeatable IP.  ​ 

- You will accelerate Business Value of overall Security adoption by improving security posture and ensuring that the solution exhibits “Secure by Design” framework, such as high-performance levels, security, scalability, maintainability, appropriate reusability and reliability upon deployment.

- You will align your individual skilling to team/area demands & Customer Success goals as you accelerate customer outcomes and share your expertise, contribute to Intellectual Property (IP) creation & re-use to accelerate customer outcomes. 

- You will run Architectural Design Sessions to build a plan for implementing the solution – governing design in line with customer business goals and their technical environment.  Outcome is consensus on solution design and next steps toward production.

eightfold:microsoft.com:1970393557038899.description:
Overview 

 We help customers turn technology investment into meaningful progress for their businesses and the people they serve. Our culture values curiosity, inclusion, accountability and trusted collaboration. We seek architects who combine sound judgment with hands-on engineering, share what they learn and create an environment where colleagues and customers can challenge ideas openly. 
 A frontier company is not defined by adopting the newest technology first. It is defined by the judgment to translate emerging capabilities into secure, reliable and measurable outcomes. This means framing ambiguous problems, making explicit tradeoffs among cost, reliability and speed, and deciding responsibly with incomplete information. It also means knowing when not to use AI, controlling scope and establishing what must be true before a solution is ready for release. 
 ISD’s frontier consulting practice brings industry understanding, solution expertise and engineering discipline together. We use AI to strengthen how we explore, design and deliver, while keeping people accountable for decisions and quality. We build early working artifacts, validate them with customers and learn from delivered work rather than self-assessment. Adoption, change and capability transfer begin at the outset, so progress becomes sustained customer value rather than a successful demonstration alone. 
 Based in the Greater Toronto Area, the Senior Solution Architect in ISD Canada will lead strategic customer engagements, with a particular focus on financial services. The role requires fluency in customer workflows, data and risk considerations before selecting products or platforms. You will partner with executives and customer engineering teams to establish a credible baseline, define success measures and connect architecture decisions to business priorities across the Toronto and Canadian market. 
 This is both a strategic and a hands-on architecture role. You will guide multidisciplinary teams, maintain full-stack depth and collaborate with specialists to validate critical design choices in working solutions. A practical AI Usage Plan will help each significant engagement improve delivery with measured benefits, clear accountability and appropriate guardrails. The opportunity is to deliver reviewed, tested and operationally ready solutions, help customers adopt them, and create reusable patterns and capabilities that other teams actually use. 

 Responsibilities 

 The Sr. Solution Architect role is organized around five key accountability areas: 

- Business Outcome-Led Architecture  

- Engage executives to understand business priorities, establish baseline performance and define measurable outcomes and success criteria that guide architecture and investment decisions. 

- Translate business requirements into actionable solution architecture, applying financial-services workflow, data and risk fluency to the customer’s operating context before recommending products or platforms. 

- Challenge assumptions, frame ambiguous problems and make explicit cost, reliability and speed tradeoffs. Decide with incomplete data, control scope and say no when a proposed approach, including AI, is not justified. 

- Develop clear, decision-oriented proposals for executive audiences that explain options, dependencies, risks and the recommended path in terms of business outcomes. 

- Technical Team & AI Leadership  

- Serve as Lead Architect and accountable technical authority on complex engagements, aligning design decisions and hands-on technical direction with customer outcomes. 

- Lead and mentor multidisciplinary teams through trust, candor and shared ownership. Encourage constructive challenge, make responsibilities clear and support colleagues in developing sound technical judgment. 

- Govern human and AI-assisted teams, including agent orchestration, context, retrieval and memory. Define action authority, authorization boundaries, blast radius, human approvals and auditability so AI operates within explicit controls. 

- Partner with Program Directors and Project Managers to maintain technical governance, delivery quality and transparent management of scope, dependencies and risks. 

- Strengthen the architecture community through reusable patterns, mentoring and capability transfer. Share evidence from delivered work and help customer and delivery teams apply assets in practice. 

- AI-Powered Delivery  

- Establish and execute an AI Usage Plan for each significant engagement as a practical operating plan, not a paperwork exercise. Define measurable benefits, accountable owners, appropriate use cases, verification responsibilities and guardrails. 

- Use AI across requirements, code, tests, documentation and architecture, with human review and verification appropriate to the work. Demonstrate improved throughput without sacrificing reviewed and tested quality. 

- Deliver the smallest viable working slice early, use demos and customer validation to test assumptions, and iterate on evidence. Seek credible proof-of-value in weeks where appropriate without compromising regulated-production readiness. 

- Measure cycle time, quality, cost and business value against the engagement baseline. Adapt the AI Usage Plan and delivery approach based on observed results rather than activity counts or self-assessment. 

- Engineering-Grade Rigor  

- Maintain engineering discipline through architecture documentation, design reviews, code review, testing, CI/CD and operational readiness. Ensure that critical design choices are validated in working artifacts. 

- Conduct solution reviews that address security, reliability and maintainability, including AI evaluations, authorization controls and the behavior of agent-based components where relevant. 

- Identify risks proactively and establish evidence-based release criteria. Lead production go/no-go recommendations with explicit attention to unresolved risks, readiness gaps and customer operating requirements. 

- Promote shared engineering accountability and honest risk escalation. Surface limitations and uncertainty early, and work with delivery leaders and customer teams to resolve issues rather than defer them. 

- Create and maintain reusable, tested reference architectures, accelerators and frameworks. Validate that other teams can adopt them and use feedback from real engagements to improve them. 

- Full Stack Solution Capability  

- Apply broad Microsoft solution capability across Data & Analytics, AI & ML, Application Development and Cloud Infrastructure to shape end-to-end customer solutions. 

- Integrate data, applications, infrastructure, identity and security into cohesive architectures, with clear interfaces, dependencies and operational ownership. 

- Maintain technical depth in two to three domains while providing full-stack architectural guidance. Validate critical assumptions hands-on through code, prototypes, tests and working demonstrations. 

- Collaborate with specialists, product teams and customer engineers to resolve complex technical issues, apply the right expertise and transfer capability without losing end-to-end architectural accountability. 
 Additional Accountabilities  

- Make the Market—shape strategic Toronto/Canada FSI opportunities and add-on scope tied to outcomes. 

- Drive & Accelerate production cloud solutions responsibly aligned with customer and Microsoft strategy. 

- Deliver Business and Operational Excellence, including adoption, realized value and customer capability transfer. 

 Qualifications 
 Required/minimum qualifications

- Master's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field AND 10+ years experience in technology solutions, practice development, architecture, consulting, and/or technology domain (e.g., Security) OR Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field AND 12+ years experience in technology solutions, practice development, architecture, consulting, and/or technology domain (e.g., Security) OR equivalent experience.

- 4+ years managing multiple, complex projects or portfolios.

- 2+ years experience leading blended, multidisciplinary teams.
 Additional or preferred qualifications

 Technical Skills — Full Stack Coverage Across:  

- Data & AI

- Azure Data Platform (Azure Synapse, Fabric, Data Factory, Databricks) 

- AI & Machine Learning (Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Studio, Cognitive Services, MLOps) 

- Big Data architectures (Lambda, Kappa), Enterprise Data Warehouse, Advanced Analytics 

- Application Development 

- Modern application architecture, microservices, API-first design 

- DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, GitHub Advanced Security, container platforms 

- App modernization, .NET, Java, and open-source software stacks 

- Cloud Infrastructure 

- Azure IaaS and PaaS services, subscription design, network architecture 

- Identity and Access Management (Azure AD, Entra), security architecture 

- Private/Hybrid/Public cloud configurations, migrations, and governance 

- Security

- Security reviews, threat modeling, Zero Trust architecture 

- Credential theft mitigation, compliance, and regulatory considerations in Canada 
 Leadership & Delivery Capabilities  

- Demonstrated ability to lead solution delivery as the Lead Architect on complex, multi-team engagements. 

- AI literacy — actively using AI tooling in day-to-day architecture and delivery work. 

- Experience writing and executing AI usage plans or equivalent AI integration strategies for customer engagements. 

- Ability to execute recognized Software Architecture methods, processes, and tools. 

- Experience applying engineering-grade practices: architecture review boards, design patterns, quality gates, test automation. 

- Ability to give compelling presentations to executive audiences, linking technical decisions to business outcomes. 

- Proven ability to build and sustain trusted relationships at the executive level (C-suite, VP, and Board) — engaging as a peer, not just a vendor, and maintaining those relationships across the full engagement lifecycle.
