Overview 
 Aperçu  

 Avec plus de 17 000 employés dans le monde, la mission de l’organisation Customer Experience & Success (CE&S) est de permettre aux clients d’accélérer la création de valeur grâce à des expériences client différenciées qui s’appuient sur les produits et services de Microsoft, portées par nos collaborateurs et notre culture. Rejoignez CE&S et aidez-nous à bâtir un avenir où les clients atteignent plus rapidement leurs objectifs d’affaires grâce à des technologies plus performantes.  

 Nous recherchons un architecte de solutions cloud (CSA) passionné par l’innovation applicative et la transformation par l’IA de nos clients sur la plateforme Microsoft. Dans le cadre de ce rôle, vous serez responsable d’engagements techniques auprès des clients et travaillerez sur certains des projets les plus complexes et stimulants de la base de clients Microsoft Azure, Azure Machine Learning et GitHub. Ce poste en contact direct avec les clients est un rôle technique pratique couvrant la conception, la création et les opérations, avec un accent sur la résolution des problèmes afin d’éliminer les obstacles techniques et les défis liés à l’adoption.  

 L’innovation applicative et l’apprentissage automatique sont désormais indissociables : les applications créées par nos clients sont de plus en plus intelligentes, et les modèles sont entraînés, déployés, gouvernés et exploités comme des composants à part entière de la solution. Nous attendons donc une expertise démontrée d’Azure Machine Learning et d’Azure AI Foundry, ainsi qu’une solide expérience du développement d’applications modernes. Vous dirigerez des discussions approfondies sur l’architecture technique avec des cadres supérieurs chez les clients, des architectes d’entreprise, des scientifiques des données, des ingénieurs de plateforme et des développeurs. Vous collaborerez également avec des équipes internes et externes pour développer des projets pilotes et superviser des projets de mise en œuvre.  

 La mission de Microsoft est de donner à chaque personne et à chaque organisation les moyens d’accomplir davantage. En tant qu’employés, nous adoptons une mentalité de croissance, innovons pour donner aux autres les moyens de réussir et collaborons afin d’atteindre nos objectifs communs. Chaque jour, nous nous appuyons sur nos valeurs de respect, d’intégrité et de responsabilité pour créer une culture inclusive où chacun peut s’épanouir au travail et au-delà. 

 Overview 
 With over 17,000 employees worldwide, the mission of the Customer Experience & Success (CE&S) organization is to empower customers to accelerate business value through differentiated customer experiences that leverage Microsoft’s products and services, ignited by our people and culture. Come join CE&S and help us build a future where customers achieve their business outcomes faster with technology that does more. 
 We are looking for a Cloud Solution Architect (CSA) who is passionate about driving our customers’ application innovation and AI transformation on the Microsoft platform. As part of this role, you will be responsible for technical customer engagements, working with the most challenging and exciting projects within the Microsoft Azure, Azure Machine Learning and GitHub customer base. This customer-facing position is a hands-on technical role spanning across design, build, and operations, with a focus on issue resolution to remove customer technical obstacles and adoption challenges. 
 Application innovation and machine learning are now inseparable: the applications our customers build are increasingly intelligent applications, where models are trained, deployed, governed and operated as first-class components of the solution. We therefore expect demonstrated depth in Azure Machine Learning and Azure AI Foundry alongside modern application development. You will lead deep technical architecture discussions with senior customer executives, enterprise architects, data scientists, platform engineers and developers, and collaborate with internal and external teams to develop pilots and oversee implementation projects. 
 Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond. 

 Responsibilities 
 Responsabilités 

- Comprendre les priorités d’affaires et informatiques des clients en matière d’ingénierie de plateforme, de développement d’applications cloud et d’adoption de l’apprentissage automatique génératif, agentique et classique, notamment les situations où Azure Machine Learning constitue la plateforme appropriée pour entraîner, déployer et gouverner les modèles. 

- Démontrer une expertise pratique approfondie d’Azure Machine Learning. Il s’agit d’une exigence du rôle et non d’un simple atout : architecture des espaces de travail avec réseau géré et points de terminaison privés, stratégie de calcul et de quotas GPU, ressources de données et magasins de caractéristiques, AutoML et entraînement distribué, registres de modèles, suivi des expériences avec MLflow, ainsi que points de terminaison en ligne et par lots gérés avec un déploiement sécuritaire. 

- Concevoir et mettre en œuvre des pratiques MLOps en production : intégration et déploiement continus pour les modèles, les composants et les invites avec Azure DevOps ou GitHub Actions, promotion entre les espaces de travail au moyen de registres, infrastructure en tant que code et surveillance de la dérive des données et des modèles avec des déclencheurs de réentraînement définis. 

- Diriger l’architecture de l’IA générative et agentique dans Azure AI Foundry et Azure Machine Learning : sélection des modèles, flux d’invites, génération augmentée par récupération avec Azure AI Search, compromis entre l’ingénierie d’invites, l’ajustement fin et la récupération, évaluation et mesures d’ancrage, sécurité du contenu et observabilité en production. 

- Veiller à ce que les applications intelligentes répondent aux attentes de l’entreprise en matière de sécurité, d’évolutivité, de facilité de maintenance et de fiabilité lors du déploiement. S’assurer également que les charges de travail d’apprentissage automatique respectent les exigences relatives à l’accès aux données fondé sur l’identité, à l’isolation réseau, au contrôle des coûts et à l’IA responsable, notamment l’équité, l’interprétabilité et la transparence. 

- Agir comme porte-parole du client en transmettant de nouveaux commentaires à l’ingénierie et des informations sur les tendances d’utilisation et d’application. Aider à accélérer la livraison des solutions grâce à des revues d’architecture, des preuves de concept, des applications de produit minimum viable (MVP), des projets pilotes de modèles et la configuration des environnements. 

- Soutenir le développement des compétences des clients en formulant des recommandations de formation ou en animant des discussions techniques, des ateliers pratiques sur Azure Machine Learning et Azure AI, ainsi que d’autres activités de préparation au cloud destinées aux développeurs, aux scientifiques des données et aux équipes de plateforme. 

- Stimuler la croissance de la consommation des services cloud et de soutien en développant des occasions qui produisent des résultats d’affaires pour la réussite client. Trouver des solutions aux obstacles des clients en s’appuyant sur une expertise spécialisée et sur les processus d’escalade internes de Microsoft. 

- Développer les relations avec les clients et les partenaires afin d’anticiper, de signaler et de résoudre les obstacles techniques. Utiliser la connaissance des plateformes d’IA et d’apprentissage automatique de Microsoft et de ses concurrents pour repérer des occasions de croissance. 

- Rester au fait des capacités d’Azure, d’Azure Machine Learning, d’Azure AI Foundry et de GitHub. Continuer à pratiquer un ou plusieurs langages d’entreprise, notamment .NET, Python, Java ou JavaScript/Node.js, avec une maîtrise pratique de la pile Python pour l’apprentissage automatique. 

- Partager des idées, des observations et des orientations techniques stratégiques avec les équipes techniques et les communautés internes. Participer à des événements techniques externes et favoriser la réutilisation de la propriété intellectuelle, le partage des meilleures pratiques et l’accélération de la consommation. 

 Responsabilities 

- Understand customers’ business and IT priorities for platform engineering, cloud application development, and the adoption of generative, agentic and classical machine learning — including where Azure Machine Learning is the right platform for training, deploying and governing models. 

- Bring demonstrated, hands-on depth in Azure Machine Learning — a requirement of this role, not a nice to have: workspace architecture with managed networking and private endpoints, compute and GPU quota strategy, data assets and feature stores, AutoML and distributed training, model registries, MLflow experiment tracking, and managed online and batch endpoints with safe rollout. 

- Design and deliver production MLOps: CI/CD for models, components and prompts with Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions, promotion across workspaces through registries, infrastructure as code, and monitoring for data and model drift with defined retraining triggers. 

- Lead generative and agentic AI architecture on Azure AI Foundry and Azure Machine Learning — model selection, prompt flow, retrieval-augmented generation with Azure AI Search, the prompting/fine-tuning/retrieval trade-off, evaluation and groundedness metrics, content safety, and production observability. 

- Ensure intelligent applications meet enterprise expectations for security, scalability, maintainability and reliability on deployment, and that machine learning workloads meet requirements for identity-based data access, network isolation, cost control and Responsible AI — fairness, interpretability and transparency. 

- Act as the voice of the customer by driving new feedback into engineering and insights on usage and application patterns, and help accelerate solution delivery through architectural reviews, proof of concept and MVP applications, model pilots and environment setup. 

- Support customer skilling by making skilling recommendations or delivering technical discussions, hands-on Azure Machine Learning and Azure AI workshops, and other cloud readiness activities for developers, data scientists and platform teams. 

- Drive consumption growth across Cloud and Support by developing opportunities that deliver Customer Success business results, and identify resolutions to customer blockers using subject matter expertise and internal Microsoft escalation processes. 

- Drive customer and partner relationships to anticipate, escalate and resolve technical blockers, and use knowledge of Microsoft and competitor AI and machine learning platforms to identify growth opportunities. 

- Stay current with Azure, Azure Machine Learning, Azure AI Foundry and GitHub capabilities, and remain a practitioner of one or more enterprise languages — .NET, Python, Java, JavaScript/Node.js — with working proficiency in the Python machine learning stack. 

- Share ideas, insights and strategic technical input with technical teams and internal communities, participate in external technical community events, and drive IP reuse, best practice sharing and consumption acceleration. 

 Qualifications 
 Qualifications requises  

- Baccalauréat en informatique, en technologies de l’information, en ingénierie, en administration des affaires ou dans un domaine connexe, ET au moins 4 ans d’expérience dans les technologies cloud ou d’infrastructure, le conseil ou le soutien en technologies de l’information, l’administration de systèmes, les opérations réseau, le développement ou le soutien logiciel, les solutions technologiques, le développement de pratiques, l’architecture et/ou le conseil OU expérience équivalente.  

 Qualifications privilégiées  

- Au moins 4 ans d’expérience dans un rôle en contact avec les clients, à l’interne et/ou à l’externe.  

- Au moins 4 ans d’expérience de travail sur des projets techniques.  

- Expérience pratique de la conception, de l’entraînement, du déploiement et de l’exploitation de modèles d’apprentissage automatique dans Azure Machine Learning au sein d’un environnement de production, y compris les pratiques MLOps et la gestion du cycle de vie des modèles.  

- Certification technique dans le cloud ou l’IA, par exemple Azure AI Engineer Associate, Azure Data Scientist Associate, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, ou une certification équivalente d’AWS, de Google ou en sécurité.  

- Expérience à l’échelle de l’entreprise des infrastructures cloud et hybrides, de la conception d’architectures et des migrations. Maîtrise de .NET, Java, JavaScript/Node.js ou Python, avec une forte préférence pour Python et l’écosystème d’apprentissage automatique.  

- Expérience de la génération augmentée par récupération, des modèles d’applications agentiques et de l’évaluation de solutions d’IA générative dans Azure AI Foundry.  

 Required Qualifications  

- Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, or related field AND 4+ years experience in cloud/infrastructure technologies, information technology (IT) consulting/support, systems administration, network operations, software development/support, technology solutions, practice development, architecture, and/or consulting OR equivalent experience 
 Preferred Qualifications  

- 4+ years experience working in a customer-facing role (internal and/or external). 

- 4+ years experience working on technical projects. 

- Hands-on experience designing, training, deploying and operating machine learning models on Azure Machine Learning in a production environment, including MLOps practices and model lifecycle management. 

- Technical certification in cloud or AI (e.g., Azure AI Engineer Associate, Azure Data Scientist Associate, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, or equivalent AWS/Google/security certifications). 

- Enterprise-scale experience with cloud and hybrid infrastructures, architecture design and migrations. Proficient in .NET, Java, JavaScript/Node.js or Python, with Python and the machine learning ecosystem strongly preferred. 

- Experience with retrieval-augmented generation, agentic application patterns, and evaluation of generative AI solutions on Azure AI Foundry.

About Miovision: 

At Miovision, we’re unlocking transportation networks that move you. Our vision and mission is to enable smart, fast, safe communities that simply flow, as we drive the Intelligent Mobility Revolution. Backed by the world’s most advanced traffic AI, Miovision’s innovations in traffic signal planning and operations are making it possible for cities to improve the transportation experience for drivers, cyclists and pedestrians.

Our values drive us. They’re at the core of everything we do. If they align with yours, proceed through the GREEN light!

 - All in to win: We're driven by a winning mindset, approaching every challenge with intensity, clarity, and speed.

 - One Miovision: We succeed as one team, uniting diverse talents, building on trust, and putting our shared mission before ego.

 - Be better every day: We're committed to continuous growth, staying curious, building mastery, and embracing challenges as learning opportunities.

 - Make it happen: We are proactive and results-driven, taking ownership, acting with urgency, and focusing on solutions that deliver real impact.

 - Earn the customer: We are deeply customer-centric, focused on earning our customers' partnership every day by delivering exceptional experiences that drive their success.


POSITION SUMMARY: 

As our Sr. Technical Program Manager - Product Development, you will sit in the driver's seat of our product delivery programs. You are the central traffic controller who leads the cross functional execution of product intent into shipped outcomes.  Working closely with hardware, software, operations, and go-to-market teams, you will map out the optimal route for new product introductions: establishing the plan, driving alignment, surfacing tradeoffs, managing dependencies, and holding the organization accountable to scope, schedule, technical readiness, and launch quality. If you excel at transforming potential roadblocks into smooth, predictable execution without losing speed, this is your green light to lead.

Reporting to the Sr. Director, Hardware, you will operate as the technical program integrator across Engineering, Product Management, Operations, Quality, and other key partners. On many programs, you will work alongside a second Technical Program Manager (TPgM) focused on detailed hardware execution. In that model, you would own the integrated product plan and cross-functional delivery system, while partnering closely with the hardware TPgM to keep hardware execution, software delivery, system integration, operational readiness, and go-to-market planning aligned. The Sr. Technical Program Manager does not replace functional technical leaders, but must understand the system deeply enough to connect decisions across disciplines, expose hidden dependencies early, and drive the right conversations at the right time.

Location: This is a flexible hybrid role based out of our HQ in Kitchener Ontario. 




OBJECTIVES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: 

 - Direct Flagship Delivery: Lead 1–3 concurrent complex product programs across hardware, firmware, cloud software, and operations to turn strategic vision into fully validated, commercially ready products.

 - Build Integrated Master Plans: Connect architecture, validation, release, and launch milestones into a single clear execution roadmap to maintain absolute visibility over critical paths and key dependencies.

 - Unify Cross-Functional Teams: Serve as the connective tissue between Engineering, Product Management, Quality, and Go-To-Market teams to keep all domain execution plans aligned.

 - Drive Risk & Tradeoff Mitigation: Identify system-level interdependencies and navigate tradeoffs between scope, cost, and schedule to resolve bottlenecks before they disrupt launch timelines.

 - Enforce Launch & Phase Readiness: Establish evidence-based entry/exit criteria for pilot builds and commercial releases to ensure flawless quality upon market release.

 - Optimize Program Governance: Elevate program management tools, decision logs, and cadence frameworks to increase predictability and accountability across the entire organization.


IDEAL PROFILE: 

 - Cross-Functional Leadership: Proven experience leading complex, end-to-end product programs spanning hardware, firmware, software, and operational launch.

 - Systems Thinking & Technical Depth: Strong ability to evaluate how hardware, firmware, cloud, and operational decisions interact across the entire product ecosystem.

 - Integrated Product Delivery: Deep knowledge of hardware/software lifecycles, cross-domain integration, system validation, and commercial launch readiness.

 - Program Governance: Expertise in building and driving integrated master schedules, dependency maps, risk mitigation strategies, and executive-level reporting.

 - Technical Credibility: Skilled at engaging with technical leads, constructively challenging incomplete plans, and surfacing hidden risks or assumptions early.

 - Cross-Domain Collaboration: Experience partnering with engineering, product, operations, and quality teams to align roadmaps and shared deliverables.

 - Go-To-Market Execution: Demonstrated ability to coordinate technical, operational, and commercial workstreams through launch and initial customer adoption.

 - Leadership & Ambiguity: Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with a track record of driving clarity, consensus, and accountability in dynamic environments.


ADDITIONAL ASSETS: 

 - Experience delivering connected devices or other products where hardware, firmware, cloud, and application releases must come together for a successful launch.

 - New Product Introduction (NPI), manufacturing ramp, regulatory compliance, and post-launch operational handoffs.

 - Background in a related industry such as transportation technology, IoT, edge systems, intelligent infrastructure, or similarly complex product environments.
   
   


WHAT YOU’LL ACHIEVE IN YEAR ONE

 - Build Strong Partnerships: Establish clear ownership, trust, and a seamless collaborative model across hardware, software, operations, and cross-functional leadership.

 - Drive End-to-End Visibility: Create high-integrity tracking for program scope, dependencies, and risk—enabling proactive decision-making and eliminating late-stage surprises.

 - Deliver a Major Milestone: Successfully drive a significant product launch across technical, operational, and go-to-market teams with strict readiness criteria.

 - Raise the Bar for Delivery: Implement scalable planning frameworks, review mechanisms, and accountability structures that make future product launches faster and more predictable.

This posting is for an actual vacancy. 

Your Rewards & Well-being:
We invest in our team with benefits designed for modern life and true work-life balance.

 - Comprehensive Coverage: Your well-being is covered from day one with comprehensive health benefits, 24/7 virtual healthcare access, and dedicated wellness programs.

 - Financial Future: Build for tomorrow with our RRSP/401K Matching Plan and share in the company's success through our Variable Incentive Plan.

 - Time to Recharge: Truly unplug with our unique Mio-Days and flexible vacation policy.

 - Work & Life Support: We support you with flexible work options, an internet subsidy, a remote work allowance, and enhanced leave for new parents.

Sound like your next adventure? Apply now and let's start building together!

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Please indicate if you require accommodation on your application, and our team will work with you to meet your accessibility needs.

These tools are one of several factors considered in the hiring process and do not replace human judgement. We do not use AI to make any final hiring or interview decisions.

PLEASE BE AWARE OF FRAUD: Applicants interested in applying for roles at Miovision should apply directly via the details provided on our careers page. We communicate directly with applicants and will not request banking information, payment, or fees during any point of the recruitment process. We do not conduct interviews via text message. If you suspect that a third party is impersonating Miovision or requesting payment for recruitment on behalf of Miovision, please alert us via recruitment@miovision.com.

Your Moneris Career - The Opportunity 

 The Senior Product Manager, Partner Experience will lead the strategy, development, commercialization, and ongoing evolution of the products, platforms, APIs, and capabilities that power the partner experience across Moneris' Distribution Partnerships portfolio.

 This role is responsible for defining how Moneris enables and supports its diverse partner ecosystem, including software platforms (ISVs), embedded payment partners, PayFacs, ISOs, associations, affiliates, referral partners, and other strategic distribution relationships.

 A key initial mandate will be leading the implementation, commercialization, and ongoing optimization of a strategic partner management platform and associated third-party acquiring capabilities. Beyond the initial platform implementation, the role will establish and evolve a broader Partner Experience product strategy focused on creating scalable, digital-first experiences that simplify how partners onboard, manage, support, and grow their merchant portfolios with Moneris.

 This is a senior product leadership role requiring strong product management expertise, strategic thinking, technical and commercial acumen, and the ability to lead complex cross-functional initiatives.

 Location: You will be based in our Toronto office, balancing in-office collaboration with remote flexibility.
 Reporting Relationship : You will report to the Director, Product - Distribution Partnerships. 
 Posting Type: New Position.
 Salary Range: The expected base salary range for this role is $125,000 - $155,000.

 Total compensation may also include variable or discretionary incentive components, including but not limited to bonuses and commissions. Individual job offers are determined by various factors, including experience, education, skills, certifications, and other business needs. 

 Your Moneris Career - What you'll do 

- Own the Partner Experience product strategy: Define and manage the product strategy, roadmap, and priorities for the Partner Experience portfolio, aligned with the broader Distribution Partnerships strategy.

- Manage the end-to-end product lifecycle: Lead products and capabilities from discovery and business case development through delivery, commercialization, adoption, measurement, and continuous improvement.

- Translate insights into product innovation: Turn partner needs, market trends, business objectives, and competitive insights into product opportunities, priorities, and scalable solutions.

- Shape and enhance the partner experience: Define and continuously improve partner and merchant experiences across onboarding, portfolio management, servicing, reporting, settlement, and related capabilities.

- Drive platform, API, and ecosystem development: Lead the implementation and evolution of partner-facing platforms, APIs, and integration capabilities that enable partners to onboard, manage, and grow merchant portfolios at scale.

- Advance automation and self-service capabilities: Identify opportunities to simplify experiences, increase automation, and support scalable portfolio growth.

- Measure and optimize performance: Establish and monitor product success metrics, using data and partner feedback to drive adoption, prioritization, and ongoing improvement.

- Lead cross-functional execution: Partner with Product, Technology, Operations, Risk, Finance, Legal, Sales, Marketing, and external stakeholders to deliver complex strategic initiatives.

- Manage strategic partner and vendor relationships: Build and maintain relationships with technology and distribution partners to ensure capabilities and investments align with Moneris' long-term objectives.

 Your Moneris Career - What you bring 
 Required skills and experience 

- 5+ years of progressive experience in product management, product strategy, platform products, payments, fintech, SaaS, or related fields, including experience operating at a senior product management level.

- Demonstrated experience owning complex products or platforms from strategy and discovery through delivery, commercialization, and ongoing optimization.

- Strong knowledge of product management disciplines, including product strategy, roadmap development, prioritization, requirements definition, agile delivery, commercialization, and performance management.

- Experience leading complex initiatives across multiple business and technology teams without direct authority.

- Experience working with APIs, platform products, integrations, or technology-enabled ecosystems.

- Experience developing business cases, evaluating investments, defining pricing or commercial models, and measuring product performance.

- Demonstrated ability to translate customer or partner needs into scalable product solutions.

- Experience presenting recommendations and influencing decisions with senior stakeholders.

- Bachelor's degree in Business, Commerce, Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.

 Experience that would set you apart 

- Experience within payments, acquiring, fintech, banking, or financial services.

- Experience working with ISVs, PayFacs, ISOs, embedded payments providers, marketplaces, or other partner-led distribution models.

- Experience with merchant acquiring, payment facilitation, third-party acquiring, or merchant lifecycle management.

- Experience with partner management, merchant onboarding, underwriting, settlement, residual management, billing, or reporting platforms.

- Experience managing vendor or technology platform relationships.

- Experience developing API-first or platform-based products and services.

 Your Moneris Career - What you get 
 At Moneris, we believe in empowering you to succeed—personally and professionally. As part of our team, you'll have access to resources, opportunities, and an inclusive environment that supports your development and career.

- Comprehensive Total Rewards Program, including performance-based bonuses, flexible benefits starting from day one, and your choice of a health spending account (HSA) or personal spending account (PSA).

- Retirement planning support, with profit-sharing programs including company match and a defined contribution pension plan.

- Growth & development opportunities, including unlimited access to Coursera, mentorship programs, and an internal gig marketplace.

- Holistic wellness support, with an Employee & Family Assistance Program, 24/7 virtual healthcare, and workplace wellness initiatives.

- Flexibility that works for you, including hybrid work arrangements, a Work from Abroad program, and paid time off programs.

- Recognition and rewards, with company-wide recognition programs, exclusive banking perks from RBC & BMO, and access to great employee discounts.

greenhouse:okta:8157885.description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

 Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

 We are seeking a Principal Product Manager, Okta Identity Threat Detection and Response Products , an individual contributor role, to drive the evolution of Okta’s cutting-edge identity security offerings. This position requires a strong technical foundation, keen product intuition, cybersecurity knowledge, and exceptional collaboration skills to shape the future of our strategic security products. You'll leverage significant cross-functional influence to execute key initiatives in this critical domain.

 Built upon the robust Okta Identity Cloud, our mission is to ensure Okta provides the most comprehensive, user-friendly, admin-friendly, and secure Identity Security product suite available. This team is responsible for products including Okta Identity Threat Protection with Okta AI , Okta ThreatInsight , and Okta Network Zones , among other vital security functionalities. Our customers depend on these solutions to safeguard their digital assets and ensure secure access for their users. This role is pivotal in ensuring that security is seamlessly integrated into every facet of our products.

 Success in this role demands a deep understanding of customer security requirements, a strong empathy for both end-user and administrator experiences, and the ability to strategically prioritize amidst competing demands from various Okta teams.

 Job Duties and Responsibilities: 

 Roadmap and Vision 

- Define the product strategy and roadmap for Okta Identity Security functionality to ensure Okta's continued leadership in the security space.

- Evangelize your vision to engineering teams, the broader product organization, and customers.

- Develop and execute a comprehensive roadmap, prioritizing features that enhance both customer security posture and administrative ease of use.

- Analyze and leverage data to inform product and roadmap decisions, ensuring data-driven strategic choices.

 Product Delivery and Execution 

- Ensure the timely and within-budget delivery of the Okta Identity Security product roadmap.

- Collaborate closely with architecture, engineering, and design to specify experiences that are platform-first and delight customers at scale.

- Work with scrum teams and Technical Program Managers (TPMs) to deliver features on time that address key security use cases.

- Rigorously prioritize across multiple product investment areas within the security domain.

- Partner with the data team to track product usage metrics, specifically tying them to improved security outcomes and business success.

 Customer Engagement and Requirements Gathering 

- Work with engineering, other product managers, and customers to capture detailed security requirements and document user stories and use cases.

- Engage with customers to deeply understand their challenges related to identity-centric threats, access control, and network security.

- Ensure that beta customer feedback is incorporated into product iterations. Maintain close relationships with customers during beta programs to integrate their insights effectively.

- Collaborate with technical marketing and sales to understand the competitive landscape for identity security and Okta’s position within it.

- Partner with product marketing to support the creation of compelling messaging and content, and define the go-to-market strategy for existing and new security offerings.

- Inform current and future pricing and packaging changes for Okta Identity Security products based on your subject matter expertise.

 Own the Product 

- Maintain a customer-success-focused mindset, actively working to unblock sales and assist customers with security-related issues.

- Responsible for supporting the field on critical requests and customer security needs.

- Drive the development of world-class identity security products and platform capabilities.

- Lead Okta Identity Security quarterly business reviews and collaborate with the go-to-market team to expand the customer pipeline from roadmap to packaging.

- Leverage your domain expertise to identify new product opportunities for Okta Identity Security to expand our portfolio.

 Qualifications: 

 Required: 

- Bachelor’s degree in a technical field.

- Proven track record of demonstrating strategic vision and product design for security-focused products.

- Experience creating new product offerings, including Go-to-Market (GTM) strategy, pricing, product naming, legal contracts, and New Product Introduction (NPI).

- Experience with defining and driving Threat Protection, Threat Intelligence, SaaS Security and Network Security as a product suite.

- Experience across the product management lifecycle for enterprise security products or services.

- Thirst for learning: able to go broad and deep across business and technical security contexts.

- Track record of owning and delivering on large strategic projects – you can see the big picture, but deliver on the details.

- Strong technical background that allows you to influence technical design and investment decisions, particularly in security architectures.

- Ability to produce solid action plans from often incomplete, conflicting, or ambiguous security inputs.

- Strong track record of influencing teams and operating effectively as a player-coach.

- Excellent communication skills across technical and business audiences, especially when discussing complex security concepts.

- Strong leadership skills and executive presence.

- Passion for Okta’s immense opportunity and growth potential in the identity security market.

- 8+ years product management experience.

- Experience interviewing and selecting candidates.

- Mentoring early-in-career product managers.

 Preferred: 

- Advanced degree in a technical or business field.

- Deep knowledge of enterprise security products and services, including cybersecurity frameworks and best practices.

- Extensive knowledge of identity and access management (IAM) and its intersection with security.

- Understanding of authentication, authorization, and threat detection standards.

- Experience with developing user flows and enabling customizable security experiences.

- Experience creating and managing multi-tenant SaaS security software products.

greenhouse:okta:8208322.description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

 Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

 The Role 

 We are looking for a Principal Product Manager to lead the strategic evolution of the Auth0 Platform Infrastructure. In this highly visible, high-impact leadership role, you will be the visionary force behind the core infrastructure, consumption models, and platform capabilities that power Auth0’s immense global scale.

 You will own the multi-year strategy for critical platform pillars, with a heavy emphasis on redefining our rate-limiting and platform consumption frameworks. As a Principal product leader, you will navigate multi-dimensional scaling challenges (including the paradigm shift of autonomous AI agents), influence executive stakeholders, and ensure our platform remains the most resilient, secure, and performant identity solution for the world’s largest enterprises.

 What You’ll Do 

- Drive the Long-Term Platform & Consumption Strategy: Define and own the multi-year roadmap for Auth0’s core infrastructure. Align deeply technical platform architecture with broader business objectives, Go-To-Market strategies, and overarching revenue goals.

- Spearhead the Strategic Evolution of Rate Limits & Monetization: Transform rate limits from a protective mechanism into a core business strategy. Pioneer dynamic consumption models, proactive policy-aware observability, and intelligent throttling strategies that align platform costs with customer value, reduce escalations, and unlock new SKUs.

- Architect Global Cloud Resilience & Scale: Champion overarching initiatives for cloud architecture, including Tierless private cloud transitions, Geo HA failover mechanisms, and service-only failovers to guarantee "four nines" reliability while optimizing infrastructure COGS.

- Define the Future of AI Agent Identity & MCP: Lead the industry-level infrastructure strategy for Model Context Protocol (MCP) enablement. Define the standards for how autonomous LLMs and AI agents securely authenticate, consume platform resources at scale, and invoke APIs without destabilizing core human-identity traffic.

- Lead Cross-Organizational Alignment: Serve as the strategic bridge between Engineering, Architecture, Security, and Go-To-Market leadership. Influence without authority across multiple domains, driving consensus among senior engineering leaders and C-level executives.

- Champion Compliance as a Market Differentiator: Ensure infrastructure strategies proactively anticipate stringent global security frameworks , turning security and compliance by design into a competitive advantage for enterprise sales.

 What You Bring 

- Experience: 8–10+ years of product management experience, with at least 3+ years operating at a Principal, Group, or Lead level. Extensive experience managing highly complex, high-scale infrastructure, platform, or deeply backend products at an enterprise SaaS company.

- Strategic Domain Expertise: Deep understanding of distributed systems, cloud-native architectures (AWS, GCP, or Azure), and infrastructure monetization. Proven track record of turning technical constraints (like rate limits and data streaming) into customer-facing value and revenue drivers.

- AI & Next-Gen Tooling Vision: Forward-looking expertise in the Model Context Protocol (MCP), agentic workflows, and securing high-velocity machine-to-machine (M2M) communications at a massive scale.

- Advanced Technical Fluency: Ability to spar with Principal Architects and Engineering Directors on complex topics such as serverless scaling, API gateways, deterministic vs. probabilistic rate-limiting algorithms, and high-availability (HA) database topologies.

- Business & Analytical Acumen: Strong data-driven approach to platform economics. Experience defining operational SLAs, managing infrastructure margins (COGS), and structuring pricing/packaging around platform consumption.

- Executive Leadership: Exceptional communication skills with the ability to distill complex architectural shifts into compelling business cases for the C-suite, while simultaneously providing crisp, actionable requirements to engineering.

 Bonus Points 
 Prior experience driving multi-million dollar infrastructure monetization strategies, deep expertise in Identity and Access Management (IAM), or leading the architectural shift from legacy cloud models to tierless/serverless architectures.

 Auth0, an Okta company, is an easy to implement authentication and authorization platform designed by developers for developers. We make access to applications safe, secure, and seamless for the more than 100 million daily logins around the world. Our modern approach to identity enables this Tier 0 global service to deliver convenience, privacy, and security so customers can focus on innovation.

 Our commitment to identity inspires and sustains our Diversity, Inclusion, and Belonging strategy as we aim to celebrate and protect the identities of everyone in our network.

 We are hiring a Senior Product Manager to join our MFA team who will help secure logins for thousands of customers and millions of people around the world. Auth0 safeguards applications and user accounts to enable anyone to safely use any technology. The MFA team is responsible for the authentication factors — such as WebAuthn, Passkeys, and Passwordless/OTP — to provide the right level of secure access based on business needs.

 In this role, you will leverage your technical background, good business sense, and ability to partner closely with engineering, product design, and product marketing teams to shape the product roadmap, deliver high-value solutions, and show measurable outcomes.

 This is a high-impact role that requires you to understand the technical aspects of authentication factors, customer use-cases and business challenges across multiple verticals, and how to simplify the experience for end-users who need to authenticate and the development teams that implement identity in their applications.

 A fierce curiosity, developer empathy, and strong collaboration skills are your keys to success.

 Job Duties and Responsibilities :

- Work with engineering and design teams to build actionable requirements and deliver high-value authentication factor solutions

- Define and socialize a roadmap that articulates your product direction and strategy

- Build compelling business cases to support ongoing product delivery efforts

- Become the go-to subject matter expert for your product area

- Develop and test product hypotheses, working in a lean and iterative way

- Prototype and validate early — build lightweight demos, proof-of-concepts, and interactive mockups (including light coding where needed) to test hypotheses with customers before committing to full development cycles

- Work with cross-functional partners in Product Marketing and field teams to enable successful feature launches and manage the product lifecycle

- Create assets to guide product development work (framing documents, story maps, opportunity canvases, stories for implementation)

- Contribute to the assessment and improvement of processes and practices that can be shared with other product teams

- Leverage AI tools throughout the product development cycle — use AI-assisted tools for research, writing, prototyping, and demo creation to move faster, reduce manual effort, and raise the quality bar at every stage

- Strong leadership skills and presence

- Technical aptitude and fluency to communicate with engineering teams and customer developers

- Track record of successful delivery of technical enterprise products

- Excellent communication skills with both internal and external stakeholders

- Functional experience in identity management, authentication factors, or security — particularly MFA mechanisms (TOTP, SMS OTP, push notifications, hardware security keys)

- Understanding of API and SDK design principles, including developer experience considerations such as error handling, versioning, and documentation

- 5+ years of experience as a product manager

- Champion for collaborative, iterative product discovery

- Love the work of identifying and deeply understanding customer problems

- Like to get your hands dirty and use the products you build

 Preferred Qualifications: 

- Hands-on technical background: prior software engineering, developer advocacy, or solutions engineering experience

- Familiarity with authentication standards and specifications: WebAuthn, FIDO2/Passkeys, OATH (TOTP/HOTP), OIDC, SAML

- Experience with cryptographic concepts relevant to authentication (public key infrastructure, attestation, challenge-response flows)

- Practical experience analyzing product and behavioral data using SQL, dashboards, or analytics tooling

- Experience working in agile/scrum environments

- Ability to travel within US or Canada

 Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

 Auth0, an Okta company, is the leading customer identity platform for developers. Our mission is to secure the world’s identities so innovators can innovate. As AI reshapes how applications are built and used, identity and security are becoming critical to enabling safe and trusted agentic experiences.

 Our team builds Auth0 products for Agentic AI with a focus on agent identity, access management, and protocols that extend trust to our customers’ AI products.

 The role is for a highly technical product manager that is adept in developing strong customer-focused product strategies.

 Responsibilities 

- Define and Execute the Identity and AI Product Strategy: Drive the roadmap and execution for Auth0’s AI portfolio with a specific focus on secure identity solutions, including Auth0 for AI Agents. Identify tactical integration opportunities and ecosystem partnerships that secure agentic workflows and deliver immediate value to developers.

- Be an Owner and Builder (0-to-1): Bring a hands-on, entrepreneurial mindset to define, prototype, and launch new identity features for AI applications. Balance rapid experimentation with the engineering discipline required to scale features into secure, production-grade identity standards.

- Collaborate and Influence Without Authority: Serve as the core product owner and direct collaborator for engineering, design, and security teams. Translate the broader AI product vision into concrete, technical requirements, managing the backlog to ensure the timely delivery of developer-friendly identity features.

- Engage Directly with Developers and Customers: Gather direct feedback from the developer community and early adopters. Actively uncover security and identity pain points in AI implementation, validating that Auth0's identity-for-agents features solve real-world problems.

- Be The Identity Standards Expert: Strategize and implement emerging standards in identity and AI, for example focusing on Model Context Protocol (MCP), Dynamic Client Registration (DCR), Client-Initiated Backchannel Authentication (CIBA), and Client ID Metadata Documents (CIMD).

- Drive Cross-Functional Go-To-Market (GTM) Support: Partner closely with GTM teams (Product Marketing, Developer Relations, and Sales) to support successful product launches. Create technical enablement assets, documentation, and messaging to drive the adoption of identity security in AI applications.

 Requirements 

- Senior Product Management Experience: 5-7+ years of product management experience, with a significant focus on Business-to-Business Software-as-a-Service (B2B SaaS) and developer-facing products.

- Deep Technical Acumen and Hands-On Identity Credibility: Strong understanding of identity protocols like OIDC, SAML, as well as AI protocols MCP, CIMD, mTLS, and CIBA.

- Agentic AI Developer Credibility: Deep understanding of the emerging agent ecosystem. Ability to write code, work directly with APIs/SDKs, and build prototypes that validate customer and developer needs. Has defined and shipped successful API/SDK products for developer usage.

- Proven "0-to-1" and Feature Launch Experience: Demonstrated success in building and launching new products, features, or programs from scratch, and executing the technical roadmap to scale them. Strong bias for execution and rapid prototyping. Startup founder or early-stage employee experience is a significant plus.

- Exceptional Product Instincts: Ability to deeply understand developer pain points, security requirements, and identity friction, translating them into compelling, secure, and integrated product experiences.

- Growth Mindset with Technical Depth: An individual contributor who is highly comfortable diving into technical API specifications, data schemas, and identity standards while collaborating on a Go-to-Market (GTM) strategy.

- Collaboration and Influence Without Authority: The ability to drive alignment and lead through influence in a highly cross-functional organization, working daily with engineering, design, product marketing, developer relations, and sales teams.

- Excellent Communication Skills: Consistently demonstrates an understanding of their audience when communicating by appropriately simplifying the message. The ability to concisely articulate complex technical architectures, developer workflows, and product value propositions clearly to both internal engineering teams and external developers.

- Passion for AI and Identity: A genuine enthusiasm for the potential of AI and a deep, demonstrable interest in the future of secure identity for users.

greenhouse:okta:8214073.title: Senior Product Manager, Okta Customer Identity
greenhouse:okta:8214073.description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

 Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

 The role

 Okta enables universal, secure access to technology for every user and organization. Okta Customer Identity (OCI) is the identity platform behind that promise for the applications our customers build for their own customers: the login, MFA, and account management layer for millions of end users across B2B, B2B2C and B2C products. OCI sits alongside Okta Workforce Identity (OWI) as one of the two halves of the Okta platform.

 We're hiring a Senior Product Manager to grow OCI's footprint inside our existing enterprise base and to incubate the next generation of platform capabilities. This is a builder's role. You'll spend a good chunk of your time in true zero-to-one territory: sizing a raw opportunity, proving it out with a design partner or two, and turning it into a capability that ships and gets adopted. You'll spend the rest of it as the connective tissue across engineering, design, research, and go-to-market, making sure those bets land in the field.

 What you will own

- New Capability Incubation: Own the pipeline of zero-to-one bets on the Okta’s Okta Customer Identity platform, from a rough problem statement through a validated design and a shipped v1. You'll decide what's worth building before anyone asks engineering to build it.

- Platform Growth: Drive the product side of Okta Customer Identity platform expansion into our existing enterprise base. You'll turn a hypothesis about why they haven't adopted the Okta Customer Identity platform into product changes that remove the reason.

- Cross-functional Delivery: Be the person engineering, design, research, and go-to-market call when a new Okta Customer Identity platform capability needs a decision. You'll write the specs, run the reviews, and keep a dozen loosely connected workstreams moving toward the same launch.

 A day in the life

 Your day splits between zero-to-one thinking and shipping discipline. You might start the morning studying churn or expansion data for a segment we don't serve well yet, trying to figure out whether the gap is a feature gap or a positioning gap. An hour later you're on a call with a design partner customer, walking through a rough prototype and taking notes on what confused them.

 By midday you're in execution mode: reviewing a spec with your engineering lead, debating whether a capability needs its own data model or can extend an existing one, and pushing back on scope that's grown past what the opportunity actually justifies. You write plainly. Your specs read like an explanation to a smart colleague, not a wish list.

 In the afternoon you sync with go-to-market and your PMM partner on how a capability in progress should be positioned once it ships, and you flag anything that changes the pitch. You close the day presenting to a customer or prospect, walking them through what's shipped and what's coming on the roadmap. 

 Responsibilities

- Identify, size, and validate new zero-to-one opportunities on the Okta Customer Identity platform, using customer conversations, usage data, and market signals rather than internal opinion alone.

- Define and execute a roadmap that balances new capability bets against platform reliability, security hardening, and performance

- Write clear, detailed specs and requirements that give engineering and design unambiguous direction, especially in areas with no existing playbook.

- Partner with sales, customer success, and product marketing to turn a shipped capability into an adopted one, including understanding why customers who should adopt haven't.

- Track the CIAM market and competitive moves from Auth0, Microsoft, and Ping, and use that context to sharpen where the Okta Customer Identity platform should and shouldn't compete.

- Be the go-to expert for your area of the Okta Customer Identity platform roadmap in front of customers, executives, and cross-functional partners.

 Required

- 5+ years of product management experience in enterprise SaaS, platform products, or identity and access management, with at least one zero-to-one launch you can speak to end to end.

- A track record of building and executing a strategy that spans multiple teams, and delivering on it, not just presenting it.

- Strong written and verbal communication. You can write a spec an engineer can build from and a one-pager an executive can act on, without changing the substance between the two.

- Strong analytical and decision-making skills. You can build a credible plan from incomplete or conflicting inputs, and explain the assumptions behind it.

- BS in Computer Science, Business, or an equivalent background, with the ability to hold your own in a design review with engineering and architecture.

 Preferred

- Experience with Customer Identity and Access Management 

- Experience partnering with sales or customer success on an attach or expansion motion, not just a net-new sales motion.

- Public speaking experience, ideally in front of customers or at industry events.

- MBA or equivalent graduate business degree.

 Top 3 qualities we are hiring for

- Zero-to-one conviction: You've taken a fuzzy opportunity from "should we even do this?" to a shipped, adopted capability, without a playbook telling you how. You know the difference between not validated yet and not going to work, and you don't confuse the two.

- Decisive action in the dark : You rarely have perfect data or complete requirements. You confidently make high-stakes calls using a mix of telemetry, customer anecdotes, and sharp product intuition. You explicitly name your assumptions, move fast, and revise them in public without ego when new information arrives.

- Unquestioned influence : You lead without relying on a reporting structure. You naturally align engineering, design, GTM, and the field behind your understanding of the customer. You are the definitive, credible voice of the product in CISO boardrooms and internal executive reviews.

 **You must attend in person orientation physically in the Toronto office on the first Tuesday of employment.
**You must go physically into the Toronto office 2 days a week.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

 About the Role 

 As Senior Product Manager, Policies, you own product strategy and execution for Okta's authentication policy roadmap. The Policies team owns how Okta evaluates risk and context to decide when, how, and whether a user, machine, or agentic identity is allowed to authenticate and stay authenticated. This includes Application Sign-On Policy, Global Session Policy, Okta Account Management Policy (OAMP), and Device Signal Collection Policy as well as the underlying Policy Framework, Policy API, and Auth Pipeline that power them.

 Policies is foundational to the entire Okta product portfolio as it's the decision layer that sits between every authentication event and the security experience a customer wants for their end users. You'll work closely with engineering, design, other product teams, and cross-functional stakeholders across Okta's platform to ensure policy capabilities evolve strategically, including how policy changes are rolled out and managed at scale (change management / identity operations).

 What You'll Do 

- Own roadmap and prioritization for your product area, balancing customer requests, platform needs, and market/strategic differentiation

- Collaborate with design and engineering to define, scope, and ship policies that have best-in-class user experience while meeting the security needs of Okta customers  

- Drive product direction for the Policy Framework, Policy API, and Auth Pipeline that underpin every policy evaluation across Okta

- Define how policy changes are managed operationally — versioning, staged rollout, auditability, and rollback — as part of a broader change management and identity operations strategy

- Work directly with customers, Solutions Engineering, Support, and other product teams to understand policy needs and translate them into product requirements

- Use AI tools to accelerate spec writing, competitive analysis, and rapid prototyping to drive roadmap alignment and execution

- Collaborate with global cross-functional teams, including engineering, field teams, tech partnerships, and marketing, to ensure successful launch and adoption of policy-related experiences

- Serve as the subject matter expert, representing Policies in customer escalations, executive briefings, and enterprise prospect evaluations, as well as partnerships with Marketing and GTM counterparts

- Track industry trends in adaptive authentication, risk-based access, and session security to develop solutions differentiated from the competition

 What You Bring to Okta 

- 6+ years experience in product management

- Experience in identity, security, enterprise-scale, platform, or developer products

- Ability to have in-depth technical discussions with engineering teams

- Ability to connect platform-level decisions to Okta's broader business outcomes and market position as a technology leader

- Ability to empathize and dig deeper into customer problems and needs before designing solutions

- Strong written and verbal communication; comfortable flexing between spec-level detail and executive narrative

- Entrepreneurial and ownership mindset - given an ambiguous problem, you decide what matters, decide what to do about it, and drive it forward

- Collaborative by default - you strive to earn trust with customers, cross-functional partners, and stakeholders. Your default is to bring people in early and often to inform a blended, stronger direction

 Nice to Have 

- Experience with policy engines, rules-based decisioning systems, or risk-scoring products

- Experience with change management tooling, feature flagging, or safe-rollout systems at scale

- Experience with non-human identity or agentic identity use cases as they relate to authentication policy

Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

 Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

 About the Role 

 We are seeking a Senior Product Manager to drive the vision, strategy, and execution for a key product area within the Auth0 Identity Security product line, with a focused mandate on the rapidly evolving domain of Agentic Security. This role sits at the intersection of product strategy, cross-functional leadership, and agile execution — requiring someone who can both shape long-term direction and deliver with precision.

 We are the team that builds solutions that protect our customer’s Auth0 environments. Our group delivers features such as attack protection, bot detection, adaptive MFA, identity security for AI Agents and related analytics / insights on the effectiveness of our solutions in thwarting attacks from bad actors.

 The ideal candidate brings direct, hands-on experience in agentic security product management, with a deep understanding of how AI agents are built, orchestrated, and secured. This includes practical knowledge of agentic workflows, MCP servers, agentic tooling, and their use through productivity applications such as Claude Code.

 A core focus of this role is runtime security & AI agent classification: building real-time detection, behavioral analysis, and protection capabilities for agentic systems. The successful candidate will have command of the OWASP Top 10 for Agentic AI attack vectors and mitigations, and will bring experience in identifying and responding to threats such as prompt injection, agent intent anomalies, and rogue agent detection — including scenarios where an agent may have been compromised or infiltrated.

 Beyond agentic-native threats, this role demands strong fluency in fraud and risk mitigation, spanning both traditional and emerging attack surfaces. This includes a depth of knowledge across classic vectors — Account Takeover (ATO), resource draining, and fraudulent account creation — as well as their evolving equivalents in multi-agent and autonomous system environments.

 Key Responsibilities 

- Product Strategy & Roadmap: Define and champion a clear product strategy and roadmap, utilizing data-driven prioritization methods to maximize customer value and business impact. Manage inputs from diverse cross-functional stakeholders.

- Customer Experience: Drive customer research (surveys, interviews, data analysis) to identify top opportunities, optimize the end-to-end customer journey, and ensure product value realization.

- Experience Design: Partner with Product Design on prototypes, wireframes, and concepts, continuously improving the usability of both the UI and APIs for technical and business audiences.

- Agile Execution & Delivery: Maintain active, daily collaboration with engineering teams. Write clear user stories, scope work for sprints, and actively participate in Agile cadences. Proactively solve problems and manage ambiguity to ensure on-time delivery.

- Performance Optimization: Drive continuous data analysis and insights into customer adoption. Establish clear hypotheses and baselines for feature launches, then track progress toward strategic targets and drive continuous product iteration based on learnings.

- Commercial Growth & Value: Partner closely with Product Marketing to run targeted customer campaigns. These efforts will drive trial conversions, accelerate Product-Led Growth (PLG) motions, boost retention, and increase high-value usage and adoption.

- Go-to-Market: Proactively monitor the competitive landscape to identify gaps and differentiators. Partner with Product Marketing and pre-sales engineering to refine product positioning, develop engaging customer value messaging, and craft supporting content (blogs, webinars).

- Field & Customer Engagement: Actively engage with the field organization (Sales, Solutions Engineering, Technical Account Managers) to build deep knowledge of the voice of the customer. Drive customer conversations during pre-sales, renewals, and at key events to gather feedback and support adoption.

- AI-Powered Productivity: Drive efficiency and strategic insight by leveraging AI tools for high-value activities, including prototyping, synthesizing customer insights, accelerating competitive and market analysis, and rapidly generating high-quality product documentation.

 Required Qualifications 

- AI Agent Experience:  Significant product experience with AI Agent creation, orchestration and the use of MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers for exposing context, tools, and resources to agents. Ability to use this experience to define how Auth0's should securely authenticate, authorize, and monitor non-human AI principals at runtime.

- Agentic Threat Remediation: You have a strong command of the OWASP Top 10 for Agentic AI, and can articulate how each attack class manifests in real-world agentic deployments. You bring direct experience identifying, triaging, and driving remediation of agentic threats, with particular depth in: prompt injection attacks, agent intent anomalies, and rogue agent detection. 

- Product Management Experience:  5-8 years of experience in Product Management, whether from startup or high-growth company environments. 

- Education : An Undergraduate and/or Masters Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems or a related technical field.

- General Security Industry Experience : Prior working experience in the security, fraud or compliance industries with foundational knowledge of Identity and Access Management (IAM/CIAM) concepts (e.g., OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, SSO, MFA, RBAC) and/or familiarity with compliance frameworks relevant to identity security (e.g., GDPR, CCPA, SOC 2).

- Communication : Excellent communication skills (presentation, verbal, and written) and a highly collaborative approach, working with cross-functional stakeholders across the organization.

- Enterprise Software : Demonstrated experience in delivery of global, enterprise software across all aspects of the product lifecycle.

- Results Driven : A clear history of being outcome-driven and achieving tangible business results through the successful delivery of products, features, or capabilities that you have owned.

- Problem Solving : Keen analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities, with a proven capacity to formulate effective action plans even when faced with incomplete, conflicting, or ambiguous inputs.

- Entrepreneurial : Bring an entrepreneurial mindset and a strong intellectual curiosity that drives you to learn and delve deeply into both business and technical aspects of this role.

- Agile Development : Deep experience working successfully with engineering teams in an Agile development environment, including scoping, sprint planning, and backlog management and prioritization.

greenhouse:okta:8247721.description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

 Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

 Role Overview 

 AI is rapidly changing how software is designed, built, tested, reviewed, deployed, and operated — and the industry playbook is being rewritten monthly. Okta's Developer Productivity and AI Enablement Engineering teams own building and operating the capabilities that make our engineers fast across the inner and outer development loops. This role is the product counterpart, embedded full-time with that organization, that makes those investments compound by uncovering and prioritizing frictions, bringing the outside in, driving standardize-vs-federate decisions, spreading what works across teams, funding and clearing the path for the best tools, and proving the value.

 We are looking for a Staff Product Manager to own developer productivity as a product across Okta's development lifecycle — AI-native and traditional tooling alike. You will start bottom-up: interviewing engineers, managers, tech leads, and architects; mapping current inner- and outer-loop tooling and the frictions; and baselining dev-cycle metrics. From there, you will own the roadmap with engineering leadership; benchmark how the best engineering organizations build with AI; define tooling requirements and/or run the tooling evaluations engineering needs in a landscape that changes monthly; find the teams inside Okta getting outsized results and turn their patterns into playbooks; lead build, buy, integrate, and standardize decisions, including the vision for reducing implementation diversity across Okta and Auth0; clear the security, legal, procurement, and budget paths that slow adoption; and own the measurement that connects investment to engineering outcomes — evidence engineering leaders can take into any room.

 This is a highly technical internal platform role that creates value for Okta through a cross-team, cross-industry, cross-functional layer that turns individual wins into organizational capability.

 What You'll Do 

- Product Strategy & Discovery: Own the vision, PRDs, and prioritized backlog for Okta's internal developer productivity and AI tooling. Treat engineers as your customers: start with deep, bottom-up discovery (dozens of engineer, EM, tech lead, and architect interviews), baseline dev-cycle metrics, and secure tooling budgets with rigorous, ROI-driven business cases.

- Ecosystem Validation (Build vs. Buy): Drive definitive "adopt, build, or pass" decisions. Run hands-on, structured evaluations of inner- and outer-loop tooling — from coding agents and MCPs to build, CI/CD, and code review systems — against strict security and TCO criteria to ensure internal investments amplify vendor capabilities.

- Hands-On Execution: Embed full-time with Developer Productivity Engineering and own the roadmap jointly with its engineering leads. Define MVP scopes, manage sprints, and incrementally ship workflows. You own the strategy and requirements (the what and why); Engineering owns the technical execution (the how).

- Adoption & Outcomes: Own org-wide adoption, clearing security, legal, and privacy hurdles along the way. Measure success by connecting tool usage directly to hard engineering outcomes (cycle time, quality, toil reduction).

- Standardization & Lighthouses: Coordinate the vision for reducing implementation diversity across Okta and Auth0 engineering. Study high-performing teams to see who is getting exceptional results, and convert those patterns into scalable playbooks that shift the broader org from passive AI use to agentic workflows.

 What We're Looking For 

- 5+ years of product management experience with developer platforms, developer tools, cloud infrastructure, or AI products.

- Experience owning internal or platform products where users have alternatives — adoption driven through product quality rather than mandate.

- Strong understanding of modern software development workflows — source control, IDEs, CI/CD, testing, code review, observability, production operations — across the inner and outer loops of development.

- Hands-on, current fluency with AI-assisted software development — coding agents, context management, MCP, evaluation frameworks — and informed views on where these tools create leverage and where they introduce risk.

- Demonstrated ability to design and run technology evaluations and controlled experiments, and to define measurement systems for developer productivity with judgment about their failure modes.

- Ability to engage credibly in technical and architectural discussions with senior engineers while maintaining clear boundaries between product outcomes and engineering implementation.

- Strong cross-functional leadership and the ability to influence senior stakeholders across engineering, security, architecture, and finance without direct authority.

- Excellent written communication in a docs-first culture; you can produce solid action plans from incomplete, conflicting, or ambiguous inputs.

 Preferred Qualifications 

- Experience deploying or scaling developer tools across a large, multi-org engineering organization — including consolidating divergent stacks and the change management that comes with it.

- Hands-on familiarity with developer AI tools, harnesses, APIs, MCPs, and agent orchestration frameworks.

- Familiarity with developer productivity research (DORA, SPACE, DX Core 4) and its failure modes.

- Experience establishing governance, evaluation frameworks, or spend management for rapidly evolving, consumption-priced technologies.

 Why This Role Matters 

 AI-assisted development is becoming both one of the largest levers on engineering velocity and one of the largest new variable costs in R&D. The playbook changes monthly, and the organizations that win are the ones that learn fastest from the outside, spread what works internally, and measure honestly. That learning-and-leverage layer doesn't build itself — engineering teams optimizing locally, however well, still leave organizational value uncaptured and accumulate divergent implementations that slow everyone down.

 This role exists to capture it: dedicated product leadership that brings engineering the external intelligence, funded tooling, cleared paths, shared patterns, and defensible evidence to build with AI faster than any single team could alone — while deepening Okta's firsthand credibility as the company that secures the AI-powered enterprise for its customers.

**Must attend in person orientation in person the first Tuesday of employment. If you are in Toronto, orientation is in Toronto. If you are in Dublin, orientation is in Dublin. 
**Must go into the local office 2 days a week.
**Must work North American hours.

- Own the end-to-end go-to-market and lifecycle marketing strategy for Okta Device Access, including positioning, messaging, launches, field readiness, customer adoption, and expansion.

- Develop a differentiated narrative for securing device sign-in and enabling seamless, passwordless, phishing-resistant access from device to applications.

- Translate complex identity, authentication, device-security, and operating-system integration capabilities into compelling customer value propositions, use cases, and practical field plays.

- Lead cross-functional launch planning and execution, including launch strategy, sales and partner enablement, customer communications, web and content strategy, internal readiness, and post-launch measurement.

- Build and execute adoption programs that help customers advance phishing-resistant access and FastPass adoption, while identifying and addressing deployment and activation friction. FastPass is Okta’s phishing-resistant, passwordless authenticator for secure access to devices and applications 

- Partner with Product and Engineering to bring customer insight into product and GTM decisions, shape roadmap communications, and ensure commercialization and packaging changes are customer- and field-ready.

- Enable Sales, Sales Engineering, Customer Success, Support, and partners with the messaging, tools, and programs needed to articulate value and drive successful deployments.

- Help shape a cohesive device-access story that can extend to adjacent workforce and frontline-worker needs as the portfolio evolves.

- Define and report on success metrics across adoption, activation, field readiness, pipeline influence, launch performance, and customer outcomes.

 Qualifications

- 8+ years of B2B enterprise product marketing experience, preferably in cybersecurity, identity, endpoint management, enterprise software, or a related technical category.

- Demonstrated experience owning GTM strategy for complex technical products—from positioning and launches through field enablement and sustained customer adoption.

- Ability to communicate credibly with security, identity, IT, and endpoint-management audiences.

- Exceptional storytelling and executive communication skills, with the ability to make sophisticated technology accessible, differentiated, and commercially compelling.

- Proven cross-functional leadership with Product, Engineering, Sales, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Digital, Pricing, and partner teams.

- Strong analytical orientation, with experience using customer insight and performance data to shape strategy and improve adoption.

- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

 Preferred qualifications

- Experience in identity and access management, authentication, passwordless or phishing-resistant access, endpoint security, device posture, zero trust, MDM/UEM, or device-aware access.

- Experience marketing Windows and/or macOS enterprise capabilities.

- Experience building adoption motions for products where deployment, admin workflows, and end-user change management are meaningful parts of the customer journey.

- Experience marketing products that integrate with broader endpoint-management or security ecosystems.
