greenhouse:okta:7559020.title: Staff Product Marketing Manager, Security
greenhouse:okta:7559020.location: Bellevue, Washington; Chicago, Illinois; San Francisco, California; Toronto, Ontario, Canada
greenhouse:okta:7559020.description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

 Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

 Staff Product Marketing Manager, Access Management and Security 

 Identity is how organizations unlock AI safely. At Okta, we build the trusted, neutral infrastructure that lets every enterprise embrace this new era with confidence. This is career-defining work for builders and owners who move with urgency and execute with excellence.

 Reporting to the Senior Manager of Product Marketing, you will be the product marketer for the secure-access layer that makes Okta indispensable to the largest enterprises in the world. Your charter is to elevate identity from a sign-in utility to the control plane for security in the AI era. You will do tis by pairing deep technical credibility with executive-grade storytelling across strategy, content, and field execution.

 The ideal candidate will be a unique blend of technologist and business strategist—someone who can dive deep into technical architecture while crafting portfolio-level value propositions that resonate with both CISOs and practitioners. Beyond strategy and content, you must be a self-motivated, execution-oriented individual who stays focused on delivering outcomes in a fast-paced environment.

 What you’ll be doing 

 Strategic GTM for core and hybrid access 

 Build and execute the go-to-market strategy for Okta's foundational access services — including secure access to hybrid and on-premises business-critical applications — positioning them as an essential pillar of Zero Trust and AI security.

 Define the market narrative, ideal customer profile, and competitive positioning that drive Global 2000 expansion, a top company priority.

 AI-forward product and content leadership 

- Collaborate to define and advance Okta's point of view on securing human, machine, and AI-agent identities, and publish thought leadership that shapes the category.

- Use AI tooling across your own workflow, including  research, competitive analysis, content generation, and field enablemen, to produce higher-quality assets in a fraction of the time. This is an expectation of the role, not a nice-to-have.

 Technical Evangelism that closes deals  

- Collaborate and drive, along with Technical Marketing, to build demos, reference architectures, and proof kits that stand up to practitioner scrutiny and shorten security evaluations.

-  Act as a spokesperson with CISOs, architects, and analysts, translating deep technical capability into strategic business outcomes.: 

 Cross-functional revenue activation 

- Partner with Product, Sales, and Customer Success to launch offers

- Equip the field with talk tracks and ROI models, and lead deal-acceleration plays on the largest, most strategic enterprise opportunities.

 What you’ll bring to the role 

- Domain Expertise: 8+ years of experience as a product marketer or product manager in cybersecurity or identity management (IAM, AD, or Entra ID). You know who the players are, where the gaps lie, and how to win.

- Hands-on Technical Proficiency: A technologist at heart. You must have a track record of supporting technical evaluations, and you must be comfortable configuring and demoing the product to technical buyers.

- Execution-Oriented Storytelling: Proven ability to take "under-the-hood" technology and turn it into an emotional and urgent business story. You know how to rise above the noise and create a sense of urgency.

- Fluency in the security implications of AI, and a track record of using AI tooling to raise your own throughput.

- Experience influencing cross-functional leaders and driving complex programs to deadline.

 Extra Credit if you have: 

- CS Degree or a strong technical background in systems architecture or engineering.

- Deep experience with modern identity protocols and securing hybrid environments (Cloud and On-Premises).

- Experience in the AI space, specifically regarding the security implications of LLMs and agentic workflows.

oracle_hcm:eeho/CX_45001:346986.title: Senior Director, Product Marketing - NetSuite
oracle_hcm:eeho/CX_45001:346986.description:
Role Overview 

 Lead product marketing strategy for the NetSuite portfolio, shaping how NetSuite brings its products and innovation to market and translating product capabilities, customer needs, and market dynamics into differentiated positioning and go-to-market strategies that drive adoption, pipeline, and revenue growth. 

 This leader will build and develop a high-performing product marketing organization and serve as a strategic partner across Product Management, Outbound Product Management, Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing. 

 Key Responsibilities 

- Own NetSuite's portfolio positioning and narrative , establishing differentiated messaging across products, industries, personas, use cases, and buyer audiences. 

- Define product marketing strategy and priorities  across the portfolio, determining where PMM resources and investments can have the greatest customer and business impact. 

- Lead go-to-market strategy for product launches and releases , establishing launch frameworks, audience strategies, messaging, readiness, and measurement in partnership with Product, Outbound Product Management, Sales, and Marketing. 

- Build the bridge between product and market , translating product capabilities and roadmap direction into compelling customer value propositions, while bringing buyer, customer, competitive, and field insights into go-to-market decisions. 

- Own NetSuite's competitive narrative and differentiation strategy , ensuring teams understand not only how NetSuite compares with competitors, but why customers should choose NetSuite. 

- Translate AI and emerging product capabilities into customer value , developing clear use cases, value propositions, messaging, and sales plays that make innovation relevant and actionable for customers and prospects. 

- Drive product adoption and lifecycle marketing strategy , extending PMM beyond launch to increase awareness, usage, adoption, expansion, and realization of customer value. 

- Set the product marketing operating model , including launch tiers, engagement models, prioritization, measurement, and clear roles and responsibilities across Product, Outbound Product Management, and Marketing. 

- Equip Sales and customer-facing teams to win , developing scalable messaging, sales plays, competitive strategies, and enablement that connect product capabilities to customer business outcomes. 

- Partner across Marketing to activate product strategy , providing the positioning, audience insights, product narratives, and strategic direction that inform demand generation, content, digital, events, communications, and executive storytelling. 

- Establish meaningful measures of PMM impact , using adoption, pipeline, revenue, competitive, engagement, and customer insights to evaluate effectiveness and continuously improve go-to-market strategy. 

- Build, lead, and develop a high-performing product marketing team , establishing clear ownership, strong PMM disciplines, career development, and a culture of customer and market orientation. 

- Manage agencies, vendors, and external resources  where specialized expertise or additional capacity is required. 

- Travel up to 25% of the time 

 Qualifications 

- Significant experience leading product marketing, portfolio marketing, or go-to-market strategy for complex B2B technology or SaaS businesses. 

- Demonstrated success building and leading high-performing product marketing teams. 

- Strong expertise in positioning, messaging, segmentation, buyer insights, competitive strategy, product launches, and sales enablement. 

- Proven ability to translate complex technology and product capabilities into clear customer value and differentiated market narratives. 

- Experience partnering closely with Product Management, Engineering, Sales, Customer Success, and cross-functional Marketing organizations. 

- Strong business judgment and ability to prioritize across a broad product portfolio and competing organizational needs. 

- Experience using customer adoption, pipeline, revenue, competitive, and market insights to guide strategy and measure impact. 

- 
 Executive-level communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders across Product, Sales, and Marketing.

Please see above.

Accrued Vacation is provided to all other employees eligible for vacation benefits. For employees working at least 35 hours per week, the vacation accrual rate is 13 days annually for the first three years of employment and 18 days annually for subsequent years of employment. Vacation accrual is prorated for employees working between 20 and 34 hours per week. Employees working fewer than 20 hours per week are not eligible for vacation.

oracle_hcm:eeho/CX_45001:340462.description:
Senior Solution Consultant – Products Industry (French-English Bilingual Required) 

 Oracle NetSuite 

 Twenty-five years ago, Oracle NetSuite pioneered cloud ERP. Today, we are defining the next era of AI-powered business transformation. Every day, tens of thousands of organizations rely on NetSuite to manage finance, manufacturing, inventory, supply chain, commerce, planning, and operations on a single intelligent platform. 

 We're looking for trusted advisors who understand business challenges—not just software—and can help customers envision what's possible with AI-powered ERP. 

 Location & Language Requirements 

 Required Location: Montreal, Quebec 

 Language Requirement: Professional fluency in both French and English (spoken and written) is required to support customers and prospects across Canada, including French-speaking organizations in Quebec. 

 Why This Opportunity? 

 The products industry is navigating global supply chain disruption, tariffs, labor shortages, sustainability initiatives, and rising customer expectations. Artificial Intelligence is transforming how organizations forecast demand, optimize inventory, improve manufacturing efficiency, and make faster, more informed business decisions. 

 As a Senior Solution Consultant, you'll partner with executive leaders to demonstrate how Oracle NetSuite can help modernize operations and accelerate business transformation through AI.

Who Thrives Here? 
 You may come from manufacturing, supply chain, ERP consulting, finance transformation, procurement, production planning, enterprise software, or digital transformation. 
 You're naturally curious, enjoy solving complex business challenges, excel at executive conversations, and are passionate about helping customers embrace innovation through technology. 
 Industry Focus 
 Consumer Goods 

- Omnichannel commerce 

- Demand forecasting 

- Inventory optimization 

- Customer experience 

- Direct-to-consumer growth 
 Industrial & Equipment Manufacturing 

- Production planning 

- Procurement 

- Predictive maintenance 

- Factory performance 

- Operational resilience 
 Food & Beverage 

- Food safety 

- Traceability 

- Supplier collaboration 

- Inventory freshness 

- Regulatory compliance 

- Waste reduction 
 What You'll Do 

- Partner with executive leaders to develop AI-enabled business transformation strategies. 

- Lead discovery sessions and executive workshops focused on customer business outcomes. 

- Deliver compelling demonstrations across manufacturing, finance, supply chain, commerce, and AI capabilities. 

- Serve as an industry expert for Consumer Goods, Industrial Manufacturing, and Food & Beverage customers. 

- Collaborate closely with Sales, Product Management, Marketing, Customer Success, and Professional Services. 

- Create thought leadership and mentor fellow Solution Consultants. 

- Stay current on emerging AI capabilities and demonstrate how they solve real-world business challenges. 
 Minimum Qualifications 

- Professional fluency in both French and English (spoken and written) is required. 

- 7+ years of experience in Solution Consulting, ERP Consulting, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, or a related field. 

- Experience supporting customers in Consumer Goods, Industrial Manufacturing, Food & Beverage, or Wholesale Distribution. 

- Strong understanding of ERP, Manufacturing, Inventory Management, Procurement, Supply Chain, Financial Management, or Commerce. 

- Experience presenting and influencing executive stakeholders. 

- Excellent communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills. 

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience. 
 Preferred Experience 
 Experience with one or more of the following solutions: 

- Oracle NetSuite 

- SAP 

- Microsoft Dynamics 

- Infor 

- Epicor 

- Blue Yonder 

- Kinaxis 

- Salesforce 
 Experience leveraging AI tools such as: 

- Claude 

- ChatGPT 

- Codex 

- Microsoft Copilot 

- Gemini 

- Similar generative AI technologies 
 Why Oracle NetSuite? 
 Oracle NetSuite is building a team of industry advisors who combine deep business expertise with the world's leading AI-powered cloud ERP platform. If you're passionate about innovation, executive engagement, and helping organizations transform businesses through intelligent technology, we'd love to hear from you.

 We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.

 We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards.  Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade. 

 Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day.  We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.

 Job Summary: 
This job focuses on leveraging data to derive insights that align with the product’s shared vision and customer needs. It involves gathering customer experience insights to inform product requirements and analyzing research, market data, and usability studies for data-driven decision-making. Responsibilities include monitoring product profitability and budget, leading sprint planning, daily standups, and retrospectives to ensure effective execution, and collaborating with content developers, data scientists, product designers, and user experience researchers to uncover new opportunities. 
 Job Description:

- Implements the architectural roadmap that balances innovative design and technical implementation, while balancing regulatory requirements, time-to-market, meeting customer needs and product profitability.

- Controls for the customer experience and customer needs in product requirements and as an input to decision making.

- Monitors metrics that inform the success of products including usability studies, research and market analysis.

- Manages one or more workstreams to include analytics, customer discovery, market research and competitive analysis to drive data-driven decision-making.

- Monitors product profitability measures, including budget.

- Participates in operational mechanisms that drive execution and accountability including Product Reviews, Operating Reviews, and Business Reviews. Interfaces with product and technology leadership as needed.

- Partners with content developers, data scientists, product designers and user experience researchers.

lever:policyme:5190b06d-00cf-4429-b65b-7.title: Principal Product Manager, Accounts & Automation (Remote)
lever:policyme:5190b06d-00cf-4429-b65b-7.description:
Overview of the Role We’re on a mission to modernize insurance - making it simpler, more accessible, and customer-first. The insurance industry is a $1T market that’s remained largely untouched by the digital revolution, and PolicyMe is here to change that. As a remote-first, Toronto-based startup with big ambitions, we’re looking for a product leader to help us build the future of insurance in Canada - and beyond. We are now seeking a Principal Product Manager to join our Accounts & Automation team within our product organization. This role will own several areas of scope, including: Defining the strategy and roadmap to make us the go-to provider for all of our customers’ personal insurance needs, including the platform-wide programs and features that drive multi-product adoption Building trust digitally across the products we offer, so customers feel similar levels of confidence and reassurance as they would get when they speak with one our licensed advisors Evolving our accounts product and internal tools to streamline operations and deliver a seamless customer experience end to end. This is a highly strategic and hands-on leadership role that blends product vision, analytical thinking, structured execution, and cross-functional leadership. You will be responsible for shaping long-term product direction while also driving day-to-day execution across multiple complex initiatives. Reporting to the VP of Product, you will work closely with leaders across Engineering, Design, Growth, Operations, Customer Success, and Data to build products that create exceptional customer outcomes and drive meaningful business impact. What you'll be doing:

Define & Own the Product Vision

  • Evolve our product strategy to improve customer delight, retention, referral growth, operational efficiency, and cross-product adoption.
  • Develop a compelling long-term vision for how to make insurance simple for Canadians, from how customers discover new products of ours to how they manage it post-sale.
  • Build and champion a roadmap that balances innovation, operational excellence, and long-term scalability.
  • Develop a deep understanding of customer and operational pain points, using those insights to shape strategy and prioritization.
  • Establish clear OKRs and success metrics that align teams around measurable business and customer outcomes.

    • Solve Ambiguous Problems

  • Take open-ended, unstructured problems and break them down into clear opportunities, strategic priorities, and executable plans.
  • Bring creative, first-principles thinking to solve complex challenges that have not been solved before in the Canadian insurance market.
  • Balance customer needs, technical constraints, operational realities, and business priorities when making product decisions.
  • Lead through ambiguity and create clarity for teams and stakeholders across the organization.

    • Drive End-to-end Execution and Delivery

  • Lead the product team through the full product lifecycle: problem definition, discovery, solution design, scoping, execution, launch, and iteration.
  • While you’ll shape the strategic direction, you’re also highly execution-oriented and willing to dive into the details when needed.
  • Ensure we build the right things, the right way, at the right time by balancing short-term wins with long-term platform investments.
  • Collaborate closely with Product Design and Engineering to build best-in-class customer and internal product experiences.
  • Write clear, actionable product specifications that connect business goals, customer needs, operational requirements, and technical constraints.
  • Coordinate closely with Growth, Customer Success, Operations, and other stakeholders to ensure launches are operationally ready and well-supported.
  • Drive alignment across teams and act as the connective tissue between stakeholders with competing priorities.

    • Measurement, Experimentation and Iteration

  • Define success metrics and measurement frameworks for all major initiatives, including customer engagement, funnel conversion, retention, operational efficiency, and long-term customer value.
  • Design and run experiments to validate hypotheses, de-risk larger investments, and accelerate learning.
  • Partner closely with Data to build dashboards, analyze product performance, and translate insights into actionable next steps - including when to pivot, double down, or sunset initiatives.
  • Use data, customer insights, and business context to continuously refine strategy and prioritization.
    • What we are looking for:
  • 8+ years of product management experience, including experience owning and scaling customer-facing digital products in high-growth environments.
  • Strong track record of leading complex cross-functional initiatives and delivering measurable business and customer outcomes.
  • Experience building both customer-facing D2C products and operational/internal tooling products.
  • Experience building prototypes with AI.
  • Experience scaling products and product practices within high-growth startups or fast-moving technology organizations.
  • Proven ability to define and communicate a compelling product vision that aligns teams and stakeholders around long-term outcomes.
  • Strong business acumen with a deep understanding of how product decisions impact revenue, operations, customer success, retention, and compliance.
  • Exceptional ability to structure ambiguous problems and turn them into clear, actionable plans.
  • Strong operational discipline with the ability to manage competing priorities, maintain momentum, and consistently close loops with stakeholders.
  • Excellent collaboration and stakeholder management skills with high emotional intelligence and a transparent leadership style.
  • Strong documentation and communication skills - able to tailor messaging effectively across executives, engineers, designers, marketers, and operational stakeholders.
  • Comfortable leading initiatives with many moving parts and driving alignment across multiple teams.
  • Strong sense of prioritization and ability to define MVP scope while balancing speed, quality, and long-term scalability.
  • Highly analytical and data-driven, with comfort working with product data, defining metrics, building measurement frameworks, and conducting analyses to inform decisions.
    • Why join us:
  • Generous PTO - 20 vacation days
  • A comprehensive benefits plan with premiums paid in full by PolicyMe
  • Investment in your professional development, including an L&D budget, AI tooling budget, performance reviews twice a year and ongoing feedback to ensure you reach your highest potential
  • An extremely high performing, low-ego, remote-first team that is truly disrupting an old industry
  • Option to work from home or our Toronto-based office (bonus: we cover the costs to bring all our employees in-person twice a year for experiential socials!)
  • Access to stock options based on performance

ashby:procurify:8474a8c8-2f96-4b31-a368-.description:
Director, Product Marketing



Location:
USA (100% Remote)
Canada (100% Remote)



Procurify is the agentic procurement platform that helps mid-market organizations get complete control over their spend.
We’re trusted by hundreds of companies around the world, across industries like biotechnology, education, health care, manufacturing, and software, to manage over $100B in spend.

Product marketing sits at the center of how we're understood in that market, and we're hiring a Director to lead it.




ABOUT THE ROLE



Procurify is looking for a Director of Product Marketing to define how we compete and win. You'll own the company narrative, the messaging architecture our go-to-market organization builds on, how we segment and prioritize the market, and the analyst relationships that influence how Procurify is understood.



This is a chance to help define Procurify's next stage of growth as the agentic procurement platform. You'll be at the center of translating that strategy into positioning, messaging, assets, and programs that drive demonstrable impact across our go-to-market organization.



This is a senior seat on the marketing leadership team, with full visibility across the company and regular engagement with executives. You'll lead two Product Marketing Managers. You'll raise their craft, sharpen their judgment, and expand what they're capable of owning, building both the team's impact and their careers as leaders in their own right.



This is a true player-coach role. Your PMMs own their product portfolios, and you'll guide their strategy and raise the quality of their work while directly owning company-level and cross-portfolio initiatives yourself. It's hands-on by design: you get the scope and influence of a senior leader while staying close to the craft.



AI fluency is table stakes for this role. We expect AI to be foundational to how you analyze information, build workflows, create and evaluate work, and scale the team's impact without compromising quality.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES




POSITIONING AND MARKET STRATEGY

 - Own Procurify's positioning strategy and define how we differentiate in the procurement market.

 - Build and maintain the company-level narrative and messaging architecture as the single source of truth across all surfaces, and translate it into positioning teams can execute against.

 - Own the AI and agentic narrative: make the platform's intelligence concrete, credible, and differentiated for finance and operations buyers.

 - Own market segmentation and use it to direct where we invest and who we talk to.

 - Own the voice of the customer with deep customer research and win/loss analysis.

 - Use product, customer, funnel, and market data to identify patterns, test assumptions, and turn evidence into clear strategic recommendations.

 - Shape Procurify's analyst relations strategy and narrative, building credible relationships with top-tier analyst firms and influencing how the company and category are represented.

 - Act as a credible external voice on procurement and the agentic shift through analyst briefings, press, and webinars.


GO-TO-MARKET

 - Set the execution standard and quality bar for the function, along with the operating rhythms that keep it consistent.

 - Own launch strategy across the portfolio and decide which messages and formats get tested in the market, in partnership with demand generation.

 - Own the strategy for direct-to-customer communications: launch and product-news emails, in-app posts, in-app tours, and lifecycle journeys.

 - Report and analyze product marketing's contribution to pipeline, adoption, and retention.


AI-FIRST PRACTICE

 - Build an AI-enabled Product Marketing practice that improves the quality, consistency, and scale of the function.

 - Establish shared tools, context, and repeatable workflows across core PMM work, and partner with Marketing’s AI specialists to make Product Marketing a model for effective AI-assisted work.


INTERNAL ALIGNMENT AND ENABLEMENT

 - Influence the roadmap, pricing, packaging, and launch sequencing with market, customer, and competitive insight.

 - Own the enablement deliverable set for each product portfolio with your PMMs, including positioning one-pagers, battlecards, playbooks, demo narratives, and objection handling, maintained as living resources in our library rather than launch-day artifacts.

 - Train Sales and Customer Success on messaging, use cases, and differentiation.

 - Set the standard for how competitive intelligence gets gathered and used by go-to-market teams.


TEAM LEADERSHIP AND COACHING

 - Coach two Product Marketing Managers: raise their craft, give direct feedback, hold a high bar on the work, and map a clear path to their next level.

 - Own the team's structure, culture, and operations: the processes, templates, and shared standards that keep output consistent across portfolios, whoever is doing the work.

 - Own the team's plan: what it takes on each quarter, what it defers, and how portfolio coverage is split across the two PMMs.
   
   


EXPERIENCE

 - 10+ years in B2B SaaS marketing, with significant Product Marketing leadership experience and direct people management.

 - You’ve owned company-level positioning and messaging for a multi-product or complex SaaS platform, including a meaningful repositioning, category shift, or evolution in market narrative.

 - You’ve led go-to-market strategy across a product portfolio, from segmentation and launch strategy through sales enablement, customer communications, and market adoption.

 - You know how to turn customer, competitive, win/loss, and market insight into decisions on positioning, roadmap, pricing, packaging, and where the business invests.

 - You’ve built credibility with senior executives, Sales, Product, Customer Success, customers, and industry analysts, and can influence decisions without relying on organizational authority.

 - You’ve built and coached a high-performing Product Marketing team, raised the quality bar for the function, and helped marketers meaningfully grow their craft and careers.

 - You’re commercially minded and comfortable measuring Product Marketing against business outcomes, including pipeline, adoption, retention, and competitive performance.

 - You’re AI-fluent in practice, not theory. You’ve changed how a team works using AI, built repeatable workflows around it, and can point to meaningful improvements in the quality or scale of the work.

 - You are an exceptional writer and storyteller who still does the work yourself. You can turn a complex platform into differentiated, credible language that a CFO can understand and repeat.

 - You maintain an up-to-date LinkedIn profile and ensure it is refreshed upon joining, to reflect your role at Procurify and help maintain a consistent, professional presence across our GTM team.
   
   


WHY PROCURIFY?




WE’RE BUILDING A PRODUCT THAT MATTERS.

Procurify is redefining how organizations manage spend - transforming a historically manual, reactive process into a strategic advantage. Today, hundreds of companies trust us to manage billions in spend, and we’re just getting started.



With fresh investment, a strong product foundation, and big ambitions in AI and payments, we’re entering our next phase of growth. That means a real opportunity to shape what we build, how we scale, and the impact we have on our customers.



The best part? The team. We’re a group of builders who move fast, think big, and show up for each other. No egos, no passengers, just people who want to do great work and win together.



If you’re looking for a place where you can make a real impact alongside a team that raises the bar, you’ll fit right in.




BE EMPOWERED TO DO YOUR BEST WORK

We’ve created an environment where personal and professional growth is a real priority. Some of the great perks we offer include:



 - Flexible working: We’re a remote-first organization with flexible working hours. Work anywhere from within Canada!

 - Responsible time off: We offer a flexible approach to time off; we trust our team to take the time they need to rest and recharge while staying accountable to their commitments.

 - Extended health benefits: We prioritize our team’s health and well-being. We offer a competitive health, vision, and dental package along with an Employee Assistance Program (EAP), and a health and wellness spending account.

 - Continuous learning: We host regular educational lunch and learns to help our team grow, share knowledge, and stay curious.

 - Stock options: Everyone has a chance to own a part of Procurify with our competitive stock program.

 - Typical Base Salary Range: 
   
   - Canada: $168,000–$210,000 CAD
   
   - United States: $140,000–$160,000 USD
     
     
     Plus a generous CIP.
     
     (The base pay range for this role depends on location and depth of experience, and doesn't include incentive bonuses, benefits, or equity that form part of your total compensation package.)
     
     


LEARN MORE

Procurify is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate against any team members or applicants for employment because of race, color, disability, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, or gender identity and/or expression.



If you feel like you don’t meet all of the requirements for this role, we encourage you to apply anyway. We know that feelings of imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting incredible candidates, and we certainly don’t want those feelings to get in the way of meeting you! We really want to get to know you and why you're great for the role. Please avoid including your picture and age on your resume.



Apply online today and let’s start a conversation.



To learn more about Procurify, check out these resources:

 - Check out what our customers are saying about us https://www.procurify.com/testimonials

 - Learn more about our agentic procurement platform https://www.procurify.com/product/

ashby:procurify:bab0f6a4-be5c-4870-a991-.title: Senior Product Manager
ashby:procurify:bab0f6a4-be5c-4870-a991-.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

 

Procurify is the leading agentic procurement platform for the mid-market, helping organizations take control of their spend and make smarter financial decisions.

 

We’re building an ambitious, high-performance company where talented people are trusted with meaningful ownership and given the opportunity to make a real impact. Our remote-first culture values accountability, resilience, collaboration, and continuous growth. You’ll work alongside driven teammates on complex, important problems, grow your career through meaningful challenges, and help shape an AI-native company at a defining moment in the evolution of agentic procurement. We’re seeking a talented and collaborative Senior Product Manager to join us in building innovative, customer-centric solutions that drive meaningful outcomes.

 

As a Senior Product Manager at Procurify, you will play a key role in defining and delivering high-impact solutions within one of our core product areas. You will work in a fast-paced, AI-Native product and engineering environment. You will partner closely with your triad of engineering and design, and collaborate across the triple diamond to move quickly from concept to delivery.

 

We are looking for someone who is driven to solve important problems for customers and motivated by the opportunity to create real impact. You thrive in a collaborative environment and see cross-functional partnership as essential to building great products. You will work closely with teams across the company to ensure we are solving the right problems with purpose and clarity.







WHAT YOU WILL BE WORKING ON



Focus on outcomes, not just features

 - You will be responsible for driving meaningful business and customer results. Your work will align with strategic priorities and guide your team to focus on the highest-impact opportunities.



Building great strategy through domain expertise

 - You will be responsible for strategic direction and effective decision-making in your product domains. This will be achieved through your depth of knowledge in your domain and through facilitation with experts within the company.



Act as a strong customer advocate

 - You will represent the voice of the customer through deep curiosity, insight, and empathy. You will champion their needs and ensure that every solution improves their experience and drives value.



Work fast in an AI-Native environment

 - You will operate within a modern product development process that uses rapid prototyping, fast experimentation, and AI tools. You will help identify how AI can unlock better solutions, faster.



Collaborate across the company

 - You will work closely within your product triad and partner across every part of the business. You will build alignment, share context, and ensure that product decisions are grounded in both customer insight and cross-functional collaboration.



Lead with clarity and purpose

 - You will approach product challenges with a strong sense of ownership and focus. You will drive decisions that balance customer needs, technical realities, and business goals, always aiming to deliver exceptional results.



Contribute to product direction

 - You will help shape the product strategy and inform roadmap decisions in your area, you will be responsible for delivering results aligned with its goals.

 


WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

 - 5+ years of product management experience in SaaS, fintech, or related industries.

 - Proven product ownership experience within the Procure-to-Pay (P2P) lifecycle. You must have deep expertise in at least one core domain:
   
   - Procurement (eg, purchase requisitions, PO management, supplier onboarding, sourcing)
   
   - Accounts Payable (eg, invoice data capture, approval workflows, payment execution)

 - Proven ability to deliver high-impact business and customer outcomes in fast-moving environments

 - Experience working in empowered, cross-functional triads with engineering and design

 - Familiarity with AI-Native development practices and rapid experimentation

 - Strong communication skills and a highly collaborative mindset

 - Analytical thinker with a focus on solving the right problems

 - Clear sense of domain ownership and ability to align work to strategic goals

 - Passion for building meaningful products as part of a high-performing team

 - Excellent project management skills to effectively run discovery, design, and development of initiatives in parallel.

 - For customer-facing roles, maintains an up-to-date LinkedIn profile and ensures it is refreshed upon joining, to reflect their role at Procurify and help maintain a consistent, professional presence across our GTM team.





WHY PROCURIFY?




HELP US MODERNIZE SPEND MANAGEMENT

Procurify is a remote-first company with a big heart and a strong ambition to modernize the way organizations manage business spend. We’re trusted by hundreds of companies around the world — across industries like biotechnology, education, health care, manufacturing, and software — to manage over $30B in spend. We recently closed $50M in Series C funding to help us strengthen our core offering, launch new payment capabilities, and provide customers with an AI-enhanced procure-to-pay experience. Read the press release here https://www.procurify.com/press_release/procurify-raises-50m-series-c/.



BE EMPOWERED TO DO YOUR BEST WORK



We’ve created an environment where personal and professional growth is a real priority. Some of the great perks we offer include:

 - Flexible working: We’re a remote-first organization with flexible working hours. Work anywhere from within Canada!

 - Unlimited responsible time off: Work hard, play harder. All team members can take advantage of our unlimited responsible time off policy.

SOLUTIONS CONSULTANT

Location: Remote (Canada or U.S.)

Procurify is the leading agentic procurement platform for the mid-market, helping organizations take control of their spend and make smarter financial decisions.

We’re building an ambitious, high-performance company where talented people are trusted with meaningful ownership and given the opportunity to make a real impact. Our remote-first culture values accountability, resilience, collaboration, and continuous growth. You’ll work alongside driven teammates on complex, important problems, grow your career through meaningful challenges, and help shape an AI-native company at a defining moment in the evolution of agentic procurement.

We're hiring an experienced Solutions Consultant to be the technical and domain authority on our sales team. This is the person who can walk into a room with a VP of Finance or a Controller, diagnose their procurement and AP pain points in minutes, and show (not just tell) why Procurify is the better platform. The role partners closely with our CRO, VP of Sales, and Executive Leadership Team to help shape how we win competitive deals.



ABOUT THE ROLE

This is not an entry-level pre-sales seat. We're looking for someone who has already sold or consulted against the players in our space or similar procure-to-pay, spend management, or AP automation providers. You'll know how to position a challenger platform to win, and you'll own the technical and domain narrative across complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles in the mid-market and lower-enterprise segment, partnering closely with Account Executives, Customer Success, Product, and Marketing.

This role sits at the intersection of deep domain expertise, competitive strategy, and consultative selling. Success looks like shorter sales cycles, higher win rates against named competitors, and a Sales org that is measurably sharper because of the enablement and positioning you bring.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



DOMAIN & COMPETITIVE EXPERTISE

 - Serve as the subject-matter expert on Procurify's platform and on the broader procure-to-pay, spend management, and AP automation landscape.

 - Maintain current, detailed knowledge of key competitors and translate that intelligence into sharp, defensible competitive positioning for Sales and Marketing.

 - Codify win/loss themes, battlecards, and objection-handling assets so the whole Sales team benefits from what you learn in the field.

 - Partner with Product Management to relay competitive gaps, market feedback, and integration needs, and help prioritize what gets built next.


DISCOVERY & DEMO EXCELLENCE

 - Lead structured, consultative discovery to uncover a prospect's procurement and AP workflows, technical environment, and business drivers.

 - Design and deliver compelling, story-driven demos that connect Procurify's capabilities to the prospect's stated business case.

 - Build and maintain a reusable library of demo environments, vertical-specific narratives, and proof points that scale across the team.

 - Conduct technical scoping for both out-of-the-box integrations and custom API integrations to client ERP and accounting systems (e.g., NetSuite, Sage Intacct, Microsoft Dynamics, QuickBooks).


SALES CYCLE & DEAL SUPPORT

 - Partner with Account Executives through complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles from qualification through close, acting as the technical and strategic co-pilot on every deal that needs one.

 - Own RFP/RFI responses, security and IT questionnaires, and solution documentation that build prospect confidence and speed up procurement decisions.

 - Present to and influence economic buyers and executive stakeholders, including CFOs, Controllers, and VPs of Finance and Procurement, translating technical capability into strategic, financial value.

 - Qualify potential customers while understanding and solving their complex workflow and approval-routing questions.


CROSS-FUNCTIONAL IMPACT & ENABLEMENT

 - Help ramp new Sales hires on demo delivery, discovery technique, and competitive positioning.

 - Get new clients set up for success by enhancing their understanding of the platform and services ahead of handoff to Customer Success.

 - Contribute market, competitive, and win/loss perspective to Procurify's Product Team

 - Other related duties as assigned.
   
   


WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 4+ years in a Solutions Consultant, Sales Engineer, or Pre-Sales Consultant role in B2B SaaS, with strong preference for candidates coming from a procure-to-pay, spend management, or AP automation provider 

 - Deep, hands-on domain knowledge of procurement and accounts payable workflows, purchase-to-pay cycles, approval routing, and financial controls.

 - A proven track record running discovery and delivering demos that have influenced complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise or mid-market deals.

 - Direct experience competing against, or working at, the providers named above, with the ability to speak credibly and specifically to how Procurify differentiates.

 - A consultative, curious, quick-thinking approach: diagnose the business problem first, then map the technical solution.

 - Experience owning technical workstreams within full sales cycles, including RFPs, security reviews, technical scoping, and executive-level presentations.

 - Comfort with ERP and accounting system integrations and API concepts; able to explain technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

 - Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the presence to influence a room of executive stakeholders.

 - Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

 - For customer-facing roles, maintains an up-to-date LinkedIn profile and ensures it is refreshed upon joining, to reflect their role at Procurify and help maintain a consistent, professional presence across our GTM team.




WHY PROCURIFY?



HELP US MODERNIZE SPEND MANAGEMENT

 

Procurify is redefining how organizations manage spend - transforming a historically manual, reactive process into a strategic advantage. Today, hundreds of companies trust us to manage billions in spend, and we’re just getting started.

 

Powered by our $50M Series C funding, we are actively expanding our core offering, launching new payment capabilities, and building an AI-enhanced procure-to-pay experience for our customers. Read the press release here https://www.procurify.com/press_release/procurify-raises-50m-series-c/. With fresh investment, a strong product foundation, and big ambitions in AI and payments, we’re entering our next phase of growth. That means a real opportunity to shape what we build, how we scale, and the impact we have on our customers.

 

The best part? The team. We’re a group of builders who move fast, think big, and show up for each other. No egos, no passengers, just people who want to do great work and win together.

 

If you’re looking for a place where you can make a real impact alongside a team that raises the bar, you’ll fit right in.

Company: 
Qualcomm Canada ULC 
 Job Area: 
Engineering Services Group, Engineering Services Group > Program Management 
 General Summary: 
 Qualcomm is seeking a Technical Program Manager to lead planning, development, execution, and delivery of software, emulation, and silicon validation for Networking Products within the Datacenter BU. You will develop, define, and execute plans, including schedules, budgets, resources, deliverables, and risks. You will oversee programs from start to finish, collaborating with internal and external stakeholders on technical matters. You will ensure on-time delivery and achieve program milestones while driving alignment across stakeholders.

 This is an excellent opportunity to join the growing Datacenter Networking Business Unit organization. You will drive the end-to-end software, firmware, emulation, and validation lifecycle across our next-generation Connectivity Products. Expect collaboration during all phases of development, working alongside designers and pre/post-silicon leaders to ensure timely delivery of software that powers the world’s most advanced connectivity technology for AI datacenters!

 Responsibilities 

- Drive requirements scoping, analysis, and planning including interdependencies, staffing constraints, and schedule optimization across technical teams and customers. 

- Establish a clear Plan of Record and drive prioritization across the organization. 

- Apply consistency and best practices through program initiation, planning, execution, and closing phases, enabling business outcomes and benefits tracking. 

- Collaborate with key stakeholders and program sponsors to develop program goals, set priorities for deliverables, discuss involvement of business processes, and drive decisions to ensure on-time delivery. 

- Establish execution discipline & communication process: risk management and mitigation, tracking, schedule trends vs baseline, recovery actions, executive reporting and stakeholder communication. 

- Develop program indicators and KPIs to manage program health including quality and timelines. 

- Promote program vision and objectives within the team, ensure program objectives are met or exceeded, present vision to management, and gain buy-in from stakeholders. 

- Own project schedule and track overall execution of baseline software development, ensuring milestones align with program commitments and customer expectations. 

- Develop and manage the execution of the program Plan of Record (e.g. on time, on budget, within scope) for multiple software programs which include schedule and resource forecasting, stakeholder identification, method and frequency of communication, scope, and prioritization. 

- Drive teams to identify program issues/risks and create a risk mitigation plan for multiple medium-sized or single complex program(s).  Maintain and update the risk tracker. 

- Establish key program success metrics and manage action plans to ensure program success when metrics deviate from Plan of Record. 

- Define and drive process frameworks across teams for efficient and consistent execution and quality deliverables. 

- Communicate clearly with executives, engineers, and stakeholders, balancing transparency with thoughtful trade-off discussions. 

- Co-manage multi-year software roadmaps and coordinate across silicon, firmware, software, and emulation teams. 

 Minimum Qualifications: 
• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related field.
• 4+ years of Program Management or related work experience.

*Completed advanced degrees in a relevant field may be substituted for up to two years (Master’s = one year, Doctorate = two years) of work experience.

- 5+ years Program Management experience or related work experience.

- 5+ years in firmware development.

- PMP Certification and/or Agile Certification.

- Experience with agile program management tools such as Jira and Confluence.

- Experience in a role requiring interaction with senior leadership (e.g. Director level and above).

- Experience working in a large matrixed organization.

- Highly organized, adaptable, with excellent verbal and written skills.

We're looking for our next Senior Product Manager. Could It Be You?

Flexiti is one of Canada's leading point-of-sale financing providers and part of Questrade Financial Group. Through the FlexitiCard® and the Flexiti Network™, we help Canadians pay for the things that matter to them over time, and we help thousands of retail partners across the country grow their sales. Product management at Flexiti means working in a genuinely two-sided business: every decision you make touches both a cardholder and a merchant, and understanding the needs of both while making the appropriate trade-offs is part of the job.

The Senior Product Manager (Sr. PM) is a strategic leader who oversees an entire product entity or a collection of high-impact product areas. Reporting directly to the Group Product Manager, you will lead complex, cross-entity initiatives, ensuring technical architecture, product specifications, and release cycles align with the company's long-term business goals. You will influence ways of working across multiple squads, establish standards for UX and data-driven decision-making, and act as a crucial liaison between product execution and executive strategy.

Need more details? Keep reading…

In this role, responsibilities include but are not limited to:

Entity specifications: Leading the drafting of specifications for complex, large-scale initiatives that span multiple product areas, identifying and proactively resolving entity dependencies and logic gaps.

Strategic architecture influence: Leveraging product vision to influence technical architecture across the division, ensuring the platform evolves to support future scaling requirements and product ambitions.

Entity-wide delivery leadership: Driving the end-to-end delivery of large-scale initiatives, making clear, accountable trade-offs across multiple squads to mitigate risk and clear organizational blockers.

Quality and design governance: Setting and upholding a high quality and user experience bar across the entity, ensuring consistency in design standards, accessibility, and operational excellence.

Data and financial rigour: Synthesizing complex data from multiple sources to make high-stakes product decisions, and applying strong financial judgment to funding models, budgets, and business case development.

Strategic roadmapping: Defining and aligning the long-term vision and product roadmap across the entity, ensuring all initiatives are complementary and directly support company-wide strategic objectives.

Stakeholder management: Actively managing and influencing senior stakeholders across the company, incorporating cross-functional goals to build broad organization-wide alignment.

Practice and craft leadership: Elevating performance across multiple squads by establishing best practices, mentoring team members, and optimizing product delivery rituals and ways of working.

So are YOU our next Senior Product Manager? You are if you…

Have a Bachelor's degree or higher in a quantitative, engineering, or business field

Have 6+ years of progressive product management experience, with at least 2 years in a lead or principal role managing complex product domains

Have demonstrated experience driving cross-functional alignment and managing technical and architectural dependencies across multiple agile teams

Have experience in highly regulated industries such as financial services, insurance, or healthtech

Additional kudos if you…

Have experience in consumer lending, BNPL or point-of-sale financing, payments, credit decisioning, retail finance, or merchant-facing B2B tooling

Additional Information…

This position sits within Flexiti Financial Inc., part of Questrade Financial Group, in Product Management.

This position reports to the Group Product Manager and has no direct reports. You will partner closely with Product Managers, Senior Product Managers, and Associate Product Managers.

This is a Full Time Regular position based in the GTA.

Compensation Information:

Base salary range: $110,000 - $150,000

The final compensation package will be commensurate with the successful candidate's experience, skills, and geographic location (Canada). It includes a comprehensive benefits plan and a competitive incentive (bonus) program for Full-Time Permanent roles.

As the Head of Product, you will be the company’s senior leader and the go-to expert for the management team on the present and future of Questrade branded Products. You will be responsible for staying abreast of the evolving regulatory environment and global best practices for developing and delivering world-class products, services, and experiences. Drive a culture of high customer-centricity, accountability for outcomes, innovation, collaboration and excellence. 

Efficiency:

Streamline operational processes and ensure the efficiency of all Build, Run and Change activities.

Have significant experience in B2B payments and financial services

Work with diverse team members in an inclusive and collaborative environment

This job posting is for future opportunities. 

Interested in Product Management roles at Questrade Financial Group but don’t see an active opening? Apply here to join our Talent Community!
Product Management roles at Questrade are drivers of product strategy, lifecycle management, and user-centric delivery across our scaling enterprise ecosystem. You will take ownership or support with complex and/or developing product portfolios, transforming shifting business expectations and deep customer insights into stable, highly competitive digital solutions. Key deliverables might include defining multi-quarter product roadmaps, producing robust product requirements, and managing successful feature deployments from discovery to launch. The scope of impact ranges from cross-functional squads to departmental alignment and enterprise-level growth, adapting naturally in complexity depending on the formal leveling of the chosen candidate and role we are seeking to fill.

Please note: This posting is intended to capture interest for future Product Management roles at Questrade. We are incredibly grateful for your interest in our team. Because we receive a large volume of applications, our talent acquisition team is only able to reach out directly to candidates whose skills and experiences most closely align with the core requirements of the position. Thank you for your understanding and for sharing your time with us. 

Need more details? Keep reading…
In this role, responsibilities might include: 

Own and Drive Product Strategy: Establish a clear product roadmap by synthesizing market analytics, user feedback, and competitive intelligence to advance enterprise commercial goals (Strategic Mindset, Business Insight).

Navigate Complex Requirements & Backlogs: Translate sophisticated, sometimes contradictory information into unambiguous product specs, user stories, and acceptance criteria to ensure engineering and design work with total clarity (Manages Complexity, Plans and Aligns).

Deliver Customer-Centric Solutions: Lead deep user research and data-driven discovery to build intuitive digital experiences that explicitly resolve client pain points and boost retention (Customer Focus).

Operate and Deliver in Ambiguity: Act with a strong sense of urgency to push minimal viable products (MVPs) and structural updates live, remaining highly adaptable when market demands or technical environments shift unexpectedly (Action Oriented, Manages Ambiguity).

Champion Collaborative Innovation: Partner cross-functionally with Engineering, Design, QA, Data, and Marketing to build shared goals, negotiate technical trade-offs, and foster a culture of creative experimentation (Collaborates, Cultivates Innovation).

Communicate and Balance Stakeholder Needs: Articulate clear product visions, roadmap trade-offs, and performance metrics to both technical engineering teams and non-technical business leaders, ensuring shared buy-in (Communicates Effectively, Balances Stakeholders).

Establish Accountability & Drive Results: Monitor post-launch product metrics, holding cross-functional squads to account for software quality, timelines, and measurable business outcomes (Ensures Accountability, Drives Results).

Required Qualifications:

Education: Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline (or equivalent practical experience).

Core Product Experience: Demonstrated track record working within a modern product management framework, scaling from feature-level implementation up to platform ecosystem management.

Problem-Solving Skills: Proven capability to break down highly technical or messy user experience challenges into systematic, solvable components.

Execution & Delivery: Experience working closely with agile engineering methodologies (Scrum/Kanban) to ship high-quality features continuously under tight parameters.

Stakeholder Management: Exceptional communication and relationship-building skills, with an innate ability to articulate complex technical ideas clearly to varied audiences.

Additional kudos if you…

Have experience within the Fintech, digital brokerage, or broader Financial Services industry.

Have familiarity with complex cloud-native architectures, data infrastructure, or API-driven ecosystems.

Have professional product management certifications (e.g., Product Management Professional, Pragmatic Institute, Agile Product Owner).

Interested? Click below to apply!

We’re looking for our next Head of Product & Technology. Could It Be You?
The Head of Product & Technology will bridge the gap between product strategy and technical infrastructure. You will lead a high-performing, co-located team of product directors and managers, engineers, designers, and data scientists to build secure, scalable, and customer-centric financial solutions.

This is a critical executive role for a leader who thrives on transforming legacy paradigms into modern, cloud-native architectures while maintaining the rigorous compliance, security, and stability standards required by the Canadian banking sector (OSFI).

Need more details? Keep reading…
In this role, responsibilities include but are not limited to: 

Own and execute the end-to-end product and technology roadmap, aligning it with Questbank’s overarching business goals.
Drive a product-led culture that leverages data analytics, user research, and continuous feedback loops to deliver exceptional digital banking experiences.
Partner with business unit leaders to ensure the product stack directly enables revenue growth, customer acquisition, and retention.
Oversee the evolution of Questbank’s architecture toward modern, API-first, and cloud-native solutions that support the product vision.
Foster a robust engineering culture rooted in DevOps, CI/CD automation, clean code practices, and technical debt management.

Evaluate, negotiate with, and manage critical third-party tech vendors, core banking providers, and FinTech partners.

Ensure all product features and technology deployments comply with OSFI guidelines (specifically B-10, B-13), FCAC, and privacy regulations (PIPEDA).
Mentor and scale a diverse team of product managers, engineers, and agile practitioners, promoting a culture of psychological safety, accountability, and continuous learning.

Optimize the cross-functional squad model to eliminate silos between product discovery and technical delivery.
Primary P&L leader for the bank

So are YOU our next Head of Product & Technology? You are if you…

Have 10+ years of progressive leadership experience in product management and/or software engineering, with at least 5 years in an executive or director-level capacity.
Have a deep understanding of the Canadian financial services landscape, including retail/commercial banking, payment networks (Interac, Payments Canada modernisation), and core banking systems.
Have a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.
Have expertise in modern product discovery frameworks and Agile/Scrum/SAFe methodologies.
Have strong literacy in cloud computing (AWS, Azure, or GCP), microservices architecture, and modern data platforms.
Have exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills; ability to translate complex product and technical concepts into business outcomes for the C-suite and Board of Directors.

We’re looking for our next Product Manager, Credit Card. Could It Be You?
As a Product Manager for Credit Cards, you will own discovery and delivery of products & features Questbank customers use to manage their money & investments. Your mandate is to take a customer problem and solve it - then build, ship, and improve it with your engineering, design, and data partners.
This is not a roadmap-administration role or a strategy-deck role. You'll sit at the intersection of customer experience, technology, and business strategy as we collapse the boundaries between investing, banking, and spending into one seamless product. It's ideal for someone who has shipped consumer products at scale, sweats the details of every customer touchpoint, and has a track record of getting real things built in complex environments.

Need more details? Keep reading…
In this role, responsibilities include but are not limited to: 

Feature Specification: Owns the end-to-end requirement gathering and definition process for highly complex, interrelated product functionality; strategically navigates technical cross-domain dependencies and descopes features when necessary to optimize sequencing and deliver continuous client value.
Making Data-Driven Decisions: You go beyond surface-level metrics to develop a deep understanding of the drivers behind product performance, identifying trends, anomalies, and opportunities that others might miss. You define and evolve the measurement framework for your product area, ensuring success is measured in a way that reflects true user and business impact. You use data to make difficult trade-off decisions and confidently challenge assumptions when the evidence demands it.
Technical Acumen: Maintains a solid understanding of technical architecture, system dependencies, and platform integrations within the product domain; works in close partnership with engineering to navigate complex architectural trade-offs and address technical bottlenecks.
Product Delivery: Reliably steers product execution, at times for multiple products, from ideation to delivery, setting a predictable release cadence while balancing execution velocity with code quality and long-term architectural stability.
Managing Up & Executive Trust: Builds deep cross-functional buy-in and organizational trust by distilling complex product updates into clear, strategic insights for leadership, providing proactive mitigation plans for upcoming risks.
Team Leadership & Morale: Cultivates a high-performing squad environment by setting a clear strategic tone, navigating healthy conflict, and actively mentoring cross-functional team members to elevate delivery quality.
Ownership Mindset: Demonstrates a relentless focus on whatever outcomes the product and squad need to succeed, championing a strong sense of collective accountability and pride in delivery.
Data-Driven Strategy: Establishes and tracks clear domain metrics, synthesizing customer insights, performance data, and competitor trends into tactical roadmap priorities.

So are YOU our next Product Manager, Credit Card? You are if you have...

Experience: 5+ years of product management experience, with a track record of shipping consumer-facing digital products at scale - ideally in banking.
Demonstrated ownership of a product area end to end: strategy, discovery, delivery, measurement, and iteration.
Deep customer obsession: you've built your instincts from real customer conversations, behavioral data, and cohort analysis - not strategy meetings or personal bias.
Fluency in data: you can define the right metrics, run and interpret experiments, and know when to trust the numbers and when to lean on principles.
Strong communication: you write clearly, present persuasively, and can translate between technical and non-technical audiences, from engineers to executives.
Comfort operating in ambiguity: you default to action, form a point of view quickly, and revise it when the evidence says so.
Prioritization Mastery: you know how to partner with engineering, design, user research, product marketing to understand technical trade-offs and make smart calls with your team.
Ability to integrate AI-powered tools and prompts: into daily operational workflows to analyze datasets, automate routine administrative tasks, and enhance data-driven decision-making.

Additional kudos if you have...

Experience at high-growth startups, especially in fintech or other domains requiring complex systems thinking.
Experience launching net-new products or entering new markets, especially in regulated industries.
Strong opinions about UI/UX - you don’t need to be a designer but should know what a category defining experience looks like.
Experience with the financial services landscape and its regulatory environment.
A portfolio of side projects, prototypes, or things you've built - with or without a mandate.

Compensation Information:

Base salary range: $120,000 - $150,000
The final compensation package will be commensurate with the successful candidate's experience, skills, and geographic location (Canada). It includes a comprehensive benefits plan and a competitive incentive (bonus) program for Full-Time Permanent roles.

jazzhr:ratehubinc:job_20260921172433_VB2.title: Senior Product Manager
jazzhr:ratehubinc:job_20260921172433_VB2.description:
WHO IS RATEHUB? 
 We’re a company on a mission - We are a unique Canadian Fintech that is the one stop shop for all financial needs of the consumer - Save, Spend, Borrow, Invest, and Protect. Every single team member, from product & engineering to sales & marketing, finance, operations, and everything in between is obsessed with one thing;  helping Canadians make better financial choices. And we’re pretty great at it, too. Via our digital application technology and our award-winning in-house brokerages, we help over 2M Canadians per month make a positive impact on their finances. We have many unique businesses - a mortgage brokerage, a life insurance brokerage, a home and auto insurance brokerage, a mortgage originations and servicing business, a Financial Services Marketplace and a content business across Ratehub and MoneySense. 365 days a year we deliver our users the best online mortgage experience, personalized Credit Card and Loans options, and cheaper auto & home insurance policies than they typically get from their existing financial adviser.  
 Changing how people make financial choices isn’t easy, though. We know that achieving our mission is full of challenges; challenges that can be complex and often unexpected, but that are always interesting, rewarding, and fun to solve as a team. This is where you come in. We are on the hunt for the right kind of people to join us and help lead us forward to continued growth. 
 Ratehub is looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our growing Product team. Reporting directly to the Chief Product and Technology Officer, you will own the end-to-end product strategy and execution for our Everyday Banking portfolio, partnering closely with the business unit leader to scale this high-growth segment. You’re a strategic, data-driven operator who can anticipate business needs, bring structure to ambiguous problems, and turn complex ideas into world-class digital experiences that empower millions of Canadians to make smarter financial choices. 
  YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES 
 Strategic Leadership & Vision 

- Own the product strategy for the Everyday Banking portfolio (including cards, chequing, savings, investments, and loans), translating market data and user insights into a high-growth vision. 

- Set the vision for AI-driven personalization that anticipates user needs and surfaces the right products and guidance. 

- Drive roadmap alignment and prioritization discussions with executive leadership, securing buy-in on critical trade-offs. 

- Develop deep expertise in fintech trends, competitor movements, and open banking to identify new market opportunities. 
   Product Execution & Delivery 

- Translate strategy into clear product requirements, defining scope, success criteria, and edge cases for the cross-functional pod comprising engineering, design, and QA. 

- Lead the pod through backlog sequencing, scrum ceremonies, and end-to-end delivery. 

- Make high-judgment trade-offs across scope, technical scalability, and timelines, backed by data. 

- Define success metrics and establish reporting to evaluate product performance, surface insights, and communicate results to leadership. 

- Optimize delivery processes and prioritization frameworks to reduce friction, mitigate risk, and accelerate team velocity. 

- Orchestrate end-to-end GTM plans across operational readiness, marketing alignment, and launch execution. 
   Growth & Funnel Optimization 

- Optimize user funnels, transforming user research and A/B testing data into opportunities that improve conversion and maximize revenue. 

- Partner with marketing and content teams to build high-converting web experiences that strengthen SEO, GEO, and landing page performance. 
   YOUR QUALIFICATIONS 

- 5+ years of product management experience, with a proven track record of owning a product line end-to-end (ideally within fintech, personal finance, or a high-growth B2C marketplace). 

- Demonstrated success defining and evolving product strategy, rather than simply executing a pre-determined roadmap. 

- Expertise using web analytics, user testing, and A/B testing to drive conversion rate optimization and measure product performance. 

- Strong Agile/Scrum background with a talent for validating concepts through MVPs and lean testing before committing to a full technology build. 

- Fluency incorporating AI tools into the product workflow to accelerate market research, data synthesis, and rapid prototyping. 

- A passion for UX/design and the ability to translate customer and business needs into outstanding products. 

- Proven ability to influence executive leadership as well as cross-functional teams. 

- Skilled at bringing structure to ambiguous problems, turning vague, open-ended challenges into clear hypotheses, scoped bets, and a sequenced plan. 

- Highly organized and adaptable, able to manage multiple workstreams and re-prioritize as conditions change. 

- A genuine interest in the personal finance space and the problems Ratehub is solving for Canadians. 

 CULTURE FIT: 

- Members first - we prioritize the interests and needs of our members above all else. We solve member pain points and focus on member satisfaction. We start with members, and end with the P&L. 

- Growth mindset - we set ambitious goals and challenge the status quo. We take responsible risks and are accountable for our actions. 

- Better together - we are One team with One common goal. We make our footprint bigger than our foot, leave our egos at the door, support each other to achieve great results as One company.  

- Run after problems - we tackle problems head-on and focus on finding solutions. Obstacles are seen as opportunities for growth and innovation. We have the hard conversations and choose the harder right over the easier wrong. And we do it with a smile. 

- Measure, Learn, Iterate, Innovate - we focus on getting things done. We measure what matters, iterate, learn, iterate many times in a data-driven way, which is how we will innovate. 
   BENEFITS & PERKS 

- Competitive Compensation: A salary that reflects your experience and the Canadian market. 

- Remote-First Environment: The flexibility to work from anywhere in Canada, with occasional in-person team gatherings for collaboration. 

- Flexible Hours: Autonomy to manage your schedule to support work-life balance. 

- Comprehensive Benefits: Full health and dental coverage with no employee-paid premiums. 

- RRSP Matching: A company-matched RRSP program to support your long-term financial goals. 

- Professional Development: An individual training allowance to help you grow your skills and career. 

- Team Socials: Regular events, both remote and in-person, to build connections across the organization. 
   The estimated compensation range for this position, inclusive of a annual performance bonus is $125,000 - 175,000.
 This job posting is for a currently open vacancy.
 AI technology is used in the screening and assessment process of our recruitment.
