ashby:rewind:182ea3c9-5a23-44b4-a82d-14a.title: Product Marketing Manager
ashby:rewind:182ea3c9-5a23-44b4-a82d-14a.description:
Rewind is a service that protects the critical data that powers businesses of all sizes. Our focus is on backing up data that lives in the cloud - in apps like Jira, GitHub, Confluence and Shopify. We are backed by Insight Partners, Inovia, Bessemer and Atlassian Ventures and are proud to be recognized as one of Canada's 50 fastest growing technology companies (2023 Deloitte Fast 50 https://www.deloitte.com/ca/en/about/press-room/deloitte-canada-announces-its-annual-technology-fast-50tm-program-winners.html). We invite you to read our startup story https://rewind.io/blog/why-we-started-rewind-backups/ to learn where we came from and where we’re going.

Read about our mission, story and values here https://rewind.com/about-us/.
To find out more about our perks, click here https://rewind.com/careers/#:~:text=Working%20at%20Rewind%20has%20its%20perks.
Some of our Blogs might help you get a better understanding of what we do here. You can find them all here https://rewind.com/blog/.

Thriving at Rewind:

We embrace the fast-paced, ever-changing nature of startup life. If you love working with speed, agility, and creativity, you’ll feel right at home here. Here's what it takes to succeed with us:

 - Team-First Mentality: We put teamwork at the core of everything we do, believing that we are better when we are together. Success is shared, and when the team wins, we all win.

 - Performance-Driven Mindset: We are proactive, goal-oriented, and focused on delivering tangible, high-quality results. We go beyond meeting expectations - we aim to exceed them.

 - Flexible Work-Life Approach: We encourage balance and understand the need to recharge. While we stay agile for urgent needs, we make sure there's time to recover and enjoy life.

 - Customer Centricity: Our commitment to customers shapes everything we do. We listen, build relationships, and innovate - from our dedicated customer support team to our engineers, everyone at our company is focused on solving problems that matter most to our users.

 - Taking Initiative: We value ownership and proactive problem-solving. We encourage team members to think creatively, take ownership, and lead improvements. Your ideas and actions drive our success.

 - We Make Time for Fun: We work hard and make time to enjoy the journey. It’s not just about hitting milestones—it’s about making the experience rewarding along the way.

About the role

This role is the steel thread between our product strategy and the sales and marketing work that turns it into results. You'll build our go-to-market strategies and run product launches from plan to launch day, working closely with product managers, partners and sales.

We do most of our product marketing through AI skills and agents that we personally build for ourselves. Research, competitive analysis, launch plans, messaging drafts and sales enablement all start with tools like Claude Code, and you'll work that way too. If you already do, great. If you're strong on product marketing fundamentals and curious about AI, we can teach you the rest.

We're a small team, so you'll own your products end to end and make a lot of your own calls. Nobody expects that on day one. You'll work closely with the team while you ramp up, and you'll have support the whole way.

What you'll do

Launches and go-to-market

 - Plan launches for new products, features and releases, and run the cross-functional plan through to launch.

 - Develop marketing programs for your products with the marketing team, including the activities and budgets for keeping current customers and winning new ones.

 - Work with the demand generation and content team on programs that keep demand coming.

 - Measure how your programs perform, show what's working and what isn't, and report back on what needs to change.

Positioning and messaging

 - Work with product management and marketing communications to develop positioning, messaging and content for our target buyer personas.

 - Explain in plain terms how our products solve our buyers' problems, and back your thinking with market evidence.

 - Represent your products externally through speaking engagements and written work.

Buyer and competitive insight

 - Be the expert on our buyers, including who they are, how they buy and what criteria drive their decisions.

 - Know the competitive landscape: how each competitor positions itself today and where they're heading.

 - Map our buyer's journey, including where buyers get information and who makes which decisions, when and why. Use what you learn to change how we sell and market.

Sales and partner enablement

 - Support our sales channels. Train them on the problems we solve, build internal tools and external collateral, and show them how and when to use each piece.

 - Turn your positioning and messaging into material our marketing, partner and sales teams can put to work.

AI-powered product marketing

 - Use AI tools every day to research markets and competitors, draft and test messaging, and build launch and enablement assets.

 - Build and refine repeatable AI workflows (prompts, templates, agents) that the wider marketing and sales teams can reuse.

 - Other responsibilities aligned with the PMA’s definition of a PMM’s responsibilities.

What you'll bring

 - 4+ years of product marketing experience in B2B, including product launches, positioning and messaging.

 - Sales enablement experience, such as training sellers and building the battlecards and collateral they rely on.

 - Hands-on use of AI tools in your daily work, or a clear appetite to learn them fast. AI is a core part of how this role works every day. We weigh PMM fundamentals more heavily than AI expertise, because AI is easier to teach.

 - Experience working with product teams to define product strategy.

 - Comfort working with technical teams and translating technical products into buyer value. A technical background is a plus.

 - Strong quantitative analytical skills, and clear written and spoken communication in positioning, messaging and storytelling.

 - A customer-centric approach, with experience talking directly to customers.

 - Diplomacy with cross-functional partners, including knowing when to push back and when to dive in.

 - Comfort working independently on a small, entrepreneurial team that moves quickly.

 - Strong organization while managing multiple projects and priorities.

Nice to have

 - Experience building AI workflows or automations for a marketing or sales team.



Compensation Philosophy
The actual base salary will vary based on various factors, including market and individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process. 

In some cases, we’re open to hiring at a higher level for the right person and are committed to paying competitively and fairly.

If your experience is closer to an earlier career stage, we may still consider your application. In that case, we would evaluate the role at a different level within our levelling framework.

Pay is just one part of the overall compensation at Rewind.



Why join Rewind

At Rewind, you’ll help shape the future of data protection for thousands of businesses. We’re performance-driven, innovative, and not afraid to challenge what’s possible. You’ll join a team that values trust, accountability, and respect for people’s time — and encourages every employee to experiment, think critically, and grow.

We support innovation through experimentation — including smart use of AI tools — and believe the best ideas come from those who aren’t afraid to push boundaries.




How Rewind Will Support You
We know that enjoying the journey is just as important as reaching our goals. We work hard to create a positive, inclusive environment where fun and laughter are part of our everyday routine. We also offer a variety of benefits to support your success both at work and in your personal life which includes but is not limited to: 

 - Flexible work hours

 - Employee stock options

 - Health benefits

 - 3 weeks vacation

 - 7 life leave days

 - 2 Level Up days for professional development

 - 1 volunteer day

 - Summer Fridays and office closed during the holiday break in December

 - Paid parental leave

 - $2000/year wellness/home office allowance

 - $5000/year professional development allowance

Rewind is committed to building an inclusive, supportive place for you to do the best and most rewarding work of your career. We value how each new hire is an opportunity for us to bring in a different perspective, and we are always eager to further diversify our company. We strongly encourage candidates of all different backgrounds and identities to apply.



AI Usage

Our recruitment process may include the use of artificial intelligence–enabled tools to help manage and review applications efficiently. These tools assist our team, but hiring decisions are ultimately made by human reviewers.

successfactors:jobs.rogers.com:143676570.description:
Our Technology team wakes up every day with one goal in mind - connecting Canadians to the people and things that matter most. Together, we are proud to support 30 million Canadians each month through managing a robust portfolio that champions leading-edge technology. We drive large-scale, complex, and high-visibility technology projects and programs that shape the future of technology in Canada and expand connectivity from coast to coast. If you are interested in being a part of this, consider applying for the following opportunity:

 Who we're looking for: 

 We’re looking for a hands-on Senior Solution Architect to lead the design and deliver scalable, secure, and reusable data and AI solutions.

 This role sits within the Data & AI team and provides technical leadership across end-to-end data and AI architecture, from requirements and design through to implementation. You’ll work closely with business partners, architects, engineers, security, governance and platform teams to translate complex business needs into practical, production-ready solutions across data, integration, and analytics environments.

 What you'll do: 

 Lead Data Solution Design

- Lead the assessment of complex business and technical requirements and translate them into end-to-end data and AI solutions.

- Own solution architecture across data processing, storage, integration, consumption, security and AI enabled capabilities.

- Build High-Level Designs (HLDs) and contribute to Detailed Design Documents (DDD), ensuring consistency across the solution lifecycle.

- Evaluate solution alternatives and make architectural recommendations based on business requirements, technical constraints, cost, scalability, performance, and operational considerations. 

- Identify architectural risks, dependencies, assumptions, and design trade-offs early in the solution lifecycle.

 Define Data and AI Architecture Patterns

- Design conceptual, logical, and physical data architectures and models that promote performance, interoperability, and reuse.

- Define patterns for structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data, including batch, streaming, API, and event-driven integration and consumption.

- Develop reusable architecture patterns for GenAI, RAG, enterprise and vector search, document processing, semantic models, and AI agents.

- Design secure integration patterns across enterprise data platforms, AI/ML platforms, LLMs, APIs, applications, and analytics solutions.

- Incorporate identity, RBAC, least-privilege access, data classification, privacy, and governance requirements into solution designs.

 Provide Technical Leadership Through Delivery

- Provide architectural leadership to project teams throughout the delivery lifecycle, from initial discovery through implementation and production readiness.

- Work closely with engineering teams to ensure designs are delivered as designed

- Participate in design reviews and provide technical direction when implementation decisions require architectural guidance.

- Support the transition of AI solutions from proof of concept to governed production implementations.

 Collaborate Across Teams

- Act as a senior technical partner to business stakeholders, architects, engineers, data science, analytics, security, governance, and platform teams.

- Align solution designs with enterprise data and AI strategies, security standards, data quality requirements, and stewardship practices.

- Communicate architectural decisions, risks, trade-offs, and recommendations clearly to technical and business stakeholders.

- Partner with AI and Data Science teams to define data and architecture requirements for AI/ML and GenAI solutions.

 Assess and Improve Solutions

- Assess existing data architectures to identify improvement opportunities for modernization, simplification, consolidation, and improvement.

- Perform impact assessments using data lineage, object dependencies, and usage information.

- Identify technical debt and recommend practical remediation or modernization strategies.

- Evaluate emerging data and AI technologies through technical assessments and proofs of concept.

- Identify architectural risks associated with AI solutions, including data exposure, inappropriate data access, model dependency, and solution reliability.

- Stay current with evolving data platforms, AI architecture patterns, model capabilities, and responsible AI practices.

 What you bring: 

- We recognize strong candidates come from different paths. You might be a great fit if you have:

- University degree in computer science, information technology, data management or equivalent.

- Strong experience architecting solutions across multiple systems, platforms, or business domains. 

- Strong understanding of data architecture, data structures, modern data platforms, database management systems and ETL.

- Hands-on experience with SQL, programming, and traditional and big data.

- Strong cloud experience with platforms and technologies such as Azure, AWS, Databricks, Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric, ADF, Event Hubs, Storage, and Key Vault.

- Experience migrating data from on premises to cloud environments.

- Strong understanding of security, privacy, data governance, access control, and data protection principles.

- A practical, hands-on mindset with the ability to contribute to both design and implementation.

- Experience designing AI/ML or GenAI-enabled enterprise solutions and integrating them with modern data platforms. 

- Experience LLMs, RAG, embeddings, vector search, semantic search, prompt/orchestration patterns, and AI agents. 

- A commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, Belonging, and Accessibility, helping create an environment where everyone feels welcomed, valued, and supported. 

 Nice to have:

- Experience working with unstructured and semi-structured data.

- Experience leading architecture for large-scale transformation or migration programs.

- Cloud architecture certifications (e.g. AWS or Azure).

- Experience with streaming platforms such as Kafka.

- Experience in the telecommunications industry.

- Effective communication and stakeholder engagement skills.

- Experience supporting or mentoring peers on technical design and implementation.

- Experience with AI capabilities across platforms such as Azure AI, Databricks and Snowflake. 

How We Work

- We design practical, production-ready data solutions

- We expect senior architects to lead the design while staying close to the build.

- We balance strong design with delivery realities

- We collaborate across teams to move solutions forward

 A Note on Applying 

- We know many people may hesitate to apply unless they meet every requirement. If this role interests you and your experience aligns with some (not all) of what we’re looking for, we encourage you to appl y.

 What’s in it for you? 

 We believe in investing in our people and helping them reach their potential as valuable members of our team. As part of our team, you’ll have access to a wide range of incredible resources, growth opportunities, discounts, and perks, including:

- Competitive salary & annual bonus

- Competitive & flexible health and dental benefits, pension plan, RRSP, TFSA, and Stock matching programs.

- Discounts: Enjoy up to 50% off Rogers Services and Blue Jays Tickets, 25% off TSC items, and a 20% discount on all wireless accessories sold in Rogers stores.

- Paid time off for volunteering

- Company matching contributions to charities you support

- Growth & Development Opportunities:

- Self-driven career development programs
Rogers First: priority in applying to internal roles of interest

- Wellness Programs:

- Employee & Family Assistance Program
Virtual Healthcare
Cognitive Behavioural Therapy (CBT)
Low or no-cost fitness membership

- Our commitment to the environment and diversity:

- Work for an organization committed to environmental protection

- Strong commitment to diversity and inclusion with employee resource groups supporting equity-deserving groups including groups representing People of Colour, 2SLGBTQIA+, Indigenous Peoples, Persons with Disabilities and Women. We all bring something different, and we know what makes us different makes us great.

- An inclusive and diverse workplace where you can bring your whole self to work.

 Work Arrangement: Team members work from the office full-time to support collaboration, learning, and connection across the business.

Our company was built on the dream of a pioneering entrepreneur, and that spirit continues to empower our work with businesses across Canada today. The Rogers Business team helps organizations of all sizes adapt, scale, and win with network services and other innovative technology solutions that are reliable, secure, and scalable. We are looking for team members who have a passion for delivering industry-leading value to customers and businesses in the communities where we live and work, so come build a rewarding career at Rogers and be a driving force behind our success story!

-

 Working Conditions

gem:rootly:4020553007.description:
About Rootly
At 
Rootly
, we are on a mission to be the go-to way companies respond when things go wrong, helping every organization be more reliable. We do this by building an industry-leading incident management platform that allows companies around the world consistently and quickly resolve incidents. We are not simply transforming an industry, we are carving an entirely new +$B segment ourselves and need incredible talent to achieve this ambitious goal together.
Customers love Rootly. Some of the fastest growing companies around the world such as NVIDIA, Figma, Canva, Tripadvisor, Squarespace and more rely on Rootly to power their critical incident management process. They obsess over our delightful enterprise-ready platform and unique partnership model. See why our customers have reviewed us 
5 stars on G2
.
Investors love Rootly. We are backed by some of the most respected funds in the world from Y Combinator to operators like the CTO of Dropbox and GitHub. We'd be happy to disclose our entire funding and profitability picture live during the interview. As a culture we relentlessly put transparency first. We conduct monthly financial reviews as a team so everyone has a pulse on the health of the business and publish what we are building in our 
weekly changelog
.
About the Role
Join our Solutions Engineering team as a technical expert and trusted advocate, guiding our customers on their journey to success with Rootly.
As a Solutions Engineer you'll bring technical expertise to customer implementations and demos. You will develop best practices and content around Incident Management and On-Call, and collaborate across Engineering, Customer Success, Support, and Product teams to represent the customers’ voice and drive continuous product improvements.
This role requires hands-on work with the integration surface that matters to our customers, including REST APIs, webhooks, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), and cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure. You will drive technical conversations with engineering teams at customer organizations and operate as a technical partner internally to ensure that solution requirements are clearly represented.
If you’re a developer or technologist who loves discussing technology, working closely with customers across industries, and possesses a problem-solving, can-do mindset, we’d love to meet you as you’ll be joining a team that delivers real value through an industry-leading product.
What You'll Need
5+ years of experience as a Solutions Engineer, Sales Engineer, or Software Engineer with direct customer engagement.
Strong knowledge of REST APIs, webhooks, data mapping, and integration patterns.
Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code, ideally Terraform, and familiarity with at least one major cloud provider (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
Proficiency with scripting or programming languages such as JavaScript, Python, Ruby, or Go.
Experience designing and implementing enterprise integrations.
Proven ability to work cross-functionally and partner with Sales, Product, Engineering, Customer Success, and Support.
Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to engage engineering and executive audiences.
Ability to prioritize responsibilities while adapting to a rapidly changing environment.
Why Rootly?
We’re not just another startup. We’re building something category-defining and want teammates who crave ownership, love solving hard problems, and thrive in a high-bar, high-impact environment.
Here’s what you can expect when you join Rootly:
Competitive compensation and early equity in a fast-growing, venture-backed company.
Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage.
3 weeks of vacation, plus unlimited sick and mental health days, and a company-wide end-of-year shutdown to recharge.
$500 stipend for home office setup.
Unlimited token usage and access to AI tools
A fast-moving, high-impact environment where your leadership and ideas directly shape the future of the company.
If this sounds like the kind of challenge and opportunity you’re looking for, apply now and let’s build something great together.
Rootly is an equal opportunity employer. We aim to create an environment where every team member at Rootly feels like they belong so they can have a greater impact on our business and customers. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Partner with engineering as a true teammate, not a handoff across a fence, to scope, prioritize, and sequence delivery.

Help keep cross-functional projects on track across the company, and support smooth GTM motions by aligning product, sales, and customer-facing teams around a shared, well-sequenced plan.

3+ years of experience working in; engineering, solutions engineering, or technical product management, with experience speaking with customer engineering teams about architecture, APIs, and integrations.

Comfortable prototyping with AI tools to quickly test ideas and validate concepts before committing engineering resources.
Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with experience working alongside engineering, sales, and customer success teams.
Prior experience in B2B SaaS, ideally in infrastructure, DevOps, or platform tooling, given Rootly's space.
A self-driven approach, with the initiative to make sound decisions and move projects forward with minimal guidance.

workday:salesforce/External_Career_Site:.description:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts. 

 Job Category 
Customer Success 
 Job Details 

 About Salesforce 
 Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

 Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

 About the Role 
 The Solutions Architect, Salesforce Migrations is an individual contributor who leads complex customer migration engagements from kickoff through successful go-live. You serve as the primary technical and strategic point of contact for your migration pod — building trust with customers, coordinating with our Global Delivery Center (GDC) engineering partners, and ensuring every engagement drives real, measurable value as customers move to modern cloud architectures.

This role sits at the intersection of customer relationship management and hands-on technical execution. You'll act as a trusted advisor who bridges a customer's legacy environment with their future-state platform — accelerating timelines through automated playbooks and AI-assisted tooling, while serving as a direct feedback channel to Product and Engineering on what's working (and what isn't) in the field.

 Note: By applying to this Solutions Architect, Salesforce Migrations role your resume will be reviewed by recruiters and hiring managers across the organization. Multiple roles are available supporting various product areas, including Data360, Revenue Cloud, Tableau, and Marketing Cloud. Our goal is for you to apply once and be considered for the opportunity that best aligns with your background.

 What You'll Be Doing
 Customer Engagement & Value Delivery

- Lead end-to-end customer migration engagements — owning technical delivery, project health, and successful go-live outcomes.

- Partner with Account Teams and Sales leadership to align migration goals with customers' broader business strategy, renewal, and expansion objectives.

- Build strong relationships with both business and technical stakeholders, translating complex migration challenges into clear, actionable decisions.

- Develop and execute focused delivery plans that prioritize high-impact milestones and hold pod-level timelines to account.

- Facilitate enablement and alignment sessions to ensure customer teams are prepared and confident for platform transitions.

 Strategic Partnerships & Tooling

- Drive adoption of AI agents and automation toolkits to accelerate discovery, data mapping, and code conversion — reducing manual effort and compressing delivery timelines.

- Collaborate closely with GDC partners, delegating repeatable technical tasks while maintaining full accountability for output quality.

- Work in close alignment with Outbound Product Managers to stay current on product roadmaps and translate field insights into product improvements.

- Identify underutilized platform capabilities and incorporate them into migration roadmaps to increase customer throughput and adoption.

 Technical Expertise & Incident Response

- Serve as a subject matter expert in at least one key domain: Marketing Cloud (Engagement/Intelligence) , Data 360 (Data Cloud) , Revenue Cloud (CPQ/Billing) , or Tableau .

- Apply AI literacy and prompt engineering skills to guide AI agents in data retrieval, migration health reporting, and task automation.

- Act as the technical point of contact during major migration incidents — coordinating with Engineering and Product to protect the customer's operations during cutover phases.

- Monitor technical trends proactively and provide tailored release recommendations to optimize migrated environments for performance and stability.

 What We're Looking For
 Required Qualifications

- 8+ years of experience in Professional Services, Customer Success, or Technical Consulting, with a strong focus on large-scale platform migrations.

- Deep, hands-on domain expertise in one or more of the following: Marketing Cloud (Engagement/Intelligence), Data 360 (Data Cloud), Revenue Cloud (CPQ/Billing), or Tableau.

- Demonstrated ability to drive business value, facilitate technical discussions, and navigate complex stakeholder conversations.

- Ability to translate complex technical architectures into business-friendly language and guide customers through data transformations.

- Proven experience working with global or offshore delivery models (such as GDC) to accelerate project delivery.

- Advanced knowledge of Salesforce core (Sales/Service Cloud) or specialized clouds (Marketing, Data, Revenue, or Tableau).

- Familiarity with AI agents or automation tools applied to data mapping, sentiment analysis, or task automation.

- Understanding of how target cloud platforms integrate with telephony systems, third-party data sources, and self-service portals.

- Degree or equivalent relevant experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the core competencies for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)

 Preferred Qualifications

- Certifications in relevant domains (e.g., Marketing Cloud Consultant, CPQ Specialist, Data Cloud Consultant, Tableau Desktop Specialist).

- Prior experience as an individual contributor leading multi-million dollar transformation engagements.

- Salesforce AI Associate or Agentblazer certifications.

 What's in It for You
 You'll join a team that is shaping how Salesforce customers adopt the next generation of cloud technology — with access to cutting-edge AI tools, a collaborative global delivery model, and a direct line to the Product teams building the platforms you work with. This role offers real influence: your field experience will directly inform how migration tooling evolves, and your work will be visible across the business.

 Unleash Your Potential 
 When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and   be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can   do your best . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world. 

 Accommodations 
 If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form . 

 Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options. 

 Posting Statement 
 Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education. 

At Salesforce, we believe in equitable compensation practices that reflect the dynamic nature of labor markets across various regions. 

For British Columbia-based roles, the base salary hiring range for this position is CAD 92,600 to CAD 240,400. 

For Ontario-based roles, the base salary hiring range for this position is CAD 92,600 to CAD 142,600 annually. 

The range represents base salary only, and does not include company bonus, incentive for sales roles, equity or benefits, as applicable. 

This posting is to fill a vacancy on our team, unless otherwise noted.

 Job Category

 Job Details 

 About Salesforce 
 Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

 Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

 Job Description 
 The Solution Architect is able to lead a workstream in sophisticated enterprise customer engagements, partnering with key collaborators to drive and achieve the vision while completing key deliverables. The Sr. Solution Architect leads one or more workstreams in sophisticated enterprise customer engagements, partnering with key collaborators to drive and achieve the vision while completing key deliverables. They serve as hands-on advisors, using strong communication skills, solution and/or technical knowledge, Salesforce product knowledge, industry experience, consulting experience, and knowledge of their client’s business to deliver customer return on investment.

Solution Architects are strong presenters and facilitators that are able to co-create the vision and own the execution with the customer as well as acquire customer acceptance of the delivered solution. They are capable of driving difficult conversations and removing roadblocks to implement the business strategies. They are proficient at analyzing issues and obstacles to resolve root cause, and can identify appropriate corrective action. They connect with technical and business customers from all levels through C-suite. On a day to day basis, they interact with customer product owner, business process owner and technical resources to understand requirements, analyze information, and craft comprehensive solutions. They also show a strong understanding of typical business challenges or common objectives faced by customers within the industry.

Solution Architects are stewards of the Professional Services Methodology. They engage with Customer Success and Product teams to ensure the solutions are driving the most effective achievement of the value objectives. Solution Architects supply to thought leadership and standard methodologies by engaging with the cloud-specific practices teams. They will chip in both internally in their Community and externally in the marketplace.

 YOUR IMPACT: Responsibilities 

 Salesforce Professional Services is looking for a Sr. Solution Architect with Regulated Industries Experience (Financial Services, Health Care, Life Sciences/Pharma). As a Solution Architect, you will be serving as a strategic advisor and Salesforce product and platform expert to the company’s largest, most complex enterprise customers. Here are some salient responsibilities the role entails -

- Serve as a trusted advisor to the client

- Guide customers and colleagues in rationalizing and deploying emerging technologies that drive increased business value

- Guiding agents to support delivery

- Work collaboratively and having very strong communications skills, especially in teaching complex concepts, and creative, prescriptive thinking across various levels of a client organization

- Identify and proactively manage risk areas and commit to seeing an issue through to complete resolution

- Manage customer expectations; negotiate solutions to complex problems with both the customer and third-party partners

- Review and correct project/program direction, approach, and key artifacts to keep programs on track and solutions extendable and maintainable going forward

- Drive a program vision while advising and articulating program/project strategies to enable technologies including the Salesforce platform

 MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS 

 This posting is inclusive of multiple levels:

- For Solution Architect: 7+ years of relevant experience in enterprise-level projects using both waterfall and agile software development methodologies throughout the whole life cycle with repeated and demonstrable success, and 1+ years experience in Regulated Industries.

- For Sr. Solution Architect: 10+ years of relevant experience in enterprise-level projects using both waterfall and agile software development methodologies throughout the whole life cycle with repeated and demonstrable success, and 3+ years experience in Regulated Industries.

- For Director, Solution Architect: 14+ years of relevant experience in enterprise-level projects using both waterfall and agile software development methodologies throughout the whole life cycle with repeated and demonstrable success, and 5+ years experience in Regulated Industries.

 Technical and Core Qualifications (Both Levels): 

- Extensive experience with configuration and customization on the Salesforce platform 

- Ability to drive agentic delivery, with experience in AI toolchains (eg. Claude, Cursor, Elements Cloud, etc.)

- Expert level experience defining the system architecture landscape, identifying gaps between current and desired end-states, and delivering a comprehensive solution that will enable achievement of the desired business outcomes

- Experience leading discovery sessions, defining business requirements, writing user stories and providing detailed system and functional designs

- Experience in documenting business processes and wire-framing system designs using process flow diagram tools, UML, sequence diagrams, etc. as well as making recommendations for future state improved processes and system designs

- Strong presentation skills; able to effectively present a point of view and clearly articulate the rationale to a variety of stakeholders

- Detail-oriented individual with the ability to rapidly learn and take advantage of new concepts, business models, and technologies

- Strong communication skills, both written and verbal; able to effectively develop materials that are appropriate for the audience

- Must be a team player as demonstrated through a customer qualification of a large scale/enterprise implementation with multiple work streams

- A great listener with the ability to communicate with people in diverse roles

- Resourceful and innovative thinker who can work through and solve problems

- Travel up to 50%

 PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS 

- Bachelor’s degree (or its foreign degree equivalent) in a Technology, Engineering (any field) or a related quantitative discipline. Equivalent demonstrable work experience in lieu of a degree will be considered

- Proven results in delivering high value business outcomes utilizing an agile approach

- Proven results leading customer and/or partner success stories

- Relevant Salesforce certifications & Accreditations

- Consulting experience is strongly recommended

- Veeva experience is strongly recommended (Life Sciences / Pharma) or Financial Service Cloud

 Unleash Your Potential 
 When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and   be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can   do your best . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world. 

 Accommodations 
 If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form . 

 Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options. 

 Posting Statement 
 Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education. 

At Salesforce, we believe in equitable compensation practices that reflect the dynamic nature of labor markets across various regions. 

For Ontario-based roles, the base salary hiring range for this position is CAD 115,200 to CAD 165,200 annually. 

The range represents base salary only, and does not include company bonus, incentive for sales roles, equity or benefits, as applicable. 

This posting is to fill a vacancy on our team, unless otherwise noted.

 Role and Responsibilities 

 PRODUCT MANAGEMENT (Wearable & Accessories) - 80%

In addition provide clarity as to the business rationale, and product strategies to support business growth.

- Build relationships with US counterparts to learn and share best practices.

Utilize profit simulation models (including impact from a trade spend/sales deductions and COG) to evaluate specific customer opportunities and provide rationale for proposed decisions to reporting manager. 

- Manages all partner programs (front and back-end), price setups, promo submissions, marketing and merchandising initiatives, etc., that require approvals.

- Forecasting of market size, segments and share to ensure divisional strategic KPI objectives are met.

- Presents monthly promotional plans and gets signoff for from reporting manager. 

- Align with reporting manager on all pricing related matters throughout product lifecycle management.

- Review channel and market feedback from and factor into product category strategy

- Holds accountability on PM forecast and works with SCM on AP2 planning to achieve objectives on financial plans, weekly sales target, weekly PSI and clear aging inventory.

- Complete various category and ad-hoc reporting and special projects within set deadlines.

- Presents during internal GTM meeting and works with all stakeholders on product launch strategy.

- Prepares and presents during external partner meetings on category presentation that includes market analysis, category business strategy, roadmap, promotional plans, merchandising, etc., and any partner specific objectives.

- Executes sample management process and tracking inbound/outbound samples.

- Works with technical PMs, HQ, R&D and partners on all items relating to product testing and certification on new product launches factoring schedules and deadlines. Communicates to all parties involved on progress throughout the cycle.

 MARKET INTELLIGENCE - 20% 

- Deliver bottom-up and top-down modelling to fulfill Samsung’s strategy by delivering key insights on consumer sales trend

- Develop an un-biased scenario models to forecast likely outcomes for the quarter, year

- Collecting and analyzing supply data based on Global Supply Chain Management (GSCM), and EDI / POS system such as product sell out, Key model performance, YoY growth etc.

- Analyze Sell Out inputs from the various SCM analysts, and advise on possible efficiencies, and change

 ·        The ability to develop tasks, work assignments, to clearly define objectives and give technical sales and marketing guidance on a day-to-day level
 ·        Ability to assist in long and mid-term business planning
 ·        Ability to manage budgets and determine ROI
 ·        Must have a proven track record on results
 ·        Ability to work in a fast paced environment is a must

 Experience:

 ·        A minimum of three years of experience ideally in the Mobile industry preferred
 ·        5+ years related experience preferred (Market Intelligence, Executive presentation materials, and Planning
 ·        5+ years of hands on experience in data modelling, scenario planning
 ·        Mobile Handsets, Tablets, Wearable or IOT background is an asset

successfactors:jobs.scotiabank.com:60699.description:
Requisition ID: 276249 

Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high-performing culture. 

 The Product Owner, Integration Solutions contributes to the overall success of the Integration Solutions team by ensuring business strategies, plans and initiatives are executed and delivered in compliance with governing regulations, internal policies and procedures. This role is responsible for delivering business value, managing the product vision and backlog priorities, and partnering with stakeholders, business subject matter experts and agile teams to deliver high-quality automation and integration solutions that improve how the Bank serves its customers. 

 Is this role right for you? In this role, you will: 

- Support the Director, Automation Solutions, in managing Integration Solutions program relationships, including program intake, process assessment, change management and benefits tracking. 

- Lead intake and diagnostic activities for potential initiatives across the enterprise, including workshops, assessments, data collection and analysis to evaluate and prioritize opportunities. 

- Define and communicate the product vision, objectives, value proposition, key risks and roadmap in collaboration with stakeholders, business SMEs and agile delivery teams. 

- Own and continuously prioritize the product backlog, ensuring features, epics and user stories are aligned with business value, customer impact and product vision. 

- Lead the development of user stories, acceptance criteria and supporting documentation, while breaking down larger objectives into actionable features and deliverables. 

- Participate in agile ceremonies, including planning sessions, stand-ups, retrospectives and iteration reviews, to ensure delivery remains aligned with agreed commitments and business value. 

- Act as the conduit between business partners and delivery teams, helping protect the team from interruptions while ensuring stakeholder needs are understood and addressed. 

- Review team outputs at the end of each iteration and before release to ensure deliverables meet expectations, quality standards and business requirements. 

- Contribute to organizational agile capability by sharing best practices, coaching stakeholders and partnering with Agile Coaches and agile teams. 

 Do you have the skills that will enable you to succeed in this role? We’d love to work with you if you have: 

- Bachelor’s degree in business, finance, economics, computer science or related discipline. 

- 5 to 8 years of progressive experience in product development, project delivery or a related business or technology environment. 

- A Certified Product Owner designation and/or practical experience working with scrum teams. 

- Strong understanding of agile practices, iterative software development methodologies and product backlog management. 

- Demonstrated ability to manage stakeholder relationships, balance competing priorities and build consensus across diverse business groups. 

- Experience facilitating workshops, gathering requirements, analyzing processes and translating business needs into user stories and delivery priorities. 

- Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to engage stakeholders at various levels, including executives and delivery teams. 

- Working knowledge of Robotics Process Automation, Robotic Desktop Automation and/or Pega BPM in financial services would be considered an asset. 

- Fluency in Spanish would be considered an asset. 

- A master’s degree or MBA would be considered an asset. 

 What’s in it for you? 

- A rewarding career path with diverse opportunities for professional development. 

- An organization committed to making a difference in our communities — for you and our customers. 

- A competitive rewards program that includes an annual bonus, flexible vacation, personal and sick days, and comprehensive benefits that start on your first day.

Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high-performing culture. 

 Role 

 The Senior Solutions Architect will work with the Group Treasury business and technology partners to define and evolve the architecture supporting Treasury systems.

- This role ensures that Treasury platforms are designed to meet evolving business and regulatory requirements while achieving high standards of reliability, scalability, security, and availability. This role is a high-impact role responsible for managing a set of tasks and techniques working as a liaison among various stakeholders.

- Provides expert advice and counsel to impact Corporate Functions IT areas will have on complex issues related to area of specialty, the position may have multiple concurrent initiatives occurring at any one time.

- The incumbent must ensure high availability, integrity and reliability of solutions developed. We are looking for a forward-thinking individual who embraces change, is passionate, flexible, curious, continuous learners and who wants to achieve challenging goals

 Is this role right for you? In this role you will: 

- Scalable Architecture: Design and guide implementation of scalable, secure, and high-performance solutions tailored to Group Treasury

- Business Alignment: Collaborate closely with business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into robust, future-proof technical solutions.

- Architectural Leadership: Lead cross-functional architectural discussions, driving strategic decisions and solutions across multiple teams and initiatives.

- Technical Mentorship: Provide hands-on guidance and mentorship to engineering teams, fostering growth and ensuring technical excellence.

- Standards Compliance: Ensure all solutions adhere to enterprise architecture principles, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices.

- Modular Modernization: Spearhead modernization efforts including cloud-native adoption, microservices architecture, and modular API-first design. Drive loosely coupled components to enable flexibility, scalability, and vendor independence.

- Platform Enablement: Build foundational capabilities that empower product, data, and AI teams to innovate securely and efficiently.

- Data Engineering: Design and optimize real-time and batch data pipelines for analytics, reporting, and AI model consumption.

- Operational Excellence: Support production systems with a focus on reliability, scalability, and continuous service improvement.

- Stakeholder Communication: Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, facilitating consensus and alignment.

- Continuously Improve: Aid in the continuous improvement of business and technical processes through prior experiences and best practice adoption

 Do you have the skills that will enable you to succeed in this role? We’d love to work with you if you have: 

- 10+ years of software engineering experience.

- Bachelor (equivalent or higher) degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related discipline.

- 5+ Experience working in the Banking and Financial Services domain

- Understanding of Group Treasury Domain and Data:

- Liquidity

- Asset and Liability Management

- Data Management (Client, Positions, Transactions etc.)

- Experience with structured Architecture practices, hybrid cloud deployments, and on-premises to-cloud migration deployments and roadmaps.

- Experience building, architecting, designing, and implementing highly distributed global based systems. Experience in network infrastructure, security, data, or application development.

- Experience in modernizing legacy systems or similar transformational initiatives

- Excellent interpersonal, communication, and influencing skills with the ability to build and foster relationships with business partners, project stakeholders, strategic technology partners and external vendors.

- Ability to collaborate across organizational boundaries, build relationships, and achieve broader organizational goals.

We embrace diversity and provide opportunities for all employee to learn, grow & participate through our various Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) that span across diverse gender identities, ethnicity, race, age, ability & veterans

Scotiabank continues to locate, remove, and prevent barriers so that we can build a diverse and inclusive environment while meeting accessibility requirements

successfactors:jobs.scotiabank.com:60644.description:
Requisition ID: 274773 

Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high-performing culture. 

 The Team 

 Global Wealth Banking and Markets Engineering (GWBMT) is the fast-moving, award-winning technology engine that powers Scotiabank's Wealth and Capital Markets businesses. 

 The Platform Engineering organization provides the foundational technology platforms and cloud services that enable application teams to innovate rapidly, securely, and at scale. Our portfolio includes enterprise Kubernetes platforms spanning on-premises and Google Cloud environments, Cloud Enablement Services, Kafka as a Service, Airflow as a Service, Fine-Grained Access Management capabilities, and future developer platform offerings that accelerate application modernization and cloud adoption. 

 The Role 

 We are seeking a Director Platform Product Owner to lead the product strategy, roadmap, adoption, and delivery of a portfolio of enterprise platform products that serve hundreds of engineers and mission-critical applications across the bank. 

 This role sits at the intersection of technology, product management, engineering, and business strategy. The successful candidate will be responsible for defining and evolving platform products that enable cloud adoption, application modernization, developer productivity, security, and operational excellence. 

 As a senior product leader, you will partner closely with Platform Engineering, Architecture, Security, Infrastructure, and application development teams to ensure our platforms deliver measurable business value, exceptional user experiences, and scalable solutions that meet the needs of a rapidly evolving enterprise landscape. 

 You will act as the voice of the engineering customer while balancing engineering priorities, platform sustainability, risk management, and strategic technology objectives. 

 Is this role right for you? In this role you will: 

 1. Product Strategy & Portfolio Leadership 

- Define and execute the strategic vision, roadmap, and lifecycle management of a portfolio of platform engineering products and services. 

- Develop product strategies that accelerate cloud adoption, platform standardization, application modernization, and engineering productivity. 

- Identify emerging customer needs and market trends to drive innovation and platform evolution. 

- Establish product success metrics, adoption goals, customer satisfaction targets, and business outcomes. 

- Prioritize investments and roadmap initiatives based on business value, engineering impact, risk reduction, and operational efficiency. 

 Product Portfolio Includes: 

- Enterprise Kubernetes Platforms (On-Prem and Google Cloud) 

- Cloud Enablement and Migration Services 

- Airflow as a Service 

- Kafka as a Service 

- Fine-Grained Access Management Platforms 

- Developer Platform Capabilities and Self-Service Engineering Solutions 

 2. Customer Engagement & Platform Adoption 

- Act as the primary advocate for platform consumers across GBM and enterprise engineering teams. 

- Build deep understanding of customer journeys, pain points, and platform adoption barriers. 

- Drive platform onboarding strategies and self-service experiences that improve developer productivity. 

- Partner with application teams to identify modernization opportunities and accelerate cloud migration initiatives. 

- Lead customer advisory forums, feedback programs, and adoption reviews to continually improve platform offerings. 

- Establish product analytics frameworks and measurable indicators to track platform utilization, customer outcomes, productivity gains, and business value realization. 

 3. Technical Product Ownership 

- Translate strategic objectives into clear product roadmaps, capabilities, requirements, and delivery plans. 

- Collaborate with architects and engineering teams to define platform capabilities, service offerings, APIs, and user experiences. 

- Ensure platform products align with enterprise architecture standards, security requirements, and regulatory obligations. 

- Define service offerings, operating models, support models, and service-level objectives (SLOs) for platform products. 

- Champion platform engineering principles, self-service capabilities, automation, and developer experience improvements. 

- Establish service consumption metrics, cost transparency models, showback/chargeback capabilities, and platform ROI measures. 

 4. Delivery Leadership & Execution 

- Lead the planning and execution of platform product initiatives from ideation through delivery and adoption. 

- Partner with engineering leaders to balance feature development, platform reliability, technical debt reduction, and operational excellence. 

- Drive agile product delivery practices, roadmap governance, backlog prioritization, and release planning. 

- Track delivery performance and ensure successful execution of strategic initiatives across multiple platform teams. 

- Manage dependencies, risks, and stakeholder expectations across a complex enterprise environment. 

 5. Platform Reliability, Security & Operational Excellence 

- Define and monitor key platform performance indicators, including availability, reliability, scalability, security, adoption, and customer satisfaction. 

- Partner with Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Security, and Operations teams to improve platform resiliency and operational maturity. 

- Ensure security controls, access governance, and compliance requirements are embedded within platform services. 

- Drive continual improvement initiatives focused on automation, observability, service health, and cost optimization. 

- Balance innovation with operational stability and risk management. 

- Own the end-to-end platform user experience across onboarding, self-service workflows, documentation, observability, support engagement, and lifecycle management. 

 6. Stakeholder Management & Executive Communication 

- Build strong relationships with senior technology leaders, architects, engineering teams, security stakeholders, and business partners. 

- Present product strategy, investment priorities, roadmap progress, and platform value realization to executive leadership. 

- Influence strategic technology decisions across cloud, platform engineering, developer experience, and modernization initiatives. 

- Communicate complex technical concepts effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences. 

 Do you have the skills that will enable you to succeed in this role? We’d love to work with you if you have: 

- 10+ years of technology experience with at least 5 years in Product Management, Platform Engineering, Cloud Engineering, Developer Platforms, or Infrastructure Services. 

- Proven experience leading the strategy, roadmap, and delivery of large-scale platform products. 

- Experience working with cloud platforms, enterprise infrastructure, and application modernization initiatives. 

- Strong understanding of platform engineering, developer experience, self-service platforms, and product operating models. 

- Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive alignment across multiple organizations. 

- Experience leading cross-functional teams in complex enterprise environments. 

- Outstanding communication, stakeholder management, and executive presentation skills. 

- Strong strategic thinking, prioritization, and data-driven decision-making capabilities. 

 Technical Expertise 

- Strong understanding of Kubernetes and container platforms operating across hybrid-cloud environments. 

- Experience with public cloud platforms, preferably Google Cloud Platform (GCP). 

- Familiarity with event-driven architectures, Kafka, streaming platforms, and modern data infrastructure. 

- Understanding of workflow orchestration and data engineering platforms such as Apache Airflow. 

- Knowledge of Identity and Access Management, Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), Fine-Grained Authorization, and Zero Trust security principles. 

- Experience with CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, platform automation, observability, and reliability engineering practices. 

- Understanding of platform security, risk management, compliance, and operational resilience requirements. 

 Preferred 

- Experience building or managing Internal Developer Platforms (IDPs) and self-service engineering ecosystems. 

- Background in Platform Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering, DevOps, Cloud Architecture, or Software Engineering. 

- Experience driving enterprise cloud transformation and migration programs. 

- Experience within financial services, capital markets, or other highly regulated industries. 

- Knowledge of Google Cloud technologies including GKE, networking, observability, and security services. 

 Success Measures 

 Success in this role will be measured by: 

- Platform adoption and customer satisfaction 

- Growth of cloud-enabled and modernized applications 

- Developer productivity improvements and self-service adoption 

- Reliability, availability, and operational performance of platform services 

- Reduction in onboarding friction and time-to-market 

- Delivery of strategic roadmap commitments 

- Platform cost optimization and operational efficiency 

- Achievement of security, compliance, and risk management objectives 

 What's in it for you? 

- Diversity, Equity, Inclusion & Allyship - We strive to create an inclusive culture where every employee is empowered to reach their fullest potential, respected for who they are, and are embraced through bias-free practices and inclusive values across Scotiabank. We embrace diversity and provide opportunities for all employee to learn, grow & participate through our various Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) that span across diverse gender identities, ethnicity, race, age, ability & veterans. 

- Accessibility and Workplace Accommodations - We value the unique skills and experiences each individual brings to the Bank and are committed to creating and maintaining an inclusive and accessible environment for everyone. Scotiabank continues to locate, remove, and prevent barriers so that we can build a diverse and inclusive environment while meeting accessibility requirements. 

- Upskilling through online courses, cross-functional development opportunities, and tuition assistance. 

- Competitive Rewards program including bonus, flexible vacation, personal, sick days, and benefits will start on day one. 

- Community Engagement - no matter where you choose to work from; we offer opportunities for community engagement & belonging with our various programs. 

 Location(s):  Canada : Ontario : Toronto 

 Scotiabank is a leading bank in the Americas. Guided by our purpose: "for every future", we help our customers, their families and their communities achieve success through a broad range of advice, products and services, including personal and commercial banking, wealth management and private banking, corporate and investment banking, and capital markets.

Requisition ID: 274856 

Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high-performing culture. 

 Senior Product Manager, Commercial Lending Decisioning & Insights - Canadian and International Commercial Banking  

 Purpose 

 The Sr. Product Mgr, Commercial Lending Decisioning & Insights plays a pivotal role executing the strategic vision, scope, and design of lending decisioning for data model platforms for Canadian Commercial Banking (CCB) and International Commercial Banking (ICB).  This position is central to collaborating within a governance framework with Risk and Business teams, coordinating model development and standardization across regions, and ensuring the successful delivery of data-driven use cases that enhance operational efficiency and risk management. The Sr. Manager will support stakeholder and vendor relationships and provide expert analysis and reporting that informs executive decision-making and supports the calculation of financial benefits. 

 Accountabilities: 

- Design and Analytical Thinking: Communicate and drive the overall vision, scope, and design of data model platforms to ensure alignment with business objectives and user needs.    Obtain sign-off from business unit stakeholders and coordinate the strategic roadmap for data-driven initiatives 

- Governance Framework: Support and work within the governance structure, collaborating closely with Risk and Business teams for successful implementation of data-driven decision models globally 

- Model Development and Standardization: Coordinate across International and Canadian Commercial Banking business and data teams to align and deliver the end-to-end lifecycle of model development, standardization, and deployment across regions. Ensure that data elements, processes, and model upgrades are harmonized and scalable 

- Delivery of Use Cases and Business Expertise: Support the identification, prioritization, and execution of high-impact use cases. Provide business expertise and feedback to delivery teams, ensuring solutions are actionable, measurable, and add value to clients and stakeholders.  Monitor industry trends and translate insights into actionable solutions 

- Backlog Management: Maintain and prioritize a dedicated backlog with partners across Commercial, Data & Analytics and Engineering partners to ensure user experience across client segments that is logical, engaging, and accessible.  Engage day to day with the scrum teams, clarifying questions and helping with decision making 

- Implement robust project management methodologies and processes to identify, assess, and mitigate project risks, ensuring successful project delivery. Escalate critical issues and drive decision-making and accountability by supporting cross-functional executive and senior management forums to align opportunities, challenges and required actions.   Report on the progress of (and escalating issues with) recommendations and solutions to consider 

- Stakeholder and Vendor Management: Build and maintain productive relationships with internal and external stakeholders, including business line leaders, risk partners, analytics teams, and technology vendors 

- Financial Benefit Support: Collaborate with finance and analytics teams to support process owners in the calculation and validation of financial benefits arising from data-driven initiatives 

- Understands how the Bank’s risk appetite and risk culture should be considered in day-to-day activities and decisions 

- Actively pursues effective and efficient operations of his/her/their respective areas in accordance with Scotiabank’s Values, its Code of Conduct and the Global Sales Principles, while ensuring the adequacy, adherence to and effectiveness of day-to-day business controls to meet obligations with respect to operational, compliance, AML/ATF/sanctions and conduct risk 

- Champions a high-performance environment and contributes to an inclusive work environment   

 Dimensions: 

- Position is both strategy-focused and execution-oriented 

- The incumbent will be involved with cross-functional project/implementation teams and use negotiation/influencing skills to ensure progress and delivery on a timely basis. 

- The incumbent is expected to independently manage his/her/their own time and resolve or escalate any issues promptly. Measurement criteria include achievement of key metrics, project delivery and budgets as determined 

- The environment is fast paced, demanding and will at times require priorities to be re-adjusted to accommodate urgent requests. This requires an individual who possess a high level of flexibility and adaptability. 

 Education: 

- Business, Engineering, Computer Science degree with related experience in product management and/or product ownership 

- MBA preferred, but not required 

 Skills/Work Experience: 

- Minimum 5 years’ experience in product management owning and delivering digital products/journey end to end, from inception to delivery 

- Strong understanding of the Commercial Banking business lines including credit policies and processes, servicing models and products 

- Full professional proficiency in both English and Spanish is required 

- Strong knowledge on a wide range of current market delivery segments and emerging technologies 

- Strong written and verbal communication skills in English & Spanish with proven ability to influence stakeholders 

- Previous work experience/success in product development/management, business analysis or in a related field 

- Excellent project delivery skills, with proven accomplishments leading cross-functional projects 

- Strong problem solver with ability to lead the team to push to solution and progress 

- Excellent organizational and analytical skills with strong attention to detail 

- Curious and experimental mindset to drive innovation amidst uncertainty 

- Ability to build trusted relationships, instill confidence and influence stakeholders 

- Skilled at identifying and solving ambiguous problems to drive customer and business value 

- Knowledgeable about multiple functional areas such as Product Management, Agile/Scrum, Engineering, UX/UI Design 

- Engineering, Computer Science or Business degrees considered an asset 

 Language Requirement:  

- Full professional proficiency in both English and Spanish is required. The successful candidate must be able to communicate effectively, both verbally and in writing, with clients, business partners, and stakeholders across multiple regions. 

 Working Conditions: 

- Work in a standard office based environment

successfactors:jobs.scotiabank.com:60641.description:
Requisition ID : 274631 

 At Tangerine, we’re redefining banking. As Canada’s leading digital bank, we thrive on innovation, agility, and bold thinking, tackling every challenge head-on with leading technology and the unstoppable power of collaboration.  

 Our client-obsessed teams deliver flexible, accessible banking solutions, breakthrough products, and award-winning service. Beyond banking, we’re committed to making an impact in the communities we serve and across our organization. We foster a culture built on integrity, inclusion, and fearless ambition – where diverse perspectives are valued, and people are empowered to do their best work.  

 Are you ready to disrupt the status quo? Do you crave challenges that push boundaries? If you’re a high performer looking to accelerate your career and reimagine the banking landscape, this is your moment.  

 Let’s shape the future of banking together!  

 Purpose 

 The Senior Security Solutions Architect plays a key role in helping Tangerine design and deliver secure technology solutions. This role provides security architecture guidance across cloud, application, data, identity, and infrastructure initiatives, working closely with technology, delivery, architecture, and security partners. The successful candidate will help ensure security requirements are considered early in the design process, aligned to enterprise standards, and implemented in a practical way that supports business delivery while reducing risk. 

 Is this role right for you? In this role, you will: 

- Provide security architecture advice for cloud, application, SaaS, API, data, identity, and infrastructure initiatives across Tangerine. 

- Review solution designs and technical proposals to identify security risks, control gaps, and practical remediation options. 

- Translate enterprise security standards and control requirements into clear design guidance for delivery and engineering teams. 

- Support secure-by-design practices by helping teams consider security requirements early in the project lifecycle. 

- Partner with technology, architecture, security, risk, and delivery teams to resolve security design issues and support timely delivery. 

- Document security design decisions, control rationale, and risk considerations to support governance, audit, and compliance needs. 

- Contribute to reusable security architecture patterns, checklists, and guidance that improve consistency and delivery efficiency. 

- Actively pursues effective and efficient operations of their respective areas in accordance with Scotiabank’s Values, its Code of Conduct and the Global Sales Principles, while ensuring the adequacy, adherence to and effectiveness of day-to-day business controls to meet obligations with respect to operational, compliance, AML/ATF/sanctions and conduct risk. 

- Champions a high-performance environment and contributes to an inclusive work environment. 

 Do you have the skills that will enable you to succeed in this role? We'd love to work with you if you have: 

- 15+ years of experience in cybersecurity, security architecture, cloud security, solution architecture, or a related technology risk role. 

- Experience reviewing technology designs and providing practical security architecture recommendations. 

- Strong knowledge of security controls across cloud, application, API, SaaS, identity and access management, data protection, network security, logging, monitoring, and vulnerability management. 

- Experience working with public cloud platforms and modern delivery practices such as DevSecOps, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code, containers, and cloud-native architectures. 

- Familiarity with security frameworks, standards, and leading practices such as NIST, CIS, CSA, or equivalent enterprise security standards. 

- Ability to assess risk, identify security gaps, document recommendations, and influence outcomes with cross-functional teams. 

- Strong communication, facilitation, analytical, and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to explain security concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences. 

- Bachelor’s degree in computer science, cybersecurity, information technology, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 

- Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, CISM, CISA, CRISC, AWS, Azure, or GCP security certifications are considered an asset. 

 What's in it for you? 

- You will be part of a diverse and inclusive team of Client-focused go-getters looking to learn from each other in an environment that celebrates and recognizes success! 

- You will have access to thousands of online and in person courses so you can shape your career growth with the support from diverse industry leaders. 

- You will get our help to save for your future and to invest in your total wellbeing through our Tangerine benefits*. 

- You belong here, we are equal and un-complicated. Bring your true self to work, dress codes don’t apply here. 

- You will enjoy workspace flexibility and all the excitement that comes from working at the official Bank of the Toronto Raptors. 

 *Tangerine employees participate in Scotiabank’s pension & benefits programs (available to permanent employees) 
 Location(s):  Canada : Ontario : Toronto 

 At Tangerine we value the unique skills and experiences each individual brings to the team, and are committed to creating and maintaining an inclusive and accessible environment. If you require accommodation during the recruitment and selection process, please let our Recruitment team know.
