successfactors:jobs.scotiabank.com:60639.title: Senior Director, IAM Product, Architecture, and Governance
successfactors:jobs.scotiabank.com:60639.description:
Requisition ID: 274541 

Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high-performing culture. 

 The Senior Director IAM Product, Architecture and Governance will lead both the Product Management, Architecture, and Application Governance functions for the Scotiabank’s global IAM services, supporting both external customers and enterprise workforce platforms, working to accelerate new product enhancements in alignment with business partners, fraud, and technology teams. 

 The incumbent will provide overall strategic product roadmaps, architectural design of IAM platforms, and ongoing governance models for supported applications which leverage IAM services, ensuring compliance with Scotiabank’s Technology Policy and Standards, global regulations, and industry standard security practices. 

 Is this role right for you? In this role, you will: 

 Oversee Product Management for IAM Services and Platforms 

- Establish and lead Product Management for Customer IAM and Workforce IAM, defining intake, prioritization, requirements, and architectural alignment, while managing a team of Product Managers responsible for backlogs, features, and enhancements across customer and enterprise IAM domains. 

- Own the IAM product strategy and roadmap for enterprise and consumer platforms, partnering with business channels, fraud technology, Engineering, and key stakeholders to align critical capabilities, oversee execution (including vendor selection, MVP definition, rollout planning), and adapt priorities as conditions change. 

- Drive outcomes, funding, and continuous improvement, developing business cases and funding models in partnership with Technology, PMO, and Finance, establishing stakeholder feedback loops and KPIs for adoption, and maintaining strong awareness of industry trends, emerging IAM capabilities, and fraud protection advancements. 

 Responsible for Enterprise Grade IAM Services and Platforms 

- Lead and govern IAM architecture delivery, overseeing a team of domain architects responsible for designing scalable, resilient solutions that meet business requirements, adhere to security by design principles, and align with Enterprise Architecture standards and technology direction. 

- Drive cross bank architectural collaboration, partnering with Product Management, Engineering, security architecture, fraud, compliance, and business channel teams to design new platforms and features, align on integration patterns, and deliver secure, end to end IAM solutions. 

- Own architectural assessment and IAM technical leadership, defining the intake and assessment process for new features and enhancements (including cost and timeline estimates), guiding engineering execution, and representing IAM as the technology SME on enterprise wide transformation initiatives. 

 IAM Application Governance 

- Establish and lead the IAM Governance and Control function, ensuring global application compliance with Scotiabank Technology Policies and Standards, regional regulatory requirements, and external audit expectations across customer and workforce platforms. 

- Define and operate sustainable governance processes and tooling, including application inventory, compliance tracking, and control effectiveness measurement, with clear KPIs that track adoption and maturity of IAM key controls enterprise wide. 

- Provide strategic IAM governance leadership and SME support, partnering with Product, Architecture, regional CISOs, and all lines of defense to align KPIs and methodologies, guide remediation of control gaps, and evolve governance as IAM platforms modernize. 

 General Accountabilities 

- Understand how the Bank’s risk appetite and risk culture should be considered in day-to-day activities and decisions. 

- Create an environment in which their team pursues effective and efficient operations of their respective areas in accordance with Scotiabank’s Values, its Code of Conduct and the Global Sales Principles, while ensuring the adequacy, adherence to and effectiveness of day-to-day business controls to meet obligations with respect to operational, compliance, AML/ATF/sanctions and conduct risk. 

- Build a high performance environment and implements a people strategy that attracts, retains, develops and motivates their team by fostering an inclusive work environment and using a coaching mindset and behaviors; communicating vison/values/business strategy; and, managing succession and development planning for the team. 

- Lead and drive a customer focused, practical, and secure, culture throughout their team to deepen client relationships and leverage broader Bank relationships, systems, and knowledge. 

 Do you have the skills that will enable you to succeed in this role? We'd love to work with you if you have: 

- Minimum of a bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) required 

- 7+ years’ experience in a Product Management (or equivalent) capacity required 

- 7+ years in an IAM Architect Role. 

- 8+ years’ experience in Information Security or Information Technology 

- 10+ years working with IAM platforms 

- Previous exposure to Regulatory, Compliance, Risk and Audit functions 

- Experience developing and documenting IAM directives, standards and policies. 

- Excellent interpersonal and communication skills 

- Strong planning and organizational skills; can manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines 

- Experience in the information security industry and with security software products 

- Excellent understanding on financial principles of large enterprise organization 

- Experience in working with complex processes 

- Willing to learn and grow, and demonstrates resilience to ever-changing priorities 

 What's in it for you? 

- Diversity, Equity, Inclusion & Allyship - We strive to create an inclusive culture where every employee is empowered to reach their fullest potential, respected for who they are, and are embraced through bias-free practices and inclusive values across Scotiabank. We embrace diversity and provide opportunities for all employee to learn, grow & participate through our various Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) that span across diverse gender identities, ethnicity, race, age, ability & veterans. 

- Accessibility and Workplace Accommodations - We value the unique skills and experiences each individual brings to the Bank and are committed to creating and maintaining an inclusive and accessible environment for everyone. Scotiabank continues to locate, remove and prevent barriers so that we can build a diverse and inclusive environment while meeting accessibility requirements.   

- Upskilling through online courses, cross-functional development opportunities, and tuition assistance. 

- Competitive Rewards program including bonus, flexible vacation, personal, sick days and benefits will start on day one. 

- Community Engagement - no matter where you choose to work from; we offer opportunities for community engagement & belonging with our various programs such as hackathons, contests, Humans of Digital and much more 

 Location(s):  Canada : Ontario : Toronto 

 Scotiabank is a leading bank in the Americas. Guided by our purpose: "for every future", we help our customers, their families and their communities achieve success through a broad range of advice, products and services, including personal and commercial banking, wealth management and private banking, corporate and investment banking, and capital markets.   

 At Scotiabank, we value the unique skills and experiences each individual brings to the Bank, and are committed to creating and maintaining an inclusive and accessible environment for everyone. If you require accommodation (including, but not limited to, an accessible interview site, alternate format documents, ASL Interpreter, or Assistive Technology) during the recruitment and selection process, please let our  Recruitment team know. If you require technical assistance, please click here . Candidates must apply directly online to be considered for this role. We thank all applicants for their interest in a career at Scotiabank; however, only those candidates who are selected for an interview will be contacted.

successfactors:jobs.scotiabank.com:60691.description:
Requisition ID: 275336 

Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high-performing culture. 

 Purpose 

 The Director, Digital Product Owner, Scotia Protect Platform is responsible for leading the business product management and roadmap execution of the ScotiaProtect Platform across International Banking markets. The incumbent will establish an integrated view of platform priorities, translate market and customer needs into scalable digital solutions, and drive successful delivery through collaboration with country, Digital, Technology, Operations, Data, Risk, Compliance, and insurer partner teams.

 This role is accountable for platform adoption, delivery governance, launch readiness, value realization, and ongoing platform evolution while ensuring alignment with enterprise objectives, regulatory requirements, and local market needs.

 What You'll Do

 Lead Product Strategy & Roadmap Execution

- Own and execute the ScotiaProtect Platform roadmap across International Banking markets, translating strategic priorities into platform capabilities, releases, and market deployments.

- Manage and prioritize the product backlog, balancing market needs, business value, and delivery capacity.

- Define success measures and business outcomes to support platform growth and scalability.

 Drive Platform Standardization & Market Deployment

- Champion the adoption of reusable platform capabilities and shared components across markets.

- Partner with country insurance and retail banking teams to define deployment strategies, customer journeys, operating models, and launch plans.

- Promote standardization and simplification while accommodating appropriate local market requirements.

 Govern Delivery & Execution

- Lead end-to-end platform governance, including planning, milestone management, dependency tracking, and executive reporting.

- Ensure business requirements, customer journeys, operational processes, and delivery artifacts are clearly defined and managed throughout the product lifecycle.

- Identify and mitigate delivery risks that may impact scope, timelines, quality, or business outcomes.

- Foster Agile product management practices across cross-functional teams to enable effective and efficient delivery.

 Build Strategic Partnerships

- Collaborate with insurer partners, vendors, country stakeholders, technology teams, and business leaders to support platform delivery and adoption.

- Communicate strategy, priorities, progress, risks, and decisions to senior leadership and partner organizations.

- Develop and maintain strong relationships that support successful platform execution and long-term growth.

 Ensure Risk Management & Operational Readiness

- Partner with Risk, Compliance, Privacy, Legal, Security, Technology, and Operations teams to ensure appropriate controls and governance are embedded throughout delivery.

- Support launch readiness through testing, training, operational preparedness, support planning, and post-launch monitoring.

- Ensure compliance with applicable regulatory requirements, operational risk standards, and internal policies.

 Deliver Data-Driven Results

- Establish and monitor key performance indicators including digital adoption, customer experience, operational performance, delivery health, and business value realization.

- Leverage customer insights and market feedback to continuously enhance platform capabilities and user experience.

- Partner with Finance and Analytics teams to align roadmap investments with strategic priorities and expected business outcomes.

 Lead & Develop High-Performing Teams

- Build, coach, and develop a high-performing product management team.

- Foster a collaborative, inclusive, and high-performance culture focused on innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement.

- Support succession planning, talent development, and product management excellence across the organization.

 What You'll Bring

- Bachelor's degree in Business, Technology, Engineering, Operations Management, Design, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

- MBA, graduate degree, Agile certification, Product Management certification, or related designation is considered an asset.

- 10+ years of progressive leadership experience in digital product management, platform leadership, program delivery, banking, insurance, or financial services.

- Proven experience leading large-scale, multi-country initiatives and delivering complex digital platforms or products.

- Strong knowledge of insurance, bancassurance, financial services, digital distribution, and customer experience management.

- Demonstrated expertise in Agile and Lean delivery methodologies.

- Experience managing product roadmaps, backlogs, release planning, launch readiness, and post-launch performance measurement.

- Strong analytical, strategic thinking, and decision-making capabilities.

- Exceptional stakeholder management, communication, influencing, and negotiation skills.

- Experience leading cross-functional teams across business, technology, operations, and external partner organizations.

- English language proficiency is required. Spanish language capability is a strong asset.

 Location(s):  Canada : Ontario : Toronto 

 Scotiabank is a leading bank in the Americas. Guided by our purpose: "for every future", we help our customers, their families and their communities achieve success through a broad range of advice, products and services, including personal and commercial banking, wealth management and private banking, corporate and investment banking, and capital markets.   

 At Scotiabank, we value the unique skills and experiences each individual brings to the Bank, and are committed to creating and maintaining an inclusive and accessible environment for everyone. successfactors:jobs.scotiabank.com:60314.description:
Requisition ID: 263389 

Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high-performing culture. 

 Global Transaction Banking  

Global Transaction Banking (GTB) is the payments and transaction engine of Scotiabank. We support Small Business, Commercial and Corporate clients with effective treasury management solutions coupled with a best-in-class service model, making it easy for clients to do business with us.

As businesses build their digital capabilities and transform their operating models, their payment needs are evolving too. Boasting a unique global footprint, GTB’s comprehensive suite of innovative banking solutions help our business clients generate operational efficiencies, streamline and simplify payments, improve working capital performance, and mitigate financial risk.

At Scotiabank, we embrace your strengths, ideas, and ambitions. GTB is a fast-growing team with a focus on the Americas, particularly Canada, the U.S., Mexico, and we are seeking top tier talent to complement our organization.

Join a purpose-driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high-performing culture.

 Purpose 
The Senior Manager, Sales Effectiveness Seismic Product Owner is accountable for maximizing the value of GTB’s Seismic platform as a core sales enablement capability. Acting as the business owner and subject‑matter expert, the role ensures the platform is strategically positioned, well‑governed, and effectively leveraged to equip sales teams with relevant, compliant content and knowledge that supports client engagement and revenue growth. 

 This role serves as the critical bridge across GTB functions, translating Sales needs into solutions while driving adoption and continuous improvement. Through strong governance, enablement, analytics, and integration with adjacent platforms, this role enhances sales productivity and content effectiveness, while ensuring alignment with enterprise standards and adherence to regulatory and risk requirements

 What You’ll Do: 

- Act as the GTB subject‑matter expert for the Seismic platform, advising Global Sales leadership on its capabilities, roadmap, and strategic application across Global Transaction Banking.

- Lead the implementation and rollout of the Seismic platform across GTB, including change management, stakeholder engagement, and adoption strategy.

- Act as the curator and governor of content within the platform, ensuring quality, relevance, and usability, while partnering with content owners responsible for creation and maintenance.

- Own and evolve the Seismic platform as GTB’s centralized sales content and knowledge repository, including enablement materials, training assets, and best practices to support sales readiness and performance.

- Serve as the primary interface between GTB Sales, Strategic Content, and Technology teams, ensuring clear prioritization, issue escalation, and alignment with GTB and Enterprise standards.

- Lead the development and delivery of enablement, training, and support materials to ensure consistent, compliant, and effective use of the Seismic platform across the GTB sales population.

- Partner with the Strategic Content team and GTB content owners to optimize content lifecycle management, taxonomy, metadata, and analytics to improve relevance and sales effectiveness.

- Track platform usage and engagement across GTB, producing actionable reporting and recommending initiatives to increase adoption, productivity, and return on investment.

- Identify and advance integration opportunities with adjacent sales and marketing platforms to streamline workflows and improve data flow for GTB client‑facing teams.

- Stay abreast of Seismic product enhancements and broader sales enablement trends, translating insights into practical recommendations for GTB leadership and stakeholders.

- Safeguard the Bank's assets and liabilities by maintaining adherence to the Bank's Anti-Money Laundering program, Guidelines for Business Conduct, Operational Risk program, and Information Security standards by reporting any unusual occurrences or fraudulent activities as per established procedures. 

 What You'll Bring: 

- 4+ years of relevant experience in Sales, Sales Enablement and/or equivalent fields

- Undergraduate degree (preferably in Commerce or Computer Science), or equivalent work experience. 

- Expert knowledge of GTB services, products, and sales culture

- Strong communication skills, both written and oral

- Exceptional attention to detail, coupled with strong editing skills

- Expert user of Microsoft Office applications, particularly: Word, PowerPoint, and Excel 

- Familiarity with using Salesforce Tier 1 and Customer 360 to track, export, analyze and disseminate information with a high degree of accuracy
High organizational and project management skills, being able to handle a large number of concurrent, high-priority activities and requests

- Strong curiosity and research capabilities to obtain background information and insights for projects which the incumbent may or may not be thoroughly familiar with

- Good understanding of the Corporate, Commercial and International Bank’s objectives, strategies, and structure is also required

 Working Conditions: 
Work in a standard office-based environment; non-standard hours are a common occurrence. 

 Interested?  
If your experience is closely related but doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification, we do encourage you to apply - you might be the right candidate for this or other roles at Scotiabank! 

 At Scotiabank, every employee is empowered to reach their fullest potential, respected for who they are and, embraced for their differences. That’s why we work to grow and diversify talent and engage employees in a performance-oriented culture.

 What's in it for you?  
Scotiabank wants you to be able to bring your best self to work – and life, every day. With a focus on holistic well-being, our many flexible benefit programs are designed to help support your unique family, financial, physical, mental, and social health needs.

successfactors:jobs.scotiabank.com:60129.description:
Requisition ID: 257137 

Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high-performing culture. 

 The Role 

 The Senior Solutions Architect ensures that the applications architecture and infrastructure supporting major, highly complex applications are designed to meet evolving business requirements and meet standards for reliability, scalability and availability.  The incumbent will provide architecture and technology guidance on all projects to ensure consistency in approaches and to optimize technology synergy.  The Solutions Architect also provides expertise and counsel ensuring technology teams and business areas understand all the options and technology choices in support of their business.  The Solutions Architect is a technology and business expert with strong leadership and facilitation skills with the ability to influence others.

 Is this role right for you? In this role you will: 

- Leads and drives a customer focused culture throughout their team to deepen client relationships and leverage broader Bank relationships, systems and knowledge

- Acts as a thought partner for senior leaders across the group – within the context of strategic technology projects and on an ongoing basis

- Recommends end-to-end technology design solutions and takes full accountability for the architecture of a solution

- Manages multiple complex and parallel projects with tight business and regulatory timelines. Is able to negotiate with the stakeholders in resolving conflicting priorities.

- Lead a wide range of technology strategy initiatives such as Applications rationalization, Cloud Migration, Legacy modernization. Synthesize findings and present clear recommendations and roadmaps ensure impactful project outcomes to senior leaders within GBM

- Ensures simplification of the technology application landscape there by achieving efficiency gains in terms cost, revenue and resources while ensuring uncompromised delivery of business value to clients.

- Keeps the Bank safe by ensuring right technology, architecture, data, and infrastructure choices are made that prevents malicious attacks against the Bank’s technology infrastructure.

- Understand how the Bank’s risk appetite and risk culture should be considered in day-to-day activities and decisions.

- Creates an environment in which his/her team pursues effective and efficient operations of his/her respective areas in accordance with Scotiabank’s Values, its Code of Conduct and the Global Sales Principles, while ensuring the adequacy, adherence to and effectiveness of day-to-day business controls to meet obligations with respect to operational, compliance, AML/ATF/sanctions and conduct risk.

 Do you have the skills that will enable you to succeed in this role? We’d love to work with you if you have: 

- 12+ years of software engineering industry experience

- Bachelor (equivalent or higher) degree in Computer Science, Engineering or related discipline.

- 5+ Experience working in the Capital Markets domain, preferably in FX Domain and products such Spots, Options, Swaps, Exotics. Experience in migrating legacy FX Platforms to modern platforms, preferably in Murex

- Experience with structured Architecture practices, hybrid cloud deployments, and on-premise to-cloud migration deployments and roadmaps.

- Experience in managing multiple complex and parallel projects with the ability to negotiate and resolve conflicting priorities

- Experience building, architecting, designing, and implementing highly distributed global based systems. Experience in network infrastructure, security, data, or application development.

- Experience in modernizing legacy systems or similar transformational initiatives

- Excellent interpersonal, communication, and influencing skills with the ability to build and foster relationships with business partners, project stakeholders, strategic technology partners and external vendors.

- Ability to collaborate across organizational boundaries, build relationships, and achieve broader organizational goals.

 What's in it for you? 

- Diversity, Equity, Inclusion & Allyship - We strive to create an inclusive culture where every employee is empowered to reach their fullest potential, respected for who they are, and are embraced through bias-free practices and inclusive values across Scotiabank. We embrace diversity and provide opportunities for all employee to learn, grow & participate through our various Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) that span across diverse gender identities, ethnicity, race, age, ability & veterans.

- Accessibility and Workplace Accommodations - We value the unique skills and experiences each individual brings to the Bank and are committed to creating and maintaining an inclusive and accessible environment for everyone. Scotiabank continues to locate, remove, and prevent barriers so that we can build a diverse and inclusive environment while meeting accessibility requirements.

- Upskilling through online courses, cross-functional development opportunities, and tuition assistance.

- Competitive Rewards program including bonus, flexible vacation, personal, sick days, and benefits will start on day one.

- Community Engagement - no matter where you choose to work from; we offer opportunities for community engagement & belonging with our various programs.

successfactors:jobs.scotiabank.com:60674.description:
Requisition ID: 275418 

Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high-performing culture. 

 The Assistant Manager, Product Management Design & Solutions supports delivery of the Global AML Transformation program & assigned projects and day to day support activities. Working closely with the Manager, Business Testing & Manager, Design Strategy & Operational Support, the Assistant Manager will coordinate across the various stakeholder groups including, Technology, AMA, Business Lines (across the Enterprise), AML Risk, PMO, and others (as required), to support delivery or programs, plans, initiatives, and strategies on time and within budget for assigned products/platforms and services in scope.  

 Is this role right for you? In this role, you will: 

- Support the Manager & Senior Manager in the formulation of the overall Product delivery strategy and delivering on the strategic roadmap for the platform, prioritizing initiatives and securing necessary resources, leveraging effective collaboration, relationship building, and negotiation leading to "buy in" and decisions supported by relevant stakeholders. 

- Applies a technical understanding of the assigned platform/product and works with technical teams to formulate the technical solutions and corresponding design documentation. Keeps an eye on the latest technologies and shares ideas on how to use them to improve the product. 

- Understands the product and the core journeys in depth, and can use competition trends to inform and improve the product, drawing ideas from across different industries with help to generate ideas for the product and its delivery. 

- Understands the significance of qualitative aspects of the assigned product experience and can guide the user on how the product performs, expressing such through effective design documentation that support end to end understanding. 

- Collaborate on queries of structured data / large databases assigned and managed, to address business issues and operational support practices ongoing such as logical access, audit retrieval, and production validation activities. 

- Assists with employing various data techniques and procedures to perform the continuous iteration and analysis of past and current data, to obtain insights about a business challenge / issue. 

- Balances a product-oriented vs project-oriented approach applying an intuitive understanding of the metrics necessary to use the right metrics to attain business goals. 

- Participates and supports the product implementation roadmap. 

- Assist with delivering within the established framework and standards that govern and accelerate our global initiatives, and support optimization, financial accountability, and execution success across the delivery value chain, including aligning portfolio to enterprise delivery framework. 

- Assist with release production validation, obtaining sign offs, and providing defect tracking, aligning to program priorities for resolution. 

- Contribute to an environment of effective and efficient operations, while ensuring the adequacy, adherence to and effectiveness of day-to-day business controls to meet assigned obligations with respect to operational risk & Business Sustainment accountabilities, regulatory compliance risk, AML/ATF risk and conduct risk, including but not limited to responsibilities under the Operational Risk Management Framework, Regulatory Compliance Risk Management Framework, AML/ATF Global Handbook and the Guidelines for Business Conduct. 

- Build partnerships globally with First Line, Second Line, Internal Audit, Technology, Data Governance Office, and other key stakeholders in connection with the Bank’s AML/ATF Program, and work collaboratively across functional teams to resolve open issues in a timely and effective manner. 

- Support project planning and execution by coordinating schedules, milestones, dependencies, risks, issues, resources, stakeholder communications, and status reporting to ensure timely delivery. 

 Do you have the skills that will enable you to succeed in this role? We'd love to work with you if you have: 

- Bachelor’s degree in business administration, commerce, finance, or similar field. 

- Working experience with change management and influencing stakeholders. 

- Deep analytical, project management and communication experience (strong professional writing and MS PowerPoint presentation skills). 

- Strong project management skills, including planning, scheduling, risk and issue management, dependency tracking, stakeholder coordination, and delivery oversight. 

- Experience and technical know-how of risk management procedures, processes, and tools. 

- AML experience and understanding of the Oracle system are an advantage. 

- Proven problem-solving skills, ability to help others organize problem solving. 

- Proven ability to operate independently and take initiative in supporting a program strategy. 

- Proven ability in execution of complex and demanding tasks under strict time pressures.

successfactors:jobs.scotiabank.com:60701.description:
Requisition ID: 273401 

Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high-performing culture. 

 The Senior Manager, Fraud & Risk Strategy provides regional strategy and subject matter expertise for application fraud across International Banking (Mexico, Peru, Chile, Uruguay, Caribbean). The role focuses specifically on first party, synthetic, and non–stolen identity fraud, which reside within credit risk rather than enterprise fraud operations. 

 This role executes and monitors the risk strategy, frameworks, and controls for digital channel originations fraud, and works with country teams to build capabilities and reduce losses. 

 Is this role right for you? In this role, you will: 

- Champions a customer focused culture to deepen client relationships and leverage broader Bank relationships, systems and knowledge. 

- Regional Strategy & Frameworks 

- Enforce the digital application fraud strategy for International Banking, including standards for identity proofing, fraud scoring, escalation thresholds, and lifecycle controls. 

- Establish and maintain a first‑party and synthetic fraud framework aligned to global policies and IB digital growth objectives. 

 Capability Building Across Countries 

- Act as the regional subject‑matter expert to support countries in strengthening application controls. 

- Lead engagement with country teams to support adoption of frameworks and standards for first-party and synthetic identity fraud prevention. 

 Monitoring & Trend Analysis 

- Maintain a regional view of fraud trends, attack vectors, and performance indicators across digital origination channels. 

- Consolidate and analyze fraud risk indicators, emerging threats, portfolio trends, and control effectiveness metrics across countries. 

 Governance & Standards 

- Develop standards, templates, and methodologies to support consistent application fraud risk management across geographies. 

- Review and challenge major fraud‑related initiatives (digital onboarding changes, data/identity tools, new product flows). 

- Identify, Select and Coordinate onboarding activities, for third-party providers supporting fraud prevention, identity verification, investigations, analytics, or governance functions. 

- Ensure compliance with global policies and alignment with the Retail Credit Risk framework. 

 Stakeholder Engagement 

- Build and maintain relationships with country risk teams, Enterprise Fraud, and Global Retail stakeholders. 

- Communicate fraud insights and recommendations to senior audiences in a clear, actionable way. 

- Understand how the Bank’s risk appetite and risk culture should be considered in day-to-day activities and decisions. 

- Creates an environment in which their team pursues effective and efficient operations of their respective areas in accordance with Scotiabank’s Values, its Code of Conduct and the Global Sales Principles, while ensuring the adequacy, adherence to and effectiveness of day-to-day business controls to meet obligations with respect to operational, compliance, AML/ATF/sanctions and conduct risk. 

- Builds a high performance environment and implements a people strategy that attracts, retains, develops and motivates their team by fostering an inclusive work environment and using a coaching mindset and behaviours; communicating vison/values/business strategy; and, managing succession and development planning for the team. 

 Do you have the skills that will enable you to succeed in this role? - We'd love to work with you if you have: 

- University degree in Business, Law, Risk Management or related field. 

- 3+ years of experience in fraud risk, credit risk, or operational risk. 

- Experience with process optimization, portfolio monitoring and strategy implementation 

- Ability to influence and lead in an evolving, multi‑country environment. 

- Fluency in English and Spanish preferred. 

 What’s in it for you? 

- An inclusive & collaborative working environment that encourages creativity, curiosity, and celebrates success!

- We offer a competitive rewards package: Performance bonus, Employee Share Ownership Program, and Pension Plan Matching, Health Benefits from day one!

- Your career matters! You will have access to career development and progression opportunities.

successfactors:jobs.scotiabank.com:60557.title: Senior Solutions Engineer
successfactors:jobs.scotiabank.com:60557.description:
Requisition ID: 267261 

Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high-performing culture. 

 The Windows Workstation OS Platform Principal Engineer & Technical Product Owner is a senior technical expert and product owner for the physical Windows workstation estate (laptops and desktops) across the enterprise. This role owns the platform end to end from a design, solutioning, engineering, and product perspective, so that the Windows client behaves as a resilient, secure, and high-performing service rather than a collection of disconnected settings.
This role leads the technical design and solutioning for the Windows workstation platform. It defines and evolves target-state solution designs, reference designs, engineering standards, and design patterns for how Windows is provisioned, configured, secured, delivered, and operated. It works within the Bank’s architecture direction and standards, partnering with the Architecture function rather than duplicating it, and translates architectural intent into practical, buildable Windows workstation solutions.
The role is defined by genuine mastery of what Windows actually is: the servicing model and release cadence, the boot and sign-in sequence, the kernel and user-mode boundary, servicing stacks and update mechanics, provisioning, policy, security baselines, and the telemetry that explains real-world behavior. The person in this role is a recognized Windows expert who shapes technical direction and reference designs for the Windows client and owns how those decisions land in production.
Critically, this role is forward-looking. It is expected to track the Windows roadmap continuously, understand upcoming features and servicing changes before they arrive, and translate what is coming into practical, sequenced design and solutioning decisions for the Bank’s workstation fleet. Awareness of the roadmap is treated as a core responsibility, not a nice-to-have.

 Is this role right for you? In this role, you will: 
• Leads the technical design and solutioning for the Windows workstation estate, defining and evolving target-state solution designs, reference designs, engineering standards, and design patterns for provisioning, configuration, compliance, application delivery, security, and lifecycle.
• Produces buildable, well-documented solution designs that are secure by design, scalable, and supportable, and that align to the Bank’s architecture direction, risk appetite, regulatory requirements, and technology-governance standards.
• Partners with the Architecture function to apply and inform enterprise architecture and standards, translating architectural intent into practical Windows workstation solutions without duplicating or overlapping the Architecture team’s mandate.
• Acts as technical product owner for the Windows workstation estate, owning the product vision, the technical backlog, and the sequencing of engineering work from concept through build, deployment, and steady-state operations.
• Translates business outcomes, user-experience needs, security and risk findings, operational feedback, and technical debt into a clear, prioritized, and defensible design and delivery roadmap for the Windows client.
• Champions a customer-focused culture, treating end-user experience, reliability, and performance as first-class outcomes for every design and workstation decision.
• Serves as the Bank’s subject-matter expert on the Windows client: servicing model and release cadence, feature and quality updates, hotpatch and update mechanics, the boot and sign-in sequence, kernel and user-mode behavior, drivers, provisioning, policy, and security baselines.
• Acts as a senior technical escalation point for complex Windows design and engineering issues, leading root-cause analysis and driving durable, permanent solutions rather than repeated workarounds.
• Uses experience telemetry and operational data (for example Endpoint Analytics and update reporting) to continuously improve performance, boot and sign-in time, reliability, and update success.
• Operates horizontally across the organization, partnering as a peer expert with other vertical engineering groups (for example virtual workspace, identity, networking, security, application, and infrastructure engineering) and with their product owners to align designs, manage dependencies, and deliver shared outcomes.
• Collaborates with, and provides Windows expertise to, the other Windows and endpoint engineering teams within Enterprise Platforms & EUC Engineering in a partnership model, contributing designs, standards, and guidance without assuming ownership of their backlogs, deliverables, or people, and respecting each team’s remit.
• Acts as a connective technical authority for Windows workstation topics, offering solutioning support, design reviews, and knowledge-sharing that raise the quality and consistency of Windows engineering across teams while avoiding duplication or overlap of responsibilities.
• Builds consensus across teams through influence and technical credibility, resolving design trade-offs collaboratively and escalating to leadership only where alignment cannot be reached.
• Continuously tracks the Windows roadmap and Windows Insider signals, maintaining a current view of upcoming releases and platform-enablement updates (for example the 26H1 platform release for next-generation silicon and the 26H2 annual feature update), and advises leadership and peer teams on timing, readiness, and impact.
• Assesses upcoming Windows capabilities and servicing changes, including AI and Copilot+ PC experiences and their NPU hardware requirements, WinUI modernization of core shell components, hotpatch adoption, and resilience features such as point-in-time restore, cloud rebuild, and Quick Machine Recovery, and translates them into practical enterprise designs, hardware standards, and adoption or deferral decisions.
• Evaluates hardware and silicon direction (including Copilot+ PC and Arm-based devices) so that the Bank’s workstation designs, refresh, and standards remain aligned to where Windows is heading, not only where it is today.
• Provides clear, evidence-based guidance to leadership and the broader project community on what is coming in Windows, what it means for the fleet, and what the Bank should do to prepare.
• Partners with Cyber Security, Risk, and Identity teams to embed security-by-design and Zero Trust principles into the Windows client design, including security baselines, encryption (for example BitLocker and hardware-accelerated BitLocker on capable devices), and update compliance.
• Ensures day-to-day design, solutioning, and operational decisions align with the Bank’s risk appetite, operational controls, AML/ATF and regulatory requirements, and technology governance standards.
• Contributes to a high-performance, inclusive engineering culture grounded in clear ownership, technical excellence, and knowledge transfer.

 Do you have the skills that will enable you to succeed in this role? We'd love to work with you if you have: 
• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience.
• 7+ years designing, solutioning, engineering, and operating enterprise Windows workstation or end-user-computing platforms at scale.
• Demonstrated experience leading technical design and solutioning for the Windows client, including target-state solution designs, reference designs, and standards, delivered in partnership with an enterprise architecture function.
• Deep, demonstrable expertise in the Windows client: servicing and release cadence, feature/quality and hotpatch updates, boot and sign-in sequence, kernel and user-mode behavior, drivers, provisioning, policy, and security baselines.
• Proven track record of tracking the Windows roadmap and Windows Insider program and turning upcoming features and servicing changes into enterprise-ready designs and standards.
• Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Intune, Windows Autopilot, and Entra ID, including Conditional Access, compliance, and configuration at enterprise scale.
• Proven ability to work horizontally across multiple engineering teams and product owners, influencing through expertise and building consensus without direct authority.
• Experience owning or co-owning a technical product backlog and prioritizing engineering work in a product-driven model.
• Hands-on automation and scripting (PowerShell strongly preferred) and comfort using telemetry and operational data to drive decisions.
• Experience delivering within regulated, large-scale enterprise environments; strong documentation, communication, and stakeholder-management skills.
• Relevant Microsoft certifications such as MD-102, SC-300, AZ-104, or equivalent are strongly preferred.

 What's in it for you? 
• Diversity, Equity, Inclusion & Allyship - We strive to create an inclusive culture where every employee is empowered to reach their fullest potential, respected for who they are, and are embraced through bias-free practices and inclusive values across Scotiabank. We embrace diversity and provide opportunities for all employee to learn, grow & participate through our various Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) that span across diverse gender identities, ethnicity, race, age, ability & veterans.
• Accessibility and Workplace Accommodations - We value the unique skills and experiences each individual brings to the Bank, and are committed to creating and maintaining an inclusive and accessible environment for everyone. Scotiabank continues to locate, remove and prevent barriers so that we can build a diverse and inclusive environment while meeting accessibility requirements.
• Upskilling through online courses, cross-functional development opportunities, and tuition assistance.  
• Competitive Rewards program including bonus, flexible vacation, personal, sick days and benefits will start on day one.
• Community Engagement - no matter where you choose to work from; we offer opportunities for community engagement & belonging with our various programs such as hackathons, contests, cooking with friends, Humans of Digital and much more!

Requisition ID: 267473 

Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high-performing culture. 

 The Senior AI Product Owner plays a key role in advancing Global Wealth Management’s AI strategy by driving the development, delivery, and adoption of innovative AI-powered solutions that enhance advisor and client experiences. This role is responsible for translating strategic objectives into actionable product roadmaps, prioritizing initiatives, and leading cross-functional teams to deliver measurable business value. The Senior AI Product Owner ensures that AI products are developed and managed in alignment with regulatory requirements, internal policies, and governance standards, while contributing to the successful execution of the organization’s global AI vision and wealth management transformation goals. 

 Is this role right for you? In this role you will: 

- Champion a customer-focused culture by prioritizing AI capabilities that enhance advisor productivity and client experience  

- Define and communicate product vision, strategy, and roadmap aligned to business partner goals and AI operating model  

- Create and maintain a roadmap outlining the evolution of AI capabilities and reusable outputs  

- Lead backlog prioritization and work with Business Analysts to ensure user stories are ready for development  

- Develop business cases and partner with stakeholders to support funding, prioritization, and delivery planning  

- Ensure all necessary risk, privacy, compliance, and AML/ATF approvals are completed for AI features  

- Translate AI capabilities, constraints, and risks into practical product decisions and measurable outcomes  

- Partner with architecture, engineering, and enterprise AI teams to align delivery to platform and governance standards  

- Participate in agile ceremonies and provide product context to enable effective delivery 

 Do you have the skills that will enable you to succeed in this role? – We’d love to work with you if you have: 

- Minimum of 5-7 years of experience in digital product management / product ownership, preferably within wealth management, financial services, or fintech 

- Demonstrated experience building or scaling AI-enabled products, enterprise automation products, decision-support products, or model-driven experiences in production environments 

- Strong knowledge of wealth-management concepts, client / advisor needs, and domain workflows relevant to the role 

- Demonstrated expertise developing and launching digital or AI-enabled solutions in cross-functional environments 

- In-depth knowledge of Agile process and principles 

- Excellent organizational and analytical skills with strong attention to detail 

- Effective communication and stakeholder-management capability, including the ability to explain AI opportunities and limitations clearly to non-technical audiences

successfactors:jobs.scotiabank.com:60621.description:
Requisition ID: 274074 

Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high-performing culture. 

 The Role: 

 As the Senior Digital Product Manager, Advice, you will drive the evolution of Scotia’s digital advice experience.  In this role, you’ll lead the delivery of innovative features and enhancements for our digital advice experience across mobile and web channels—shaping how clients discover, access, and act on personalized financial guidance, from goal planning to financial wellbeing insights. 

 You will work at the intersection of customer experience, business strategy, data, design, and technology to create advice experiences that are intuitive, personalized, and impactful. The role emphasizes ownership of roadmap and backlog prioritization, customer-centric design, data-driven decision making, and close partnership with Business, Engineering, and Design teams. 

 Is this role right for you?  In this role you will: 

- Prioritize and manage the backlog for digital advice capabilities—spanning multiple business lines—with a thorough understanding  of the technological ecosystem that support these capabilities 

- Gather, document, and refine business requirements: Lead and support the understanding and documenting of business needs through Agile methods such as user stories, acceptance criteria, definition of done, etc. 

- Support discovery and development of the product strategy and roadmap for digital advice capabilities 

- Use data to drive decisions, build hypotheses, test and iterate, including planning for the right incorporation of data and analytics strategies into roadmap 

- Build strong relationships with business stakeholders, wealth and retail banking partners, legal, compliance, risk, analytics, and technology teams 

- Champion a customer focused culture to deepen client relationships and leverage broader Bank relationships, systems and knowledge 

- Actively pursue effective and efficient operations of your respective areas in accordance with Scotiabank’s Values, its Code of Conduct and the Global Sales Principles, while ensuring the adequacy, adherence to and effectiveness of day-to-day business controls to meet obligations with respect to operational, compliance, AML/ATF/sanctions and conduct risk 

 Do you have the skills that will enable you to succeed in this role?  We'd love to work with you if you have: 

- Minimum 5 years experience in building customer facing digital products  

- Managed a technology product or a digital journey end to end, from inception to delivery 

- Ability to build trusted relationships, instill confidence and influence stakeholders 

- Skilled at identifying and solving ambiguous problems to drive customer and business value 

- Knowledgeable about multiple functional areas such as Product Management, Agile/Scrum, Engineering, UX/UI Design, Finance 

- Excellent organizational and analytical skills with strong attention to detail 

- Great verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to engage and influence stakeholders at different levels in the organizations  

 What's in it for you? 

- Diversity, Equity, Inclusion & Allyship - We strive to create an inclusive culture where every employee is empowered to reach their fullest potential, respected for who they are, and are embraced through bias-free practices and inclusive values across Scotiabank. 

- We embrace diversity and provide opportunities for all employees to learn, grow & participate through our various Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) that span across diverse gender identities, ethnicity, race, age, ability & veterans.  

- Accessibility and Workplace Accommodations - We value the unique skills and experiences each individual brings to the Bank and are committed to creating and maintaining an inclusive and accessible environment for everyone. Scotiabank continues to locate, remove and prevent barriers so that we can build a diverse and inclusive environment while meeting accessibility requirements.   

- Upskilling through online courses, cross-functional development opportunities, and tuition assistance. 

- Competitive Rewards program including bonus, flexible vacation, personal, sick days and benefits will start on day one. 

- Community Engagement - no matter where you choose to work from; we offer opportunities for community engagement & belonging with our various programs such as hackathons, contests, Humans of Digital and much more!

successfactors:jobs.scotiabank.com:60687.description:
Requisition ID: 275951 

Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high-performing culture. 

 Purpose 

 Drive sustained and profitable revenue growth through the planning, development and delivery of acquisition and customer engagement marketing programs. As a member of the Marketing Planning and Delivery practice (within Canadian Banking Marketing), drives full-funnel marketing planning, and delivery of benefit-led campaigns that enable the Canadian Bank to achieve its strategic objectives.

 Is this role right for you? In this role, you will be involved in: 

 Marketing Planning: 

 •    With Director, sets and refines annual and quarterly marketing plans for assigned portfolio 
•    Monitors consumer sentiment, market conditions, competitive activity, and short-term-demand opportunity on an ongoing basis to increase agility of planning processes and flexibility of budget deployment.
•    Collaborates with Credit Card teams to plan and execute Bank-wide level action plans and marketing programs.
•    Accountable for a customer-centric team that acquires, analyzes, and leverages insights drawn from market research and data analysis to establish the strategic direction of benefit-led campaign briefs.
•    Contributes in plans and briefs a deep understanding of Bank-wide and business partner needs, ensuring full buy-in (agreement) and participation of multiple business, channel, and marketing partners in a highly matrixed environment. 
•    Lead annual, quarterly, and in-year marketing planning processes. 
•    Translate business objectives into actionable marketing plans and roadmaps. 
•    Partner with business leaders to prioritize initiatives based on impact, capacity, and strategic alignment. 
•    Identify opportunities, dependencies, risks, and trade-offs across the portfolio.

 Campaign Delivery leadership: 

 •    Ensures Canadian Banking Marketing’s squads have an efficient and effective central point to build-out campaign calendars (including media mix) and set individual program workback schedules.
•    Responsible for providing insight on budget management and coordination with partners for budget revisions.
•    Contributes to development and deployment of creative assets, agnostic of media channel and across all touchpoints, acting as squad’s main point of contact for creative and media agencies.
•    Leads building a high-performance culture centered on effective collaboration with business partners, Marketing Performance Management and Marketing Media Strategy to review campaign results, identify actionable insights, and apply learnings to improve future campaign planning, delivery and performance.
•    Champions proper usage of the Scotiabank brand in Canada, in full compliance with global brand guidelines and Scotiabank’s visual identity continuum.
•    Establish success metrics and measurement frameworks for marketing initiatives.
•    Monitor performance against business and marketing objectives.
•    Provide insights and recommendations to improve effectiveness, efficiency, and client outcomes.
•    Support executive reporting and business reviews.

 Talent leadership: 

 •    Leads and drives a customer focused culture throughout their team to deepen client relationships and leverage broader Bank relationships, systems and knowledge.
•    Champions a high-performance environment and demonstrates a commitment to Scotiabank’s values: accountability, passion, integrity and respect. Delivers results in accordance to Scotiabank behavioural competencies. Creates an inclusive team culture and an environment where team members hear, share, and appreciate diverse perspectives.
•    Act as a key liaison between Marketing, Product, Loyalty, Analytics, Finance, Digital, Creative, and Agency partners.
•    Facilitate planning forums, leadership reviews, and executive decision-making processes.
•    Drive alignment across stakeholder groups to ensure successful delivery of marketing initiatives.
•    Directs day-to-day activities in a manner consistent with the Bank’s risk culture and the relevant risk appetite statement and limits. Communicates and models the Bank’s risk culture and risk appetite statement throughout their teams. 
•    Creates an environment in which his/her team pursues effective and efficient operations of his/her respective areas in accordance with Scotiabank’s Values, its Code of Conduct, and the Global Sales Principles, while ensuring the adequacy, adherence to and effectiveness of day-to-day business controls to meet obligations with respect to operational, compliance, AML/ATF/sanctions and conduct risk. 
•    Builds a high-performance environment and implements a people strategy that attracts, retains, develops, and motivates their team by fostering an inclusive work environment. Uses a coaching mindset and behaviors; communicating vison/values/business strategy; and managing succession and development planning for the team. 

 Direct Reports:  2 Managers, Marketing Planning and Delivery

 Dimensions 

•    Designing and implementing global customer-first strategies across all operating countries and ensuring that creative and media agency resources are best aligned to support global and divisional needs. Ensure best practices and global standards are implemented and followed in the global digital technologies and site deployments and develop and track global benchmarks and goals to measure performance. 

 Do you have the skills that will enable you to succeed? We’d love to work with you if you have the following:  

•    Exposure to the Agile methodology 
•    Expertise in driving performance growth across multiple dimensions and KPIs
•    Strong experience with campaign measurement, results analysis and insight development to optimize future marketing campaigns
•    Deep knowledge of the marketing tech stack
•    Authentic, decisive, resilient, highly collaborative, and results-oriented 

 Working Conditions 
•    Work in a standard office-based environment; non-standard hours are a common occurrence.  Limited travel domestically.

successfactors:jobs.scotiabank.com:60657.description:
Requisition ID: 275115 

Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high-performing culture. 

 The Role   

 The Senior Manager – Data Product Manager  leads the strategy, lifecycle and value realization of data products and shared data capabilities for International Banking. Reporting to the Director, Data Engineering, the incumbent acts as the senior product authority for the portfolio in scope: defining product vision and outcomes, owning roadmaps and prioritized backlogs, setting measurable success criteria, and aligning business, engineering, architecture, governance, risk and country stakeholders around a common direction. The role translates strategic priorities and customer needs into governed, reusable, domain-aligned data products published on Harbour, the bank's Azure Databricks data platform, following the Harbour target architecture and its producer/consumer model ("engineer once, consume many"). This includes the migration and rationalization of legacy on-premises and Google Cloud Platform workloads onto Harbour. The incumbent also leads a small team of Data Product Managers/Product Owners, establishing product management standards and coaching, developing and directing their work across concurrent initiatives and markets.  

 Is this role right for you? In this role you will: 

- 
 Define and own the product vision, strategy and outcome-based roadmap for the data products and shared data capabilities in scope (e.g., curated Gold-layer domain data products, analytics-ready datasets and reusable data services), organized by business domain (BIAN-inspired) and aligned with International Banking strategic priorities and the Harbour target architecture.   

- 
 Own and prioritize the product backlogs for the portfolio in scope, balancing business value, regulatory commitments, technical debt and platform capacity; make clear trade-off decisions and communicate the rationale to stakeholders.   

- 
 Engage business, Analytics, Risk, Finance, Data Office and country stakeholders to understand data consumer needs, use cases and pain points, and translate them into product requirements, epics, user stories and acceptance criteria.   

- 
 Define measurable success criteria and KPIs for each data product (adoption, consumer satisfaction, data quality, timeliness/SLA, reuse and cost-to-serve) and track value realization after release.   

- 
 Partner with Senior Data Engineers, Architecture and the Harbour Platform team (Data & AI Technology) to shape data products that follow approved Harbour patterns. These patterns include standard ingestion (metadata-driven batch through Azure Data Factory into ADLS Gen2 and, where applicable, change data capture), data contracts, medallion layering (Bronze, Silver, Gold) and a clear producer/consumer separation, so data is engineered once and reused across consumers rather than rebuilt for each use case.   

- 
 Lead product-level planning for the migration and rationalization of legacy workloads (on-premises platforms such as DB2, SQL Server, Hadoop and SAS, and existing Google Cloud Platform estates) onto Harbour. This includes source inventory, value and risk classification, prioritization of operational (mirrored) sources as the preferred source of truth, historical load strategy, decommissioning of temporary legacy analytical assets, consumer transition, and sequencing aligned with country workspace onboarding.   

- 
 Embed governance by design into every data product, in partnership with the Data Office, Risk and Compliance: clear data ownership, domain catalogs within the centralized Unity Catalog governance model, metadata and semantic definitions, lineage, data quality monitoring, data classification, and role-based access controls that support both country-specific and approved regional (e.g., AML) consumption through country-segregated workspaces.   

- 
 Ensure data products comply with enterprise security, privacy, data residency and local regulatory requirements across International Banking markets, including the country-specific regulatory approvals and attestations required to use Harbour. Contribute product inputs to required assessments (e.g., TRA, PIA, technical design documentation) and support the evidencing of controls and on-time closure of audit and regulatory commitments.   

- 
 Manage the full product lifecycle, discovery, design, launch, adoption, enhancement and retirement—working with Delivery Managers and Agile squads on release planning and incremental value delivery.   

- 
 Own the product business case for the portfolio in scope: benefits definition, funding requests, cost-to-serve and Azure/Databricks consumption (FinOps) attributed through the IB application APMs, including the legacy license and platform costs avoided through decommissioning, with timely escalation of variances.   

- 
 Communicate product strategy, roadmap, progress and key decisions to senior leadership and stakeholders through clear, executive-ready materials, managing expectations across competing priorities.   

- 
 Lead, coach and develop a team of Data Product Managers/Product Owners, including work assignment across products and markets, objective setting, performance feedback, career development and participation in hiring; set product management standards (discovery, roadmapping, OKRs, backlog practices) and promote a culture of customer focus, collaboration and continuous improvement.  

 Do you have the skills that will enable you to succeed in this role? We'd love to work with you if you have:    

 Education:   

- 
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Business Administration, Economics or a related field. A Master's degree (e.g., MBA or MSc in Data/Analytics) is a plus.   

- 
 Product management certifications are highly desirable (e.g., Certified Scrum Product Owner / Advanced CSPO, SAFe Product Owner/Product Manager, Pragmatic Institute); data and cloud certifications (e.g., DAMA CDMP, Azure Data Fundamentals DP-900, Databricks Fundamentals) are an asset.  

 Experience:   

- 
 5+ years of progressive experience in product management, data management or data and analytics roles, including at least 3 years as a Product Manager or Product Owner for data products, data platforms or analytics capabilities.   

- 
 Proven track record defining, launching and scaling data products with measurable business outcomes and consumer adoption in a global, matrixed organization across multiple countries.   

- 
 Demonstrated experience directly supervising, coaching and developing product professionals (Product Managers, Product Owners or Business Analysts), including work assignment, performance feedback and hiring.   

- 
 Experience in banking or financial services, with working knowledge of regulatory and audit expectations (e.g., OSFI, local LATAM regulators, GDPR and data residency/privacy requirements) and how they shape data product design.   

- 
 Solid understanding of modern lakehouse architecture on Microsoft Azure: Azure Databricks, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2, Azure Data Factory, change data capture/event streaming (e.g., Azure Event Hubs), data contracts, medallion patterns, producer/consumer design, and consumption through Power BI and SQL. Knowledge should be sufficient to shape solutions, challenge trade-offs and hold credible technical conversations; exposure to AI/ML consumption patterns is an asset.   

- 
 Experience with product discovery and prioritization practices (user research, value/effort frameworks such as WSJF or RICE, OKRs) and with tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, Confluence and Power BI for product metrics and reporting.   

- 
 Experience building business cases, securing funding and managing product cost-to-serve, including cloud cost (FinOps) awareness.   

- 
 Familiarity with data governance, data quality frameworks, metadata, semantic layers and catalog tools (e.g., Unity Catalog), domain-oriented data ownership (data mesh concepts, BIAN domain models) and control evidence requirements in a regulated, multi-country environment.  

 Skills:   

- 
 Strategic product thinking, with the ability to set a compelling vision and translate it into a prioritized, outcome-driven roadmap.   

- 
 Exceptional communication, storytelling and influencing skills, with the ability to bridge technical and business audiences and present clearly to senior leadership.   

- 
 Strong customer focus and understanding of data consumers, turning ambiguous business needs into clear, valuable product definitions.   

- 
 Sound judgment in prioritization and decision-making under competing demands, with strong negotiation and conflict-resolution abilities in high-visibility environments.   

- 
 Strong analytical skills and a data-driven approach to measuring product value, adoption and quality.   

- 
 Ability to coach product teams, leaders and stakeholders on product management practices and a product-oriented operating model for data.   

- 
 Spanish language ability is a strong asset given the International Banking footprint across Latin America and the Caribbean.   

 Location(s):  Canada : Ontario : Toronto

Requisition ID: 267119 

Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high-performing culture. 

 As a Senior Product Owner, you will play a critical role in delivering large-scale transformation across Wealth Management by modernizing client and account onboarding and servicing experiences. This role sits at the center of cross-functional delivery, driving initiatives that reduce manual effort, improve Advisor productivity, and enable scalable, compliant client growth. You will own the product vision and roadmap for complex, multi-system capabilities, partnering across business, technology, and operations to deliver seamless, end-to-end client journeys aligned with strategic outcomes. 

 Is this role right for you? In this role you will: 

- Define and own the product vision and roadmap for onboarding and servicing capabilities, aligned to business strategy, regulatory requirements, and client needs 

- Translate strategic priorities into a clear, actionable roadmap with defined outcomes and measurable impact 

- Own and prioritize the product backlog, ensuring delivery teams are aligned to highest-value initiatives 

- Drive end-to-end execution across squads, ensuring transparency on progress, risks, and dependencies 

- Lead resolution of complex delivery challenges across systems, partners, and stakeholders 

- Lead the design and optimization of onboarding and servicing journeys to eliminate friction and improve usability 

- Identify and address key pain points through data, feedback, and continuous iteration 

- Ensure solutions deliver measurable improvements in client and Advisor experience 

- Leverage data, research, and industry insights to inform decision-making and prioritization 

- Monitor outcomes and continuously refine the roadmap based on performance, adoption, and business impact 

- Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to align on priorities, scope, and delivery outcomes 

- Ensure initiatives adhere to risk, compliance, and operational standards 

- Communicate progress, risks, and outcomes effectively to senior leadership 

- Foster a high-performing, client-focused team culture 

- Mentor junior team members and contribute to capability development across the organization 

- Challenge the status quo and drive continuous improvement in processes and ways of working 

 Do you have the skills that will enable you to succeed in this role? – We’d love to work with you if you have: 

- Undergraduate degree in Business, Finance, Technology, or related field 

- Advanced degree or certifications (e.g., Agile, PMP, CFA, CSM) are assets 

- Canadian Securities Course (CSC) or equivalent designation preferred 

- 8+ years of experience in product ownership or product management, preferably within wealth management, financial services, and/or fintech 

- A proven track record delivering complex, large-scale initiatives in regulated environments 

- A deep understanding of client onboarding, servicing workflows, and associated regulatory considerations 

- A demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams and influence stakeholders at all levels 

- Strong delivery management skills with experience navigating competing priorities and ambiguity 

- A data-driven mindset with the ability to translate insights into product decisions 

- Experience working with complex systems and workflows; exposure to APIs or workflow platforms is an asset 

- Experience with Agile delivery tools (e.g., JIRA, Confluence) and workflow visualization tools (e.g., Visio) 

- Familiarity with design thinking and agile methodologies

successfactors:jobs.scotiabank.com:60583.description:
Requisition ID: 267695 

Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high-performing culture. 

 The Senior Manager, Data Product Management, has a key role in the Global Wealth Management (GWM) Data Centre of Excellence. Reporting to the Director, Data Product Management, this role is responsible for the end-to-end lifecycle management of data products. The Senior Manager will work closely with business stakeholders, technology partners, and data stewards to define, develop, and deliver high-quality data products that drive business value and align with GWM's data strategy. This role is pivotal in fostering an insight-driven culture and ensuring that data is leveraged as a strategic asset across the organization. 

 Is this role right for you? In this role you will: 

- Manage the entire data product lifecycle from ideation, through development and testing, to launch, and iteration 

- Be responsible for the strategic vision around enabling enterprise-scale AI through trusted, governed, interoperable, and reusable data products that transform data into intelligent business outcomes 

- Contribute to the data product roadmap, prioritize features, and define product requirements based on business needs and user feedback 

- Champion data governance and ensure data products adhere to all policies, standards, and quality metrics. 

- Work with Data Stewards to define and document metadata, data lineage, and quality controls for data products 

- Develop and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) for data products, including usage, quality, and business value 

- Collaborate with business lines, technology teams, and the Chief Data Office (CDO) to ensure alignment of data strategies, standards, and governance 

- Act as a key liaison between technical teams and business users to translate business needs into technical requirements and vice versa 

- Foster cross-functional collaboration to ensure efficient data access and management 

- Identify new opportunities to create business value through the development of innovative data products 

- Support the strategic, use-case-based approach to growing data product capabilities and maturing GWM's data practice 

 Do you have the skills that will enable you to succeed in this role? – We’d love to work with you if you have: 

- Undergraduate degree in technology, commerce, or a related field 

- Spanish language skills are mandatory due to regular interactions with Spanish-speaking clients and stakeholders 

- Strong knowledge of industry standards, trends in data products, data quality, data storage and distribution solutions, data governance, and product ownership 

- Excellent negotiation skills when communicating with business and technical stakeholders and aligning needs, capabilities, and technology. 

- Proven experience managing the end-to-end product lifecycle for data-intensive products 

- Strong knowledge of the Wealth Management or Financial Services industry is required 

- Experience with data management tools and query languages (e.g., SQL, Python) 

- Familiarity with data analytics and visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Looker). 

- Knowledge of modern data platforms and cloud environments (e.g., GCP, Azure, Databricks) is an asset 

- Excellent stakeholder management, negotiation, and communication skills 

- Strong ability to explain complex data concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences 

- Creative, self-starting, and results-oriented with a strong ability to solve complex problems 

- Proven ability to balance strategic vision with practical, hands-on execution 

 Location(s):  Canada : Ontario : Toronto
