workday:unitytech/Unity:JOBREQ-2616621.description:
The opportunity 

 Unity powers the majority of top mobile games and underpins real-time 3D experiences in nearly every country on earth. When studios and developers decide how to build, ship, and monetize, Unity is usually what they choose. The tools we build shape what the entire industry can make. 

 Product marketing at Unity spans the engine developers build in, the services they use to ship and operate live games, the ecosystem of tools and partners around them, and the AI capabilities now being built into all of it. Each of those reaches a technical audience that evaluates claims carefully and has little patience for marketing that outruns the product. 
 We are looking for an experienced product marketer to take on a defined body of that work on a contract basis. You will pick up a product area or a set of launches, own the marketing for it end to end, and produce work that ships. This is a role for someone who can arrive with limited context, ask the right questions quickly, and start producing positioning, launch plans and enablement material without waiting to be told how. 

 Scope of the engagement 

- Duration: initial engagement of 1yr, with the possibility of extension based on business need. 

- Location: fully remote or near one of our many hub locations: NYC, SF, MTV, MTL, etc . We ask for meaningful working-hour overlap with US time zones, since product and marketing reviews run on that clock. 

- Commitment: full-time equivalent hours for the duration of the engagement. 

 What you'll be doing 

- Positioning and narrative — Own the positioning and messaging for the product areas assigned to you. Translate technical capability into obvious workflow value, and write the narrative that Sales, Community and Content all work from. 

- Go-to-market execution — Lead go-to-market for launches, betas and feature rollouts: tiering, audience targeting, channel plan, enablement and launch-day execution, followed by an honest read on what worked. 

- Audience definition — Define precisely who a product is for, from indie creators to technical directors, and document it clearly enough that other teams can act on it without reinterpreting it. 

- Developer credibility — Developers are inherently skeptical of marketing claims, and increasingly so of AI claims. Write messaging that earns credibility with practitioners rather than hyping past them, working with Community and DevRel to meet developers where the real discussions happen. 

- Competitive and market intelligence — Track the relevant landscape and turn market shifts into sharp positioning and usable sales material. 

- Voice of the customer — Turn forum threads, interviews and community feedback into signal that product and marketing teams can actually use. 

- Enablement and content — Equip Sales, Success and Support with pitch decks, battlecards and objection handling. Partner with Content marketing on launch assets and developer-facing material. 

- Partner and ecosystem marketing — Where an initiative involves third-party tools or platform partners, drive the joint go-to-market and co-marketing motion. 

- Measurement — Work with Product and Analytics to define what success looks like for each launch in advance, and report against it afterwards. 

 What we're looking for 

- 7-9 years in product marketing or go-to-market roles , with a clear track record of owning a product line or a major launch end to end. 

- Game production fluency — a background in games, or a deep grasp of modern development pipelines and creator workflows. Strongly preferred. 

- Proven experience marketing to technical audiences such as developers, engineers or technical artists, and the credibility to win over users whose default posture is skepticism. 

- Exceptional writing. You can turn complex technology into a crisp, obvious narrative across a launch page, a keynote section, a battlecard or a Slack thread with engineers. 

- Independent operator. Contract engagements come with less context and less standing than a permanent role. You need to be comfortable getting yourself oriented, driving work forward across teams you have just met, and producing finished artifacts rather than waiting for direction. 

- High comfort with ambiguity , including early-stage products where the strategy is still moving and the roadmap shifts underneath you. 

- Strong data literacy. You can set the right metrics, read performance signals honestly, and change course on evidence. 

- Strong with AI tools such as Claude Code, Gemini or similar, and a practical sense of how to use them to move faster without letting the output go out unchecked. 

 Nice to have 

- Platform and ecosystem go-to-market — experience marketing developer platforms, game engines, SDKs or plugin ecosystems. 

- Direct experience with AI or ML products , and the technical judgment to tell a production-ready capability from a good demo. 

- Hands-on creation experience — you have shipped something in Unity or a comparable real-time creation tool. 

- Partner co-marketing — a track record running joint go-to-market motions with major technology partners. 

- Category creation — experience taking a product through a market shift and educating users on a new way of working. 

- Prior contract or consulting experience inside a large matrixed organisation, where you have had to be effective without formal authority. 

 Base Salary Range: We determine the base salary range for this role based on your primary work location: 

 Zone A: $72.12 – $90.14 USD/hour
 Zone B: $81.25 – $103.37 USD/hour
 Zone C: $91.59 – $114.47 USD/hour

 Cette fourchette correspond au salaire de base prévu pour ce poste. En plus du salaire de base, ce poste peut donner droit à des attributions d’actions et à une participation à nos programmes d’incitation de l’entreprise, comme des primes annuelles discrétionnaires ou des commissions de vente. Le montant final de l’offre dépendra de plusieurs facteurs, notamment l’emplacement géographique ainsi que l’expérience pertinente, le parcours professionnel et les compétences du/de la candidat(e).

 This range reflects the anticipated base salary for this position. Beyond base salary, this role may be eligible for equity awards and participation in our company incentive plans (such as annual discretionary bonuses or sales commissions). The final offer amount will depend on several factors, including geographic location and the candidate’s relevant experience, professional background, and skill set. 
 Avantages 

 Chez Unity, nous voulons que nos membres d’équipe s’épanouissent. Nous offrons un large éventail d’avantages conçus pour soutenir le bien-être et l’équilibre travail-vie personnelle.

 Veuillez noter: L’admissibilité aux avantages, les offres spécifiques et la couverture varient selon le pays et le statut d’emploi.

 Bien que les avantages précis puissent varier, voici certaines des façons dont nous nous efforçons de prendre soin de nos membres d’équipe admissibles à l’échelle mondiale : assurance santé, vie et invalidité complète | Subvention pour les déplacements | Participation des employés à l’actionnariat | Régimes de retraite/pension compétitifs | Vacances et congés personnels généreux | Soutien aux nouveaux parents grâce à des congés et des programmes de soutien aux familles | Collations offertes au bureau | Programmes et soutien en matière de santé mentale et de bien-être | Groupes-ressources pour employés | Programme mondial d’aide aux employés | Programmes de formation et de perfectionnement | Programme de bénévolat et de jumelage de dons
 La vie chez Unity 

 Unity [NYSE : U] est le premier moteur de jeu au monde, propulsant les expériences de plus de 3 milliards d’utilisateurs(rices) chaque mois. Les plus grands jeux mobiles, les titres indépendants PC les plus populaires, des jeux console parmi les plus innovants, ainsi que la quasi-totalité des principales expériences XR et jeux Web sont développés, déployés et optimisés avec Unity.

 Unity accompagne également des équipes dans des secteurs tels que l’automobile, l’industrie manufacturière et la santé pour concevoir, simuler et collaborer en 3D - comblant ainsi l’écart entre les idées et la réalité. Pour plus d’informations, veuillez visiter www.unity.com .

 Unity est un employeur fier de garantir l’égalité des chances. Nous nous engageons à favoriser un environnement inclusif et innovateur et à célébrer nos employés à travers l’âge, l’éthinicité, la couleur, l’ascendance, l’origine nationale, la religion, le handicap, le sexe, l’identité ou l’expression de genre, l’orientation sexuelle ou tout autre statut protégé conformément à la loi applicable. Si vous êtes en situation de handicap ou avez des besoins spécifiques nécessitant des aménagements pour que votre entretien se déroule dans les meilleures conditions, nous vous invitons à remplir ce formulaire afin de nous en informer et que nous puissions faire le nécessaire. 

 Ce poste exige que son ou sa titulaire possède une connaissance de l’anglais qui soit suffisante pour lui permettre d’avoir des échanges professionnels verbaux et écrits dans cette langue, puisque l’accomplissement des tâches liées à ce poste nécessite des communications fréquentes et régulières avec des collègues et partenaire situés à l’échelle mondiale et dont la langue commune est l’anglais. 

 Les chasseurs de têtes et les agences de recrutement ne peuvent pas soumettre résumes/CV par ce site Web ou directement aux superviseurs. Unity n’accepte pas des chasseurs de têtes non sollicités et des résumés (CV) d’agence. Unity ne payera pas d’honoraires à aucune agence tierce ou entreprise qui n’a pas signé d’ententes avec Unity. 

 La protection de votre vie privée est importante pour nous. Veuillez prendre un moment pour consulter nos politiques de confidentialité pour les prospects et les candidats . Si vous avez des questions concernant la protection de votre vie privée, veuillez nous contacter à DPO@unity.com. 
 Benefits 

 At Unity, we want our team members to thrive. We offer a wide range of benefits designed to support well-being and work-life balance.

 Please note: Benefits eligibility, specific offerings, and coverage vary based on the country and employment status.

 While specific benefits vary, here are some of the ways we strive to take care of our eligible team members globally: Comprehensive health, life, and disability insurance | Commute subsidy | Employee stock ownership | Competitive retirement/pension plans | Generous vacation and personal days | Support for new parents through leave and family-care programs | Office food snacks | Mental Health and Wellbeing programs and support | Employee Resource Groups | Global Employee Assistance Program | Training and development programs | Volunteering and donation matching program

 Unity [NYSE: U] is the world’s leading game engine, powering play for more than 3 billion consumers each month. The top mobile games in the world, the most played PC indie titles, the most innovative console games, and virtually all of the top XR and Web Games are developed, deployed, and grown in Unity. Unity also enables teams across industries like automotive, manufacturing, and healthcare to design, simulate, and collaborate in 3D — closing the gap between ideas and reality. workday:unitytech/Unity:JOBREQ-2616436.description:
À titre de gestionnaire de produit technique Staff chez Unity , vous ferez partie de l'équipe de gestion de produit de la plateforme, avec un accent particulier sur les systèmes et les fonctionnalités qui permettent de déployer les capacités d'Unity dans l'écosystème mobile, afin d'offrir aux développeur(se)s une expérience fluide et de grande qualité sur chaque appareil visé. Il s'agit d'un rôle Sénior qui pilote la feuille de route de la plateforme mobile, touchant à l'optimisation de la performance, à l'expansion multiplateforme et aux outils destinés à la communauté des développeur(se)s. Vous serez intégré(e) au sein de nos équipes de développement, où vous recueillerez des données et des commentaires détaillés afin d'orienter nos feuilles de route, tout en dégageant une vision claire de l'utilisation par la clientèle, de la demande pour les fonctionnalités déployées, de celles en cours de développement, ainsi que des futurs axes de croissance.

 Ce que vous ferez 

- Piloter la feuille de route de la plateforme mobile en déterminant les investissements requis pour permettre aux développeur(se)s de lancer des jeux performants et de haute qualité sur l'ensemble du matériel mobile.

- Collaborer étroitement avec la clientèle et les gestionnaires de produit de la plateforme pour cerner de nouveaux besoins, définir les exigences relatives aux fonctionnalités et valider celles en cours de développement.

- Négocier avec les partenaires de plateforme et harmoniser les orientations afin qu'Unity conserve une longueur d'avance sur les changements de plateforme et l'arrivée de nouvelles catégories d'appareils.

- Traduire des feuilles de route hautement techniques en récits stratégiques destinés aux dirigeant(e)s et aux publics externes, tout en assurant le lien entre les équipes de plateforme d'Unity afin que les enjeux transversaux soient soulevés, harmonisés et planifiés adéquatement.

 Ce que nous recherchons 

- -Une expérience en gestion de produit technique acquise dans le lancement d'outils complexes destinés aux développeur(se)s ou de produits au niveau du système d'exploitation, ou de solides bases en développement logiciel ou en création de jeux vidéo, voire une combinaison des deux.

- Une excellente maîtrise des plateformes mobiles, incluant une solide compréhension des cycles de vie du développement logiciel, des API et de l'abstraction matérielle, avec une expertise reconnue sur Android.

- Des antécédents éprouvés d'influence auprès de la haute direction, de gestion des interdépendances organisationnelles complexes et de relations avec de multiples parties prenantes.

- De solides compétences en communication technique et la capacité de transformer les commentaires et les demandes de la clientèle en besoins sous-jacents et en objectifs plus larges, tout en formulant des concepts complexes de façon claire et concise pour les collaborateur(rice)s non technique(s).

- De solides capacités analytiques et une expérience avec les outils d'analyse de données, ainsi qu'une empathie démontrée envers les utilisateur(rice)s et une prise de décision fondée sur les données.

 Atouts additionnels 

- Une expérience pratique du lancement d'un jeu ou d'une application interactive à l'aide d'Unity, ou d'autres outils de développement 3D en temps réel.

- Une expérience en profilage et en optimisation de la performance sur du matériel mobile.

 Échelle salariale de base 
 Nous déterminons l'échelle salariale de base pour ce poste en fonction de votre lieu de travail principal :
 Zone A : 153 000 $ CA – 229 600 $ CA (brut)

- Technical product management experience shipping complex developer tools or OS-level products, or a strong engineering or game development background in combination.

At Varicent, we’re not just transforming the Sales Performance Management (SPM) market—we’re redefining how organizations achieve revenue success. Our cutting-edge SaaS solutions empower revenue leaders globally to design smarter go-to-market strategies, maximize seller performance, and unlock untapped potential. Varicent stands at the forefront of innovation, celebrated as a market leader in the  2025 Forrester Wave Report for SPM ,  2023 Ventana Research Revenue Performance Management (RPM) Value Index ,  Gartner Peer Insights ,  2024 Gartner SPM Market Guide , and  G2.  Our solutions are trusted by a diverse range of global industry leaders like T-Mobile, ServiceNow, Wawanesa Bank, Shaw Industries, Moody's, Stryker and hundreds more. Here’s why you’ll thrive at Varicent:

- Innovate with Purpose: Build impactful solutions for customers worldwide. 

- Join Excellence: Work in a diverse, collaborative, and innovative team. 

- Shape the Future: Lead in redefining revenue optimization. 

- Grow Together: Unlock your potential in a supportive environment. 

 Join us at Varicent—where your talent and ambition meet limitless opportunities for success!

 Summary of the Role and Team 

 As Director of Deal Desk & Pricing, you will lead and scale Varicent's Deal Desk function, serving as the central authority for deal governance, pricing operations, quote-to-booking processes, and commercial execution. You'll work closely with Sales, Customer Success, Renewals, Finance, Legal, Product, and Revenue Operations to drive pricing accuracy, data integrity, operational efficiency, and compliance throughout the customer lifecycle. This role combines strategic leadership with hands-on execution — you'll establish the processes, governance frameworks, systems alignment, and team structure that enable scalable growth. This is a people leadership role: you'll manage and grow Deal Desk professionals while improving deal velocity, profitability, forecasting accuracy, and operational excellence.

 What You Will Be Doing 

- Lead and develop the Deal Desk team, including coaching, performance management, capacity planning, and workload prioritization.

- Establish and run Deal Desk operating processes: deal intake, approvals, escalations, service-level expectations, and stakeholder communications.

- Own quote-to-booking governance for new business, renewals, expansions, and cross-sell opportunities, ensuring pricing accuracy and policy compliance.

- Work with Sales and Customer Success on deal structuring, pricing decisions, exception management, and commercial approvals.

- Maintain data integrity and system alignment across Salesforce, CPQ platforms, pricing tools, and related commercial systems.

- Partner with Finance on forecasting activities, revenue recognition requirements, commercial risk assessments, and audit readiness.

- Build and maintain governance frameworks, policies, documentation, and enablement resources that drive consistent business practices.

- Lead process improvement and change management initiatives to reduce deal cycle times and improve scalability and reporting quality.

 What You Bring 

- Demonstrated expertise in Deal Desk, Pricing, Revenue Operations, Commercial Operations, FP&A, Commercial Finance, or related business functions (typically gained over 10–12+ years)

- Experience leading teams, programs, or cross-functional operational functions (typically 5+ years)

- Experience with complex B2B sales motions, including new business, renewals, expansions, and cross-sell transactions

- Expertise in Deal Desk operations, pricing governance, quote-to-booking workflows, commercial approvals, and process design

- Experience working with Salesforce, DealHub CPQ, or comparable CPQ/CRM platforms

- Solid grasp of how pricing structures, commercial terms, ACV, and contract structures impact forecasting and revenue recognition

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a track record of using operational data to improve business processes and decisions

- Ability to influence senior stakeholders across Sales, Finance, Legal, Customer Success, Product, and Revenue Operations

 Success Outcomes 

 First 90 Days 

- Build a working understanding of Varicent's pricing structure, commercial processes, systems landscape, and quote-to-booking workflows.

- Establish strong relationships with Sales, Customer Success, Finance, Legal, Product, and Revenue Operations stakeholders.

- Assess current Deal Desk processes, governance controls, approval workflows, and reporting capabilities.

- Identify opportunities to improve deal execution efficiency, data quality, and process consistency.

 Within 6 Months 

- Roll out clear governance frameworks, approval structures, and operational standards across the Deal Desk function.

- Raise quote quality, pricing accuracy, and first-pass approval rates while cutting rework and processing delays.

- Set up consistent forecasting workflows with Finance using Deal Desk insights and commercial data.

- Strengthen data integrity and alignment across Salesforce, CPQ platforms, pricing tools, and related systems.

- Develop scalable team operating rhythms and performance metrics aligned to business objectives.

 Within 12 Months 

- Position Deal Desk as a go-to strategic partner across Go-To-Market, Finance, and Executive teams.

- Show measurable gains in deal cycle times, pricing governance, compliance, and forecasting accuracy.

- Deliver scalable quote-to-booking processes that support growth while maintaining strong controls and audit readiness.

- Build a high-performing Deal Desk organization with clear accountability and operational excellence.

- Create a sustainable operating model that supports revenue growth, profitability objectives, and commercial scalability.

workday:visa/Visa:REF087532W.description:
About Us 
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

 At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

 Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

 Job Description 

 Commercial and Money Movement Solutions (CMS) represents a key strategic growth area for Visa globally as we expand beyond consumer payments into business payments and broader money movement flows among individuals, businesses and governments. As part of our suite of solutions, including Visa Commercial Solutions, Visa Direct, Visa B2B Connect and Visa Cross-Border Solutions, Visa offers payment services that help clients, including issuers, fintechs, acquirers, processors, merchants and service providers, facilitate payment and money movement between accounts, cards and digital wallets in Canada and around the world.   

 The Senior Manager, Strategy & Operations will support the VP, Head of Commercial & Money Movement Solutions (CMS) for Visa Canada and the CMS Canada leadership team in driving growth planning, strategic initiatives, performance management and business operations for this high-growth business in Canada. This role will help translate CMS priorities into clear plans, operating rhythms, reporting, insights and execution support across the Canadian business.   

 Operating in a matrixed environment, this role will work closely with teams across Visa Canada and North America, including Visa Commercial Solutions, Visa Money Movement Solutions, Real-Time Payments, Open Banking, sales, product, client consulting, marketing, corporate communications, legal, finance, risk and other functional partners. Strong organizational skills, analytical capability and interpersonal effectiveness are critical, as this role helps coordinate cross-functional activities and support alig nment against CMS Canada's business objectives.   

 The ideal candidate will be able to quickly build subject matter depth across a range of payments, commercial and money movement topics, synthesize qualitative and quantitative information, and translate analysis into practical insights and recommendations for leadership. The role requires strong analytical and critical thinking skills, comfort working through ambiguity, and the ability to manage multiple workstreams while maintaining attention to detail and execution discipline.   

 Best-suited candidates will be clear communicators, highly collaborative, self-motivated, analytical and comfortable working with stakeholders from a diversity of backgrounds. The Senior Manager will be expected to support strategy development, operating cadence, executive reporting, business planning and priority initiatives that help CMS Canada continue to grow and operate effectively.   

 Essential Functions   

 Financial Management & Scorecard Reporting   

- Support CMS Canada management reporting including scorecards, dashboards, financial reporting, business performance updates and strategic initiative tracking.   

- Track budgets, contractual commitments and key business metrics in partnership with Finance and business owners, identifying risks, gaps and areas requiring leadership attention.   

- Maintain reporting discipline and data quality by coordinating inputs, validating information and ensuring timely updates through appropriate tools and processes, including Dynamics where applicable.   

 Sales Enablement & Operations   

- Support core sales operations activities including client engagement survey reporting, action planning, client event coordination and management of priority sponsorship assets for client engagement.   

- Partner with sales and product teams to organize client-facing priorities, track follow-ups, prepare materials and help ensure key initiatives move from planning to execution.   

- Help improve operating processes by identifying friction points, documenting requirements and recommending practical ways to improve speed, visibility and accountability.   

 Annual Planning Process   

- Support annual business planning for CMS Canada including planning calendars, inputs, goal setting, objective tracking, scorecard development and coordination of annual account sales plans.   

- Prepare analysis and materials to support leadership discussions on priorities, resources, performance expectations and growth opportunities.   

- Coordinate planning inputs across functions and help ensure alignment with Canada market priorities and North America CMS planning requirements.   

 Strategic Initiatives & PMO Support   

- Lead or support workstreams for CMS Canada strategic initiatives including project plans, milestones, risks, dependencies, business cases, analysis and action plans.   

- Act as PMO support for priority initiatives by tracking progress, coordinating stakeholders, surfacing issues and ensuring follow-through against agreed actions.   

- Develop fact-based analysis and recommendations to support strategic and financial soundness, including quantitative analysis, market context and stakeholder input.   

 Strategic Alignment with Functional Partners   

- Collaborate with Marketing, Communications, Government Relations and other functional teams to support external presence strategy across CMS business lines, including industry events, speaking opportunities, client forums and market-facing materials.   

- Facilitate alignment with internal strategy and operations partners including Canada market teams and North America functional groups across Visa Commercial Solutions, Visa Direct, Consumer Payments and related teams.   

- Support operating rhythms and governance that help CMS Canada leadership make timely decisions, manage priorities and maintain cross-functional accountability.   

 Insights & Thought Leadership Development   

- Generate data-driven insights by analyzing Visa data, market reports, benchmarks and internal performance information to identify opportunities, risks and trends.   

- Monitor payments industry developments and competitor strategies and develop executive summaries or strategic responses that inform CMS Canada priorities.   

- Support quarterly strategy, planning and operations reviews by developing clear, concise and leadership-ready analysis, narratives and presentation materials.   

 CMS Canada Narrative & Executive Materials   

- Support development of internal and external leadership materials including senior executive briefings, Visa Canada Advisory Board content, client quarterly business reviews, industry forum presentations and strategic updates.   

- Translate complex topics into clear business narratives that connect CMS Canada strategy, performance, market context and client priorities.   

- Maintain a consistent CMS Canada narrative across planning, reporting, leadership forums and priority communications.   

 Team Culture & Operational Effectiveness   

- Support CMS Canada team culture and engagement activities including team-wide communications, operating meetings, engagement initiatives, recruiting process support and priority event coordination.   

- Track progress against key operational initiatives and help ensure actions, owners and timelines are clear across the CMS Canada team.

ashby:visier:d4cbef2a-5935-4ac4-9ae9-449.description:
Visier is the global leader in Workforce Intelligence that powers every people decision. We bring Workforce AI to life for HR departments through our award-winning, agentic AI technology by surfacing the insights leaders need to plan, decide, and act with confidence in the moments that matter most. As the market leader in people analytics, workforce planning, organizational design, and manager effectiveness solutions, we fuel smarter decision-making for organizations across the globe. Our mission is to help businesses lead with insight at scale as they continuously transform.

Founded in 2010 by the pioneers of business intelligence, we have over 85,000 customers in 75 countries—including enterprises like BASF, Panasonic, Domino’s Pizza, Experian, Amgen, eBay, and Ford Motor Company.


POSITION OVERVIEW



As the Privacy and AI Program Manager, you will operationalize the evolution of our privacy program to encompass the rapidly changing landscape of artificial intelligence. You will embed responsible AI, Privacy by Design, and data protection across our SaaS development lifecycle, directly enabling our strategic shift toward outcomes-based selling. By acting as the operational bridge between legal, product, security, and our customers, you ensure our data practices build the trust required to accelerate deal velocity and drive measurable business impact.

You are a seasoned privacy enabler who thrives on simplifying complexity for diverse stakeholders, ensuring our customers feel confident in our data governance. You will use your deep domain expertise in global privacy and AI regulations to protect our business while empowering our sales and product teams to move fast and win.





WHAT YOU WILL DELIVER:

 - Outcomes-Based Sales Enablement: Accelerate the sales cycle and drive revenue by clearly articulating our privacy posture and AI governance to enterprise prospects, directly supporting our transition to outcomes-based selling.

 - EU AI Act & Global Compliance: Operationalize strategic readiness for the EU AI Act and other emerging global AI regulations, translating complex legislative requirements into actionable product standards.

 - Automated Decision Making Governance: Establish and maintain robust frameworks for transparency, fairness, and human oversight in automated decision-making processes, mitigating bias and ensuring compliance with evolving data protection laws.

 - Responsible AI Integration: Partner internally to conduct Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIAs) and review AI use cases, identifying risks early in the software development lifecycle.

 - Data Subject Protection & Trust: Champion the continuous privacy and protection of data subjects across both Visier's internal employee workforce and the millions of employees represented within our customers' data. With a customer base that includes a significant portion of the Fortune 1000 and major multinationals, you will ensure our data governance strategies provide uncompromising security, ethical handling, and compliance for highly sensitive information at global scale.
   
    


WHAT YOU WILL BRING TO THE TABLE:

 - Education & Experience: 4+ years of blended experience managing global privacy programs (GDPR, CCPA) within a B2B Enterprise SaaS environment, including direct exposure to AI/ML data governance.

 - Commercial Muscle: A proven track record of supporting enterprise sales and renewal cycles by translating complex privacy controls into customer-facing value and trust.

 - Regulatory Competency: Core understanding of current data protection laws and emerging frameworks (including the EU AI Act and automated decision making legislation), with the ability to operationalize these rules without slowing down the pace of development.

 - Technical Fluency: Solid understanding of data flows, cloud infrastructure, and AI models, enabling you to confidently collaborate with engineering teams on system design.

 - Cross-Functional Influence: Strong communication skills geared toward building productive working relationships with technical, legal, and commercial stakeholders.

 - Agile Problem Solving: A scrappy, roll-up-your-sleeves mentality with a proven track record of finding practical, scalable solutions to novel compliance challenges.
   
    



Benefits and working arrangements may vary depending on your seniority, location and employment type. The compensation offered will be determined by factors such as relevant qualifications, experience, knowledge and skills. Many of our positions are eligible for additional compensation such as commission or bonus plans. Your Talent Acquisition partner will walk through the details if you interview for the role.



AI in Hiring
As a people analytics company, we think carefully about how AI is used in decisions that affect people, including our own. Our Talent Acquisition team uses AI tools to help review resumes and application responses, so every candidate's application is assessed quickly and consistently against the role's requirements. AI may also assist with scheduling and summarizing interview notes. These tools support our team; they don't replace it. Every hiring decision at Visier is made by a person, not an algorithm.


How you prepare is up to you, and there's no issue with using AI as a helpful tool along the way. What matters most to us is that what you share, whether in your application or in conversation with us, reflects your own real experience and skills. We ask that live interviews be AI-free, so we can get to know how you communicate, think through problems, and describe the work you've actually done. We reserve the right to end the interview early if candidate fraud is suspected.


If you have questions about how AI is used in our process or how your data is handled, review our Visier Candidate Privacy Notice https://www.visier.com/candidate-privacy-notice-and-recruiter-policy/ or reach out to us.

lever:waabi:74ff3e1c-821c-4c31-aada-54f4.description:
Waabi, founded by AI visionary Raquel Urtasun, is the leader in Physical AI. With a world-class team, we're unlocking the next era of autonomous transportation with technology that's powering commercial autonomous trucks and robotaxis. Waabi is backed by and partners with world leaders in AI, automotive, logistics, and deep tech.
 
With offices in Toronto, San Francisco, Dallas, and Pittsburgh, Waabi is growing quickly and looking for diverse, innovative and collaborative candidates who want to impact the world in a positive way. To learn more visit: www.waabi.ai


We are seeking a Product Manager to lead product definition for the hardware platform that carries the Waabi Driver, across autonomous trucks and robotaxi. This is our first dedicated hardware product role, and it requires someone who is grounded in hardware: a product leader who can turn the needs of autonomy, safety, operations, riders, and the public into clear requirements, and who knows enough about hardware to tell an ambitious idea from an impossible one. You will sit at the line between requirements and implementation, laying out scenarios, testing ideas in mock-ups and vehicles, partnering with hardware engineering on high-level solutions, and representing product with our OEM and supplier partners until the product is right end-to-end.
You will...
Own product requirements for Waabi's hardware platform across trucks and robotaxi, turning field and integration feedback into requirements for future revisions and new vehicle platforms.
Define how our vehicles interact with the people around them, including riders, law enforcement, first responders, and the public. This covers exterior communication and signaling, cabin monitoring and security, in-cabin safety, and resilience to tampering and vandalism.
Lead product definition for new hardware programs before engineering kickoff, turning real-world scenarios into requirements with clear acceptance criteria and a plan to verify and validate each one.
Bring an industrial design and human factors perspective to physical touchpoints like displays, lighting, reach, and controls, and validate them hands-on in mock-ups and real vehicles.
Build trusted relationships with OEM and supplier partners, understanding their constraints and processes and keeping requirements aligned across organizations.
Represent hardware credibly in cross-functional product decisions about what's possible, what's costly, and what's out of scope.
Qualifications:
A hardware background, through an engineering degree (mechanical, electrical, systems, or similar) or equivalent hands-on experience, deep enough to earn engineering teams' trust while you work at the requirements level.
8+ years of experience in product management, hardware product, or systems engineering roles on physical products, ideally in automotive, autonomous vehicles, robotics, or complex consumer hardware.
A track record of taking hardware from concept to production, with an understanding of how requirements evolve across prototype and sample stages.
Industrial design experience, through formal training or close work with industrial designers on shipped products, and strong instincts for HMI and human factors.
Strong requirements writing skills. You can turn a messy real-world scenario into a clear, testable requirement, with acceptance criteria and a verification method such as test, analysis, inspection, or demonstration.
Experience building working relationships with OEMs and suppliers, and an understanding of how they develop, source, and deliver hardware.
A commitment to trust, transparency, and honesty in a safety-critical environment.
Willingness to be on site regularly for mock-ups, vehicle evaluations, and testing.
Bonus/nice to have:
Experience on autonomous vehicles or robotaxi, especially rider experience, external communication with road users, or first responder interaction.
Familiarity with automotive development processes such as APQP, PPAP, and A/B/C sample phases.
Exposure to functional safety and AV safety standards such as ISO 26262, SOTIF (ISO 21448), or UL 4600, or to vehicle regulations.

Define and maintain the integrated robotaxi program plan — key milestones, cross-team dependencies, and critical path — spanning autonomy, vehicle hardware, safety/V&V, fleet operations, and commercial launch readiness.

Build and run executive reporting — concise, credible updates on program status, risk, and path-to-green for leadership.

Establish scalable processes and tooling for robotaxi program tracking, ensuring a single source of truth as the program and fleet scale.
Represent the robotaxi program in cross-company planning, ensuring it's properly sequenced against Waabi's trucking roadmap and shared platform investments.
Qualifications:
10+ years of technical program management experience, with a track record leading complex, cross-functional technical programs from ambiguity to delivery.
Direct experience in autonomous vehicles, robotics, or another safety-critical, deeply cross-functional environment spanning hardware, software, and safety.
Demonstrated ability to build program structure from scratch — dependency maps, risk registers, executive reporting, milestone tracking — in a fast-moving, early-stage environment.
Strong technical fluency across hardware, software, and autonomy/ML domains — able to ask the right questions and spot a false dependency without being a domain expert in any one area.
Excellent written and verbal communication; comfortable writing a crisp one-pager for an executive audience and facilitating a working-level technical review in the same week.
Proven cross-functional leadership without formal authority — you drive alignment and hold teams accountable through influence, not org-chart position.
Hands-on experience with program tracking tools such as Jira, Asana, or other Project Management.
BS or MS in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience.
 
Bonus/Nice to Have:
Proven history executing driverless commercial rollouts, operational domain expansions, or initial market deployments for robotic transport platforms.
Working knowledge of system safety assurance, ODD boundaries, and integrating safety sign-off gates into target deployment schedules.
Track record establishing or scaling continuous fleet management, remote command facilities, or real-time operations centers.
Prior collaboration with policy, legal, and public affairs stakeholders to secure local operating authorizations and permits.
Hands-on application of modern AI solutions to streamline operational tracking, eliminate manual administrative friction, and speed up critical decisions.

lever:waabi:01ee26ae-76e5-41df-a5d1-d03d.description:

Waabi's Commercial Product team defines and delivers the end-to-end commercial product that makes autonomous trucking deployable, scalable, and valuable to customers. We sit between autonomy, operations, business development, and customers, turning driverless capability into a real-world product that can be launched, sold, operated, and scaled.
As Waabi rapidly scales from commercial pilots to large-scale driverless deployments, this role serves as the critical integration layer between truck supply, customer commitments, expansion efforts, site activations, and autonomy capabilities. You will manage the execution of the commercial plan, proactively tracking dependencies and mitigating risks to drive clear commercial progress.
We are hiring a Senior Program Manager to own and align the single integrated commercialization plan, ensuring every element converges seamlessly.
While functional program leads manage their respective areas, you will integrate their milestones into the overarching commercial plan. Success relies on sound judgment: identifying critical dependencies, distinguishing real timeline slips, and resolving decision bottlenecks. A year from now, when leadership asks whether we are on track for a launch, a truck delivery or a customer commitment, the answer should be one page, current, and believed by every team on it.
What You'll Do
You will own the integrated commercialization roadmap for trucking and the weekly operating cadence around it. This includes:
Build and own the integrated roadmap that ties customer commitments, OEM truck supply, autonomy and ODD readiness, lane and site activation, Mission Control, operations readiness and Account Management launches to dates, with the dependencies between them made explicit. You own the plan end to end.

Lead the execution of key company milestones involving multiple departments at Waabi.

lever:waabi:ebe37947-7f32-47f1-bbf8-0ae2.description:
Waabi, founded by AI visionary Raquel Urtasun, is the leader in Physical AI. With a world-class team, we're unlocking the next era of autonomous transportation with technology that's powering commercial autonomous trucks and robotaxis. Waabi is backed by and partners with world leaders in AI, automotive, logistics, and deep tech.
 
With offices in Toronto, San Francisco, Dallas, and Pittsburgh, Waabi is growing quickly and looking for diverse, innovative and collaborative candidates who want to impact the world in a positive way. To learn more visit: www.waabi.ai


Waabi is adding OEM partners, and each partnership needs an engineer who owns the technical integration from program setup to on-road milestones. The Vehicle Program Manager is Waabi's technical face to one OEM partner. They turn company goals into an integrated program plan, align Hardware, Embedded, Onboard, Infra and Autonomy to deliver it, and make sure integration milestones land on schedule. A successful candidate can span the range of executive meetings to in vehicle debugging on the test track. As we scale to more partners, each OEM needs its own dedicated owner, for focus and for partner confidentiality. We are looking for an engineer with breadth across the autonomous capable systems, the ability to go deep, and a curious, startup mindset that speeds up our autonomous vehicle programs.
 
You will...
Own the technical integration of the Waabi Driver with an OEM partner, from program setup through driverless operation.
Be part of a team of multidisciplinary Engineers and Research Scientists using an AI-first approach to enable safe self-driving at scale.
Turn company goals into an integrated program plan with the partner, covering Waabi and OEM deliverables, cross-team dependencies and the critical path.
Balance resources and priorities across Hardware, Embedded, Onboard, Infra and Autonomy, and make trade-off calls when one plan affects another.
Act as Waabi's technical face to the OEM and build trust at every level, from executive reviews to working-level engineering teams.
Go deep when it matters: work with engineers on test vehicles to triage integration issues and drive them to a decision.
Spot risk before it reaches the schedule, bring options with a recommendation, and escalate early and clearly.
Hold Waabi's technical standards with the partner, adapting to how each OEM works and pushing back credibly when needed.
Develop and maintain program reporting for Waabi leadership and partner executive forums

8+ years of engineering experience in vehicle development, autonomous vehicles, ADAS or robotics, including 3+ years leading technical integration programs.
Bachelor's degree or higher in Mechanical, Electrical, Computer or Systems Engineering, or a related technical field.
Breadth across actuation and autonomy system integration (sensors, compute, embedded, and software) and the judgment to weigh trade-offs between them.
Ability to rapidly go deep on a technical issue with engineers, work it to a decision, and return to the program view.
Solid problem solving using dependency mapping, critical-path analysis and risk management, with clear options for leadership.
Strong written and verbal communication, equally effective in an OEM executive review and a test-vehicle debug session.
Comfort with ambiguity and a startup pace: filters signal from noise and adds structure without adding overhead.
Open-minded and collaborative team player with the willingness to help others.
Passionate about self-driving technologies, solving hard problems, and creating innovative solutions.
 
Bonus/nice to have:
Solid understanding of how vehicle OEMs plan, gate, validate and decide, including vehicle programs, DVP&R, V&V and supplier management.
Experience with commercial truck or heavy-duty vehicle platforms.
Hands-on experience with test vehicles, vehicle networks such as CAN, and field issue triage.
Experience with program tools such as Jira, and with AI tools that reduce manual tracking.
Technical experience in developing self-driving vehicles.

ashby:wealthsimple:87df1a4c-b9b9-4080-b1.description:
BUILD SOMETHING PEOPLE LOVE

Wealthsimple is Canada’s leading financial innovator. The company offers a full suite of simple, sophisticated financial products across managed investing, do-it-yourself trading, cryptocurrency, tax filing, spending and saving. Wealthsimple currently serves more than 4 million Canadians and holds over $155 billion in assets under administration. The company was founded in 2014 by a team of financial experts and technology entrepreneurs, and is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.



We're proud of what we've built — and we're just getting started. Read our Culture Manual https://www.wealthsimple.com/en-ca/culture and learn more about how we work https://www.wealthsimple.com/en-ca/careers.




ABOUT THE TEAM

The Financial Risk team is responsible for protecting Wealthsimple and its clients from fraud while enabling safe, fast, and scalable money movement. We own the Decision Platform — a real-time rules engine that processes streaming data to make fraud decisions across every major payment rail — as well as the tooling and automations that power fraud investigation workflows, transaction decisioning, account restrictions, and deposit holds. Our systems are the infrastructure layer that payment and money movement teams plug into to move money safely.




ABOUT THE ROLE

This is a platform PM role with a dual mandate: prevent fraud by building and tuning real-time interventions and decision rules, and enable fraud investigations by building automations and tooling that make our fraud operations team faster and more effective. You'll own a broad surface area — from the streaming decision engine that blocks fraudulent withdrawals in milliseconds, to the case management system that routes alerts to investigators, to the restriction and suspension frameworks that protect compromised accounts.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own the product vision and strategy for the Financial Risk platform, balancing fraud prevention with client experience - every intervention has a cost, and you'll need to make sharp tradeoffs between friction and protection.

 - Drive the roadmap for the Decision Platform, our real-time rules engine that evaluates fraud risk across withdrawals, deposits, e-transfers, crypto transactions, and cheque deposits.

 - Build and improve fraud investigation tooling and automations - including case management workflows, alert deduplication, and enrichment pipelines - that help our fraud operations team investigate and resolve cases faster.

 - Define and evolve the restriction and mitigation framework that enables the right response to fraud signals: suspensions, withdrawal blocks, spend switch blocks, and account-level restrictions.

 - Operate as a platform PM, designing extensible APIs, decision schemas, and integration patterns that payment and money movement teams can reliably plug into as new products and payment rails launch.

 - Partner deeply with Fraud and Data Science teams on fraud model integration, fraud rule development, and the feedback loops that improve detection accuracy over time.

 - Own key risk metrics - fraud loss rates, false positive rates, investigation cycle times, decision latency - and use data to drive prioritization.

 - Break down complex, behind-the-scenes infrastructure projects into discrete phases that deliver value incrementally - this is platform work where the "client" is often another engineering team.
   
   


SKILLS YOU BRING

 - 6-8+ years of product management experience with significant depth in fraud, risk, or trust & safety - you've built fraud prevention systems, investigation tooling, or risk decisioning platforms and understand the cat-and-mouse dynamics of financial fraud.

 - Experience operating as a platform PM: you've built systems that other teams consume, and you know how to balance internal developer experience with business outcomes. You think in APIs, schemas, and extensibility.

 - Strong technical fluency: you can go deep on streaming architectures, workflow orchestration, and ML model integration. You don't need to write code, but you need to reason about system design tradeoffs with engineering.

 - Comfort with breadth: this role spans real-time decisioning, investigation tooling, restrictions infrastructure, and regulatory reporting. You thrive when context-switching across a wide problem space, not when going narrow.

 - Data-driven decision making: you use quantitative analysis to identify fraud patterns, measure intervention effectiveness, and prioritize investments.

 - Experience working with fraud operations teams: you understand investigation workflows, alert triage, case management, and the tooling that makes analysts productive. You've closed the loop between detection and investigation.

 - A shipping mentality: we don't believe in spending forever analyzing and debating. The best way to validate a fraud rule is to ship it, monitor it, and iterate.

 - Strong communication skills: you can translate complex risk and platform concepts for engineering, operations, compliance, and executive stakeholders.

 - Ability to work independently: biasing towards action to drive projects forward across a broad surface area.




WHY WEALTHSIMPLE?

🌸 Top-tier health benefits and life insurance

📈 Long-term group savings with employer match, through Wealthsimple for Business

🌴 20 vacation days, 4 wellness days, and unlimited sick and mental health days per year*

✈️ 90 days away: work outside Canada for up to 90 days per year*

👥 Employee resource groups, including Rainbow (2SLGBTQ), Women of WS, and Black at WS

🌎 We are a hybrid team with over 1,500 employees across North America. The people are one of the best parts of working here: you'll collaborate with incredibly talented, curious, and driven teammates who are deeply committed to doing great work.

*Unlimited paid sick days, Wellness Days and the 90 day away program do not apply to certain roles. 




ICYMI

Technology & Innovation at Wealthsimple: We move quickly and build thoughtfully. That means we're always looking for better ways to work — whether that's new tools, AI, or rethinking how we approach a problem. We don't expect you to have all the answers, but we do expect curiosity and a willingness to evolve alongside the products we're building.



Inclusion Statement: We're building products for a diverse world, and we need a diverse team to do it well. We strongly encourage applications from everyone, regardless of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status.



Accessibility Statement: We're committed to an accessible hiring experience. If you need any accommodations throughout the interview process, please let us know — we'll work with you to make sure you have what you need. We also welcome any feedback on how we can better accommodate candidates with accessibility needs.



AI in Hiring: We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of our hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our team but don't replace human judgment – all final hiring decisions are made by people. If you have questions about how your data is used, reach out to us.

Wealthsimple currently serves more than 4 million Canadians and holds over $155 billion in assets under administration. ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Staff Product Manager to own Wealthsimple’s Connectivity Platform, spanning two critical areas:

 - Brokerage & Bank Linking: How clients securely and reliably connect external financial institutions to Wealthsimple.

 - Public API: How clients and partners securely access and use Wealthsimple financial data outside of Wealthsimple.



Together, these capabilities define how Wealthsimple connects to the broader financial ecosystem, and how every product team inside Wealthsimple builds on the external financial data that flows through it. This role will set the strategy for that platform and turn it into a reliable, scalable and differentiated capability for our clients, our product teams and our partners.



This is a platform role with a meaningful client experience surface. You’ll need to be equally comfortable thinking about APIs, data models and platform architecture as you are designing a client UX or deciding how Wealthsimple should work with an external provider.




ABOUT THE TEAM

The Brokerage & Bank Linking team builds the technology that lets clients link their outside bank and brokerage accounts to Wealthsimple. It owns the automated and manual linking experiences end to end, along with the three connectors behind them: Plaid, Flinks, and WST, our own in-house connector. That makes it one of the highest leverage surfaces in the company, and powers a growing set of experiences built by other product teams.




WHAT YOU’LL OWN

Connectivity Strategy

 - Set the long term vision and strategy for how Wealthsimple connects with the broader financial ecosystem.

 - Define the capabilities we should build ourselves, where we should rely on partners, and where we can create differentiated client value.

 - Develop a roadmap that balances immediate product needs with investments in reusable platform capabilities.

Brokerage & Bank Linking

 - Own the end to end experience for connecting external bank and brokerage accounts to Wealthsimple — automated and manual, including how clients recover when an automated connection fails.

 - Improve connection success, reliability and coverage across institutions, and own the routing strategy that decides which connector handles which institution and flow.

 - Own the client experience, including institution selection, authentication, errors, recovery and connection management.

 - Drive reliability and AI Powered  self-healing so connections detect and recover from failure without manual intervention.

 - Balance conversion against fraud exposure and operational load, making those tradeoffs deliberately with our risk and operations partners.

 - Develop the platform capabilities that allow Wealthsimple products to consume external financial data consistently.

 - Own relationships and product integrations with connectivity vendors such as Plaid and Flinks, and decide where our own connector should lead — including how much of the connector business Wealthsimple should be in long term and where it makes more sense to partner.

Public API

 - Own the strategy and roadmap for Wealthsimple’s Public API and external data connectivity.

 - Make it safe and easy for clients to permission their Wealthsimple financial data to the products and services they choose.

 - Define the platform capabilities required for authentication, consent, permissions, data access and partner integrations.

 - Identify and prioritize the partners and use cases that matter most to Wealthsimple clients.

 - Build toward a world where Wealthsimple is the financial institution where clients have the most control over their financial data.

 - Accelerate wealthsimple and our industry toward open banking.




SKILLS YOU BRING

You’re a strong product thinker who can operate across platform infrastructure, external ecosystems and client experience. You likely have:

 - Experience owning a platform, API, developer product or integrations platform, with a track record on metric-attached outcomes like conversion, success rate or reliability — not only feature delivery.

 - Enough technical depth to work closely with engineers on APIs, authentication, data models, routing and platform architecture.

 - Experience delivering through external vendors or partners whose roadmaps you don’t control, including making thoughtful build versus buy decisions and holding vendors accountable for product outcomes.

 - Comfort treating reliability as product work — error taxonomies, failure recovery, observability, and the operational load a product creates.

 - Experience weighing growth against fraud, risk and compliance, and holding both sides of that tradeoff.

 - The ability to turn a collection of technical capabilities into a clear product strategy and compelling long term vision, and to make the case for investing in it.

 - Strong analytical instincts and comfort using data to understand reliability, conversion, coverage and product performance, including building the measurement where it doesn’t exist yet.

 - Excellent cross functional leadership across Engineering, Design, Security, Legal, Compliance, Operations and external partners.

 - A bias toward simplifying complicated systems rather than layering more complexity on top of them.




NICE TO HAVES

 - Experience with open banking, Canada’s consumer-driven banking framework, or building to a data sharing standard

 - A background in financial data aggregation, whether at an aggregator, a bank, or a fintech consuming one

 - Experience shipping a public API or developer platform as a commercial product, including partner onboarding and support




WHAT GREAT LOOKS LIKE

You won’t just operate Bank Linking and ship API endpoints.



You’ll create a coherent connectivity strategy for Wealthsimple: making it easier for clients to bring their financial life to Wealthsimple, easier to move their financial data where they want it to go, easier for any team at Wealthsimple to build on that data, and increasingly less dependent on the slow pace of connectivity innovation from incumbent financial institutions.



You’ll also have made the case for what this platform should become — the metrics, the roadmap and the investment argument that get it there.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Our team, Consolidation, owns the first mile of the Wealthsimple relationship: onboarding, the homescreen + first layer of the app, and our Tiers program (Premium and Generation). Our job is to get new clients in the door, funded, and consolidating more of their financial life with Wealthsimple.



Our fastest-growing segment this year were high-net-worth clients. We're seeing real organic pull, and continuing to grow net deposits at the rate we have means winning larger, more complex relationships. Clients who today are typically served by private bankers and expect a level of service, product depth, and recognition that we need to meet and then beat.



That's the mandate for this role: continue to expand Wealthsimple’s growth upmarket. It means evolving our Tiers program into something a high-net-worth client would choose over their bank, and it means using what we know about a client to make a sharper, more personal case for bringing the rest of their financial life here. Convincing millions of Canadians to consolidate their financial lives at Wealthsimple is the mission we've been on for over 10 years, and we're looking for someone who can lead the next phase of this work and own it end to end.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Help define the product vision and strategy for how Wealthsimple wins and serves high-net-worth clients, and own the roadmap to bring it to life.

 - Lead the planning, development, launch, and iteration of a step change in our Tiers program. The service, product depth, and recognition that makes a client choose us as their primary financial institution.

 - Build the personalized experiences that compel clients to consolidate: understanding a client's current financial life and making the case, in-product, for moving it to Wealthsimple.

 - Working across the funding and consolidation funnel end to end, from a client's first session through to a fully consolidated relationship. Crafting the right incentives, onboarding journey, and product experiences along the way.

 - Support a cross-functional team of engineers, designers, and data scientists as we collectively explore new ways of working.

 - Partner deeply with other product teams and departments across the company (e.g. Marketing, Operations, Client Experience, Legal and Compliance, and more). You'll own a meaningful piece of this directly and influence a much larger piece through others.

 - A bias to ship. We don't do endless debate. The fastest way to know if something works is to put it in front of clients — so we ship, learn, and iterate.

 - Enough technical fluency to keep up with engineers — you can talk architecture and tradeoffs, and you're hungry to learn what you don't know yet so you can make better calls.

 - A real belief in financial inclusion — you want to build things that give more people access to financial freedom, not fewer.

 - Bonus: Experience building, shipping, iterating and growing products from 0 to 1 over multiple years. We know building new client experiences that client love will require a sustained multi-year effort.

 - A strong technical partner. You work hand-in-hand with engineering to turn a logical design into a real technical architecture.

 - Comfortable in the grey. You can take raw, messy data (qualitative or quantitative) and pull out the actual problem, the real insight, the requirement that matters.

Your work days are brighter here. 

 We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.

 About the Team 
The Intelligent Experience Platform (IXP) team builds technology that powers a unified, intelligent, and seamless user experience across the Workday ecosystem. As part of Core Services within Workday's Platform organization, IXP delivers the foundational layers that every Workday application and agent is built on and every user interacts with. Through data-driven insights, cutting-edge technology, and strong cross-functional collaboration, the team multiplies the impact of every application team by delivering scalable, user-centric solutions and a cohesive, agent-ready foundation essential to Workday's next era of innovation. We are passionate about bringing industry-leading solutions to life while putting our people first—embracing new challenges with courage, and staying committed to delivering exceptional value for our customers. 
 About the Role 

This is a defining leadership role at the intersection of enterprise strategy and AI innovation. As a Senior Principal Product Manager for the Intelligent Experience Platform (IXP), you will serve as the strategic visionary and product authority for the platform powering Workday’s next generation user and agentic experiences. You will have deep expertise in core UI/UX platform technologies that deliver modern scalable experiences to 10s of millions of users. This is a chance to shape how the world's largest organizations leverage AI and Workday to drive measurable business value.

In this role, you will be responsible for:

Building and executing product strategy for a mission-critical platform, ensuring a highly-governed, scalable, and user-centric environment where AI agents and multiple surfaces deliver complex business actions with precision on high-fidelity enterprise data. 
Defining long-term product roadmaps and product success metrics that effectively capture the needs of our various stakeholders; creating IXP OKRs as needed and aligning these metrics to company-wide OKRs
Aligning the IXP strategic vision to the Platform, Product & Technology, and Workday-wide strategic visions and priorities, and creating a compelling and motivating narrative for IXP and the platform we are building.
Driving strategic alignment across high-stakes business domains and leading cross-functional efforts within IXP and with Platform partners —uniting engineering, design, cross-Workday teams to deliver transformative user-interface interactions across every Workday surface.
Managing and orchestrating required workstreams to achieve product milestones and customer needs, resolving ambiguity on product direction and serving as the ultimate product authority. 
 About You 

 Basic Qualifications  

- 10+ years of experience as a product management leader, conceiving, defining, and delivering transformative SaaS and/or (cloud-based) enterprise software products with market impact. 

- Bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline such as Business, Computer Science, or a related discipline; a Master's degree preferred or equivalent practical experience. 

 Other Qualifications 

- Exceptional ability to exert significant Business Influence across the organization and with external partners, driving strategic alignment and securing buy-in for major product initiatives. 

- Mastery in leading Cross-Team Collaboration, effectively working with and influencing Engineering, UX Design, Data Science, alongside executive stakeholders, to synchronize roadmaps and deliver unified, cross-functional initiatives to define and deliver complex, cross-functional product strategies and initiatives. 

- Proven ability to be a visionary Customer Advocate, deeply understanding and anticipating customer needs in product strategy and decisions, and driving a customer-obsessed culture throughout the organization through defining long-term customer experience principles and embedding customer-centricity directly into the platform architecture and agentic product vision. 

- Deep mastery of Customer Empathy, proactively identifying fundamental customer pain points and translating them into transformative product strategies and innovative user experiences by conducting deep-dive qualitative research, analyzing user sentiment across enterprise workflows, and mapping complex user journeys to uncover latent needs. 

- Exceptional skills in Data Analysis, using advanced product analytics, predictive modeling techniques, and A/B testing methodologies to inform product strategy, prioritize feature backlogs, and measure platform success through actionable KPIs to derive critical insights for shaping product strategy, driving prioritization at an organizational level, and establishing key performance indicators for long-term success. 

- Mastery in Decision Making in complex and strategic product-related matters, balancing user needs, business goals, and technical feasibility with a long-term, holistic perspective, and effectively communicating those decisions with clear strategic rationale and considering broad organizational impact using multi-criteria decision analysis, trade-off frameworks, and rigorous ROI modeling to ensure alignment with long-term platform strategy and organizational business objectives. 

- Deep and strategic Domain Knowledge of the relevant industry and market, with a comprehensive understanding of enterprise SaaS trends, UI/UX Platforms, AI/ML agentic frameworks, large-scale user experience patterns, and the evolving regulatory landscape surrounding generative AI. 

- Proven ability to lead and define Research strategies to inform product vision, identify disruptive opportunities, and gain deep understanding of user behavior at a fundamental level, utilizing generative research, ethnographic studies, and rapid prototyping feedback loops to identify disruptive innovation opportunities and validate platform enhancements. 

- Mastery in Stakeholder Management, effectively communicating with, influencing, and managing expectations of executive leadership teams, product peers across business units, and key strategic partners to ensure alignment on platform vision, investment priorities, and delivery timelines. 

- Exceptional Strategic Thinking skills, shaping the long-term vision and direction of a product portfolio or business unit and identifying disruptive opportunities by identifying white-space opportunities, formulating multi-year platform roadmaps, and architecting new market-entry strategies that drive competitive differentiation.

Primary Location: CAN.BC.Victoria 

Primary CAN Base Pay Range: $195,400 - $293,000 CAD 

Additional CAN Location(s) Base Pay Range: $195,400 - $293,000 CAD 

 Our Approach to Flexible Work 

 With Flex Work, we’re combining the best of both worlds: in-person time and remote. Our approach enables our teams to deepen connections, maintain a strong community, and do their best work. We know that flexibility can take shape in many ways, so rather than a number of required days in-office each week, we simply spend at least half (50%) of our time each quarter in the office or in the field with our customers, prospects, and partners (depending on role). This means you'll have the freedom to create a flexible schedule that caters to your business, team, and personal needs, while being intentional to make the most of time spent together. Those in our remote "home office" roles also have the opportunity to come together in our offices for important moments that matter.

Please see below for more details including how to request an accommodation as a qualified veteran, due to a disability or for religious reasons, or as otherwise provided under applicable law. 

 Workday prohibits taking adverse action against any candidate or employee for reporting a possible violation of this policy, requesting one or more work accommodations, exercising a privacy right, or cooperating in an investigation in accordance with applicable law. Any employee who retaliates against a candidate or employee for doing so may be subject to disciplinary action, up to and including termination of employment, to the fullest extent allowable under applicable law.

We operate as a 0-to-1 team inside Workday: identifying high-conviction bets in complex, regulated domains like finance and HCM, then building production-grade agents that will become revenue lines.  We are looking for Principal Product Managers who have shipped production AI agent systems and want to do it again at enterprise scale. You will own an agent from concept through GA: scoping the bet, prototyping solutions, running early adopter programs, and scaling to Workday's global customer base. This is not a strategy-deck role. You will be hands-on with agent architectures, evaluation frameworks, and customer workflows daily, while also making sharp prioritization calls across a fast-moving portfolio.

- Own an AI agent end-to-end, from identifying the opportunity through GA launch and beyond

- 11+ years of product management experience 

- 5+ years in SaaS/B2B enterprise software 

- Direct experience building and shipping external, revenue generating AI forward product and /or agent systems to production (not just AI/ML features, but agents that reason, plan, and take action autonomously) 

- Deep technical acumen: you can evaluate agent architectures, debug failure modes, and make informed design tradeoffs with engineering 

- Strong communication and relationship-building skills across engineering, customers, and executive stakeholders 

 Other Qualifications: 

- Experience in regulated or complex domains (finance, HCM, healthcare, legal) where trust, compliance, and auditability are non-negotiable 

- Track record of 0-to-1 product development: you've taken something from idea to revenue, not just maintained an existing product 

- Bias for action, comfortable making high-stakes decisions with incomplete information and iterating from there 

- Experience managing Early Adopter or beta programs with enterprise customers 

- Ability to operate across multiple functions, influence senior executives, and drive alignment without authority 

 You'll be a great fit if: 

- You are already building agent systems, whether prototyping on weekends, shipping side projects, or pushing the boundaries at your current company 

- You have strong opinions on agent evaluation, reliability, and human-in-the-loop design, formed from hands-on experience, not just reading papers 

- You learn complex customer domains fast and can identify where agents create step-function value versus where they create risk 

- You are motivated by building new product lines from scratch, not optimizing existing ones 

- You are organized enough to track dozens of moving pieces across customers, engineering, and stakeholders while maintaining velocity
