Your work days are brighter here. 

 We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.

 About the Team 
Join the Evisort AI team at Workday, which powers Document Intelligence AI and Workday’s CLM and Contract Intelligence offerings. powering Workday’s CLM and Contract Intelligence Offerings. Our mission is to change the way business deals get done. 

We build ground breaking AI technology that can read and understand contract language to make every part of the deal-making process from drafting, negotiating, reviewing, approving, or managing the contracts happen faster, better, with reduced risks. We build AI first products, and automate manual work, freeing up our customers time and accelerating their businesses. 

You will be joining the Evisort AI team, which functions as a startup within Workday. This is your opportunity to build at the pace of innovation of a startup, while backed by the enormous support and impacting Workday’s incredible customer base of 70M+ users. 
 About the Role 

 This role isn’t a traditional Product Manager. It is part high-level Product Strategy, part Solutions Architecture, and part "Client Whisperer." Your mission is to bridge the gap between our cutting-edge AI Workday Contracts Management powered by Evisort, and the real-world customer environment, ensuring our global enterprise customers understand, trust, and adopt our product.

 As a Product Manager - Evisort AI , you won’t just be building features; you’ll be defining how AI is positioned, demo’ed, and evaluated. You will act as a thought partner to both our internal teams and our enterprise customers, helping them navigate one of the biggest shifts in legal history: evaluating the ROI of AI and mapping its impact across complex practice areas. This is a high-impact, strategic role meant for someone who thrives in the "calm in the storm" and enjoys bringing structure to the ambiguity of emerging tech. 

 Key Responsibilities: 

- Pre-Sales Activation Strategy: Define the global strategy for activating AI agents. Set the bar for what great looks like in a technical evaluation and ensure Product and Sales are perfectly aligned. 

- Demo & POC Innovation: Shape how AI proofs-of-concept are approached. Partner with Solutions Consulting to ensure demos aren’t just "cool," but are credible, repeatable, and tied to real customer questions. 

- The Voice of the User: Act as the primary feedback loop. Translate field experience and client "pain points" into structured insights that directly inform product development and roadmap priorities. 

- Narrative & Value Definition: Define the technical narrative. Clarify AI differentiation and known limitations to ensure our messaging supports a credible, honest, and high-value customer evaluation. 

- Cross-Functional Partnership: Partner deeply with Solutions Architecture and Enterprise Architecture leadership to evolve our activation approach as our AI maturity grows. 

 What Success Looks Like: 

- Credibility: AI agents are represented with confidence and accuracy across all pre-sales engagements and post-sales implementations. 

- Impact: Evisort/Workday drives meaningful revenue impact through increased attach rates, expansion, net-new wins, and customer retention. 

- Adoption: Customers don't just buy the AI; they successfully adopt and use it post-sale because it was scoped correctly from day one. 

- Influence: You are the "calm, credible presence" that helps lawyers and engineers speak the same language. 

 About You 

 You come from a world of complex problem-solving, and you’ve never been content with the status quo. You are tech-curious and product-savvy—you don’t need to be a coder, but you must be passionate about navigating technical conversations around generative AI and technology implementation. You care deeply about quality but don't get stuck in perfectionism; you get things done and iterate until they are world-class.

 Basic Qualifications 

- 4+ years of experience in product management and/or GTM implementation, defining, launching, and iterating on impactful SaaS and/or cloud-based enterprise software products. 

- Bachelor’s degree in a relevant discipline (Business, Computer Science, Law) or equivalent practical experience. 

- Industry Context: A background in law or legal tech, with experience at a top-tier firm, in-house legal team, or a disruptive legal-tech venture. 

 Other Qualifications 

- Business Influence & Stakeholder Management : Proven ability to exert significant influence across product teams and executive leadership to drive alignment. 

- Cross-Team Collaboration: A master of "translating" across disciplines—effectively leading Engineering, Design, and Marketing to deliver complex strategies. 

- Customer Empathy & Advocacy : Deep experience in identifying "thorny" operational problems and translating them into impactful product solutions. 

- Strategic Thinking : The ability to see the "big picture" of the legal business and how emerging technologies will improve existing processes. 

- Data-Driven Decision Making : Solid skills in using data analysis to derive actionable insights, prioritize roadmaps, and measure the success of AI initiatives. 

- Ambiguity Management : Proactive and self-directed, with the ability to bring structure to complex, fast-moving environments while juggling multiple high-stakes relationships

As a part of the total compensation package, this role may be eligible for the Workday Bonus Plan or a role-specific commission/bonus, as well as annual refresh stock grants. Each candidate’s compensation offer will be based on multiple factors including, but not limited to, geography, experience, skills, job duties, and business need, among other things.  With Flex Work, we’re combining the best of both worlds: in-person time and remote. Our approach enables our teams to deepen connections, maintain a strong community, and do their best work. We know that flexibility can take shape in many ways, so rather than a number of required days in-office each week, we simply spend at least half (50%) of our time each quarter in the office or in the field with our customers, prospects, and partners (depending on role). This means you'll have the freedom to create a flexible schedule that caters to your business, team, and personal needs, while being intentional to make the most of time spent together. Those in our remote "home office" roles also have the opportunity to come together in our offices for important moments that matter.

About Xanadu: 
 Xanadu’s mission is to build quantum computers that are useful and available to people everywhere. 

At Xanadu, we are learners, innovators, researchers, collaborators and problem solvers. We are creating something that has never been built before. What we are doing is extremely hard, the classic moon shot. Few people in their life will be able to be a part of something like this, where if we are successful, the technologies we develop will solve some of the world’s most challenging problems, and literally change the world. And that is something to be excited about!

 Your role and responsibilities:
 As a Sr. Technical Program Manager, your primary mission is to ensure we successfully deliver new versions of our quantum hardware systems on schedule and within budget. You are the high-velocity driver of the project lifecycle, focused on identifying and clearing the path for our engineering teams. This role will specifically be tasked with handling our DARPA QBI program and other contracts with diverse agencies.

- Position Location: US Remote (regular monthly/quarterly travel to Toronto) or Toronto Office

- Schedule & Budget Ownership: Define and maintain the master program schedule, ensuring that all modular subsystem tranches meet critical milestones without cost overruns.

- Communication with DARPA: Be the primary contact with the DARPA team communicating our progress and other important information as the program progresses.

- Bottleneck Removal: Proactively identify technical and operational "blockers" in the development pipeline and orchestrate rapid-response solutions to keep delivery on track.

- Cross-Functional Alignment: Coordinate efforts across all teams to ensure that dependencies are managed and integration happens seamlessly and on time.

- Resource Management: Optimize the allocation of personnel and specialized equipment to ensure that the most critical path items receive the necessary support for timely completion.

- Process Efficiency: Drive process improvements to increase the reliability and repeatability of hardware deployment and validation workflows.

- Risk Mitigation: Perform continuous system risk analysis to anticipate potential delays and design recovery strategies before they impact the bottom line.

 Basic qualifications and experience:

- BSc or MSc in Engineering, Physics, or a related technical field.

- Proficient in MS Project Plan tool usage.

- PMP project management certification.

- 5+ years of experience in technical project or program management, specifically driving the delivery of complex hardware-software systems.

- Demonstrated expertise in project management tools and methodologies (Agile, Gantt, Critical Path Analysis) for hardware environments.

- Proven track record of managing multi-million-dollar budgets and complex technical supply chains.

- Exceptional leadership skills with a focus on accountability, timeline adherence, and resolving team-level friction.

 Preferred qualifications and experience:

- Experience delivering programs for US government entities such as DARPA, ARPA, NIST etc.

- Experience in high-stakes industries such as Semiconductor, Aerospace, Satellite engineering, or Quantum computing where schedule slips have significant mission impact.

- Experience with vendor management and defining tool acceptance criteria to ensure third-party delivery stays on schedule.

- Background in streamlining automated validation workflows to reduce time-to-delivery.

 Your role and responsibilities:
 Xanadu Quantum Technologies is seeking a Technical Product Marketing Manager to lead the messaging, positioning, and go-to-market strategy for PennyLane, our industry-leading open-source software framework for quantum machine learning and quantum computing.

As a Technical Product Marketing Manager at Xanadu, you will stand at the intersection of quantum physics, software engineering, and business strategy. You will serve as the strategic link between technical development and commercial growth, partnering closely with engineering, product management, and business development teams to shape how developers, researchers, and enterprise R&D departments build on PennyLane. In this role, you will translate cutting-edge quantum capabilities into compelling narratives and design targeted campaigns that attract new users and drive business pipeline.

- Define, refine, and capture core positioning and value propositions for PennyLane.

- Architect, execute, and scale multi-channel marketing campaigns designed to attract new developers, students, and industry scientists expanding market share and directly generating qualified pipeline.

- Perform ongoing competitive analysis and SWOT evaluations across the quantum software ecosystem to refine messaging, map market trends, and defend key technical differentiators.

- Build high-value technical assets—whitepapers, blogs, customer stories, and technical presentations—and represent Xanadu as a technical evangelist at industry events and analyst briefings.

- Measure and report on the impact of product marketing initiatives, tracking platform adoption, developer engagement, and campaign contribution to overall revenue pipeline.

 Basic qualifications and experience:

- 5+ years in technical product marketing, product management, or technical developer marketing within open-source software, cloud computing, AI/ML, or deep tech.

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Physics, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

- Demonstrated experience partnering with software engineering teams on product planning, messaging, positioning, and competitive analysis.

- Proven track record of designing marketing campaigns that attract new customers and drive measurable sales or adoption pipeline.

- Demonstrated experience taking technical products to market.

- Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, impactful content and hands-on demonstrations.

- Strong analytical, communication, and cross-functional project management skills.

greenhouse:zafinlabsamericasinc:51896930.description:
Zafin is an AI platform company helping regulated institutions modernize how critical work is designed, governed, and delivered. Our technology enables organizations to move faster while maintaining the governance, accountability, and control required in highly regulated environments.

 Our portfolio includes Zafin AIOS , an agent orchestration platform for governed AI work; the Zafin Banking Platform , which helps banks modernize product, pricing, offers, billing, loyalty, and relationship management; and Zafin IO , an integration platform that connects data, systems, and workflows across complex enterprise environments.

 Headquartered in Toronto, Canada, Zafin partners with leading financial institutions across North America, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and Asia-Pacific. As AI transforms the future of financial services, we're building the platforms that help regulated organizations adopt AI responsibly and at scale.

 What is the Opportunity?

 As a Product Manager, UX for AIOS, you will define and drive product experiences that make complex AI workflows clear, usable, and valuable for customers in regulated financial services.

 You will sit at the intersection of product management, user experience, engineering, AI, and customer delivery. Your focus will be understanding users, shaping the roadmap, defining product requirements, partnering closely with design, and ensuring AIOS experiences support real work: agent orchestration, workflow setup, monitoring, review, exception handling, and human-in-the-loop control.

 This role matters because governed AI only creates value when users can understand it, trust it, and operate it confidently. You will help AIOS move from technical capability to product experiences that customers can adopt at scale.

 What Will You Do?

- Define product strategy, roadmap priorities, and UX-focused product requirements for AIOS experiences and workflows.

- Deeply understand user needs through discovery, stakeholder interviews, customer feedback, workflow analysis, and collaboration with delivery teams.

- Partner closely with product designers to shape user journeys, wireframes, prototypes, interaction patterns, and design decisions for AIOS features.

- Translate customer problems, business goals, and technical constraints into clear product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and success measures.

- Work with engineering, AI, architecture, QA, and DevOps teams to make trade-offs, clarify implementation details, and deliver high-quality product capabilities.

- Define and track product success metrics such as adoption, task completion, workflow efficiency, user satisfaction, feature usage, quality, and support feedback.

- Prioritize the roadmap based on customer value, technical feasibility, delivery commitments, risk, and strategic fit with AIOS.

- Support demos, customer conversations, internal enablement, and go-to-market readiness for new AIOS product experiences.

- Champion usability, accessibility, clarity, and trust in AI-powered workflows, especially where users need transparency, control, and confidence.

- Continuously improve product discovery and delivery practices so the team can move quickly while staying anchored in customer outcomes.

 What Do You Need to Succeed?

 Must haves

- 3+ years of product management, technical product management, UX product management, product design leadership, or closely related experience in software products.

- 2+ years of experience working on enterprise SaaS, workflow, platform, data, AI, automation, or developer/productivity tools.

- Strong understanding of product discovery, roadmap planning, user research methods, requirement definition, prioritization, and product delivery.

- Demonstrated ability to partner with designers on UX strategy, user journeys, wireframes, prototypes, and usability feedback.

- Ability to translate ambiguous customer problems into clear product requirements, success metrics, and delivery-ready stories.

- Comfort working with technical teams and discussing APIs, data flows, AI behavior, system constraints, and implementation trade-offs.

- Strong analytical skills, including the ability to use qualitative feedback and quantitative data to make product decisions.

- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to align engineering, design, delivery, leadership, and customer stakeholders.

- Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Design, Human-Computer Interaction, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

 Nice to have

- Experience with AI-powered products, LLM-based workflows, agent orchestration, human-in-the-loop systems, or responsible AI controls.

- Experience in banking, financial services, regulatory technology, enterprise operations, or other high-trust domains.

- Experience with Figma or similar product design and prototyping tools.

- Experience working with design systems, accessibility standards, and complex enterprise UX patterns.

- Experience supporting customer workshops, product demos, or executive-level product conversations.

- Experience taking a product from early concept through launch and post-launch iteration.

- Comfort working in a fast-moving environment where product direction evolves based on customer learning and technical discovery.

 Additional Job Details  

 At Zafin, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive rewards program is designed to support your health, financial well-being, and work-life balance, including:

- Fully company-paid health benefits

- Annual bonus opportunities

- Generous vacation and holidays

- RRSP matching

- Employer-paid insurance coverage

- Wellness resources

- Extensive paramedical benefits, and more

 Vacancy Status: Open Position to be filled

 Expected Salary range : Depends on candidate's experience and competence)

 Mode of Work : Hybrid

 Use of AI : Zafin may use Artificial Intelligence (AI) and/or other forms of automated technology to screen and/or assess applicants for this position. Zafin will not utilize AI for conducting interviews and/or making hiring decisions. 

 What’s in it for you 

 Joining our team means being part of a culture that values diversity, teamwork, and high-quality work. We offer competitive salaries, annual bonus potential, generous paid time off, paid volunteering days, wellness benefits, and robust opportunities for professional growth and career advancement.  Headquartered in Toronto, Canada, Zafin partners with leading financial institutions across North America, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and Asia-Pacific. As AI transforms the future of financial services, we're building the platforms that help regulated organizations adopt AI responsibly and at scale.

 What’s the Opportunity?  

 As a Technical Product Manager at Zafin, you will drive the strategy, roadmap, and execution of technology products and platform capabilities that power our solutions. Working closely with engineering, architecture, design, and business stakeholders, you will translate customer and business needs into clear product direction and deliver high-impact capabilities that create measurable value on Zafin's AI Operating System (AIOS).

 You are equally comfortable discussing customer problems, defining product requirements, prioritizing backlogs, and partnering with engineering teams to deliver scalable, high-quality software.

 What Will You Do?  

- Define and communicate product vision, strategy, and roadmap for assigned products or platform capabilities.

- Partner with engineering, architecture, design, and business stakeholders to translate business needs into clear product requirements and priorities.

- Own and manage the product backlog, balancing customer value, technical priorities, and business objectives.

- Write user stories, define acceptance criteria, and support delivery throughout the software development lifecycle.

- Collaborate with engineering teams to ensure successful delivery of high-quality, scalable solutions.

- Engage with customers and internal stakeholders to gather feedback, validate assumptions, and identify opportunities for continuous improvement.

- Analyze product performance, usage, and market trends to inform product decisions.

- Support release planning, feature launches, adoption activities, and ongoing product evolution.

- Foster collaboration across cross-functional teams while driving alignment around priorities and outcomes.

 What Do You Need to Succeed?  

 Must Haves  

- Experience managing technology products in an Agile software development environment.

- Strong understanding of software development processes and the ability to work effectively with engineering teams.

- Experience defining product requirements, managing backlogs, and prioritizing competing initiatives.

- Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.

- Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

- Ability to balance customer needs, technical considerations, and business objectives.

- Experience working with Agile tools such as Jira or similar platforms.

 Nice to Have  

- Experience with enterprise SaaS products.

- Experience with AI, automation, workflow, or platform technologies.

- Experience in banking, financial services, or other regulated industries.

 Additional Job Details  

- Compensatio n is aligned to the role level and reflects a candidate’s experience, skills, and overall qualifications . 

- At Zafin, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive rewards program is designed to support your health, financial well-being, and work-life balance, including:

- Annual bonus opportunities

 What’s in it for you

We offer competitive salaries, annual bonus potential, generous paid time off, paid volunteering days, wellness benefits, and robust opportunities for professional growth and career advancement. We’re looking for a Senior Solutions Consultant to lead onboarding for new customers and drive their implementation of our product. We’re also looking for someone who is excited to be hands-on and influence our product roadmap.

As every business needs our type of product, you’ll work with a variety of new clients and industries as Zip scales. Current clients include Coinbase, Snowflake, Notion, Canva, Samsara, Databricks.

 - Extreme attention to detail and pride yourself in being incredibly proactive

 - Drive the product strategy and roadmap to reduce payment risk -- including Zip's AI-powered fraud detection system that flags risky invoices directly to customers

 - Lead payments onboarding automation – building customer-facing workflows that reduce manual operational overhead and accelerate go-live.

 - Define product strategy for payment method management to help buyers and vendors transact seamlessly, including multi-provider support and payout group management.

 - Lead payments platform modernization -- expanding payment rails and payout capabilities, improving payment cycle times, and ensuring enterprise-grade reliability at scale.

 - Drive currency localization across Zip – enabling customers to support multi-currency workflows across all payment surfaces.

 - Collaborate deeply with engineering and design to define requirements, provide product direction, make tradeoffs, and deliver high-quality, enterprise-grade payment capabilities.




QUALIFICATIONS

 - 6+ years of product management and 10+ years of overall professional experience; experience working on payments infrastructure, fintech, bank integrations, risk/fraud, or financial compliance is a requirement.

 - Ability to break down complex payment and risk problems into structured components and deliver clear product recommendations.

 - Technical fluency with the ability to partner effectively with engineering on integration architectures, API design, payment processing systems, and data-driven risk systems.

 - Ability to lead cross-functional initiatives, influence without authority, and drive alignment across engineering, design, operations, and customer-facing teams.

 - Strong analytical skills and comfort using data to drive product decisions, measure fraud metrics, and evaluate risk model performance.

 - Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to tailor messaging to diverse technical and non-technical audiences.
